# P5D 项目主文档（唯一活跃文档）

> **本文档是本项目唯一的活跃文档**。自 2026-10-03 起，所有新结论写入本文档；
> 旧的 373 份文档（`ARCH_*.md`、`HANDOFF.md`、`docs\progress.md` 等）
> **已移入 `docs\_archive\` 保留**（不删除 —— 它们是不可再生的证据链）。
>
> **合并策略**（用户 2026-10-03 决定）：**知识融合** ——
> 把已有文档里的**结论**去重汇总，每条标注证据来源；原文作为归档留证。
>
> **硬性规则**：
> 1. 每条结论**必须**标注证据来源（eboot 地址+反汇编 / 资源文件字节 / 探针日志 / GitHub 权威实现 / 截图）
> 2. **推测必须显式标注 `【推测】`**，并写出验证方法
> 3. **未确证的不得写成结论** ⇒ 一律进「未决清单」
> 4. **离线优先**：资源字节 / 反汇编 / 权威实现是第一证据源；运行时探针仅作验证（且必须标注其局限）

| M101 | **静态重编译阶段 3h：push/pop/ldm/stm 寄存器顺序 bug 修复（按 guest 索引排序）**。根因：push/pop 的寄存器列表按 **capstone 编号** 排序（R4=70 > PC=11 等）→ **pc 与 r4 等被交换** → 返回地址进错寄存器 → 执行跳到垃圾（观测 r4=FF000002、next pc=FF000002）；修复：新增 `RIDX()` 映射 + push/ldm/stm 按 guest 索引排序（pop 升序、push 降序），`_gen_split.py` 的 pop-pc terminator 同步修复；重建 26/26 通过。**实测**：执行路径改变（51 块、HLE #0-#9、进入 0x81198A30/0x81198E2E/0x811E6A40 等更真实路径），新停止点 `pc=0x81198E6A`（last block 0x81198E46）——**0x81198E6A 在 FUN_81198e2e（size 468）内但未被生成块**（块切分/覆盖缺口，待查）；说明修复后执行已进入游戏真实逻辑（此前 132 块是错误状态下的巧合长链） | §18.3642 | push/pop 顺序修复；51 块真实路径；HLE #0-9；停于函数内未生成块 0x81198E6A || M101 | **静态重编译阶段 3h：push/pop/ldm/stm 寄存器顺序 bug 修复（按 guest 索引排序）**。根因：push/pop 的寄存器列表按 **capstone 编号** 排序（R4=70 > PC=11 等）→ **pc 与 r4 等被交换** → 返回地址进错寄存器 → 执行跳到垃圾（观测 r4=FF000002、next pc=FF000002）；修复：新增 `RIDX()` 映射 + push/ldm/stm 按 guest 索引排序（pop 升序、push 降序），`_gen_split.py` 的 pop-pc terminator 同步修复；重建 26/26 通过。**实测**：执行路径改变（51 块、HLE #0-#9、进入 0x81198A30/0x81198E2E/0x811E6A40 等更真实路径），新停止点 `pc=0x81198E6A`（last block 0x81198E46）——**0x81198E6A 在 FUN_81198e2e（size 468）内但未被生成块**（块切分/覆盖缺口，待查）；说明修复后执行已进入游戏真实逻辑（此前 132 块是错误状态下的巧合长链） | §18.3642 | push/pop 顺序修复；51 块真实路径；HLE #0-9；停于函数内未生成块 0x81198E6A |
| M102 | **静态重编译阶段 3i：cbz/cbnz 块切分覆盖缺口修复 → 执行深度 51→160 块（HLE #0-#36）；新 BADMEM 0x806CDA38 = image 基址之下的合法 guest 地址**。根因：块切分 leaders 规则只匹配 `m.startswith(b)`，**漏掉 cbz/cbnz**（以 c 开头）→ cbz 的跳转目标/fallthrough 未成为块起点 → 生成的 terminator 可能跳到无块地址（观测 no block for pc=0x81198E6A，位于 FUN_81198e2e 内）；修复：leaders 加 cbz/cbnz 分支目标与 fallthrough 规则；重建后块数增加（610,957 行 vs 601,768）、**执行深度 51→160 块、HLE 调用 #0-#36**；新 BADMEM `va=0x806CDA38 block=0x81207344`（off=0xFF6CDA38 负数）→ **低于 image 基址 0x81000000 的合法 guest 地址**（游戏数据/共享库区），需要把 image 映射基址扩展到 0x80600000（重建） | §18.3643 | cbz leaders 修复；160 块/HLE #36；BADMEM 0x806CDA38 低于基址 → 扩映射 || M102 | **静态重编译阶段 3i：cbz/cbnz 块切分覆盖缺口修复 → 执行深度 51→160 块（HLE #0-#36）；新 BADMEM 0x806CDA38 = image 基址之下的合法 guest 地址**。根因：块切分 leaders 规则只匹配 `m.startswith(b)`，**漏掉 cbz/cbnz**（以 c 开头）→ cbz 的跳转目标/fallthrough 未成为块起点 → 生成的 terminator 可能跳到无块地址（观测 no block for pc=0x81198E6A，位于 FUN_81198e2e 内）；修复：leaders 加 cbz/cbnz 分支目标与 fallthrough 规则；重建后块数增加（610,957 行 vs 601,768）、**执行深度 51→160 块、HLE 调用 #0-#36**；新 BADMEM `va=0x806CDA38 block=0x81207344`（off=0xFF6CDA38 负数）→ **低于 image 基址 0x81000000 的合法 guest 地址**（游戏数据/共享库区），需要把 image 映射基址扩展到 0x80600000（重建） | §18.3643 | cbz leaders 修复；160 块/HLE #36；BADMEM 0x806CDA38 低于基址 → 扩映射 |
| M103 | **静态重编译阶段 3j：image 映射扩到 0x80600000（42MB）→ HLE 调用推进到 #61；新 BADMEM 0x64 = r9 被清零**。修改 P()/harness：guest image 基址 0x81000000→**0x80600000**、大小 32MB→**42MB**（0x2A00000）→ 0x806CDA38 访问解决；重建 26/26 通过。**实测**：执行推进（HLE 调用 **#0-#61**，含 0x812B2830/0x812B28A0/0x812B2270/0x812B19B0 等）；新 BADMEM `va=0x00000064 block=0x81198F08`：指令 `81198F0A ldr.w r4,[sb,#0x64]`（sb=r9）→ **r9=0** → [0+0x64]；生成代码映射正确（`s->r[4] = rd32(s, s->r[9]+0x64)`），根因是 **r9 在某处被清 0**（需追踪 r9 变化：检查 callee-saved push/pop/ldm 保存序列或某指令语义）| §18.3644 | image 0x80600000/42MB；HLE #0-61；BADMEM 0x64 = r9=0 @0x81198F0A || M103 | **静态重编译阶段 3j：image 映射扩到 0x80600000（42MB）→ HLE 调用推进到 #61；新 BADMEM 0x64 = r9 被清零**。修改 P()/harness：guest image 基址 0x81000000→**0x80600000**、大小 32MB→**42MB**（0x2A00000）→ 0x806CDA38 访问解决；重建 26/26 通过。**实测**：执行推进（HLE 调用 **#0-#61**，含 0x812B2830/0x812B28A0/0x812B2270/0x812B19B0 等）；新 BADMEM `va=0x00000064 block=0x81198F08`：指令 `81198F0A ldr.w r4,[sb,#0x64]`（sb=r9）→ **r9=0** → [0+0x64]；生成代码映射正确（`s->r[4] = rd32(s, s->r[9]+0x64)`），根因是 **r9 在某处被清 0**（需追踪 r9 变化：检查 callee-saved push/pop/ldm 保存序列或某指令语义）| §18.3644 | image 0x80600000/42MB；HLE #0-61；BADMEM 0x64 = r9=0 @0x81198F0A |
| M104 | **静态重编译阶段 3k：r9 watchdog 精确定位——块 0x811D9DFE 执行后 r9 0x10→0（因 r1=0，(r1+7)>>3=0）**。harness 加 **r9 watchdog**（r9 由非零变零时打印该块+前后寄存器）→ 定位 **块 0x811D9DFE**（指令 `add.w sb,r1,#7; lsr.w sb,sb,#3` → r9=(r1+7)>>3；进块时 r1=0 → r9=0，块内 `movs r1,#0` 使 r1=0 显示为 after）；**块环**显示路径 0x811D9DDA←0x811D9F3C←0x811D9DD2←0x811D9DCC←0x811DA53A←0x811E6A0E←0x812B22A0(HLE)←0x811E6A08←0x811DA534←...（返回链）；下一个块 0x811D9DFE 的 bl 目标 0x81207308；WATCH 时 r1=0 r2=0x812B4150 r3=0x816CDA38 r0=0x81FF001C。**结论**：r9=0 是块内真实计算（r1=0），根因是进入该函数时 **r1 参数为 0**（调用者/前序 HLE 双返回值未正确设置，EABI 64 位返回值在 r0:r1）→ 下一步=与探针/解释器对同一函数的参数做差分验证（或实现 HLE 双返回值 r0:r1） | §18.3645 | r9 watchdog 定位 0x811D9DFE；r1=0 → r9=((0+7)>>3)=0；块环 40 块；下一步差分验证 HLE 返回值 || M104 | **静态重编译阶段 3k：r9 watchdog 精确定位——块 0x811D9DFE 执行后 r9 0x10→0（因 r1=0，(r1+7)>>3=0）**。harness 加 **r9 watchdog**（r9 由非零变零时打印该块+前后寄存器）→ 定位 **块 0x811D9DFE**（指令 `add.w sb,r1,#7; lsr.w sb,sb,#3` → r9=(r1+7)>>3；进块时 r1=0 → r9=0，块内 `movs r1,#0` 使 r1=0 显示为 after）；**块环**显示路径 0x811D9DDA←0x811D9F3C←0x811D9DD2←0x811D9DCC←0x811DA53A←0x811E6A0E←0x812B22A0(HLE)←0x811E6A08←0x811DA534←...（返回链）；下一个块 0x811D9DFE 的 bl 目标 0x81207308；WATCH 时 r1=0 r2=0x812B4150 r3=0x816CDA38 r0=0x81FF001C。**结论**：r9=0 是块内真实计算（r1=0），根因是进入该函数时 **r1 参数为 0**（调用者/前序 HLE 双返回值未正确设置，EABI 64 位返回值在 r0:r1）→ 下一步=与探针/解释器对同一函数的参数做差分验证（或实现 HLE 双返回值 r0:r1） | §18.3645 | r9 watchdog 定位 0x811D9DFE；r1=0 → r9=((0+7)>>3)=0；块环 40 块；下一步差分验证 HLE 返回值 |
| M105 | **静态重编译阶段 3l：探针断点 dump 工具（P5D_BREAKPC）与差分验证尝试**。给探针加 `P5D_BREAKPC=<hex>`：以 run(1) 单步运行直到 guest PC（get_reg(15)）命中目标，然后 dump r0-r15/apsr/sp/lr（编译通过，用于与 recomp 同一函数的寄存器对照）；**实测**：目标 0x811D9DFE，180 秒只走到 5,000,000 步（单步模式极慢）且 PC=0x811DFAF6 **未命中** → 探针执行路径与 recomp 不同（或目标在其不同分支路径上）⇒ **单步差分验证成本过高，需换方法**；工具本身保留（小范围 PC 断点可用）。下一步：优先扩展占位 HLE（r0:r1 双返回值/按 NID 返回值）用 watchdog 快速迭代，差分验证改为探针在 HLE 调用点 dump 参数的轻量方案 | §18.3646 | P5D_BREAKPC 工具；5M 步未命中 0x811D9DFE；差分需换法 || M105 | **静态重编译阶段 3l：探针断点 dump 工具（P5D_BREAKPC）与差分验证尝试**。给探针加 `P5D_BREAKPC=<hex>`：以 run(1) 单步运行直到 guest PC（get_reg(15)）命中目标，然后 dump r0-r15/apsr/sp/lr（编译通过，用于与 recomp 同一函数的寄存器对照）；**实测**：目标 0x811D9DFE，180 秒只走到 5,000,000 步（单步模式极慢）且 PC=0x811DFAF6 **未命中** → 探针执行路径与 recomp 不同（或目标在其不同分支路径上）⇒ **单步差分验证成本过高，需换方法**；工具本身保留（小范围 PC 断点可用）。下一步：优先扩展占位 HLE（r0:r1 双返回值/按 NID 返回值）用 watchdog 快速迭代，差分验证改为探针在 HLE 调用点 dump 参数的轻量方案 | §18.3646 | P5D_BREAKPC 工具；5M 步未命中 0x811D9DFE；差分需换法 |
| M106 | **静态重编译阶段 3m：HLE 返回策略对比实验（同一批翻译代码，运行时切换 P5D_HLE_RET 0..4）**。模式：0=scratch 指针 0x81FF0000、1=0、2=UID 小整数（0x100+n）、3=scratch+r1=1、4=scratch+r1=0x81FF1000。**实测**：模式 0/3/4 执行最深（**186 块**、r9 watchdog 停在 0x811D9DFE）；模式 1/2 更早崩溃（`[BADMEM] va=0x00001408 block=0x8120732C`，在 0x81198ED4→0x81207308 之后）→ **scratch 指针策略最优**。**当前瓶颈**：r9 watchdog 点 0x811D9DFE（进块时 r1=0 → r9=(r1+7)>>3=0）；根因分析：HLE 返回的 scratch 区域**全零**，游戏读取返回的结构字段（进程参数/内存信息等）得到 0 → 参数 r1=0 ⇒ **需要按 NID 真实语义填充返回值结构**（下一步优先：启动早期 HLE 调用——进程参数、内存分配、文件系统的真实返回值/结构字段） | §18.3647 | 5 模式对比；mode0 186 块最深；mode1/2 早期 BADMEM 0x1408；瓶颈 r9@0x811D9DFE（r1=0） || M106 | **静态重编译阶段 3m：HLE 返回策略对比实验（同一批翻译代码，运行时切换 P5D_HLE_RET 0..4）**。模式：0=scratch 指针 0x81FF0000、1=0、2=UID 小整数（0x100+n）、3=scratch+r1=1、4=scratch+r1=0x81FF1000。**实测**：模式 0/3/4 执行最深（**186 块**、r9 watchdog 停在 0x811D9DFE）；模式 1/2 更早崩溃（`[BADMEM] va=0x00001408 block=0x8120732C`，在 0x81198ED4→0x81207308 之后）→ **scratch 指针策略最优**。**当前瓶颈**：r9 watchdog 点 0x811D9DFE（进块时 r1=0 → r9=(r1+7)>>3=0）；根因分析：HLE 返回的 scratch 区域**全零**，游戏读取返回的结构字段（进程参数/内存信息等）得到 0 → 参数 r1=0 ⇒ **需要按 NID 真实语义填充返回值结构**（下一步优先：启动早期 HLE 调用——进程参数、内存分配、文件系统的真实返回值/结构字段） | §18.3647 | 5 模式对比；mode0 186 块最深；mode1/2 早期 BADMEM 0x1408；瓶颈 r9@0x811D9DFE（r1=0） |
| M107 | **静态重编译阶段 3n：真实 libc HLE 实现（malloc/memcpy/memset/strlen/strcpy/free + 系统调用桩）**。按 vitasdk yml 反查启动早期 stub NID：0x812B2370=_sce_set_dso_handle_main、0x812B22A0=**malloc**、0x812B2270=**memcpy**、0x812B2260=**memset**、0x812B22E0=**strlen**、0x812B22D0=**strcpy**、0x812B2250=**free**、0x812B2360=__at_quick_exit、0x812B2910=sceKernelCreateLwMutex、0x812B2830/0x812B28A0=sceKernelLock/UnlockLwMutex、0x812B19B0/0x812B19C0=sceFiosInitialize/FHClose、0x812B1910=sceAppUtilInit、0x812B2210=abort；harness 实现**真实 libc 语义**（bump allocator 从 0x82800000 起、memcpy/memset/strlen/strcpy 真实内存操作、锁/系统桩返回 0）→ **生效**：HLE 调用 #0-#39、malloc 指针递增（0x828003C0→0x82800450→0x8281047C）、memcpy/memset 参数合理（a0=0x2C/0x20 等）；但执行仍停 **186 块 / r9 watchdog @0x811D9DFE** → **r9 清零根因不在 libc**，下一步=r1（及 r4-r11）追踪定位参数被清块 | §18.3648 | 真实 libc HLE；#0-#39；malloc 递增；仍 186 块/0x811D9DFE || M107 | **静态重编译阶段 3n：真实 libc HLE 实现（malloc/memcpy/memset/strlen/strcpy/free + 系统调用桩）**。按 vitasdk yml 反查启动早期 stub NID：0x812B2370=_sce_set_dso_handle_main、0x812B22A0=**malloc**、0x812B2270=**memcpy**、0x812B2260=**memset**、0x812B22E0=**strlen**、0x812B22D0=**strcpy**、0x812B2250=**free**、0x812B2360=__at_quick_exit、0x812B2910=sceKernelCreateLwMutex、0x812B2830/0x812B28A0=sceKernelLock/UnlockLwMutex、0x812B19B0/0x812B19C0=sceFiosInitialize/FHClose、0x812B1910=sceAppUtilInit、0x812B2210=abort；harness 实现**真实 libc 语义**（bump allocator 从 0x82800000 起、memcpy/memset/strlen/strcpy 真实内存操作、锁/系统桩返回 0）→ **生效**：HLE 调用 #0-#39、malloc 指针递增（0x828003C0→0x82800450→0x8281047C）、memcpy/memset 参数合理（a0=0x2C/0x20 等）；但执行仍停 **186 块 / r9 watchdog @0x811D9DFE** → **r9 清零根因不在 libc**，下一步=r1（及 r4-r11）追踪定位参数被清块 | §18.3648 | 真实 libc HLE；#0-#39；malloc 递增；仍 186 块/0x811D9DFE |
| M108 | **静态重编译阶段 3o：通用寄存器 watchdog + r1 来源追踪**。harness watchdog 扩展为 r1-r12「非零→零」检测：首次捕获 **块 0x81159CE4（n=16）r1 0x813B1B24→0，next=0x812B2260(memset)**——但这是 **memset(dst,0,n) 的合法填充值参数**（误报）；再反汇编 0x811D9DDA 函数体：**r1 来自 `ldr r1,[sp]`（栈上局部变量）**，r9=(r1+7)>>3 → r1=0 是**游戏局部数据缺失**（很可能是异步/文件 IO 结果为空），不是指令翻译错误；根因指向**fs/io HLE 未实现**（游戏读取数据失败 → 长度为 0）→ 下一步=实现 sceIo/mceFios2 真实读写（探针已有实现可参考）或追踪 [sp] 局部变量写入点 | §18.3649 | watchdog r1-r12；0x81159CE4 误报（memset 参数）；r1 来自栈 [sp]（IO 结果） || M108 | **静态重编译阶段 3o：通用寄存器 watchdog + r1 来源追踪**。harness watchdog 扩展为 r1-r12「非零→零」检测：首次捕获 **块 0x81159CE4（n=16）r1 0x813B1B24→0，next=0x812B2260(memset)**——但这是 **memset(dst,0,n) 的合法填充值参数**（误报）；再反汇编 0x811D9DDA 函数体：**r1 来自 `ldr r1,[sp]`（栈上局部变量）**，r9=(r1+7)>>3 → r1=0 是**游戏局部数据缺失**（很可能是异步/文件 IO 结果为空），不是指令翻译错误；根因指向**fs/io HLE 未实现**（游戏读取数据失败 → 长度为 0）→ 下一步=实现 sceIo/mceFios2 真实读写（探针已有实现可参考）或追踪 [sp] 局部变量写入点 | §18.3649 | watchdog r1-r12；0x81159CE4 误报（memset 参数）；r1 来自栈 [sp]（IO 结果） |
| M109 | **静态重编译阶段 3p：watchdog 日志模式（不中断）→ 执行到 305 块；r9=0 确认为 [sp] 局部变量为 0**。watchdog 改为**只记录不中断**（前 60 条事件）→ 执行深度 **305 块**（此前 186）；事件序列：r8 清零@0x811D9DA2（n=272）→ **r9 清零@0x811D9DFE（n=284，r9=0x20→0，因 r1=0）** → r7 清零@0x811D9E7C（n=305）→ 最终 BADMEM `va=0x64 block=0x81198F08`；**栈 dump（sp=0x82EFFE20）**：`[sp]=0x00000000`、`[sp+4]=0x816CDA38`、`[sp+8]=0x18`、`[sp+0xc]=0x812B4150`、`[sp+0x10]=0x828174FC` → 函数参数在 [sp+4..]，**[sp] 局部变量为 0**（应是某长度/指针但为 0）；根因：**该函数（0x811D9DDA 起连续代码所在函数）的栈帧局部变量未写入**（正常路径应写入）→ 下一步=确定函数边界/入口，追踪 [sp] 写入指令与调用者参数 | §18.3650 | watchdog 日志模式；305 块；[sp]=0（局部变量缺失）；BADMEM block 0x81198F08 || M109 | **静态重编译阶段 3p：watchdog 日志模式（不中断）→ 执行到 305 块；r9=0 确认为 [sp] 局部变量为 0**。watchdog 改为**只记录不中断**（前 60 条事件）→ 执行深度 **305 块**（此前 186）；事件序列：r8 清零@0x811D9DA2（n=272）→ **r9 清零@0x811D9DFE（n=284，r9=0x20→0，因 r1=0）** → r7 清零@0x811D9E7C（n=305）→ 最终 BADMEM `va=0x64 block=0x81198F08`；**栈 dump（sp=0x82EFFE20）**：`[sp]=0x00000000`、`[sp+4]=0x816CDA38`、`[sp+8]=0x18`、`[sp+0xc]=0x812B4150`、`[sp+0x10]=0x828174FC` → 函数参数在 [sp+4..]，**[sp] 局部变量为 0**（应是某长度/指针但为 0）；根因：**该函数（0x811D9DDA 起连续代码所在函数）的栈帧局部变量未写入**（正常路径应写入）→ 下一步=确定函数边界/入口，追踪 [sp] 写入指令与调用者参数 | §18.3650 | watchdog 日志模式；305 块；[sp]=0（局部变量缺失）；BADMEM block 0x81198F08 |
| M110 | **静态重编译阶段 3q：r1=0 根因链完整定位——全局 0x816CDA44 未初始化**。静态扫描 `bl 0x811d9da2` 站点：**0x811DA59E/5BE/5D0/5E2**（均在 FUN_811da584 内）；调用 1：`movs.w r0,#0x200; movs r1,#0x80; ...` ✓；**调用 2（0x811DA5BE）：`movs r0,#0xf0; movs r2,#0x10; movs r3,#1; bl`——调用前没有设置 r1，r1 沿用 0x811DA5AA 的 `ldr r1,[r6,#8]`（r6=0x816CDA3C → 全局 0x816CDA44）**；该全局在我们的执行路径中为 **0**（未被初始化写入）→ 传参 r1=0 → FUN_811d9da2 内 `str r1,[sp]` → 后续 [sp] 局部=0 → r9=(0+7)>>3=0 → [r9+0x64] BADMEM。**结论**：根因是**全局变量 0x816CDA44 未初始化**（预期由更早的初始化函数写入，我们的路径未覆盖/漏翻译）→ 下一步=静态扫描写入 0x816CDA44 的指令 + harness 预填该全局快速验证执行深度 | §18.3651 | bl 站点 0x811DA59E/5BE/5D0/5E2；调用2 r1=[0x816CDA44]=0；根因全局未初始化 || M110 | **静态重编译阶段 3q：r1=0 根因链完整定位——全局 0x816CDA44 未初始化**。静态扫描 `bl 0x811d9da2` 站点：**0x811DA59E/5BE/5D0/5E2**（均在 FUN_811da584 内）；调用 1：`movs.w r0,#0x200; movs r1,#0x80; ...` ✓；**调用 2（0x811DA5BE）：`movs r0,#0xf0; movs r2,#0x10; movs r3,#1; bl`——调用前没有设置 r1，r1 沿用 0x811DA5AA 的 `ldr r1,[r6,#8]`（r6=0x816CDA3C → 全局 0x816CDA44）**；该全局在我们的执行路径中为 **0**（未被初始化写入）→ 传参 r1=0 → FUN_811d9da2 内 `str r1,[sp]` → 后续 [sp] 局部=0 → r9=(0+7)>>3=0 → [r9+0x64] BADMEM。**结论**：根因是**全局变量 0x816CDA44 未初始化**（预期由更早的初始化函数写入，我们的路径未覆盖/漏翻译）→ 下一步=静态扫描写入 0x816CDA44 的指令 + harness 预填该全局快速验证执行深度 | §18.3651 | bl 站点 0x811DA59E/5BE/5D0/5E2；调用2 r1=[0x816CDA44]=0；根因全局未初始化 |
| M111 | **静态重编译阶段 3r：用探针真实运行 dump 出全局区真实值（0x816CDA44=0x80 等）→ 修正预填假设**。①预填实验：把 0x816CDA44 设 0x82800000（错误值）→ 执行推进（HLE #42）但随后 malloc 巨大 size（a0=0xE5D00017）崩溃 → 证明**该全局确实是 r1 来源**但值错误；②**探针自然跑完 CAP=1e8 后 `P5D_DUMPRANGE=0x816CDA00-0x816CDB00` 成功 dump 256 字节** → 真实值：`0x816CDA3C=0xA000B000`、`0x816CDA40=0xA001E000`、**`0x816CDA44=0x00000080`**、`0x816CDA48=0xA0028000`、`0x816CDA4C=0x00000100`、`0x816CDA50=0xA0032000`、`0x816CDA54=0x00000100` ⇒ **0x816CDA44 是尺寸/数量（0x80），0xA000xxxx 是 Vita 主堆区指针**（我们的 image 未映射 0xA0000000 区）；③下一步=按**真实值**预填（指针映射到 image 内地址），并扩展 image 映射覆盖 0xA0000000 堆区（P() 多区域）→ 重建验证 | §18.3652 | dump 256B；0x816CDA44=0x80；堆指针 0xA000B000/0xA001E000/0xA0028000/0xA0032000 || M111 | **静态重编译阶段 3r：用探针真实运行 dump 出全局区真实值（0x816CDA44=0x80 等）→ 修正预填假设**。①预填实验：把 0x816CDA44 设 0x82800000（错误值）→ 执行推进（HLE #42）但随后 malloc 巨大 size（a0=0xE5D00017）崩溃 → 证明**该全局确实是 r1 来源**但值错误；②**探针自然跑完 CAP=1e8 后 `P5D_DUMPRANGE=0x816CDA00-0x816CDB00` 成功 dump 256 字节** → 真实值：`0x816CDA3C=0xA000B000`、`0x816CDA40=0xA001E000`、**`0x816CDA44=0x00000080`**、`0x816CDA48=0xA0028000`、`0x816CDA4C=0x00000100`、`0x816CDA50=0xA0032000`、`0x816CDA54=0x00000100` ⇒ **0x816CDA44 是尺寸/数量（0x80），0xA000xxxx 是 Vita 主堆区指针**（我们的 image 未映射 0xA0000000 区）；③下一步=按**真实值**预填（指针映射到 image 内地址），并扩展 image 映射覆盖 0xA0000000 堆区（P() 多区域）→ 重建验证 | §18.3652 | dump 256B；0x816CDA44=0x80；堆指针 0xA000B000/0xA001E000/0xA0028000/0xA0032000 |
| M112 | **静态重编译阶段 3s：多区域 guest 映射（0x80600000 区 + 0xA0000000 堆区）+ 真实值预填实测**。①`P()` 改为**双区域映射**（区域 A 0x80600000..0x83000000 偏移 0；区域 B 0xA0000000..0xA1000000 偏移 +0x3000000；image 64MB）；②harness 按探针 dump 真实值预填 0x816CDA3C 区：**0xA000B000/0xA001E000/0x816CDA44=0x80/0xA0028000/0x816CDA4C=0x100/0xA0032000/0x816CDA54=0x100**；③重建 26/26 通过；④**实测**：HLE 调用推进到 **#0-#61**（此前 #42）；新 BADMEM `va=0x00000084 block=0x81198F08`——**r9=0x20**（来自预填 0x816CDA4C=0x100 → r9=(0x100+7)>>3=0x20），但 **r9 应为主堆指针而非尺寸** → **推断：0x816CDA3C 区是堆管理器结构**（指针+尺寸字段），探针 dump 的是**运行后（CAP=1e8 时）状态**，与 recomp 启动初期状态不一致 → 硬编码不可行，**必须实现系统内存管理 HLE（sceKernelAllocMemBlock/堆管理）让游戏自己的初始化函数设置这些全局** | §18.3653 | 双区域映射；HLE #61；BADMEM 0x84（r9=0x20 尺寸非指针）；堆结构需 HLE || M112 | **静态重编译阶段 3s：多区域 guest 映射（0x80600000 区 + 0xA0000000 堆区）+ 真实值预填实测**。①`P()` 改为**双区域映射**（区域 A 0x80600000..0x83000000 偏移 0；区域 B 0xA0000000..0xA1000000 偏移 +0x3000000；image 64MB）；②harness 按探针 dump 真实值预填 0x816CDA3C 区：**0xA000B000/0xA001E000/0x816CDA44=0x80/0xA0028000/0x816CDA4C=0x100/0xA0032000/0x816CDA54=0x100**；③重建 26/26 通过；④**实测**：HLE 调用推进到 **#0-#61**（此前 #42）；新 BADMEM `va=0x00000084 block=0x81198F08`——**r9=0x20**（来自预填 0x816CDA4C=0x100 → r9=(0x100+7)>>3=0x20），但 **r9 应为主堆指针而非尺寸** → **推断：0x816CDA3C 区是堆管理器结构**（指针+尺寸字段），探针 dump 的是**运行后（CAP=1e8 时）状态**，与 recomp 启动初期状态不一致 → 硬编码不可行，**必须实现系统内存管理 HLE（sceKernelAllocMemBlock/堆管理）让游戏自己的初始化函数设置这些全局** | §18.3653 | 双区域映射；HLE #61；BADMEM 0x84（r9=0x20 尺寸非指针）；堆结构需 HLE |

| M115 | **静态重编译阶段 3v：r9 破坏根因——FUN_811d9da2 的 push/pop 不匹配（栈不平衡）**。①R9CHG 追踪：r9 变化事件 3 条——`block=0x81198E2E old=0 new=0x82EFFF28`（合法，入口 sb=r0）、`block=0x811D9DFE old=0x82EFFF28 new=0x10`、`block=0x811D9DFE old=0x10 new=0x20`（FUN_811d9da2 内部用 r9 作 sb 临时，正常）；②**关键发现**：FUN_811d9da2 入口 `push.w {r4,r5,r6,r7,r8,sb,sl,fp,lr}`（**9 个寄存器 = 36B**）+ `sub sp,#0x14`，但尾部（0x811D9F44-46）`add sp,#0x14; pop.w {r4,r7,r8,sb,sl,fp,pc}`（**7 个 = 28B**）→ **push/pop 不匹配、栈不平衡 8B** → 返回时 r5/r6 未恢复、栈错位 → 后续 r9/栈状态错误；③根因：**function_bounds 的 FUN_811d9da2 边界（0x811D9DA2 size 0x1A8）与真实汇编入口不一致**（Ghidra 导出边界可能把函数中间当入口）→ 影响块划分/栈平衡；下一步=用真实汇编核对 push/pop 配对修正函数边界（或从探针/解释器确认真实入口） | §18.3656 | R9CHG 3 事件；push 9 regs vs pop 7 regs 不匹配（栈不平衡 8B）；函数边界数据待修正 || M115 | **静态重编译阶段 3v：r9 破坏根因——FUN_811d9da2 的 push/pop 不匹配（栈不平衡）**。①R9CHG 追踪：r9 变化事件 3 条——`block=0x81198E2E old=0 new=0x82EFFF28`（合法，入口 sb=r0）、`block=0x811D9DFE old=0x82EFFF28 new=0x10`、`block=0x811D9DFE old=0x10 new=0x20`（FUN_811d9da2 内部用 r9 作 sb 临时，正常）；②**关键发现**：FUN_811d9da2 入口 `push.w {r4,r5,r6,r7,r8,sb,sl,fp,lr}`（**9 个寄存器 = 36B**）+ `sub sp,#0x14`，但尾部（0x811D9F44-46）`add sp,#0x14; pop.w {r4,r7,r8,sb,sl,fp,pc}`（**7 个 = 28B**）→ **push/pop 不匹配、栈不平衡 8B** → 返回时 r5/r6 未恢复、栈错位 → 后续 r9/栈状态错误；③根因：**function_bounds 的 FUN_811d9da2 边界（0x811D9DA2 size 0x1A8）与真实汇编入口不一致**（Ghidra 导出边界可能把函数中间当入口）→ 影响块划分/栈平衡；下一步=用真实汇编核对 push/pop 配对修正函数边界（或从探针/解释器确认真实入口） | §18.3656 | R9CHG 3 事件；push 9 regs vs pop 7 regs 不匹配（栈不平衡 8B）；函数边界数据待修正 |
| M116 | **【知识复用/防遗忘】主文档既有知识盘点：Ghidra 边界偏差已有先例（§5S9）——当前 FUN_811d9da2 push/pop 不匹配属同类案例，按既有 objdump 核对法处理，不重复论证**。①**§5S9 已记录**：`Ghidra 的 VA 标注与真实指令边界有偏差（与第 410 次修正同理）` + 方法论 `表基址/浮点常量须双重复核（objdump + 逐步验算）`；②**§2U.11 权威模块映射**（305 文件/2,541 函数/714,542 字节，`docs\_MODULE_ADDR_MAP.txt`）——FUN_811d9da2 不在其中（属 Global 未命名库函数，非应用层），边界修正应基于已命名函数表 + 实测汇编；③**口径修正**：§5D8/§5DE 声称函数边界「100%」指 Ghidra 导出精度，**不等于与真实汇编完全一致**（§5S9 案例）；④**当前结论复用**：FUN_811d9da2（0x811D9DA2 size 0x1A8）入口 push 9 寄存器 vs 尾部 pop 7 寄存器 = Ghidra 边界偏差的新案例（真实入口/尾部需按 objdump 核对修正）；⑤**检索确认无重复**：主文档中 FUN_811d9da2 仅有本轮 M109-M115 记录（无更早独立分析） | §18.3657 | §5S9 边界偏差先例；§2U.11 权威映射；§5D8/5DE 口径修正；FUN_811d9da2 边界按既有方法修正 || M116 | **【知识复用/防遗忘】主文档既有知识盘点：Ghidra 边界偏差已有先例（§5S9）——当前 FUN_811d9da2 push/pop 不匹配属同类案例，按既有 objdump 核对法处理，不重复论证**。①**§5S9 已记录**：`Ghidra 的 VA 标注与真实指令边界有偏差（与第 410 次修正同理）` + 方法论 `表基址/浮点常量须双重复核（objdump + 逐步验算）`；②**§2U.11 权威模块映射**（305 文件/2,541 函数/714,542 字节，`docs\_MODULE_ADDR_MAP.txt`）——FUN_811d9da2 不在其中（属 Global 未命名库函数，非应用层），边界修正应基于已命名函数表 + 实测汇编；③**口径修正**：§5D8/§5DE 声称函数边界「100%」指 Ghidra 导出精度，**不等于与真实汇编完全一致**（§5S9 案例）；④**当前结论复用**：FUN_811d9da2（0x811D9DA2 size 0x1A8）入口 push 9 寄存器 vs 尾部 pop 7 寄存器 = Ghidra 边界偏差的新案例（真实入口/尾部需按 objdump 核对修正）；⑤**检索确认无重复**：主文档中 FUN_811d9da2 仅有本轮 M109-M115 记录（无更早独立分析） | §18.3657 | §5S9 边界偏差先例；§2U.11 权威映射；§5D8/5DE 口径修正；FUN_811d9da2 边界按既有方法修正 |
| M117 | **静态重编译阶段 3w：push/pop 配对审计工具（全 12,801 函数）→ 诚实修正 M115 的错误结论**。①工具 `_push_pop_audit.py`：对每个函数取入口 push 寄存器集合与所有 pop-pc 路径比对 → **mismatch=0、missing_pop=575**（有 push 无 pop-pc，可能是多返回/内联/尾部跳转）；②**诚实修正**：M115 称「FUN_811d9da2 入口 push 9 regs vs 尾部 pop 7 regs 不匹配」是**错误判断**——capstone 实测 FUN_811d9da2 入口 `push.w {r4,r7,r8,sb,sl,fp,lr}`（**7 个**）与尾部 `pop.w {r4,r7,r8,sb,sl,fp,pc}`（**7 个**）**完全一致**（我之前把 0x811D9F4A 的 9 寄存器 push 误当成 FUN_811d9da2 的）→ **栈平衡问题不存在**；③**r9 破坏另有原因**：R9CHG 最后事件 `block=0x811D9DFE old=0x10 new=0x20` 之后**再无 r9 恢复事件**（若 pop 恢复应出现 new=0x82EFFF28）→ 说明 **FUN_811d9da2 返回时 r9 未恢复**（或栈上保存的 sb 槽被写成 0x20）→ 下一步=在 FUN_811d9da2 返回点 dump r9/栈，定位恢复失败原因 | §18.3658 | 审计 12,801 函数 mismatch=0；修正 M115；r9 恢复缺失待查 || M117 | **静态重编译阶段 3w：push/pop 配对审计工具（全 12,801 函数）→ 诚实修正 M115 的错误结论**。①工具 `_push_pop_audit.py`：对每个函数取入口 push 寄存器集合与所有 pop-pc 路径比对 → **mismatch=0、missing_pop=575**（有 push 无 pop-pc，可能是多返回/内联/尾部跳转）；②**诚实修正**：M115 称「FUN_811d9da2 入口 push 9 regs vs 尾部 pop 7 regs 不匹配」是**错误判断**——capstone 实测 FUN_811d9da2 入口 `push.w {r4,r7,r8,sb,sl,fp,lr}`（**7 个**）与尾部 `pop.w {r4,r7,r8,sb,sl,fp,pc}`（**7 个**）**完全一致**（我之前把 0x811D9F4A 的 9 寄存器 push 误当成 FUN_811d9da2 的）→ **栈平衡问题不存在**；③**r9 破坏另有原因**：R9CHG 最后事件 `block=0x811D9DFE old=0x10 new=0x20` 之后**再无 r9 恢复事件**（若 pop 恢复应出现 new=0x82EFFF28）→ 说明 **FUN_811d9da2 返回时 r9 未恢复**（或栈上保存的 sb 槽被写成 0x20）→ 下一步=在 FUN_811d9da2 返回点 dump r9/栈，定位恢复失败原因 | §18.3658 | 审计 12,801 函数 mismatch=0；修正 M115；r9 恢复缺失待查 |
| M118 | **【重大修复 #3】pop-pc terminator 寄存器映射 bug——此前直接写 `s->r[70..77]`（越界 + 不恢复 r9），修复后 r9 正确恢复**。根因定位：`_gen_split.py` 的 pop-pc terminator 生成代码用 **capstone 寄存器编号直接索引**（`s->r[70]…s->r[77]`）而不是 R() 映射——①越界写 RecState 字段（r70-r77 超出 r[16]）；②**未恢复 r9（sb）** → 函数返回后 r9 保持内部临时值（0x10/0x20）→ 后续 `[r9+0x64]` 崩溃；修复：pop-pc 改为 `%s = rd32(...)` + R(r)；重建 26/26 通过。**验证（决定性）**：`[EPI2] after pop.w: r9=82EFFF28`（此前 0x20）、`[R9CHG] block=0x811D9F44 old=0x20 new=0x82EFFF28` ✓ **r9 恢复成功**；执行 319 块、HLE #61；**新 BADMEM `va=0x13EC unmapped block=0x81198F08`**（另一指针缺失，待继续追） | §18.3659 | pop-pc 映射修复；r9 恢复验证（EPI2/R9CHG）；319 块/HLE #61；新 BADMEM 0x13EC || M118 | **【重大修复 #3】pop-pc terminator 寄存器映射 bug——此前直接写 `s->r[70..77]`（越界 + 不恢复 r9），修复后 r9 正确恢复**。根因定位：`_gen_split.py` 的 pop-pc terminator 生成代码用 **capstone 寄存器编号直接索引**（`s->r[70]…s->r[77]`）而不是 R() 映射——①越界写 RecState 字段（r70-r77 超出 r[16]）；②**未恢复 r9（sb）** → 函数返回后 r9 保持内部临时值（0x10/0x20）→ 后续 `[r9+0x64]` 崩溃；修复：pop-pc 改为 `%s = rd32(...)` + R(r)；重建 26/26 通过。**验证（决定性）**：`[EPI2] after pop.w: r9=82EFFF28`（此前 0x20）、`[R9CHG] block=0x811D9F44 old=0x20 new=0x82EFFF28` ✓ **r9 恢复成功**；执行 319 块、HLE #61；**新 BADMEM `va=0x13EC unmapped block=0x81198F08`**（另一指针缺失，待继续追） | §18.3659 | pop-pc 映射修复；r9 恢复验证（EPI2/R9CHG）；319 块/HLE #61；新 BADMEM 0x13EC |
| M119 | **【重大修复 #4】2 操作数高寄存器 add/sub（如 `add r5,r8`）被静默丢弃 → 修复后 0x13EC 错误消失、执行进入 FUN_81198e2e 初始化序列；新问题：sl(r10) 高位被破坏（0x03ECC630）**。根因：M100 重写 add/sub 规则时漏掉 `len(ops)==2 and both reg` 形式（`add rd, rm`）→ 生成代码**静默丢失指令**（movw 立即数后没有 add → r5=0x13EC 小整数 → `[r5]` BADMEM 0x13EC）；修复：add/sub 分支加回 2 操作数寄存器形式（含 flags 更新）；重建 26/26；**实测**：0x13EC 错误消失、执行推进（blk 98-103 进入 FUN_81198e2e 初始化序列 0x81198ED4 等）；**新 BADMEM `va=0x03ECDA38 block=0x8120732C`**：`movw r0,#0x1408; add r0,sl` → 期望 0x816CDA38，实际 **0x03ECDA38** ⇒ **sl(r10)=0x03ECC630（高位 0x03EC 错，应 0x816C）**——callee-saved r10 被破坏（与 r9 同类问题）→ 下一步=r10 变化追踪（watchdog 扩展）+ 检查 callee-saved 恢复 | §18.3660 | 2-op add 修复；0x13EC 消失；新 BADMEM 0x03ECDA38（sl 高位错）；r10 待追踪 || M119 | **【重大修复 #4】2 操作数高寄存器 add/sub（如 `add r5,r8`）被静默丢弃 → 修复后 0x13EC 错误消失、执行进入 FUN_81198e2e 初始化序列；新问题：sl(r10) 高位被破坏（0x03ECC630）**。根因：M100 重写 add/sub 规则时漏掉 `len(ops)==2 and both reg` 形式（`add rd, rm`）→ 生成代码**静默丢失指令**（movw 立即数后没有 add → r5=0x13EC 小整数 → `[r5]` BADMEM 0x13EC）；修复：add/sub 分支加回 2 操作数寄存器形式（含 flags 更新）；重建 26/26；**实测**：0x13EC 错误消失、执行推进（blk 98-103 进入 FUN_81198e2e 初始化序列 0x81198ED4 等）；**新 BADMEM `va=0x03ECDA38 block=0x8120732C`**：`movw r0,#0x1408; add r0,sl` → 期望 0x816CDA38，实际 **0x03ECDA38** ⇒ **sl(r10)=0x03ECC630（高位 0x03EC 错，应 0x816C）**——callee-saved r10 被破坏（与 r9 同类问题）→ 下一步=r10 变化追踪（watchdog 扩展）+ 检查 callee-saved 恢复 | §18.3660 | 2-op add 修复；0x13EC 消失；新 BADMEM 0x03ECDA38（sl 高位错）；r10 待追踪 |
| M120 | **静态重编译阶段 3x：r10 追踪结果——sl 未被破坏（诚实修正 M119 推断）；BADMEM 0x03ECDA38 来源待重新定位**。①harness 加 r10 变化追踪：**仅 1 条事件** `block=0x81198E6A old=0 new=816CC630 n=52`（合法：`movw sl,#0xc630; movt sl,#0x816c`），之后 r10 无变化 ⇒ **sl 未被破坏**（修正 M119 的 sl 高位错误推断）；②BADMEM `0x03ECDA38 block=0x8120732C` 实际发生在 **HLE wrapper 函数 0x812073xx** 内（HLE #25 lr=0x8120732C），即 wrapper 返回后使用 r0=0x03ECDA38（该值来自调用者计算或 wrapper 参数），不是 sl 加法结果；③下一步：在块 0x8120732C 进入时 dump r0-r12 + 调用者上下文，定位 0x03ECDA38 的生成来源（可能又是遗漏的指令或 HLE 返回值语义） | §18.3661 | r10 仅 1 合法事件；sl 未破坏（修正 M119）；BADMEM 0x03ECDA38 在 wrapper 0x812073xx 内待查 || M120 | **静态重编译阶段 3x：r10 追踪结果——sl 未被破坏（诚实修正 M119 推断）；BADMEM 0x03ECDA38 来源待重新定位**。①harness 加 r10 变化追踪：**仅 1 条事件** `block=0x81198E6A old=0 new=816CC630 n=52`（合法：`movw sl,#0xc630; movt sl,#0x816c`），之后 r10 无变化 ⇒ **sl 未被破坏**（修正 M119 的 sl 高位错误推断）；②BADMEM `0x03ECDA38 block=0x8120732C` 实际发生在 **HLE wrapper 函数 0x812073xx** 内（HLE #25 lr=0x8120732C），即 wrapper 返回后使用 r0=0x03ECDA38（该值来自调用者计算或 wrapper 参数），不是 sl 加法结果；③下一步：在块 0x8120732C 进入时 dump r0-r12 + 调用者上下文，定位 0x03ECDA38 的生成来源（可能又是遗漏的指令或 HLE 返回值语义） | §18.3661 | r10 仅 1 合法事件；sl 未破坏（修正 M119）；BADMEM 0x03ECDA38 在 wrapper 0x812073xx 内待查 |
| M121 | **静态重编译阶段 3y：0x03ECDA38 精确定位到块 0x81198ED4（`movw r0,#0x1408; add r0,sl`）**。①harness 日志语义澄清（`after blk N: pc=<块地址>` 打印的是**执行前块地址**）→ BADMEM 前的 0x03ECDA38 由**块 0x81198ED4 执行产生**；②该块真实指令：`movw r0,#0x1408; add r0,sl; bl 0x81207308`；生成代码：`r0 = (0x1408 | (r0 & 0xFFFF0000)); _a=r0; _b=s->r[10]; _r=_a+_b; r0=_r`；③wrapper dump 显示进入 wrapper 时 sl(r10)=0x816CC630 ✓ 正常，且 R10CHG 仅 1 条合法设置 → **sl 正常但块 0x81198ED4 算出 0x03ECDA38**（=0x03EC1408+0x0? 或 0x1408+0x03ECC630）→ 推测 movw 的 old 高位来源（r0 在块前的高 16 位）或生成代码指令顺序问题；下一步=在块 0x81198ED4 执行**前/后**分别 dump r0/r10 精确值（下条指令级追踪）→ 定位计算错误 | §18.3662 | 0x03ECDA38 来自块 0x81198ED4；sl 正常；movw/add 生成待细查 || M121 | **静态重编译阶段 3y：0x03ECDA38 精确定位到块 0x81198ED4（`movw r0,#0x1408; add r0,sl`）**。①harness 日志语义澄清（`after blk N: pc=<块地址>` 打印的是**执行前块地址**）→ BADMEM 前的 0x03ECDA38 由**块 0x81198ED4 执行产生**；②该块真实指令：`movw r0,#0x1408; add r0,sl; bl 0x81207308`；生成代码：`r0 = (0x1408 | (r0 & 0xFFFF0000)); _a=r0; _b=s->r[10]; _r=_a+_b; r0=_r`；③wrapper dump 显示进入 wrapper 时 sl(r10)=0x816CC630 ✓ 正常，且 R10CHG 仅 1 条合法设置 → **sl 正常但块 0x81198ED4 算出 0x03ECDA38**（=0x03EC1408+0x0? 或 0x1408+0x03ECC630）→ 推测 movw 的 old 高位来源（r0 在块前的高 16 位）或生成代码指令顺序问题；下一步=在块 0x81198ED4 执行**前/后**分别 dump r0/r10 精确值（下条指令级追踪）→ 定位计算错误 | §18.3662 | 0x03ECDA38 来自块 0x81198ED4；sl 正常；movw/add 生成待细查 |
| M122 | **【重大修复 #5】MOVW 语义 bug（高 16 位未清零）修复 → 执行 393 块、HLE 调用 #78（此前 #61/319 块）；新问题：malloc 512MB OOM**。根因：ARM `MOVW` 语义是「rD = imm16（**高 16 位清零**）」，生成器却写成 `(imm16 | (rD & 0xFFFF0000))`（**保留旧高半**）→ 高半垃圾值被带入后续 add（例：r0 高半 0x03EC → movw → 0x03EC1408 → add sl → 0x03ECDA38 BADMEM）；修复：movw 生成改为 `rD = imm16`；重建 26/26 通过。**实测**：执行 **393 块**、HLE 调用 **#0-#78**（明显推进）；**新问题**：`[HLE] malloc OOM n=536870912`（0x20000000=512MB）→ malloc 返回 0 → `[BADMEM] va=0x00000004 block=0x811E6112`；根因=**游戏请求大内存（Vita 有 512MB）而我们的 image 仅 64MB** → 下一步=**扩大内存映射/大块分配策略**（如 0xA0000000 区扩展、或按请求动态映射） | §18.3663 | MOVW 修复；393 块/HLE #78；malloc 512MB OOM→[0+4] BADMEM；需扩内存 || M122 | **【重大修复 #5】MOVW 语义 bug（高 16 位未清零）修复 → 执行 393 块、HLE 调用 #78（此前 #61/319 块）；新问题：malloc 512MB OOM**。根因：ARM `MOVW` 语义是「rD = imm16（**高 16 位清零**）」，生成器却写成 `(imm16 | (rD & 0xFFFF0000))`（**保留旧高半**）→ 高半垃圾值被带入后续 add（例：r0 高半 0x03EC → movw → 0x03EC1408 → add sl → 0x03ECDA38 BADMEM）；修复：movw 生成改为 `rD = imm16`；重建 26/26 通过。**实测**：执行 **393 块**、HLE 调用 **#0-#78**（明显推进）；**新问题**：`[HLE] malloc OOM n=536870912`（0x20000000=512MB）→ malloc 返回 0 → `[BADMEM] va=0x00000004 block=0x811E6112`；根因=**游戏请求大内存（Vita 有 512MB）而我们的 image 仅 64MB** → 下一步=**扩大内存映射/大块分配策略**（如 0xA0000000 区扩展、或按请求动态映射） | §18.3663 | MOVW 修复；393 块/HLE #78；malloc 512MB OOM→[0+4] BADMEM；需扩内存 |
| M123 | **静态重编译阶段 3z：大 malloc（512MB）来源定位到 `FUN_811E60xx` 的 `lsl.w r0,sl,#3`——sl=0x4000000 错误**。BIGMALLOC 记录：`#75 a0=0x20000000 lr=0x811E6A0E block=0x812B22A0`（malloc wrapper）；反汇编调用者 FUN_811E60xx：`811E60E0 lsl.w r0,sl,#3; 811E60E8 bl 0x811da534`（=malloc(r0)）→ **sl<<3 = 0x20000000（512MB）** ⇒ **sl=0x4000000（64M）**（数量参数，真实应为小值如 0x100/0x1000）→ malloc OOM → 返回 0 → `ldr.w r0,[sb,#0x24]`（0）→ [0+..] BADMEM（块 0x811E6112）；`str.w sl,[sb,#0x28]` 也记录该值。**结论**：sl 在进入 FUN_811E60xx 时就是 0x4000000（错误数量/大小）→ 下一步=追踪 FUN_811E60xx 入口 sl 来源（参数/全局/结构字段），修正后再重建验证 | §18.3664 | 大 malloc=lsl sl,#3；sl=0x4000000（64M）错误；来源待查 || M123 | **静态重编译阶段 3z：大 malloc（512MB）来源定位到 `FUN_811E60xx` 的 `lsl.w r0,sl,#3`——sl=0x4000000 错误**。BIGMALLOC 记录：`#75 a0=0x20000000 lr=0x811E6A0E block=0x812B22A0`（malloc wrapper）；反汇编调用者 FUN_811E60xx：`811E60E0 lsl.w r0,sl,#3; 811E60E8 bl 0x811da534`（=malloc(r0)）→ **sl<<3 = 0x20000000（512MB）** ⇒ **sl=0x4000000（64M）**（数量参数，真实应为小值如 0x100/0x1000）→ malloc OOM → 返回 0 → `ldr.w r0,[sb,#0x24]`（0）→ [0+..] BADMEM（块 0x811E6112）；`str.w sl,[sb,#0x28]` 也记录该值。**结论**：sl 在进入 FUN_811E60xx 时就是 0x4000000（错误数量/大小）→ 下一步=追踪 FUN_811E60xx 入口 sl 来源（参数/全局/结构字段），修正后再重建验证 | §18.3664 | 大 malloc=lsl sl,#3；sl=0x4000000（64M）错误；来源待查 |
| M124 | **静态重编译阶段 4a：sl 参数来源——FUN_811e603e 的 3 个调用点与生成代码核对**。①FUN_811e603e 入口 `mov sl, r2`（sl=第 3 参数）；②静态扫描 `bl 0x811e603e`：**3 个站点** 0x811E619A（r1=0x200、**r2=1**、r3=0x1000<<16）、0x811E61C8（r1=0x2800、**r2=4**）、0x811E61EC；③调用者块 0x811E6176 生成代码**正确**：`s->r[2]=0x1; setf_nz(...)`（movs r2,#1 ✓）→ 理论上 sl 应为 1/4 而非 0x4000000；④**矛盾**：实际 sl=0x4000000 → 说明实际执行**走了不同调用点/或 r2 在调用前被改**（可能另一块/该函数内部路径）；下一步=在 FUN_811e603e 入口 dump r0-r3 + 调用者块 + 块环，确认实际调用点与 r2 值 | §18.3665 | 3 调用点 r2=1/4；生成代码正确；实际 sl=0x4000000 矛盾待查 || M124 | **静态重编译阶段 4a：sl 参数来源——FUN_811e603e 的 3 个调用点与生成代码核对**。①FUN_811e603e 入口 `mov sl, r2`（sl=第 3 参数）；②静态扫描 `bl 0x811e603e`：**3 个站点** 0x811E619A（r1=0x200、**r2=1**、r3=0x1000<<16）、0x811E61C8（r1=0x2800、**r2=4**）、0x811E61EC；③调用者块 0x811E6176 生成代码**正确**：`s->r[2]=0x1; setf_nz(...)`（movs r2,#1 ✓）→ 理论上 sl 应为 1/4 而非 0x4000000；④**矛盾**：实际 sl=0x4000000 → 说明实际执行**走了不同调用点/或 r2 在调用前被改**（可能另一块/该函数内部路径）；下一步=在 FUN_811e603e 入口 dump r0-r3 + 调用者块 + 块环，确认实际调用点与 r2 值 | §18.3665 | 3 调用点 r2=1/4；生成代码正确；实际 sl=0x4000000 矛盾待查 |
| M125 | **静态重编译阶段 4b：修复线索——块 0x811E60DC 生成代码里 lsl.w 被生成两次（shift + ror）→ r0=0x20000000 → malloc 512MB**。①入口 dump 确认：进入 FUN_811e603e 时 **r2=1**（正确，调用点 0x811E619A）；②但 `lsl.w r0,sl,#3` 的**生成代码出现两条 r0 赋值**：`r0 = r10 << 3;` 和 `r0 = ((r10 >> 3) | (r10 << (32-3)));`（= **ror**）→ 最终 r0 = ror(1,3) = **0x20000000** → malloc(0x20000000=512MB) → OOM ⇒ **完全吻合**；③真实指令只有一条 `lsl.w`（0x811E60E0）+ `str.w`(0x811E60E4)，**多出的 ror 是生成/解码重复** → 根因候选：块切分/反汇编把 lsl.w 解成两条、或生成器 lsl 分支重复生成；下一步=打印块 0x811E60DC 的指令列表与生成语句逐条对照，定位重复来源并修复 | §18.3666 | 入口 r2=1；生成代码 shift+ror 双赋值；r0=ror(1,3)=0x20000000；多出 ror 待修 || M125 | **静态重编译阶段 4b：修复线索——块 0x811E60DC 生成代码里 lsl.w 被生成两次（shift + ror）→ r0=0x20000000 → malloc 512MB**。①入口 dump 确认：进入 FUN_811e603e 时 **r2=1**（正确，调用点 0x811E619A）；②但 `lsl.w r0,sl,#3` 的**生成代码出现两条 r0 赋值**：`r0 = r10 << 3;` 和 `r0 = ((r10 >> 3) | (r10 << (32-3)));`（= **ror**）→ 最终 r0 = ror(1,3) = **0x20000000** → malloc(0x20000000=512MB) → OOM ⇒ **完全吻合**；③真实指令只有一条 `lsl.w`（0x811E60E0）+ `str.w`(0x811E60E4)，**多出的 ror 是生成/解码重复** → 根因候选：块切分/反汇编把 lsl.w 解成两条、或生成器 lsl 分支重复生成；下一步=打印块 0x811E60DC 的指令列表与生成语句逐条对照，定位重复来源并修复 | §18.3666 | 入口 r2=1；生成代码 shift+ror 双赋值；r0=ror(1,3)=0x20000000；多出 ror 待修 |
| M126 | **【重大修复 #6】shift 规则 if/elif 链断裂（lsl 多生成 ror）→ 执行 526 块/HLE #110、OOM 消失；新瓶颈=间接调用未翻译（0x81207504）**。根因：`_gen_batch2.py` shift 规则中 `if m.startswith(lsl)` 后插入的 `if m.endswith(s)` 打断了 if/elif 链 → 对**无 S 后缀的 lsl/lsr/asr**（如 lsl.w→`lsl`）走最终 `else` 生成**错误 ror**（每遇一条 lsl 多一条 ror）→ r0=ror(1,3)=0x20000000 → malloc 512MB；修复：shift if/elif 链保持完整、setf_nz 移到链后独立执行；验证：`lsl.w` 生成代码变为**单条 shift** ✓；重建 26/26。**实测**：执行 **526 块**（此前 393）、HLE 调用 **#110**（此前 #78）、**malloc OOM=0**、无崩溃（exit=0）；最终停在 **`indirect untranslated at pc=0x81207504`**（间接调用未翻译）→ 下一步=实现**间接跳转分发表**（bx/blx reg/ldr pc → 按函数地址表查目标块） | §18.3667 | shift 链修复；lsl 单条生成；526 块/HLE #110/OOM=0；间接调用成新瓶颈 || M126 | **【重大修复 #6】shift 规则 if/elif 链断裂（lsl 多生成 ror）→ 执行 526 块/HLE #110、OOM 消失；新瓶颈=间接调用未翻译（0x81207504）**。根因：`_gen_batch2.py` shift 规则中 `if m.startswith(lsl)` 后插入的 `if m.endswith(s)` 打断了 if/elif 链 → 对**无 S 后缀的 lsl/lsr/asr**（如 lsl.w→`lsl`）走最终 `else` 生成**错误 ror**（每遇一条 lsl 多一条 ror）→ r0=ror(1,3)=0x20000000 → malloc 512MB；修复：shift if/elif 链保持完整、setf_nz 移到链后独立执行；验证：`lsl.w` 生成代码变为**单条 shift** ✓；重建 26/26。**实测**：执行 **526 块**（此前 393）、HLE 调用 **#110**（此前 #78）、**malloc OOM=0**、无崩溃（exit=0）；最终停在 **`indirect untranslated at pc=0x81207504`**（间接调用未翻译）→ 下一步=实现**间接跳转分发表**（bx/blx reg/ldr pc → 按函数地址表查目标块） | §18.3667 | shift 链修复；lsl 单条生成；526 块/HLE #110/OOM=0；间接调用成新瓶颈 |

| M186 | STATIC-RECOMP STAGE 6i: D683C dump exposed the real cause of BADMEM 0x80 - block 0x8120683C (main loop) is entered with r0=0 via return address 0x8120683A (prev=0x8120683A, r14=0x8120683A), but 0x8120683A is NOT a valid code address: function 0x812067A0 ends at 0x81206834 ('pop {r4,r5,pc}') and 0x81206836.. is inter-function padding. So the fiber's pop-pc popped GARBAGE (0x8120683A) - i.e. the fiber's stack frame was lost/corrupted. ROOT CAUSE: our fiber_load hack forces SP to the stack top (0xA0F00000) on EVERY load; when a fiber yields inside a function and is resumed, its frame is gone, so pop pc returns garbage. FIX PLAN: remove the per-load SP reset and use the saved context SP; give each fiber a large real stack in region B (e.g. 8MB each: fiber1 0xA0E00000, fiber2 0xA0600000) and set it only on first start. The known -8B/round drift is then harmless for 200k blocks (~552KB). Implement next. | §18.3727 | BADMEM 0x80 cause: pop-pc garbage 0x8120683A (padding) - fiber stack frame lost because fiber_load forces SP every round; fix: keep context SP, large first-start stack in region B (8MB/fiber) || M186 | STATIC-RECOMP STAGE 6i: D683C dump exposed the real cause of BADMEM 0x80 - block 0x8120683C (main loop) is entered with r0=0 via return address 0x8120683A (prev=0x8120683A, r14=0x8120683A), but 0x8120683A is NOT a valid code address: function 0x812067A0 ends at 0x81206834 ('pop {r4,r5,pc}') and 0x81206836.. is inter-function padding. Result: the SLICE trace never printed and the run still dies with BADMEM 0x4 at block 0x8120776E, i.e. the crash happens in fiber2's FIRST task run, long before the 2000-block slice. Combined with the earlier finding that the watchpoint on 0x8130CC68 sees no change (= ELF 0x0C20D060), the faulting access must come from a LATER invocation/path of FUN_81207734 (the D7734 dump showed only the first call, r1=0). | M197 | AOT PRINCIPLE AUDIT (user reminder: this is STATIC RECOMPILATION, not emulation): the pipeline is confirmed one-shot static translation - 220,991 basic blocks are pre-generated as C++ functions (26 batch files, ~1MB each) at build time, each translating original ARM/Thumb instructions to native C++/x86-64 semantics; the harness only dispatches pre-compiled block pointers via gbn(pc) and bridges system APIs through HLE stubs. There is NO instruction interpreter in the execution path (no run_guest call, no decode/step/IR loop; run_guest exists only as dead code and will be removed). Audit found 116 of 12,917 function entry points had no generated block (coverage 99.1%) because those functions were missing from the last batch build (function_bounds.json was updated by the gap-fill pass after the last rebuild); a full 26-batch rebuild is now running to cover them, so every known ARM function is translated. Next: verify the new block count (expected >220,991), relink, run 300k blocks; keep the pure-AOT guarantee documented here. | §18.3737 | static-recomp principle audit: 220,991 precompiled blocks, no interpreter; 116/12917 entries missing from last batch build -> full rebuild running to reach full coverage || M197 | AOT PRINCIPLE AUDIT (user reminder: this is STATIC RECOMPILATION, not emulation): the pipeline is confirmed one-shot static translation - 220,991 basic blocks are pre-generated as C++ functions (26 batch files, ~1MB each) at build time, each translating original ARM/Thumb instructions to native C++/x86-64 semantics; the harness only dispatches pre-compiled block pointers via gbn(pc) and bridges system APIs through HLE stubs. Next: verify the new block count (expected >220,991), relink, run 300k blocks; keep the pure-AOT guarantee documented here. | §18.3737 | static-recomp principle audit: 220,991 precompiled blocks, no interpreter; 116/12917 entries missing from last batch build -> full rebuild running to reach full coverage |
| M198 | AOT COVERAGE ROOT CAUSE (18.3738): after a full 26-batch rebuild the block count was still 220,991 and the same 116 function entries still lacked blocks. Investigation of 0x810108DE (one of them): function_bounds.json contains it with size=1 (a degenerate single-byte size from boundary analysis), so gen_batch disassembles an empty/1-byte range -> 'if not insns: continue' skips the function entirely; yet the actual code at that address is a valid Thumb function prologue (push.w {r4,r5,r6,r7,r8,sb,sl,fp,lr}). FIX: extend every function whose recorded size <= 1 up to the next function boundary (max 0x100) when that byte range disassembles exactly, then rebuild. This makes the AOT translation cover all real code (pure static recompilation: every original ARM instruction translated once at build time). Next: verify the new block count/entry coverage after rebuild#2 and relink. | §18.3738 | 116 missing entries = function_bounds size=1 boundary artifacts skipped by gen_batch; fix: extend degenerate sizes to next boundary; rebuild#2 running || M198 | AOT COVERAGE ROOT CAUSE (18.3738): after a full 26-batch rebuild the block count was still 220,991 and the same 116 function entries still lacked blocks. | M199 | CRITICAL AOT GENERATOR BUG FIXED (18.3739): the BADMEM 0x4 at 0x8120776E was caused by the translator dropping the INDEX register of register-offset memory operands. Example: original `ldr r1,[r1,r0]` (r1=4, r0=0x8130CC68) must read [0x8130CC6C], but generated code was `s->r[1] = rd32(s, s->r[1] + 0x0u)` i.e. [0x4] -> BADMEM. Root cause: mem() in _gen_batch2.py returned only (base, disp) and ignored op.mem.index (and its shift). FIX: mem() now builds the full address expression base + index (with LSL/LSR/ASR shift) + disp for all ldr/ldrb/ldrh/ldrsh/ldrsb/ldrd/str/strb/strh/strd forms; full 26-batch rebuild#4 is running. This class of instructions is common in the original binary, so the fix may also explain several earlier 'phantom' crashes (stack/list/table accesses). Next: verify rebuild compiles, relink, run 300k blocks, and check whether the fiber2 task chain now proceeds. | §18.3739 | CRITICAL: register-offset loads/stores dropped their index register (rd32(s, base+0) instead of base+index) -> whole instruction class mistranslated; fixed mem() to emit base+index(shift)+disp; rebuild#4 running || M199 | CRITICAL AOT GENERATOR BUG FIXED (18.3739): the BADMEM 0x4 at 0x8120776E was caused by the translator dropping the INDEX register of register-offset memory operands. | M207 | STATIC-RECOMP STAGE 6z: FUN_811D9DA2 = the in-game heap structure initializer. | M211 | STATIC-RECOMP STAGE 6ad: BUG FIXED - is_term() treated 'bics' (bit-clear with flags) as a BRANCH because the prefix check 'm.startswith("b")' lacked bics in its exclusion list (bic/bfi/bfc were listed, bics was not). Consequence: for any block whose LAST instruction was bics (very common: alignment/mask sequences like 0x811D9DFA 'bics.w sl,sl,r0'), the emitter used _seq = insns[:-1] and silently DROPPED that instruction. That is exactly why [heap+8] stayed 0x20F instead of 0x200. FIX: exclude 'bics' in is_term(); full 26-batch rebuild#5 running. This is a whole-class translation bug (like the earlier dual-register addressing fix) and should fix many similar dropped-instruction sites. | M310 | ★ ROOT CAUSE FOUND - REGION-B ADDRESS ALIASING. The FH1C probe printed the smoking gun: `[FH1C] in-handler change 00000000->5C545657 fh=0000302B dst=A00BD020 size=87536`. Region B VA 0xA00BD020 maps via GP() to image offset (0xA00BD020-0xA0000000)+0x1000000 = 0x010BD020, which is the SAME image bytes as low-region VA 0x816BD020; the 87,536-byte memcpy covers image 0x010BD020..0x010D2610 = low-VA 0x816BD020..0x816D2610, and the loader global [0x816CDA1C] lies at image 0x010CDA1C inside that range (verified by arithmetic: covered YES). So when the game reads a file into heap2 (region B), our unified mapping aliases those bytes onto the low-image data segment and clobbers game globals - which is why 24 nodes happened not to hit it and 48+ did. FIX: Region B must not overlap the low 64MB image. Plan: enlarge the image to 128MB (0x80600000..0x88600000), keep low region mapping unchanged, map region B to image + 0x7A00000 (= VA 0x88000000, safely above the low image); update P() in the generator header (all batches), GP() in the harness, and the host allocation size; rebuild the 26 batches. | M319 | STATIC-RECOMP STAGE 6eg: per-block tracing inside the fiber2 pump pinpoints the real cause of the `no block pc=0x1` failures. Trace: `[PMP2B] ppc=8115D7C4 fn=... r0=00000000 sp=A05FFF18 lr=8120732C` then `[PMP2C] nx=00000001`, i.e. the pump's FIRST executed block is 0x8115D7C4 - NOT the user entry 0x81198C0A. The restart branch (`if c2.r[15]==0`) never fires: fiber2's saved FCtx has a NON-ZERO pc = 0x8115D7C4 (left over from the boot pass, which evidently stopped mid-task rather than completing to pc=0; M182/M252 said 47 blocks ending pc=0 for the tested path, but this FCtx is from a different boot continuation). | M345 | STATIC-RECOMP STAGE 6fg: fiber_exec no-block handling improved (gbn_back fallback + fiber_save before break) but the 0x8115D7C7 case reveals a bad fallback target: [FBACK] pc=8115D7C7 -> block 8115D7C4 (back 2), then the block runs and returns pc=0x00000001 -> [FIBER-EXEC] no block for pc=00000001. Inspecting blk_8115D7C4 explains it: its generated code is `s->r[4]=rd32(s,s->r[13]); s->r[13]+=4; { uint32_t _pc=rd32(s,s->r[13]); s->r[13]+=4; return _pc; }` i.e. a `pop {r4,pc}` FUNCTION-RETURN block. So 0x8115D7C7 is a mid-function address whose containing block is a return epilogue, and 'executing the containing block from its start' performs an unwanted return that pops garbage (0x1) from the stack. | M375 | ROUTE AUDIT (user asked 'are we going off-course?'): our actual route is the orthodox STATIC-RECOMPILATION stack, not emulation: (1) AOT layer - capstone disasm of the unmodified eboot ARM/Thumb -> CFG -> generated C++ block functions (221,745 blocks in 26 batches) -> g++ -O2 x86-64 native, RecState register file; (2) HLE layer - ELF import stubs detected via ARM_STUB pattern (364 hle_call blocks) implemented in C++ (file/CPK->local dirs, bump heaps + 512MB image mapping, partial SceGxm init, SceFiber); (3) hand-written fiber scheduler (g_fiber_switch_to defer + exec_origin restore); (4) test-driven debugging (N-block runs + pc/dispatch rings + guards). This architecture matches the canonical static-recomp projects (N64-recomp style translator + HLE + graphics-API translation). THREE REAL DEVIATIONS: (a) runtime workarounds instead of correct translation (gbn_back mid-block fallback, id_reg/id_tbb fallbacks, NOFN fiber resume, forced fiber2 pump, defer-switch) - short-term progress but accumulating unsafe assumptions; the correct path is fixing CFG/instruction semantics properly (NEON ~15,828 unsupported etc.); (b) asset injection (300-node CPK request chain fed to the loader) instead of letting the game create its own requests - a hack that masks startup-flow bugs; (c) CRITICAL: the RENDER layer has not started - only ~5 of 100 SceGxm imports are init stubs, no Vulkan backend, no shader translation, no texture/render-target/display path; the goal is 'picture matches original', so this is the largest untouched work item. Quantified state: AOT engine ~80%, HLE system APIs ~10%, fiber scheduler ~40% (hack-heavy), render 0%, scenes 0%, packaging 0%. Recommendation (adjust course, not architecture): start a MINIMAL RENDER PIPELINE NOW (SceGxmCreateContext/BeginScene/EndScene/Display -> Vulkan clear+present, even a black frame) to validate the presentation path; converge runtime hacks into a real SceFiber scheduler; stop asset injection and let the startup flow create requests; make the next milestone 'one presented frame' instead of 'another crash fixed'. | §18.3915 | ROUTE AUDIT: route = orthodox static-recompilation (AOT 221,745 blocks + HLE 364 stubs + hand-written fiber scheduler + test-driven rings), architecture matches N64-recomp style; three deviations: (a) runtime workarounds (gbn_back/id_reg/NOFN/pump/defer) instead of correct CFG+instruction semantics (NEON unsupported), (b) 300-node asset injection masks startup-flow bugs, (c) RENDER LAYER NOT STARTED (5/100 SceGxm stubs, no Vulkan/shader/texture/display). | M387 | STATIC-RECOMP STAGE 6gt: the `_isgpr` widening to 0..13 (include sp) had NO effect - rebuild#20c gives the same UNSUPPORTED_NEON = 4,060 (identical obj bytes 64,767,420) as #20b. So the vldmia 1,061 / vstmia 1,145 fallbacks are NOT caused by sp being excluded; the real cause is the operand FORM: vldmia/vstmia's first operand can be an ARM_OP_MEM (e.g. `[r0]`, `[r0]!`) rather than an ARM_OP_REG (`r0!`), and the branch condition `_isgpr(0)` is False for a memory operand, so those instructions never enter the handling branch and fall through to the final UNSUPPORTED_NEON else. The implementation is fairly complete: it does cooperative round-robin at main-loop level (every 100th switch it runs another fiber via fiber_load + fiber_exec_to_completion), defers switches from inside fiber_exec (g_fiber_switch_to), handles self-switch/yield, and at the end: `uint32_t fb = s->r[0] & ~1u; if (!fb) { r0 = 0; break; } if (g_in_fiber_exec) { if (fb != g_cur_fiber) g_fiber_switch_to = fb; r0 = 0; break; } if (fb == g_cur_fiber) {...}`. KEY: when the target fiber is ZERO the HLE simply returns 0 WITHOUT switching. In the busy-wait loop the game calls 0x812B1BA0 with the GLOBAL FIBER-LIST HEAD (loaded from 0x816CBC08+0xa1c at 0x81206818); if that head is 0 the HLE does nothing and the completion manager loops forever. | M480 | ★★★ STATIC-RECOMP STAGE 6jn: THE FIBER SWITCH IS FAILING WITH 'unknown target' - THAT IS THE LOOP. Grep over the 10M run shows: `[FEVT] switch cur=84676750 to=846867F0 runs=1` - only ONE switch ever happened; but `[SWP] fb=846867F0 in=1 cur=84676750 sp=A0DFFFE8` appears MANY times (sceFiberSwitch(fiber2) called repeatedly from inside fiber_exec, which only arms g_fiber_switch_to); and `[FIBER-SW] unknown target 846867F0` appears. So: fiber1 repeatedly calls sceFiberSwitch(fiber2), the deferred switch is consumed by fiber_exec, but `g_fctx.find(fiber2)` FAILS - fiber2 is NOT registered in g_fctx - so the switch handler logs 'unknown target', breaks, and fiber1 keeps running and retrying forever. ROOT CAUSE: fiber2's FCtx was never created via fiber_load (the only path that populates g_fctx for a new fiber), because our earlier flow created the fiber OBJECT (0x81206700) but never loaded/resumed it in this run. FIX: in the switch handler, when the target fiber is missing from g_fctx, CREATE its FCtx on the spot (call fiber_load(s, t, entry, arg) which reads the fiber object's [fiber+0x84] user entry and [fiber+0x88] argOnRun) and proceed with the switch instead of breaking. Generated block `blk_8115F448` ends with `... s->r[1] = 0x4u; setf_nz(s, s->r[1]); return id_reg(6, s);` - i.e. the `blx r6` is implemented as `return id_reg(6, s)` (an INDIRECT CALL helper returning the target pc). The callee (0x8115D7BE malloc wrapper) does `bl 0x8115D1F0` which OVERWRITES LR, then `pop {r4,pc}` returns to the WRONG address - the function never reaches 0x8115F458, and the caller's stack/canary state ends up inconsistent, producing the sl=0 crash at 0x8115D28C. NEXT: read the implementation of `id_reg` (and how the call site passes the return address) and make it set LR (s->r[14]) to the correct continuation pc for a blx/indirect call - likely `id_reg` currently only handles the target register, and the generic call return mechanism sets LR somewhere else (or not at all for indirect calls). Two facts: (1) a normal `bl` block is generated correctly as `s->r[14] = 0x81015F6Au; return 0x81173194u; /* bl */` (see blk_81015F62 in batch_001.cpp:10899 - the LR is set to the return address). Then regenerate all blocks and relink. NEXT: patch _gen_split.py line ~286, regenerate (`py -3 _gen_split.py 500 4`), relink, run 10M, and check whether [F458] now fires and the sl=0 crash is gone. | M493 | ★★★ STATIC-RECOMP STAGE 6ka: THE NEW BADMEM (0x8115F9D4) IS A DELIBERATE NULL-WRITE / ASSERT-PATH. Disassembly: `8115F9CA push {r4,lr}; 8115F9CC bl 0x8115F7E0; 8115F9D0 cmp r0,#0; 8115F9D2 beq 0x8115F9D8; 8115F9D4 movs r0,#0; 8115F9D6 str r0,[r0]; 8115F9D8 pop {r4,pc}`. The old implementation eboot_probe.cpp is not present in C:\dev anymore. CONCLUSION: the current crash (invalid mutex pointer 0x1F8465 from r8 in blk_811AC9CC) is a SYMPTOM of this missing subsystem: the guest is running the real job-pool/worker path but the AOT harness has no pool table / real LwMutex / sema / event-flag state, so it hands out garbage pointers. CORRECT DIRECTION (not another single-point crash chase): port the documented 4GM/4GN/5ZH model into the AOT harness - (1) initialize the pool table [0x8169E080] and the three pools; (2) implement real LwMutex (attr/lockCount/holder, guest-held semantics per doc 3.3); (3) implement Sema/EventFlag/thread HLE with wake semantics; (4) implement the worker main loop dispatch per doc 4GN. | M508 | STATIC-RECOMP STAGE 6kp: 0x811731D8 IS A SHARED LOCK WRAPPER WITH 10+ CALLERS, SO WE NEED THE ENTRY LR TO DISCRIMINATE. Disassembly: `811731D8 push {r4,lr}; 811731DA bl 0x811732EE; ...` - a pure wrapper that forwards r0 to the LwMutex chain. | M516 | ★★★★ STATIC-RECOMP STAGE 6kx: FOUND THE REAL ROOT CAUSE - A GENERATOR BUG: SHIFTED-REGISTER ADD IS TRANSLATED WITH THE SHIFT LOST ("+2" INSTEAD OF "*17"). The probes: `[D3A6] r8=846968A4 [r8+4]=846968C0 r9=00000000 (n=1)` / `r9=00000001 (n=2)` and `[D3B2] r0_out=846968C0 r1=00000000 sb=00000000 (n=1)` / `r0_out=846968C2 r1=00000002 sb=00000001 (n=2)`. So [r8+4] is stable (0x846968C0); the difference comes purely from r9 (sb) = 0 vs 1 multiplied by 2: r0 = base + sb*2. BUT the actual instruction at 0x8115D3AA is `add.w r1,sb,sb,lsl #4` = sb + (sb<<4) = sb*17, NOT sb*2! And the generated code for blk_8115D3A6 is `s->r[1] = s->r[9] + s->r[9];` - the `lsl #4` SHIFT OPERAND IS LOST. So the AOT generator drops the shift on register-shifted ADD (and likely other shifted-register ALU ops), producing sb*2 instead of sb*17 -> the array index is wrong -> the container pointer lands 2 bytes off (and would be much more wrong for larger sb) -> [obj+4] read from a misaligned address -> 0x1F8469 garbage -> BADMEM. This is a CORE GENERATOR BUG (like the earlier id_reg LR bug), not a game/object issue. FIX: in _gen_split.py, when emitting shifted-register ALU instructions (`add.w Rd,Rn,Rm,lsl #N` etc), apply the shift to the Rm operand: `s->r[d] = s->r[n] + (s->r[m] << N)` (and analogously for lsr/asr/ror and for sub/and/orr/eor). | M562 | ★★★ STATIC-RECOMP STAGE 6m7: THE CALLBACK SIGNATURE IS FULLY CLARIFIED - IT IS `(opcode, arg1, OBJECT)` WITH THE OBJECT IN r2, AND THE LOOKUP CALLER PASSES (4, 0, 0) - A DOUBLE MISMATCH. Full disassembly of 0x8116F3C6: `8116F3C6 push {r4,lr}; 8116F3C8 adds r1,r0,#0 (r1 = arg0 = OPCODE); 8116F3CA adds r0,r2,#0 (r0 = arg2 = OBJECT); 8116F3CC cmp r1,#1; ble return0; cmp r1,#2; ble return0; cmp r1,#3; bgt return0 (only opcode 3 proceeds); 8116F3D8 bl 0x81016818 (accessor on the OBJECT); 8116F3DC ldr r0,[r0,#0xC]; 8116F3DE bl 0x8116F45E; return 0`. So the callback API is `cb(opcode, arg1, object)` and it dereferences [object+0xC]. The lookup caller 0x81016404 does `movs r0,#4; movs r1,#0; movs r2,#0; blx cb` -> opcode=4 (rejected) AND object=0 (would assert even for opcode 3). The crash at va=0 block=0x811EAB44 is inside FUN_811EA552 (size 4148), which uses the GLOBAL BSS structure at **0x816CBC08**; field +0x304 (0x816CBF0C) is the base of a **slot array with 0x60 stride** (blocks 0x811EAB1E/0x811EAB44 do `r1=[r9]; r0=[r1]` and then pass it to HLE stub 0x812B1660). Probes show r9=0x816CBF0C at entry but [0x816CBF0C]=0, so `ldr r1,[r0]` faults at va=0. The slot array is filled by the pool helper at **0x811EB6BA**: it computes r7=0x816CBF0C, r5=0x816CBEB4, r6=0x816CBF10, walks 0x60-strided slots while [r7]==0, and on a free slot calls HLE stub 0x812B1200 (0x811EB6EC), calls game fn 0x81207874, then writes the buffer pointer with `wr32([r7], r4)` at 0x811EB702. | M601 | ★★★ STATIC-RECOMP STAGE 6na: DISPATCH-SITE ARCHAEOLOGY + ALL gsc+0x304 WRITER CANDIDATES PROVEN UNREACHABLE - THE WRITER LIVES IN A BOOT/SCHEDULER STEP WE NEVER EXECUTE. The harness contains THREE dispatch sites: site1 (nested exec helper, `RecState* s` pointer), site2 (hle_thr_pump thread runner), and site3 (main loop, `RecState s` value). Previous probe scripts only ever inserted at sites 1&2, so main-loop execution was invisible to those probes - that is now corrected (site3 probes added). | M604 | ★★★★★ STATIC-RECOMP STAGE 6nd: TWO NEW ROOT CAUSES FIXED - MISSING memalign HLE AND THE AOT ldm/stm BASE-OVERWRITE GENERATOR BUG. (1) The crash at FUN_811C0D74 was NOT an allocator OOM: the caller 0x811C17DC tried `memalign(align, 0x200000)` through the chain 0x811C17DC -> 0x811DA53C -> 0x811E6A10 -> blx 0x812B2340 (documented in M100 as SceLibc memalign NID 0xA9363E6B), and our harness had NO case for 0x812B2340, so it returned 0; the allocator-init then received base=0 and crashed writing `[r0+8]`. Evidence: `[ALLOC] enter r0=00000000 r1=00200000 lr=811C180E`, `[BIGALLOC] n=0020001C -> 84796A40` (the plain malloc DID succeed), `[C1804] r0=00000000 r5=00200000 lr=811E6A16 blk=811DA542`. FIX: implement memalign (case 0x812B2340: align-aware bump allocation, 16-byte minimum). RESULT: the 0x811C0DA8 crash is GONE and execution moves to a new area: `[BADMEM] guest va=0x00000004 unmapped block=0x812615AC ring_va=00000004: 81279194 8127918A ...`. (2) Investigating 0x812615AC exposed a NEW AOT GENERATOR BUG: for `ldm r0,{r0,r1}` (block 0x812615AC: `movw r0,#0xfb00; movt r0,#0x8153; ldm r0,{r0,r1}`) the generator emitted `r0 = [0x8153FB00]; r1 = [r0+4]` - the base register was OVERWRITTEN before the second word load - plus a spurious writeback `r0 += 8` even though the instruction has no `!`. The bogus second load reads address 0x00000004 exactly as observed. FIX in _gen_batch2.py: ldm/stm now capture the base in a temp `_lb`/`_sb`, load/store all words from the ORIGINAL base, and only perform writeback when `!` is present in the instruction. 26 batches regenerated (backup _gen_batch2_4144.py). | M612 | ★★★★★ FIRST FULLY CRASH-FREE 10,000,000-BLOCK RUN - HLE __stack_chk_fail NOW EMULATES THE CALLER'S EPILOGUE RETURN INSTEAD OF FALLING THROUGH. The canary mismatch from M611 (block 0x811E5928 start-stub stack init overwriting the saved-canary slot A0DFFFDC of the live 0x812067A0 frame) made the game call `__stack_chk_fail` (HLE 0x812B2810). Previously the stub returned normally, so execution fell through the two nops into the NEXT function with r0=0 and crashed at [r0+0x80]. On a real Vita the canary never fails, so the correct host behaviour for this artifact is to make the check harmless: the HLE case now reads the caller frame at sp+0xC (push {{r4,r5,lr}} after sub sp,#0xC), restores r4/r5, restores the saved LR, sets sp += 0x18 and returns r0=0 with PC = saved LR - i.e. it emulates a normal function return and the game continues. RESULT (10M run): **exit=0, ZERO BADMEM lines**, title assets loaded (CPKNAME=25), 20 worker threads (THR=20); `[STKFIX] emulate epilogue: sp=A0DFFFD8 frame=A0DFFFE4 saved_lr=81198BEE saved_r4=811E5CEA saved_r5=84836750 fib=84836750` repeats consistently. | M615 | ★★★★★ THE appGxModel.c:809 ASSERT IS BYPASSED - THE MISSING [ABORTSKIP] WAS ON A FOURTH DISPATCH LOOP (THE FIBER2 PUMP); 10M BLOCKS NOW RUN IN 26 s WITH ZERO BADMEM, BUT THE MAIN THREAD IS STUCK IN A SCHEDULER POLL LOOP. Discovery: the harness has a FOURTH block-dispatch loop - the fiber2 pump `while (budget-- > 0) { uint32_t ppc = s.r[15]; BlockFn f2fn = gbn(ppc); ... }` (line ~2249) - and it had NO [ABORTSKIP] and no probes. The old ABORTSKIP lines (at the old dispatch sites) had become dead code after the many probe insertions; re-adding `if (pc == 0x8115F9D0) r0 = 0` to the three main sites did NOT stop the assert, proving the crash came through the fiber2 pump. Adding [ABORTSKIP3] to that 4th loop fixed it: 3M run exit=0 with ZERO BADMEM (24 s), then 10M run **exit=0, ZERO BADMEM, CPKNAME=25, THR=20, CHKFIX2=333, wall 26 s**. However the PROG trace shows the MAIN thread cycling `pc=812068D2 last_block=812068C6 sp=82EFFE68` and `pc=8120686C last_block=812B1B70` (HLE sceFiberGetSelf), i.e. it is stuck in the game's scheduler polling loop waiting for a task/loader that never finishes (GXM is still 0). | M616 | ★★★★ SCHEDULER POLL LOOP BROKEN: FORCING THE PENDING FIBER TO RUN AND PUBLISHING ITS COMPLETION BIT LETS THE MAIN THREAD LEAVE FUN_8120683C; EXECUTION ADVANCES AND THE CRASH MOVES TO A SWITCH-RESUME MID-FUNCTION ENTRY. Analysis of the poll loop (FUN_8120683C, the game's fiber scheduler step): `r5` = scheduler context / waiting fiber = **0x848467F0 (fiber2!)**, `[r5+0x80]=1` (active bit, completion bit2 NOT set), `[r5+0x94]=0` (no next fiber), global run queue `[0x816CC620]=0 / [0x816CC624]=0`; the loop at 0x8120685A calls sceFiberGetSelf and re-checks `[r5+0x80]&2`, so it spins forever because (a) the run queue has no next fiber and (b) fiber2's completion bit is never published. [SPOLL] probe evidence: `pc=812068C6/812068D6 r5=848467F0 r0=0 f80=00000001 f94=00000000 g18=0 g1c=0 fib=0 fex=0 fl=2`. FIX (harness orchestration): when the main thread hits the scheduler idle poll (0x812068D8), [SCHEDRUN] loads and runs the pending fiber (`fiber_load + fiber_exec_to_completion + fiber_restore_thread`, fiber 0x848467F0 entry 0x81198C0B arg 0x82EFFF28), then [SCHEDRUN2] publishes the completion bit `[fiber+0x80] |= 2` (the existing FINBIT only fires on the pc==0 return path, which this fiber does not use). RESULT: the scheduler loop is left (`[SCHEDRUN] fiber=848467F0 ret=0000000A done bit2-set`), CHKFIX2 drops from 16,482 to **0**, and the crash moves to `[BADMEM] guest va=0 unmapped block=0x8120682A ring 8127B8AE 8127B8BC` - block 0x8120682A uses r5 before any prologue set it (r5 should be 0x812B414C from 0x812067A4), i.e. a fiber switch-resume entered the function mid-way. | M617 | ★★★★ FIBER1 LOADER LOOP DECODED AND BROKEN - IT IS A SKIP-LOAD SPIN ON `[0x816CC630] & 2`; CLEARING THE BIT EXITS THE LOOP AND THE MAIN THREAD RETURNS. The loop is: fiber1 entry 0x81198BE8 (LOADER LOOP, cf. M236) -> `0x81198BF2: bl 0x812067A0` (fiber mgr) -> `0x81198BF6: r0=[0x816CC630]; r0&=2; if (r0!=0) return 0x81198BEA (loop); else return 0x81198C06`. [LP2] probe proof (repeating cycle): `blk=81198BF2 r0=0 -> blk=8120682A (passes canary check) -> blk=81206832 -> blk=81198BF6 r0=00000002 -> blk=81198BF2 ...`, `sp=A0DFFFF0 fib=84836750`. Bit1 of the global 0x816CC630 = 'load in progress' flag, so the loader loop spins forever when the load never completes in our HLE. FIX (workaround): [LOADCLEAR] at block 0x81198BF6 - after 500 iterations clear bit1 in [0x816CC630]. RESULT: `[LOADCLEAR] cleared bit1 at 0x816CC630 (iters=502) -> 00000000 fib=84836750`; the loader loop exits and the 3M run completes in **5 s** with exit=0, ZERO BADMEM, CHKFIX2=0, GXM=12 (the GXM surface-init calls that the fiber2 task performed), THR=20. After that the MAIN THREAD RETURNS: PROG shows `pc=00000000 last_block=81206C5C sp=A0E00000` - the game's main thread finished and the harness idles because nothing drives the remaining fiber/frame work. | M618 | ★★★ DIAGNOSTIC: AFTER THE MAIN THREAD RETURNS THE MAIN LOOP'S `nxt` BECOMES 0 BUT THE DISPATCH `pc` STAYS NON-ZERO, SO THE HARNESS KEEPS SPINNING WITHOUT EXECUTING THE POST-MAIN FIBER/RENDER WORK. With the M617 loader-loop workaround active, the run prints `[PROG] ... pc=00000000 last_block=81206C5C sp=A0E00000` for every 5000-block sample. However a dedicated probe inserted at the main-loop post-main hook shows `[PC0PROBE]` NEVER fires, i.e. in the main-loop body the variable `pc` is not 0/0xFFFFFFF0 when `fn(&s)` returns 0 - the PROG line prints the **`nxt`** (return value of the block function), not `pc`. So when a block returns 0 the loop does not take a clean exit path; it keeps iterating with a stale non-zero `pc`/fn and burns the budget (PROG count 600/600 at pc=0 for the whole 3M run, 5 s). | M620 | ★★★★ THRARG FIX: HLE StartThread MUST COPY THE ARGUMENT BLOCK OUT OF THE CREATOR'S STACK FRAME. The 0x8127C1D2 crash was traced live: `[THR2] create tid=4001A000 entry=8127C1D3 lr=8127BF18 sp=A05FFB38` then `[THR2] start tid=4001A000 entry=8127C1D3 arglen=4 argp=A05FFB48 lr=8127BF3C`. Disassembly of the creator shows exactly the standard Vita pattern: at 0x8127BED0 `str r8,[sp,#0x10]`, then `8127BF34 movs r1,#4; 8127BF36 add r2,sp,#0x10; 8127BF38 blx 0x812B2940` - i.e. argp = &(creator's local slot holding r8), and the thread entry does `ldr r1,[r1]` to recover that pointer. Our HLE passed the creator's raw stack address to the new thread, but the new thread only ran later (quantum scheduling) - by then the creator's frame had been reused/zeroed, so [argp]=0 and the entry crashed at [r1+4]=va=4. FIX: HLE StartThread now copies `arglen` bytes from argp into a private hle_malloc buffer and passes that buffer. RESULT: `[THRARG] copied arglen=4 argp=A05FFB48 -> 84B7D830 val0=816A0B10` (17 copies total for all thread types), and the entry now runs correctly: `[C1D2] enter r0=00000004 r1=84B7D830 ...` then `[C1D2] pre pc=8127B3A2 r0=816A0AC0 r1=816A0B10` - the va=4 crash is GONE. The next crash is different and higher-level: `[HLE-BADMEM] hle access va=9FE00000 blk=812B1B80 ring: 811F0B0A 811F0B14 811F0B22 81207352 812B2...` - the thread now calls sceFiberRun (HLE 0x812B1B80) with an invalid fiber address (0x9FE00000), from the new 0x811F0xxx area. Decoded the loader loop at 0x811EFF92: it iterates 34 entries (r8 0..0x22, table stride 0x48 at 0x815142F0) and for each does `r0=[program]` -> `0x812B1530` (sceGxmShaderPatcherGetProgramFromId, NID 0xA949A803) -> `0x812B12A0(program, name)` (sceGxmProgramFindParameterByName, NID 0x277794C4) -> if param!=0 `0x812B1270(param)` (sceGxmProgramParameterGetCategory, NID 0x1997DC17) and keeps the param when category==1. FIX: HLE cases - 0x812B1530 returns a cached fake program object (hle_malloc 0x60), 0x812B12A0 returns a cached fake parameter object (hle_malloc 0x40, field +0x10=1), 0x812B1270 returns category 1. | M630 | ★★★★★ TWO AOT/HLE BUGS FIXED THAT WERE BLOCKING FIBER2: (1) ldrex/strex MEMORY-OPERAND EMISSION was silently dropped in the generator (produced an INFINITE SPIN LOOP at 0x81207290), and (2) SceLibc calloc (HLE 0x812B23E0, NID 0xE7EC3D0B) was unimplemented and returned 0 -> game dereferenced [0+0x98]. AFTER THE FIXES: 3M and 8M runs finish exit=0 with ZERO BADMEM and the game progresses deep into render/GxModel initialization. (1) Evidence: the generated block `blk_81207290` only did `r2=r1+1; cmp r3,#0; bne 0x81207290` - the ldrex at 0x81207290 and strex at 0x81207296 were dropped because their memory operand made `isr(1)`/`isr(2)` fail, so `r3` (the strex status) kept its old non-zero value and the retry loop never exited (10M blocks stuck at pc=0x81207290). FIX in _gen_batch2.py: `ldrex Rt,[Rn]` uses ops[1].MEM.base and `strex Rd,Rt,[Rn]` uses ops[2].MEM.base. Generated code is now `s->r[1]=rd32(s,s->r[0]); r2=r1+1; wr32(s,s->r[0],r2); s->r[3]=0; cmp r3,#0; bne` - the loop exits correctly. (2) Evidence: `[NX9A] r0=00000000 ... ring: ... 811E6A28 812B23E0 811E6A2E ...` at crash block 0x81182C9A (`wr32(s, s->r[5]+0x98, ...)` with r5=0). Docs identify 0x812B23E0 = SceLibc NID 0xE7EC3D0B; the call site passes (n=1, sz=0x200)/(n=0x160, sz=1) - it is calloc. Implemented HLE case 0x812B23E0: `calloc(nmemb,size)` -> hle_malloc(nmemb*size) (zeroed). RESULT: `[CALLOC] n=160 sz=1 -> 85003D50`, `[CALLOC] n=1 sz=200 -> 85003DF0`; 3M run exit=0 / 30 s / ZERO BADMEM; 8M run exit=0 / 30 s / ZERO BADMEM. | M634 | ★★★ PUMP-DURING-FIBER EXPERIMENT REVERTED: ALLOWING hle_thr_pump() TO RUN WORKER THREADS WHILE A FIBER EXECUTES (DEPTH<=1) TURNED THE 8M RUN INTO A >10 MINUTE LIVELOCK, SO THE ORIGINAL GUARD WAS RESTORED. Motivation: fiber2's poll loop calls DelayThread/CheckCallback and yields between fibers entirely inside ONE HLE call, so the main loop never regains control and `hle_thr_pump` (which only runs from the main loop every 0x1FF blocks, and returns early when `g_in_fiber_exec || g_cur_fiber`) starves the worker threads that are supposed to advance the wait object's state. Experiment: relax the guard to `g_in_fex > 1`, clear g_cur_fiber/g_in_fiber_exec around the pump, and call `hle_thr_pump(s, 200)` from inside the fiber_exec loop every 256 blocks. RESULT: the run did not finish within 600 s (previous 8M baseline was 30 s) - the thread pumping inside fiber context livelocks (threads and fibers compete for the same RecState / HLE state). REVERT: restored `if (g_cur_thr || g_in_fiber_exec || g_cur_fiber) return;` and removed the in-exec pump call; 3M run is exit=0 / ZERO BADMEM / flags=00000002 / GXM=12 / frames=0 again. NOTE: current 3M wall time is 113 s (the earlier baseline was 30 s) - likely because the extra per-block probes (FLPROBE/W8C8/F2BLK/FRAMEDUMP) and the heavier fiber ping-pong path; verify/trim on the next round before drawing speed conclusions. | M636 | ★★★★ ROOT OF THE [obj+4] ← obj+0x2C WRITE FOUND: IT IS THE HARNESS'S OWN OLD [INJECT] WORKAROUND (fake CPK load-request chain at n==20000), NOT GUEST CODE - AND THE INJECTION IS NOW DISABLED. The 20000-block block in main() builds a fake load-request chain via hle_malloc(0x2c+256) with layout `+0 flags, +4 name ptr, +8 -1, +0xc/+0x10/+0x14 payload, +0x20 -1, +0x24 prev, +0x28 next, +0x2c name buffer` and writes `f[8] = {0, nameptr=node+0x2c, 0xFFFFFFFF, ...}` - so `[node+4] = node+0x2C` exactly matches `[WWRITE] old=00000000 new=85003D7C n=20001 addr=85003D54` (the object at 0x85003D50 was an injected node, size 0x12C). That is why the guest wr32 watch never saw it (M635): the store is host-side, in the harness injection code. Since the CPK HLE loader is real now (CPKNAME=25), the injection is obsolete and potentially harmful (fake nodes enter the game's load queue). Disabled it (`if (false && n == 20000)`, marker 18.4176). RESULT: 3M run exit=0, ZERO BADMEM, `flags=00000002` stable, INJECT=0, but fiber2 STILL polls `[obj+4]==3` at 0x811830CC (the wait object is a real game object, not the injected node; [W8C8] did not fire within 3M blocks). | M639 | ★★★★★ STALL WATCHDOG REVEALS THE REAL ARCHITECTURAL BLOCKER: THE ENTIRE FIBER WORLD RUNS INSIDE ONE NESTED HLE CALL, SO THE MAIN LOOP NEVER ADVANCES AND WORKER THREADS CAN NEVER RUN. Added a detached host watchdog thread ([WD], every 2 s) that dumps the block counter, current block/fiber/thread, the last 12 HLE calls and the PC ring. With the UNCOND3 diagnostic active the run stalls at **n = 2,710,912 frozen** (stall counter 8..13 while wall time kept going): the watchdog prints `[WD] n=2710912 blk=811830CC/811830D6/8120760C/812B2A50 fib=84846860 thr=00000000 stall=13` and the HLE ring is dominated by `812B2A50@81207612` repeated (sceKernelDelayThread called from 0x81207612) with `[PMP2B] ppc=8120760C r0=00007530 sp=A05FFDA8` / `[PMP2C] nx=811830DE r0=0`. The PC ring cycles the fiber1 lifecycle, the fiber2 delay wait and the scheduler blocks (81198BF6/811E5CDA/812067A0/812B1B70 and 811830CC/811830D6/8120760C/812B2A50 and 8120682A/81206832), i.e. both fibers keep ping-ponging forever inside one HLE call while the main-loop block counter does not move. That is why worker threads (and thus the state producers) are starved, and why the frame counter [0x816CC630+0xC] stays 0 even after the wait state is forced. NEXT: implement a controlled UNWIND from the nested fiber execution back to the main loop (cooperative yield-to-main: on every Nth fiber yield set a flag, save the fiber contexts, return a sentinel from fiber_exec_to_completion through the HLE frames, let the main loop run one hle_thr_pump quantum, then re-enter the fiber world from the saved context). | M661 | ★★★★ OLD GXM BACKEND INTEGRATION FEASIBILITY CONFIRMED: (a) `src/gxm/texture_format.cpp` compiles cleanly with MinGW g++ (`-std=c++17 -Isrc -Isrc/common -Isrc/loader -Isrc/gxm -Ithird_party/vulkan/include`, exit=0); (b) Vulkan headers present at `third_party/vulkan/include/vulkan/vulkan.h`; (c) the old backend exposes a usable public API (`p5d::vulkan::begin_frame()`, `end_frame()`, `present_frame(colorData)`, `materialize_fragment_textures(const void* const controls[16])`, plus `g_backend` state). ABI convention decoded from `src/gxm/sce_gxm.cpp`: the old HLE handlers receive **host pointers directly** (`sceGxmTextureInitLinear(SceGxmTexture texture,...) { p5d_gxm_pack_texture((SceUInt8*)texture, ...); }` - it writes through the pointer), so the old interpreter's import bridge pre-translated guest VAs to host pointers; our adapter must therefore translate RecState args via GP() before calling the typed function and write back r0. Dependencies of the backend: `mem::translate/contains` (19 uses in gxm), `common/log.h`, Windows/Vulkan, and helper functions in sce_gxm.cpp (`p5d_gxm_pack_texture`, `p5d_gxm_fill_fragment_controls`, `gxm_draw_arrays`). Integration recipe: (1) build `sce_gxm.cpp + vulkan_backend.cpp + texture_format.cpp` into the static-AOT harness; (2) implement a `mem::translate` shim over `GP()` and register the guest image as a region; (3) generate per-function ABI wrappers from `src/gxm/sce_gxm.h` prototypes (pointer args -> GP(), ints passthrough, return -> r0) and route the harness's 0x812B1xxx GXM stubs through `_gxm_table.csv` to these wrappers; (4) initialize the backend from the harness and call begin/end/present at the game's frames; (5) keep stubs only for unimplemented functions. This replaces the current dummy GXM objects with real ones and should remove the null +0x20 chain at its source. | §18.4201 | ★★★★ old GXM backend integration feasibility confirmed (a) src/gxm/texture_format.cpp compiles cleanly MinGW g++ -std=c++17 -Isrc -Isrc/common -Isrc/loader -Isrc/gxm -Ithird_party/vulkan/include exit=0 (b) Vulkan headers present third_party/vulkan/include/vulkan/vulkan.h (c) public API p5d::vulkan::begin_frame() end_frame() present_frame(colorData) materialize_fragment_textures(const void* const controls[16]) g_backend state; | M664 | ★★★★ THE OLD GXM→VULKAN BACKEND IS NOW **LINKED INTO THE STATIC-AOT HARNESS**: compiled 5 modules to objects (`gxm_sce.o` 86KB from sce_gxm.cpp; `gxm_vk.o` 300KB from vulkan_backend.cpp with `-include cmath`; `gxm_tex.o`; `mem_addrspace.o` 51KB; `common_log.o`) and linked them with `recomp_harness.cpp + batch_*.o -lvulkan-1 -lgdi32 -luser32` -> **link exit=0, exe 54,564,375 bytes**. The 5 required bridge symbols are now implemented in the harness (`p5d_last_exec_pc()` = g_cur_block; `p5d_guest_lr()`, `p5d_guest_reg(int)`, `p5d_t_since_start()`, `p5d_t_mark(const char*)` with a [VKMARK] log) and `common/log.cpp` provides `g_log_level`. SMOKE TEST REVEALED A CRITICAL PATHOLOGY: the 30M run produced a **1.4 GB stdout log** with `[NULLDESC]` appearing **2,947,635 times in the first 3M lines** - the NULLDESC guard (skip the null-descriptor length provider 0x811DE912 and return 0) turns a crash into an **infinite retry loop** (the loader's conversion/wait path retries forever because the skipped call never delivers the data it waits for); the run hangs, no progress. This is direct empirical proof of the M660 conclusion: the semantic patch stack (XSKIP/REFNULL/NULLOBJ/RET1/RETFAM/DUMMYPROG/NULLDESC) converts crashes into hangs and must be replaced by correct state, not extended. The backend itself was dormant and is not the cause (no GXM call routed into it yet). NEXT: (1) revert the semantic patch stack to a clean baseline (only AOT/HLE correctness fixes kept), documenting each removed guard; (2) investigate the wait condition at the caller of 0x811DE912 / the conversion path so the real data producer runs (rather than skipping); (3) then wire the GXM HLE stubs through _gxm_table.csv + ABI wrappers to the newly linked backend, initialize it, and let real objects replace dummy ones. | §18.4204 | ★★★★ old GXM->Vulkan backend now LINKED into static-AOT harness: compiled 5 modules gxm_sce.o 86KB sce_gxm.cpp gxm_vk.o 300KB vulkan_backend.cpp -include cmath gxm_tex.o mem_addrspace.o 51KB common_log.o; | M666 | ★★★★★ THE FIVE GAME ASSERTS ARE DECODED - **ALL OF THEM ARE "SINGLETON ALREADY NON-ZERO ON INIT" (DOUBLE-INITIALIZATION) CHECKS**, i.e. our run calls the same init functions twice. (1) HLE formatter 0x812B2280 extended: now formats `%d/%i/%u/%x/%X/%c/%%` in addition to `%s` (consumes up to 8 args from r2,r3, then [sp..]), so assert messages now show exact **file:line**. (2) Captured assert sites: `appAllocatorHandler.c:187`, `appPad.c:235`, `appTouch.c:439`, `appGxScene.c:347`, `appGxEffect.c:476`. (3) Disassembly of the assert sites (thumb, from p5d_true.elf + func_srcfile.tsv mapping): `appPad.c:235` in FUN_8116e63c: `r5=0x813AFC0C; ldr r0,[r5]; cbz r0->ok; else assert` -> asserts when **[0x813AFC0C] != 0**; `appTouch.c:439` in FUN_8117339c: `sl=0x813AFCDC; ldr r0,[sl]; cbz r0->ok; else assert` -> asserts when **[0x813AFCDC] != 0**; `appAllocatorHandler.c:187` in FUN_8115d5e2: `r1=[0x813AF830]; cbz r1->ok; else assert` -> asserts when **[0x813AF830] != 0**; `appGxScene.c:347` in FUN_81008222: `r0=[0x81328B08]; cbz r0->ok; else assert` -> asserts when **[0x81328B08] != 0**. So all four relevant asserts fire because a manager/scene singleton is **already initialized** when the init function runs again - the run performs a double initialization (boot/init path executed twice), not because an HLE call failed. This is a much more specific root cause than "input HLE missing" and points at the harness boot/scheduling (the game's init sequence runs twice: likely both fiber1 and fiber2 boot paths, or a restart of the app after the first init). NEXT: watch writes to the four singleton globals (0x813AFC0C, 0x813AFCDC, 0x813AF830, 0x81328B08) with pc/lr, find the two init call sites, then fix the boot so app init runs exactly once. | §18.4206 | ★★★★★ five game asserts decoded all are singleton already non-zero on init double-initialization checks our run calls same init functions twice; (1) HLE formatter 0x812B2280 extended now formats %d/%i/%u/%x/%X/%c/%% in addition to %s consumes up to 8 args from r2,r3 then sp assert messages now show exact file:line; (2) captured assert sites appAllocatorHandler.c:187 appPad.c:235 appTouch.c:439 appGxScene.c:347 appGxEffect.c:476; (3) disassembly appPad.c:235 FUN_8116e63c r5=0x813AFC0C ldr r0,[r5] cbz ok else assert asserts when [0x813AFC0C]!=0; appTouch.c:439 FUN_8117339c sl=0x813AFCDC ldr r0,[sl] cbz ok else assert asserts when [0x813AFCDC]!=0; appAllocatorHandler.c:187 FUN_8115d5e2 r1=[0x813AF830] cbz ok else assert asserts when [0x813AF830]!=0; appGxScene.c:347 FUN_81008222 r0=[0x81328B08] cbz ok else assert asserts when [0x81328B08]!=0; all four asserts fire because manager/scene singleton already initialized when init function runs again run performs double initialization boot/init path executed twice not because HLE call failed; much more specific root cause than input HLE missing points at harness boot/scheduling game init sequence runs twice likely both fiber1 and fiber2 boot paths or restart of app after first init; NEXT watch writes to four singleton globals 0x813AFC0C 0x813AFCDC 0x813AF830 0x81328B08 with pc/lr find two init call sites fix boot so app init runs exactly once || M666 | ★★★★★ THE FIVE GAME ASSERTS ARE DECODED - **ALL OF THEM ARE "SINGLETON ALREADY NON-ZERO ON INIT" (DOUBLE-INITIALIZATION) CHECKS**, i.e. our run calls the same init functions twice. | M668 | ★★★★★ THE DOUBLE-INITIALIZATION ROOT CAUSE IS FOUND AND FIXED: the **fiber2 pump loop was force-resetting fiber2's context to its user entry on the first pump pass, re-executing the entire app-init sequence a second time**. Evidence (with a new `g_loop_site` dispatch-loop tag): `[INITW] initEntry-A-336 #1 loop=0 ...` then `#2 loop=3` - the same init entry ran once in dispatch loop 0 (fiber_exec) and once in loop 3 (fiber2 pump), both from the same caller `lr=0x81198C18` and same fiber `0x84846860`. The pump code at the pump start did: `f1=g_cur_fiber; save f1; f2=other; if (pump_first || c2.r[15]==0) { force-reset c2 to entry 0x81198C0A }` - so even though fiber2 had already executed and its context was saved, the first pump discarded it and re-ran from the entry, replaying init (this is what triggered all five \"singleton already initialized\" asserts). FIX (18.4208 (note b)): record the last fiber whose context was genuinely saved by execution (`g_f2_seen = g_cur_fiber` in the fiber save path), and only force-reset when the fiber has NOT actually run: `const bool f2_ran = (g_f2_seen == f2); if ((pump_first && !f2_ran) || c2.r[15] == 0u) { reset } else { resume saved ctx; pump_first = 0; }`. RESULT (30M run, clean baseline + assert HLE + fix): `[PMP2] fiber2 RESUME saved ctx pc=8120766A (f2_ran=1)` / `pc=811E5EE8` / `pc=811E5ECE`; **init sequence runs exactly once**; **ALL FIVE ASSERTS DISAPPEAR**; the run advances past them to a new, later blocker: `[BADMEM] guest va=0x00000002 block=0x81207344` - block `81207344: push {r4,lr}; ldr r0,[r0]; movs r1,#1; movs r2,#0; blx 0x812B2830; pop {r4,pc}` is called with an invalid object pointer **r0=2** (guest VA 0x2), i.e. a small handle/index value used as a pointer - the next root cause to chase. | §18.4208 | ★★★★★ double-initialization root cause found and fixed fiber2 pump loop was force-resetting fiber2 context to user entry on first pump pass re-executing app-init second time; | M669 | ★★★★ DETERMINISTIC PUMP SCHEDULING + FIRST CAPTURE OF THE r0=2 BAD DISPATCH. (1) The pump pass had a **wall-clock budget** (`>80 ms -> break`), which made interleaving depend on machine load - the same binary produced different blockers on different runs (va=2 at `0x81207344` vs va=0 at `0x8120682A`). Changed it to **block-count-only by default** (`g_pump_wallclock`, `P5D_PUMP_WALLCLOCK=1` restores old behavior); two consecutive 30M runs are now **bit-identical** (34,635 stdout lines, same blocker, same pc ring). (2) First capture of the bad dispatch (probe added to the post-pump re-dispatch path `pc = s.r[15]; probe; fn = gbn(pc)`): `[H7344]-BAD pc=81207344 r0=00000002 r1=812B4150 r2=0 r3=848367C0 lr=81198BEE sp=A0DFFBA0 fib=848367C0 loop=3` - the faulting block is reached from the **restored fiber1 context** (pc=0x81207344, lr=0x81198BEE) with r0=2. (3) Semantics of the faulting guest code: `0x81207344: push {r4,lr}; ldr r0,[r0]; movs r1,#1; movs r2,#0; blx 0x812B2830; pop {r4,pc}` where `0x812B2830` = **sceKernelLockLwMutex** HLE (harness `case 0x812B2830u: r0 = 0;`) - so it is a lock-mutex wrapper that expects a mutex-object pointer in r0; r0=2 is invalid. The loader helper `0x811E5CDA` (`push {r4,lr}; ldr r0,[0x81513DEC]; cbz; blx r0; pop`) is its likely invocation path. Static value of the callback global `[0x81513DEC]` in `p5d_true.elf` is **0x811E5929** (not 0x81207344), so either the saved fiber context is inconsistent (restored pc/lr pair from mid-callback) or the global got clobbered; this is the next thing to verify. | M670 | ★★★★★ **THE r0=2 CORRUPTION SOURCE IS PINPOINTED: A FIBER SWITCH THAT HAPPENS INSIDE THE PUMP PASS**, AND ITS BAD CONTEXT IS SAVED AS fiber2's `f2_pc=0x81207344`. Instrumentation added: (a) **pre-pump context snapshot** `FCtx f1_pre` taken right after saving the suspended fiber at pump start, and restore now uses the snapshot instead of a possibly-clobbered `g_fctx[f1]` (18.4210); (b) diagnostics print `pre_pc/pre_lr/pre_r0/pre_sp`, the restored pc, the loader callback `[0x81513DEC]`, and `f2_pc`; (c) a `[PUMPSW]` guard so the pump **stops the pass when `g_fiber_switch_to`/`g_fiber_flag_return` is armed** instead of silently dropping the request. Captured restore log: n=1..12 all normal (`pre_pc=81198BF2 pre_lr=81198BEE pre_r0=2 pre_sp=A0DFFFF0 restored_pc=81198BF2 cb=811E5929 f2_pc=8120766A`); n=13 `pre_pc=81207612 pre_lr=81207648 pre_r0=A0D7FD90 ... f2_pc=81207344`; n=14 **`pre_pc=81207344 pre_lr=81198BEE pre_r0=00000002 pre_sp=A0DFFFF0 ... f2_pc=81207612`** - i.e. after one pump pass the **fiber2 saved context already has pc=0x81207344**, and the next pump start captures that same pc as the main fiber's snapshot, after which the bad block executes and BADMEMs (va=2). `[PUMPSW] stop pump pass: switch_to=84846860 flag_return=0 ppc=8120766A` proves a **fiber switch to f1 (0x84846860) is requested inside the pump**, which is why the pump writes a wrong context into the fiber table.
