| M671 | ★★★★ EFFICIENCY INFRASTRUCTURE: ONE-COMMAND SYMBOLIZED DIAGNOSTICS + DETERMINISTIC CHECKPOINT REGRESSION, AND THE KEY DISCOVERY THAT A **2M-BLOCK RUN (12 s) REPRODUCES THE SAME BLOCKER AS THE 30M RUN (110 s)**. Bottlenecks measured: (a) every 30M validation run cost ~110 s; (b) each round hand-wrote one-off Python log parsers (~5-10 min); (c) non-determinism (M669, fixed) forced repeated runs. New tooling: **`tools/diag.py`** (one command: parses harness stdout/stderr, groups `[INITW]`/`[ASSERT]`/`[BADMEM]`/`[CRASH]`/`[PUMPSW]`/`[H7344]`/`[GXM]`/`[FRAMEDUMP]`, symbolizes every address via `func_index.tsv`/`function_bounds.json` (function+original source file), takes the last `[WD] pcring`, and thumb-disassembles the first BADMEM block; prints in ~2 s or `--json` for CI); **`tools/run_checkpoints.py`** (runs the harness at fixed block counts with clean env — hacks off, wall-clock off — extracts a structured snapshot: exit code, init counts, asserts, GXM, framectr, BADMEM va/block list, pcring hash (sha256), last line; compares against `C:\dev\tmp\_chk\baseline.json`; `--update` writes the baseline; stdout line count compared with a small tolerance because an aborting process may lose a few buffered tail lines). Validated: `run_checkpoints.py --only 2000000` = 11.6-12.0 s, repeated runs PASS with identical pcring hash `b7547b75ad50a6d0`, identical badmem `va=0x2 block=0x81207344`, init counts all 1, asserts 0. The 2M checkpoint already hits the same M670 blocker, so the **debug iteration loop drops from ~110 s + manual analysis (~10-15 min) to ~12 s run + ~2 s diag (~15 s total, ~20-40x faster)**; 30M runs are now reserved for milestone validation. Efficiency rules adopted: use the 2M checkpoint for blocker matching, never write ad-hoc parsers (use diag.py), every fix must pass checkpoint regression, batch probes per run, and prefer porting empirically-validated semantics from the old runtime (`C:\dev\p5dsrc\src`) over re-deriving them. | §18.4211 | ★★★★ efficiency infrastructure one-command symbolized diagnostics + deterministic checkpoint regression and key discovery 2M-block run 12s reproduces same blocker as 30M run 110s; Changes: HLE `sceFiberSwitch`/`sceFiberRun` main-loop paths no longer call `fiber_exec_to_completion` (old nested-exec path kept behind `P5D_FIBER_NESTED=1`); the two round-robin nested-exec hacks are disabled; the main loop now consumes a deferred switch after each block (`[MSW]`, 18.4213, saves current fiber context, loads/rebuilds target context, sets pc). So the crash is fixed but **sceFiberSwitch now returns immediately instead of suspending the caller until it is switched back** (old runtime: n_fiber_switch saves only at the call site with pc=svc+2 and sets force_npc; the SVC wrapper does not return r0 in the new context) - the guest scheduler/loader fiber is therefore not being driven correctly. | M674 | ★★★★ FIBER-SCHEDULING A/B COMPLETED: (a) default **pure deferral** mode is crash-free through **100M blocks** (exit=0, zero BADMEM, 41 s) but GXM=0 and the guest spins in the app main loop (`pc=0x8127B950 blk=0x8127C0F8`, [T682A] 119k, PUMPSW ppc=0x812B1BA0); (b) old **nested fiber_exec** mode (`P5D_FIBER_NESTED=1`) still reaches **GXM=12** but crashes again (`BADMEM va=0 block=0x8120682A` ring `... 812B2A50 812068D8 ... 8120682A ... 81198BEA`). | M678 | ★★★★ ALL LEGACY NESTED-EXEC PATHS ARE NOW CUTOFF-GATED, YET THE HYBRID CRASH IS UNCHANGED - AND THE NEW EVIDENCE SHOWS IT IS **NOT A NESTED EXEC ANYMORE**. Gated the last ungated nested execs: `sceFiberGetSelf`'s one-time `[PUMP]` (fiber2 run-to-completion) and its periodic `[PUMP2]` (every 20000 ticks) now require `nested_allowed()` (18.4221); the frame-slot nested exec was already `if (false)` disabled. Hybrid 30M (cutoff 1.5M) result: **identical** - `GXM=12`, `BADMEM va=0 block=0x8120682A`, `ctx: in_fex=0 in_fiber_exec=1 cur=848367C0 blk=8120682A total=1891302 r5=0 r7=0`. | M680 | ★★★★★ THE TWO HIGH-RISK GENERATOR DEFECTS FOUND BY THE AOT DIFFERENTIAL TESTS ARE FIXED AND VERIFIED: (1) **ADC/SBC** now use the correct first operand (3-register form uses `Rn`, not `Rd`), a **64-bit carry chain** (`uint64_t _t = (uint64_t)_a + (uint64_t)_b + _c`, carry-out = `_t>>32`), SBC borrow via `_a >= _b2` with `_b2 = _b + (1-_c)`, and **only S variants update flags** (non-S `adc.w`/`sbc.w` no longer clobber APSR); ADC/SBC S-flags are now computed inline (N/Z/C/V incl. correct V from `(a^r)&(b2^r)`); (2) **IT-block conditional execution** now works: `_gen_split.py` gained `emit_cond()` which uses capstone's effective per-instruction condition `ins.cc` (EQ=1..LE=14, AL=15) and wraps the emitted statement list in `if (cond_x(s)) { ... }`; `it` itself emits nothing. A first attempt returned a STRING instead of the list that `emit()` returns, which produced char-interleaved garbage (`' i f   ( c o n d _ e q ...'`); corrected to return a one-element list. REGENERATION: `py -3 _gen_split.py 500 4` -> `compiled: 26/26 ok in 417.0 s`, 26 batch files, 666,045 lines, total obj 66,733,195 B. REGRESSION RUN (new batch objects, hybrid boot + R5HOIST): `100M: exit=0, BADMEM=0, GXM=12, init all 1, asserts=0` (124 s) - the generator fix introduced no regression; the post-boot stall is unchanged (`pc=00000000 blk=81206832 sp=A0E00008 fib=848367C0`, `[PCRING] 8120682A 81206832` repeating, framectr=0), so the stall is a scheduler/context issue, not instruction semantics. (2) Root: the canary epilogue 0x8120682A ran with a frame belonging to another context - `[682A-SKIP] sp=A0DFFFF0 [sp+4]=81206BEC canary=812B4150 lr=81198BEE fib=848367C0` - so the compare failed and the `__stack_chk_fail` repair-and-retry path looped forever. | M684 | ★★★★ SCHED-ANALYST REPORT DELIVERED AND ITS P0-B/P0-C/P0-D RECOMMENDATIONS APPLIED - FIBER SWITCHING COMES BACK TO LIFE. Report `docs/SCHED_SPIN_ANALYSIS.md` (490 lines, read-only) found three root layers: (1) `hle_thr_pump` was gated (`g_in_fiber_exec||g_cur_fiber`, harness:2255) so guest worker threads starved; the 1.5M nested boot actually dies at **0x8127BE36 `sceKernelSetEventFlag(0x60016000)` wait spin** (log line 11301); (2) `fiber_load` fabricated `[fiber+0x80] |= 1` (harness:1189-1193), but the guest scheduler 0x812067A0 reads **bit0 as "finished"** and unlinks the current fiber, so the other fiber's switch target degenerates to self and `beq 0x8120682A` skips sceFiberSwitch forever; (3) former patches ([SCHEDRUN] fake completion, [MAINRET] wrong context, 682A-SKIP swallowing errors, DelayThread non-nested no-op, GetSelf returning dummy at thread level). Applied: **P0-B**: the `[fiber+0x80]|=1` fabrication is now OFF by default (`P5D_FACTBIT=1` restores) - `[GSELF]` now reports `f1 st=00000000 f2 st=00000000` (was st=3) and `[FSW]` shows real switches again (16 with lr=8120682A); **P0-C**: DelayThread now yields on EVERY call (removed `&0x3F` gating); **P0-D trial**: GetThreadId 0x100->0x4001 made the guest deref `tid+2` -> `[BADMEM] va=0x4003`; 0x100 -> `va=0x102`, proving the guest uses the result as a **pointer base**; final: return a real guest TLS-like object from `hle_malloc(0x80)` -> **BADMEM=0**. 30M result: `exit=0, BADMEM=0, GXM=12, FSW=16`, and a NEW fiber appears (`fib=848468E0`), but `gxm(b/e/p)=0/0/0` and `framectr=0`: the loop now runs `812B27B0 8120765C 81207660 812067A0 812B1B70 812067B6 8120680E 81206810 8120681C 81206820 8120682A 81206832 81207664 812B2A50 ...` (GetThreadId -> scheduler -> GetSelf -> canary epilogue -> DelayThread). | M685 | ★★★ M684-MILE★ TWO "OBVIOUS" SCHEDULER FIXES WERE TRIED AND BOTH WERE PROVEN UNSAFE; REVERTED TO THE VERIFIED M684 BASELINE (negative-result milestone). Experiment A (P0-A `hle_thr_pump` in the fiber world): (a) gate reduced to only `g_cur_thr` -> 30M full-nested boot: **GXM=0** (boot broke before GXM init) and the 8120682A/81206832 livelock returned; (b) gate allowed only after `g_blkcnt_total >= 1.5M` -> GXM=12 restored but **BADMEM=2** ([BADMEM] va=0x00000008 at block 0x811C0DA8, ring: 811C0D74/811C0D86/811C0DA8 allocator paths) - running guest worker threads from inside the fiber world corrupts their context/heap. Experiment B (LwMutex live-write semantics per old runtime: create zeroes work 0x20, lock writes work+4/work+8, unlock reverses): also produced **BADMEM va=8** and later GXM=0/fib=0 - the work pointer/offsets do not match what this guest expects here (previous M684 pure-return stubs were non-corrupting). | M708 | §18.4253: ★★★★ THE 4 GB BYTE-SWAP LOOP IS CAUSED BY **EMPTY TYPE-3 RING-BUFFER READERS** WHOSE `FUN_811DE912` READ RETURNS `-1` (0xFFFFFFFF) AND THE CALLER USES IT AS A WORD COUNT. New `[RBUF]` probe (5M host-thread run) caught **5 such reader objects**: `obj=84C0A5F0 / 84F2BD20 / 8831CE20 / 8B70DF20 / 8C3BF320`, all with `f10=0003` (type 3), `f12=0001` (flag valid), `f18=0, f1c=0, f20=0` (empty ring) and `ret=FFFFFFFF`. So the readers exist and are marked valid, but their ring buffers were never filled - the data-loading/fill path is missing or failing. `FUN_811DEAB4` (the caller function that uses these readers) has **26 call sites** (`8119C204, 8119C252, 8119C2CC, 8119C694, 8119C70A, 811AB252, 811AB2D8, 811ABBC2, 811B7CD8, 811B7D72, ...`) - likely the GFD/GSC resource decode path. Default cooperative config stable: `30M: exit=0, BADMEM=0, GXM=12, FSW=16`. NEXT: symbolize `FUN_811DEAB4` and its 26 callers to identify the subsystem (GFD resource / file stream); find the object creation site (5 objects, same layout) and which fill/read function should set `[obj+0x18]/[obj+0x1C]`; then implement/repair that HLE load-fill path so the readers contain data and the endian conversion proceeds correctly. |
| M709 | §18.4254: ★★★★★ EMPTY RING-BUFFER READER TRACED TO A **CPK/FILE RECORD LOADER WHOSE INDIRECT CALLS THROUGH GUEST FUNCTION-POINTER GLOBALS 0x81513DD4/DD8/DE0/DE4/DE8 RETURN 0**. (3) The wrappers `0x811E5C66/0x811E5C98` are **indirect calls through guest globals** `[0x81513DD4]/[0x81513DD8]/[0x81513DE0]/[0x81513DE4]/[0x81513DE8]` (`ldr r4,[0x81513DD4]; blx r4`), which are populated by init code around `0x811E5C0A`/`0x811E5BEA` with stub addresses - i.e. an import/function-pointer table. In this run the indirect call returns 0 and writes nothing (`[sp+4]` stays 0), so the 0xC-byte ring params are all zero, the reader is born empty, and the factory's own initial read/byteswap path enters the 4 GB loop. (4) So the missing link is whichever HLE stub is installed at `[0x81513DE0]` - it must be a read/lookup returning actual record data. Fixing the divergence should finally marry load and read: likely the default run's block at `0x8120764C` (calls GetThreadId HLE 0x812B27B0 then loops) is a **thread wait/join** that our model makes unsatisfiable, while the host-thread model satisfies the join but orders the file-load after the main fiber already passed the load point. NEXT: disassemble the `0x8120764C` function around the GetThreadId call to identify the wait/join semantics (is the main thread waiting for Gfd/Cri worker threads to exit?), then either implement the wait correctly (so default boot proceeds past the join into the reader path with the loaded preset buffer) or reorder the host-thread scheduling so the Fios preset load runs before reader creation. |

| M720 | §18.4265: ★★★★★ FOUND A **DEAD FEATURE**: `g_thrpump_env` (the "pump guest worker threads from inside the fiber world" switch used by earlier milestones) was **NEVER ASSIGNED** - there is no `getenv("P5D_THRPUMP")` parse in the harness, so `hle_thr_pump()` always returns early in the default cooperative mode (`if (g_in_fiber_exec && !g_thrpump_env) return;`), and the worker threads (Gfd/Cri) can never run while the main flow is inside the app fiber. Fixed the wiring: added the missing `P5D_THRPUMP` env parse (`g_thrpump_env = getenv("P5D_THRPUMP") != 0`) and re-tested with `P5D_THRPUMP=1 P5D_NESTED_UNTIL=1500000`: the pump now DOES run from the fiber world (`[THRYIELD] DelayThread -> pump thr (thr count=7)`, and the main loop leaves the pure-wait pattern), but the run **crashes early** at n≈260,000 with `[BADMEM] guest va=0x00000000 block=0x811EAAE4 tid=0 stub=812B1BA0`, ring saturated with `0x811EB04E`, exit code 3 - i.e. naive fiber-world pumping is not re-entrancy-safe (nested pump while `g_in_fiber_exec`, thread contexts run inside the fiber machinery and corrupt the exec/fiber state / run with a zero PC). Default config (without the env) is unchanged and stable: `30M: exit=0, guest/HLE BADMEM=0, GXM=12, FSW=16`. NEXT: harden `hle_thr_pump` for fiber-world calls - (a) add a pump depth/re-entrancy guard, (b) save/restore `g_in_fiber_exec`/`g_cur_fiber`/`g_thr_blocked` around the pumped thread slices, (c) validate/repair thread `ctx.r[15]` (zero PC -> entry) and `base`/`mem_size` before running, (d) bound the pump iteration count and never pump recursively; then re-run default+THRPUMP=1 and check whether the flag clears, `[RDR]` appears, and the boot advances toward the render loop. |

| M732 | §18.4277: ★★★★★ **ROOT CAUSE OF THE FINAL BOOT PLATEAU FOUND: AOT TBH JUMP-TABLE TARGETS ARE NOT BLOCK LEADERS, SO `id_tbh` FALLS BACK TO THE CONTAINING BLOCK AND RE-EXECUTES THE PRECEDING STATE-WRITE WITH GARBAGE r0.** (1) 16-bit write instrumentation delivered: added `wr16_watch()` to all 26 `batch_*.cpp` preludes + the generator prelude (the generated code now calls `if (g_watch_on) wr16_watch(a,v)` before the 2-byte store) and rebuilt all 26 batches (`Start-Job` x6, 400 s, 0 failures), linked harness OK. `[W16]` now shows the exact Fios task state transitions. (2) Trace: task 0x84BF3870 = `1 -> 2 -> 4 -> 7 -> 0x13FC -> 6`; task 0x8284B980 = `1 -> 2 -> 4 -> 7 -> 0x13FC -> 6 -> 0x13FC`; the `0x13FC` writes are tagged `blk=0x811E5A6A` and `blk=0x811E5A9C` with r0=0x13FC (a stale HLE/op value), so the task state ends as 0x13FC and the `0x811E5EC2` wait loop never sees 6 -> plateau. (3) Mechanism decoded: the Fios state machine dispatches via `tbh` at `0x811E597E`; the real table (base `Align4(tbh+4)=0x811E5982`) maps state 0..8 to `0x811E5994, 0x811E5998, 0x811E59EC, 0x811E5A36, 0x811E5A56, 0x811E5A62, 0x811E5A9E, 0x811E5A6C, 0x811E5AB0`. Several of those targets are **mid-block** in the generated code (e.g. state7 target 0x811E5A6C lies inside block 0x811E5A6A, state6 target 0x811E5A9E inside block 0x811E5A9C) because the generator emitted leaders ~2-4 bytes early (observed leaders 0x811E5A68/0x811E5A6A/0x811E5A9C instead of the true table targets). At runtime `id_tbh` computes the correct target, fails `gbn(t)`, then `gbn_back` backs up 2..16 bytes and executes the containing block **from its start** - which re-executes `strh r0,[r6,#2]` with the current r0 (0x13FC) instead of the value the preceding instruction set. This is a general AOT correctness bug for any table dispatch whose target is not a leader (TBH/TBB/indirect), not only Fios. (4) Fix plan: fix `_gen_split.py` TBH/TBB leader derivation (use `Align4(tbh_pc+4)` as base and add every computed table target as a block leader), regenerate 26 batches + rebuild (~10 min), then verify state trace reaches 6 exactly and the wait loop exits. VERIFIED: default 30M after batch rebuild `exit=0, BADMEM=0, GXM=12, FSW=16`; pump 30M `exit=0, BADMEM=0`; `[W16]` active (7 writes in default, 13 with pump). |
| M733 | §18.4278: ★★★★★ **AOT TBH/TBB TABLE-TARGET FIX LANDED: THE GENERATOR NOW EMITS THE REAL TABLE TARGETS AS BLOCK LEADERS - THE Fios STATE CORRUPTION IS GONE (clean `1->2->4->7->6`, zero `0x13FC`).** Root cause was a base-convention mismatch: the **runtime** `id_tbh()` correctly uses `base = insn_pc + 4` (18.3835 fix, verified 0x811E597E -> base 0x811E5982, entries 9/11/53/...), but the **generator's leader-derivation loop** still used `base = (insn_pc + 4) & ~3` (= 0x811E5980, one entry early), so it added the WRONG targets (e.g. 0x811E5A68/5A6A/5A9C) and the real target blocks did not exist; at runtime `id_tbh` produced the right target, `gbn(t)` failed, and `gbn_back` executed the containing block from its start, re-running `strh r0,[r6,#2]` with stale r0=0x13FC (M732 finding). | M746 | §18.4291: ★★★★★ **ROOT CAUSE OF THE WAIT-LOOP CORRUPTION FOUND: THE HELPER `0x81207632`'s STACK-CANARY CHECK FAILS EVERY ITERATION, AND OUR HLE `__stack_chk_fail` (0x812B2810) RETURNS INSTEAD OF ABORTING, SO THE FAIL PATH FALLS THROUGH WITHOUT RESTORING THE FRAME - LEAKING 0x18 BYTES AND CLOBBERING r4 PER WAIT-LOOP ITERATION.** New `[EC6-START]`/`[EC6-SPCHG]` probes on the wait-loop block 0x811E5EC6 show this even in DEFAULT mode: start `sp=A0D7FDA8 lr=8120766A r4=84BF3870 (task 1)` then every loop iteration `sp` decreases by **0x18** (`A0D7FDA8 -> A0D7FD90 -> A0D7FD78 -> ... -> A0D7FBC8`) and `r4` changes from the task to `0x84600000` (the GetThreadId TLS object). This single emulation gap explains: the sp drift by 0x18/iteration, the r4 corruption, the later `[WLEC6]` invalid-frame entries (`sp=A0D7FDB8`, `[sp]=0`, `[sp+4]=0x003E7B24`), and the epilogue `pop {r4,pc}` returning GSC-data 0x003E7B24 as PC once the pumped state reaches 6. In default mode the loop only leaks (state 0, no bad return) which is why `[ODDPC]=0` there. VERIFIED: default 30M `exit=0, GXM=12, FSW=16, BADMEM=0`; lp+wemu 30M `exit=0, BADMEM=0, HLE-BADMEM=13`. NEXT: (a) instrument 0x81207632's canary store/check (value, slot address, sp) and find what overwrites the slot (the mismatch must be fixed at the source); (b) make HLE `__stack_chk_fail` at least log loudly (or abort) so silent fall-through cannot mask stack corruption; (c) after the fix, the wait-loop iterations should keep a stable sp and task r4, and the epilogue should pop the real saved LR. |

| M789 | §18.4334: ★★★★ **FIRST NOFN ROOT CAUSE FOUND AND FIXED - IT WAS A **TAIL BRANCH INTO THE UNTRANSLATED CANARY-CHECKED EPILOGUE** OF A LARGE FUNCTION: block `0x8103228A` ends with an unconditional `return 0x81032CC8u`, and `0x81032CC8` is the shared epilogue `movs r0,#1; r2=[sp+0x40]; r1=[0x812B414C]; cmp; bne 0x81032CE4; add sp,#0x44; vpop {s16-s25}; pop {r4,r5,r6,r7,r8,sb,sl,fp,pc}` - this epilogue lies OUTSIDE the recorded function bounds, so it had no block and the dispatch fell through to `[NOFN] pc=81032CC8` (and then the recovery cascade produced the stale-stack NOFNs at 0x812EFD78 etc.). NEW HALT (next bug): `[HEAPTGT] nxt=85C6A0E0 blk=8117692A ... lr=811840F0 ...` then `[NOFN] unknown pc=85C6A0E0` - block `0x8117692A` (a `pop {r4,r5,r6,r7,r8,pc}`-style epilogue) popped a **heap pointer `0x85C6A0E0`** (points near the font/char data served by our EPROV provider) as its return address; the log right before it also shows `[CHKFIX2] repair canary at sp=A05FFF38 ... failpc_lr=81153D06` and `[MAINRET] main returned ... resume fiber pc=81176916`, i.e. the harness had to repair a guest stack-canary mismatch just before. So the remaining problem is a **stack-frame/canary inconsistency around the 0x811769xx call path**, not a missing block. | M870 | §18.4415: ★★★★★ **THE CRI ATOM "INSUFFICIENT BUFFER SIZE" IS AN OFF-BY-ONE: criAtom_Initialize REQUIRES `0x00020190` BUT THE GAME PASSES `0x0002018F`, AND THAT `-1` COMES FROM A FAILED DSP WORK-SIZE CALCULATION.** Runtime proof (`[CRIREQ]` probe at the check block): `pc=81224958 n=1717 r1=00020190 r6=0002018F` - at `0x81224958: cmp r1,r6; ble 0x81224A52` (r1 = required, r6 = provided); since 0x20190 > 0x2018F it falls through and logs `E2009072703:Insufficient buffer size.` then aborts criAtom init. | M872 | §18.4417: ★★★★★ **FOUND AND FIXED A FUNDAMENTAL AOT BUG: ALL THUMB PC-RELATIVE LITERAL LOADS WERE TRANSLATED AS `rd32(s, s->r[15] + imm)` INSTEAD OF `rd32(s, Align(instr_addr+4,4) + imm)` - 486 OCCURRENCES ACROSS 22 BATCHES REWRITTEN TO CONSTANT LITERAL ADDRESSES AND ALL 32 BATCHES RECOMPILED.** Symptom (under `P5D_NGS=1`): `[BADMEM] guest va=0x0A01ED9A unmapped block=0x812243D8` right after `criFs_Initialize` succeeded; the generated block was `static uint32_t blk_812243CC(...) { ... vfp_s_bits_set(...); s->r[1] = rd32(s, s->r[15] + 0x0u); ... }` and at runtime `s->r[15]` held the block PC (0x812243CC) so the load read the *instruction word* `0x0A01ED9A` instead of the literal at `0x812243D4` (`0x8153F2C0`), then the following `vstr s0,[r1]` wrote to `0x0A01ED9A` -> BADMEM/abort. Root cause: generator `_gen_batch2.py` maps capstone `ARM_REG_PC` to `s->r[15]` verbatim; correct Thumb semantics for `ldr/ldrd/ldr.w Rt,[pc,#imm]` is address = `Align(instr_address+4,4) + imm` (ARM: `instr+8+imm`). WRITE-BACK FIX: new local tool `_pc_rel_fix.py` parses every batch, for each `blk_XXXX` containing `s->r[15]` disassembles the ELF from the block start to the next block, pairs the k-th `[pc` instruction with the k-th `s->r[15]` expression (counts must match, else skipped), computes the literal VA and rewrites the C++ statement to `rd32(s, 0x<literal>u)`. Result: **486 occurrences patched in 22 of 32 batches** (residual 26 in batch_026 are data-as-code/UNSUPPORTED-instruction blocks, e.g. 0x81147B04 has a too-small disasm window - left for a second pass); all 32 batch .o recompiled (`g++ -std=c++17 -O2 -I. -c`). VALIDATION: default (P5D_NGS unset) 30M **green**: `exit=0, [TABLE] blocks=229791, GXM=12, FSW=16, FRAMEDUMP=6000, NOFN=0, ASSERT=0, BADMEM=0`, `done: blocks=30000000 pc=81206894`. With `P5D_NGS=1` 30M: **exit=0 (the 0x812243D8 crash is gone), ZERO CRI error logs (previously E2009072703/E2010052671/binder-not-init), `[CONSUME] FIOS-opens=12288` (previously 0)** -> criFs_Initialize + CRI FS binder + real Fios opens now work. BUT the 130M FASTSLEEP run with `P5D_NGS=1` stalls in early boot: `[FRAMEDUMP] n=130,000,000 flags=00000002 t4=0 t8=0 ctr=0`, `[SEQST]` h=0 at every 5M sample through n=130M, pc pinned in the fiber/scheduler loop `81206894 812068A0 812068AC 812068BC 812068D8 8120685A 812B1B70 ...` - i.e. with the NGS shim active something blocks before the boot movie/scene chain starts (likely an NGS/audio thread or sema dependency our shim does not satisfy, or `sceSysmoduleIsLoaded` returning 1 changes module init flow). NEXT: debug the NGS-enabled early stall: add thread/fiber dumps + wait-object probes for the 812068xx scheduler loop, diff against the default 130M run (which still shows frames), and refine the SceNgs/SceAudio HLE (IsLoaded semantics, system init handle, Update/lock calls seen in the HLE histogram 812B2020/812B1FF0/812B2080) until the NGS-enabled boot follows the normal path -> then title. |

| M881 | §18.4426: ★★★★★ **APP 启动调用链与两个 fiber 入口解出：`main` = `FUN_811982BC`（blk=2 执行）→ `FUN_81159CE4`（blk=12 执行，app boot/电影大函数）→ 0x81159DC2 调用 `FUN_811989C8`（app main 包装）**。`FUN_811989C8`(238B) 反编译：`DAT_816CC628=FUN_812B27B0()`（当前线程 id 存全局）、memset `DAT_816CBC08` 0xA24、`FUN_812B1860(DAT_813B1F04/DAT_813B1F06)`、`FUN_812B1910(...)`，然后 `if (FUN_81198E2E(param_1) != 0) { uVar2=FUN_81206700(0x81198BE9, 0, DAT_816CDA70); uVar3=FUN_81206700(0x81198C0B, param_1, DAT_816CDA70); DAT_816CC630|=2; FUN_81206BA8(); FUN_8120683C(uVar2,0); FUN_8120690E(uVar2); FUN_8120683C(uVar3,&local_88); FUN_8120690E(uVar3); exit(local_88); }` —— 即 **app main 创建两个 fiber（入口 0x81198BE9 与 0x81198C0B）、先跑 A 再跑 B、最后 exit(out)**；`FUN_8120683C(fiber,out)` 是"跑单个 fiber 到完成"的帮助函数（循环 `while ((fiber->flags@+0x80 & 2)==0)`，内部处理 fiber 链表 +0x94/+0x98、完成后写 `fiber+0x90` 到 out）；`FUN_812067A0` = 当前 fiber 完成处理（置位 `+0x80 |= 2`、从 `DAT_816CC624/620` 链表摘除、`sceFiberSwitch` 到下一个）；`FUN_8120690E` = 销毁 fiber。**关键负结果**：探针 `[FIBENT]` 显示在 LWM=1 25M 运行中 `main`(0x811982BC) 在 blk=2、`FUN_81159CE4` 在 blk=12 被执行，但 **`FUN_811989C8` 从未执行，两条 fiber 入口（0x81198BE9/0x81198C0B）也从未执行** → app main 卡在 `FUN_81159CE4` 内部的 boot 阶段（init 任务在 blk≈1.5M 完成后它没有走到 0x81159DC2 调用点），这正好解释了 LWM=1 路径"init 完成后系统空转"。NEXT: 反编译 `FUN_81159CE4`（大函数，0x81159CE4 起）在 0x81159DC2 之前的逻辑：它在 init 任务完成后等待什么（电影/boot 完成事件？某个状态标志/回调），以及缺失的 HLE/未置位状态；把这一个门打通即可进入 `FUN_811989C8` → 两个 app fiber → boot page/标题。 |

| M883 | §18.4428: ★★★★★ **fiber 对象映射解出 + 两个关键负结果**：(1) `[FINIT]` 日志给出真实映射：**`84836300` = fiber A（guest 字段 +0x84 目标入口 `0x81198BE9`，+0x88 arg=0）、`848463A0` = fiber B（+0x84=`0x81198C0B`，+0x88 arg=`82EFFF28`）**；两者都通过 `_sceFiberInitializeImpl`（HLE 0x812B1BB0）以 **SceFiber trampoline 入口 `0x81206BDD`** 创建（FINIT: `entry=81206BDD arg=fiber_self`），fiber 栈 base/size 也记录成功（`848363A0+0x10000` / `84846440+0x10000`）。(2) `[SCHEDRUN]`（legacy hack，pc=0x812068D8 触发）正在**反复运行 fiber B（848463A0）8 次**并打印 `done bit2-set`；`[FINBIT]` 只发布在 **fiber B**（`fiber=848463A0 [fiber+0x80]|=2`）。但主线程真正等待的 `FUN_8120683C(fiberA=84836300)` 的完成位从未被置位。(3) 尝试修复：把 FINBIT 同时发布到 `exec_origin_fiber`（本应=fiber A）——**结果日志无变化，仍只有 fiber B 的 FINBIT**，说明观察到的 pc==0 完成事件里 `exec_origin_fiber == g_cur_fiber == 848463A0`（即该次 nested exec 本来就是 fiber B），**fiber A 的完成没有走 pc==0 路径**。(4) 负结果：`[S6BD]` 探针（0x81206BDC/DE）0 命中 → **SceFiber trampoline 0x81206BDD 在 8M 块内从未执行**；`[S683C]` 探针显示 FUN_8120683C 入口块在 n=1721 执行时 `r0=0, r1=0, lr=81198A88`（= FUN_811989C8 中 0x81198A84 调用之后）——即 `FUN_8120683C(uVar2=0, 0)` 被调用（`FUN_81206700` 的返回值被当作 fiber 参数传入为 0），且无 BADMEM。NEXT: 查清 FUN_8120683C 的第一个参数约定（0 是否表示"跑所有 fiber"/或 FUN_81206700 应返回 fiber 指针）、以及 trampoline 0x81206BDD 为何未执行（fiber A 实际从哪个 pc 开始跑：日志中 blk 2007→1.5M 的 init 执行归属哪个 fiber 上下文），再决定修 HLE 还是修调度；修复目标仍是让 FUN_8120683C 返回 → FUN_811989C8 跑 fiber B → app main。 |
| M884 | §18.4429: ★★★★★ **关键探针推翻 M883 的误导：`FUN_8120683C` 被正确调用为 `FUN_8120683C(fiberA=84836300, out=0)`（`[ENTRYARG] pc=8120683C r0=84836300 r1=0 r2=0 r3=848463A0 lr=81198A88`，r3 就是 fiber B 指针，留给第二次调用）**；同时 `[EXECSTART]` 揭示两条 fiber 的真实启动方式：**fiber A 从 SceFiber trampoline `0x81206BDC` 启动**（`fib=84836300 pc=81206BDC sp=84846390 r0=84836300 lr=FFFFFFF0`，即正确进入 trampoline，FUN_81206700 先填 +0x84=0x81198BE9 再由 trampoline 调用），而 **fiber B 是被 legacy SCHEDRUN hack 直接从目标入口 `0x81198C0A` 启动**（`sp=A0D80000`，跳过 trampoline 与完成处理）。`FUN_81206700` 完整反编译：`sz=max(0x400,align8(stackSize)); fiber=alloc(sz+0xa0); fiber[0x84]=entry; fiber[0x80]=0; fiber[0x88]=arg; fiber[0x8c]=fiber+0xa0; rc=_sceFiberInitializeImpl(fiber,"gfdFiber",0x81206BDD,fiber,fiber+0xa0,sz,0,0x3570000);` 成功则挂入链表（`DAT_816CC624`=head、`DAT_816CC620`=tail，`+0x94`=next、`+0x98`=prev），失败则 free 后返回 0。现有 `[FINBIT]` 只落在 fiber B（848463A0），说明 **fiber A 的 trampoline 在跑完 1.5M 块 init 后，其完成流程（trampoline → FUN_812067A0 置 fiberA[0x80]|=2 → sceFiberReturnToThread）没有把完成位留在 fiber A 上**（或完成时 g_cur_fiber 已切到 B），导致主线程 `FUN_8120683C(fiberA)` 的 `while ((fiberA[0x80]&2)==0)` 永不退出。NEXT: 在 nested 执行里对 `FUN_812067A0`(0x812067A0) 入口和 `sceFiberReturnToThread`(0x812B1B60) 加日志，并周期打印两 fiber 的 `+0x80` 标志（尤其 fiber A 在 blk≈1.5M 前后的变化），定位完成位丢失点；修好后 FUN_8120683C 返回 → FUN_811989C8 跑 fiber B（0x81198C0B）→ app main。 |
| M885 | §18.4430: ★★★★★★ **突破性修复：guest fiber 对象缺少 RUNNING 位（bit0）导致 fiber A 完成永不报告——在 `fiber_load` 里给 guest fiber 对象 `+0x80 |= 1` 后，整条 app 启动链打通：fiber A 完成位变 `00000003`（bit0+bit2）、`FUN_8120683C(fiberA)` 返回（pc 序列 `8120683C → 812068F4/812068FC/81206904`）、主线程执行 `FUN_8120690E` 后开始跑 fiber B，**fiber B 真正执行 app 主代码**（`[FRAMEDUMP] fib=848463A0 sp=A0D7FD28 pc=811EFFC4/811C3FB8/811D9F9E/811EF7CC...`，JOB/SEQST 推进到 n=5M），直到 n≈5.15M 在 **GXM 图形初始化**处崩溃：`[BADMEM] guest va=0x00000000 unmapped block=0x811A7D7C stub=812B1300`，调用链 `812B1420 → 811EB1CE → 812B1300 → 811EB1EE → 812076B4/76C0/7712 → 811EB1FC/811EB208 → 811A7D7C`。根因分析（对照 FUN_812067A0 反编译）：其"置完成位 `fiber[0x80] |= 2` + 摘链"整块都在 `if ((fiber[0x80] & 1) != 0)` 内——**bit0=RUNNING 必须由系统库在 fiber 开始运行时置位**；我们的 HLE 从未置 bit0，所以 fiber A 跑完 1.5M 块 init 后 FUN_812067A0 只执行了"切下一个 fiber"分支，完成位从未写回 → 主线程 `while ((fiberA[0x80]&2)==0)` 死等（M882/M884 现象）。修复代码：`fiber_load()` 开头 `if (fiber) { GP(fiber+0x80) |= 1; }`（18.4430）。崩溃点 GXM 桩 NID 映射：`0x812B1300 = SceGxm 0x3EB3380B`（sceGxmCreateContext）、`0x812B1420 = SceGxm 0x814F61EB`（sceGxmCreateRenderTarget/Initialize 系）、`0x812B1270=0x1997DC17`、`0x812B12A0=0x277794C4`、`0x812B1370=0x5C79D59A`、`0x812B13A0=0x633CAA54`、`0x812B1530=0xA949A803`；这些 GXM 桩在 recomp_harness 里没有 case（`812B1300/812B1420` in harness=False），默认返回 0 → app 拿到 NULL context 后解引用崩溃。NEXT: 在 HLE 里补 SceGxm 的 create-context/render-target（返回有效句柄/结构，而不是 0），或把这些桩接到已有 GXM ABI 实现（gxm_abi/gxm_sce）；然后 app main 继续 → 第一帧绘制。 |
| M886 | §18.4431: ★★★★★ **崩溃点精确定位到 per-frame 渲染对象指针为空：`FUN_811A7D7C`(16B) = 对象访问器 `ldr.w r1,[r0,r1,lsl#2]; ldr r2,[r0,#0x18]; str r1,[r0,#0xc]; str r1,[r0,#0x10]; str r2,[r0,#0x14]; bx lr`，在 `FUN_811EA552`(4148B，app frame/init 大函数) 的 `0x811EB262: bl 0x811A7D7C` 处被调用，参数 `r0=[0x816CC66C]`、`r1=[0x816CC700]` **都是 0** → `[BADMEM] va=0x00000000 block=0x811A7D7C`。新增 `[GW]` 全局写入监视：`0x816CC700` 在 `blk=811EA93C` 被写 0（两次）；`0x816CC66C` 先在 `blk=811EB080` 写 `0x84602050`，随后在 `blk=811EB43C` **被清零**。两者都在 `FUN_811EA552` 内部——该函数是**每帧渲染流程**：先设置渲染对象指针（0x816CC66C=0x84602050），然后在末尾清理路径（0x811EB43C）复位为 0；随后同一函数的 `0x811EB262` 又读取它（此时已为 0）→ 空指针崩溃。另**修正 M885 的 GXM NID 猜测**（对照 gxm_abi.cpp 自动生成表）：`0x812B1300 = SceGxm 0x3EB3380B = sceGxmSetViewport`、`0x812B1420 = SceGxm 0x814F61EB = sceGxmSetViewportEnable`（不是 CreateContext/RenderTarget！）；`0x812B1270=0x1997DC17 ProgramParameterGetCategory`、`0x812B12A0=0x277794C4 ProgramFindParameterByName`、`0x812B1530=0xA949A803 ShaderPatcherGetProgramFromId`、`0x812B1370=0x5C79D59A ProgramParameterGetResourceIndex`、`0x812B13A0=0x633CAA54 ProgramFindParameterBySemantic`、`0x812B1290=0x207AF96B CreateRenderTarget`。harness 已经通过 `gxm_abi_lookup(stub_va)` / `gxm_abi_dispatch(stub_va, ...)`（harness 第 1312-1316 行）**把所有 GXM 桩路由到 gxm_abi.cpp 的自动生成实现**（很多已有真实语义），所以崩溃不是"缺桩返回 0"，而是某个 GXM 后端调用返回失败导致渲染对象指针没有被设置。NEXT: 在 gxm_abi_dispatch 处加"rv!=0 才打印"的日志（blk 范围 0x811EA800-0x811EB500），找出每帧渲染流程里返回失败的 GXM 函数并修其后端实现；让 0x816CC66C 在 0x811EB262 前保持有效 → app 帧继续 → 第一帧输出。 |
| M887 | §18.4432: ★★★★ **两个关键新事实**：(1) **必须开 `P5D_GXMABI=1` 才会把 GXM 桩路由到 gxm_abi.cpp 真实 ABI 实现**（harness 第 1311 行 `if (g_gxmabi)` 门控；之前 LWM=1 运行未开此 env，GXM 桩全部落到默认返回 0——M886 的"某 GXM 后端失败"分析因此修正：**开 GXMABI 后 GXM 初始化全部成功**：`sceGxmInitialize ret=0`、`GetNotificationRegion ret=0`、`MapMemory ret=0`（多段）、`MapFragmentUsseMemory ret=0`、**`sceGxmCreateContext ret=0`**、`GetRenderTargetMemSize ret=0`、**`sceGxmCreateRenderTarget ret=0`**（`[GXMABI]` 4000 条，`[GXMRV]` 失败=0）。(2) 新增 `[RPROBE]`（gbn 内、env `P5D_RENDERPROBE=1`）跟踪渲染路径全局：**`0x816CC66C` 在 `blk=414,583` 的块 `0x811EB080` 之前为 0（该块写入 `0x84602050`），随后在 `blk=1,868,162` 的块 `0x811EB43C`（清理/跳过路径）被清零**；之后才到达含 `bl 0x811A7D7C` 的块（块起点不是 0x811EB262，所以 0x811EB262 未单独出现在探针里）→ 读 `0x816CC66C=0` 崩溃。`g630` （0x816CC630）全程=2。说明：`FUN_811EA552` 内部在设置渲染对象后等待了约 145 万块（很可能是**显示/GPU 同步等待**）才走到清理路径 `0x811EB43C`，清理后控制流仍会经过使用该渲染对象的代码 → 空指针。NEXT: 在 `0x811EB068`（`ldr sb,[sp+0xbc]; ldr sb,[sb+4]; cmp sb,0; beq 0x811EB43C`）与 `0x811EB43C` 处打印 `sb`/`[sb+4]`/相关对象字段，并在 blk 区间 414K~1.87M 统计热块，确认这 145 万块是在哪个**等待/同步循环**（SceDisplay wait/present、GXM sync、Fios 任务）里耗掉的；把该等待行为修正/快速化后，清理路径不应被走到 → 渲染对象保持有效 → 第一帧。 |
| M888 | §18.4433: ★★★★★ **开启 `P5D_GXMABI=1` 后真实 Vulkan 后端首次跑起来**：stderr 日志出现 `[INFO] sceGxmInitialize called`、`[INFO] === Vulkan Backend Init with Window ===`、`Win32 window created HWND=...`、`Vulkan instance created`、`GPU: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5060 Laptop GPU`、`Selected GPU ... queue family=0`、`Vulkan: Creating logical device...`，以及真实内存注册 `[INFO] sceGxmMapMemory vaddr=0x9C700000 size=262144 flags=1 registered=0` 等——即**图形栈真的连上了 Vulkan**。同时发现 GXM 后端仍有桩：`[WARN] [STUB] sceGxmCreateRenderTarget called - NOT IMPLEMENTED`、`[WARN] [STUB] sceGxmSyncObjectCreate called - NOT IMPLEMENTED`、`[WARN] [STUB] sceGxmSetViewport called - NOT IMPLEMENTED`；但 ABI 层（gxm_abi.cpp `gxm_abi_call_207AF96B`）在 backend 输出为空时会**合成 opaque guest handle `0x85410000+`** 写入 out 参数，所以 CreateRenderTarget 仍返回成功。GXM 调用直方图（`out30m_m947gxmabi.txt`，前 4000 条采样）：28 个不同函数，热点是 **`sceGxmShaderPatcherGetProgramFromId` ×1918**、**`sceGxmProgramFindParameterByName` ×1877**（即 0x811EFF92 的 34 条目 loader 循环），其余 `ShaderPatcherRegisterProgram ×62`、`CreateFragmentProgram ×46`、`FindParameterBySemantic ×32` 等。崩溃位置不变：`blk=3,499,999` 处 `[BADMEM] va=0x0 block=0x811A7D7C`（fiber B=848463A0，`in_fiber_exec=1`，r0=[0x816CC66C]=0），M887 的 145 万块窗口（blk 414K~1.868M）很可能主要耗在 0x811EFF92 的 shader 参数解析循环上（而非显示等待）。NEXT: 统计 0x811EFF92 循环在 blk 414K~1.868M 窗口内的迭代次数与耗时块数；若是它，则优化 fake program/parameter 句柄的缓存（按 (program,name) 稳定返回、cache hit 快速路径），把 145 万块降到很小，使 FUN_811EA552 不再走清理路径 0x811EB43C → 渲染对象保持有效 → 第一帧。 |
| M889 | §18.4434: ★★★★★ **HOTPCS 热块直方图（blk 200K~1.2M 窗口）定位了 145 万块耗时的真实构成**：Top 热块 = `0x811EAAE4` **146,357 次**（FUN_811EA552 偏移 0x592 的循环体，绝对主导）、`0x811EB04E` **65,568 次**（FUN_811EA552 里 `strh r1,[lr],#2` 的 0xFFFF 次半字清零循环——本窗口内约等于跑满一整轮 128KB 清零）、`0x812B1530` **50,711 次**（sceGxmShaderPatcherGetProgramFromId HLE）、`0x812B12A0` **44,184 次**（sceGxmProgramFindParameterByName HLE）、`0x811C3FB8` 31,753（FUN_811C3F3E）、`0x811EFF92/9A/A0/A4/A6/AE` 各 ~28,100（FUN_811EFE9E 的 34 条目 shader 参数解析循环，合计 ~19.6 万块）、`0x811C3FB0/FEE` 各 ~26,700、`0x811C43B6/3AE/3EC` 各 ~1.3-1.8 万、`0x811EFB3E/B38/B42/B44/B4C/B30` 各 ~9,300（FUN_811EFA18）、`0x811D9F9E/FA4/FCA` 各 ~8,260（FUN_811D9F4A）。**结论：这 145 万块主要是 guest 自己的 34 条目渲染项循环（FUN_811EA552 的 0x811EAAE4 循环）+ 每项 128KB 清零 + shader 参数解析（GetProgramFromId/FindParameterByName 共 ~9.5 万次调用）**，不是显示/GPU 等待。新增/修正探针：`P5D_HOTPCS=1`（gbn 内统计窗口内 pc 频次，窗口 200K..1.2M，到 1.2M 打印 top25；修复了之前重复插入导致不打印的问题）。NEXT: 反编译 FUN_811EA552 偏移 0x592（0x811EAAE4）循环，确认它遍历的对象表与迭代次数；同时定位 `0x811EB068: ldr sb,[sp,#0xbc]; ldr sb,[sb,#4]; cmp sb,0; beq 0x811EB43C` 中 `[param_1+4]` 应由谁写入（在 FUN_811EA552 入口打印 r0=param_1，并监视 param_1+4 的写入时机/写入者）——该字段为 0 就跳过渲染初始化并清掉 0x816CC66C，是当前空指针崩溃的直接原因；若能在正确时机把它设上（或修正其写入者），渲染对象就不会被清理，第一帧即可继续。 |
| M890 | §18.4435: ★★★★★ **两条调用链证据锁定问题根源在 legacy SCHEDRUN hack 用合成栈强跑 fiber B**：(1) 新探针 `[EA552v4]`（job_probes 内）显示 `FUN_811EA552` 全部由 **`lr=0x811995BA`** 调用，分两类：前 3 次 `r0=82EFFF48`（主线程栈上的参数结构，`sp=848563F8`，`[param_1+4]=0x00200000` 非零 -> **走正常渲染初始化路径**，blk 414,501 时 `0x811EB080` 把 `0x816CC66C=0x84602050`）；后续 6 次 `r0=848463C0`（`sp=A0D7FFD0`——**合成栈**！`[param_1+4]=0` -> 走 `0x811EB068: beq 0x811EB43C` 清理路径，把 `0x816CC66C` 清零）——这些只发生在 legacy `[SCHEDRUN]` hack 用合成栈 `A0D80000` 直接启动 fiber B（`[EXECSTART] sp=A0D80000`）时。(2) **决定性实验**：`P5D_NOSCHEDRUN=1` + `P5D_GXMABI=1` + fiber bit0 修复，12M 运行 **exit=0 且无崩溃**（`[SCHEDRUN]`=0、`[EXECSTART]` 只有 fiber A、`[OBJWR]` 只有设置 0x816CC66C 没有清零），但游戏状态为空转（`[FRAMEDUMP] ctr=0`、`[SEQST] h=0`、`[JOB] binit=0`、`[FINBIT]`=0）→ 回到"主线程在 FUN_8120683C(fiberA) 等完成"的状态。结论：**SCHEDRUN hack 是当前唯一驱动 fiber B 的东西，但它用合成栈导致 param_1[+4]=0、走清理路径并最终空指针崩溃；关掉它又回到 fiber A 完成位无法送达主线程的问题**。NEXT: 在 `P5D_NOSCHEDRUN=1` 下用 `P5D_MGRPROBE=1` 探针检查 fiber A 的 guest 完成流程（trampoline 0x81206BDC 返回后是否调 `FUN_812067A0`、flagsA 是否从 00000001 变 00000003、主线程 FUN_8120683C 是否返回）；若 guest 完成流程正常，则让 guest 自己进入第二次 FUN_8120683C(fiberB)（真实栈）→ 不再崩溃；若没有，则在 HLE 里补 fiber A 的完成投递（当 HLE sceFiberRun 的嵌套执行返回 pc==0 时，直接对 exec_origin_fiber 置 bit2 并唤醒主线程）。 |
| M891 | §18.4436: ★★★★★ **关掉 SCHEDRUN 后 guest 自己的双 fiber 启动链已经完全打通**：(1) `[MGRENT]`（FUN_812067A0 入口）显示 **fiber A 的 guest 完成流程正常工作**：`#0 blk=21 flagsA=00000001` → `#1 blk=4022 flagsA=00000003 flagsB=00000001`（bit0+bit2），且 `[FLAGS] blk=1500000` 的 pc 序列 `8120683C → 812068F4 → 812068FC → 81206904 → 81198A88 → 8120690E → 81206932 → 812069D0 → 812B1B90 → 812069D6` 证明：**第一次 `FUN_8120683C(fiberA)` 返回 → `FUN_8120690E(fiberA)` 销毁 A → 进入运行 fiber B 的路径**（81206932/812069D0/812B1B90 系调用 sceFiberRun 族），`[FINBIT]`=0（我们 HLE 的 pc==0 完成位补丁不再需要，guest 原生完成覆盖）。(2) 主线程 n=3M 栈回溯：`[sp+01C]=81198A96` = **第二次 `FUN_8120683C(fiberB=848463A0)` 的返回地址**（0x81198A92 调用之后），`[sp+010]=848463A0`（fiber B ctx）、`[sp+014]=84836300`（fiber A ctx）、`[sp+0A4]=81159DC6`、`[sp+164]=8119841A` → **主线程正等待 fiber B 完成**。(3) fiber B 确实执行过 app 主代码（`[EA552v4]` 3 次正常栈调用 r0=82EFFF48、sp=848563F8），但之后让出调度器不再被恢复 → 系统空闲（`[FRAMEDUMP] ctr=0`、pc 在 `8120686C/812068D2` 调度循环、blk=812068C6/812B1B70），期间每个循环产生一条非致命 `[HLE-BADMEM] hle access va=0x28 blk=812068C6 stub=812B2AE0`。结论：**app 启动链已从"fiber A 卡死"推进到"fiber B 等待/让出后不被恢复"**，且未崩溃（exit=0）。NEXT: 用 `[FIBSW]`（distinct-pc）记录 blk 1.5M~4M 期间 fiber B 的最后 pc/让出点（sceFiberSwitch/ReturnToThread 目标与 lr），确认 fiber B 是在等显示/视频/CRI 事件（SceDisplay/SceGxm present、criMana）还是被我们的 SceFiberGetSelf dummy 语义挡住；然后补对应 HLE 或修正 fiber 恢复逻辑，让 fiber B 的 app 主循环持续被调度 → 第一帧。 |
| M892 | §18.4437: ★★★★ **fiber B 不被恢复的机制进一步定位 + 两个负结果**：(1) `[FIBSW]`（上限提到 4000）在 `NOSCHEDRUN=1` 运行里只有 **565 条**，全部止于 `blk=1,498,023`（`n=1717` 内嵌阶段）——**fiber A 完成后主线程进入第二次 `FUN_8120683C(fiberB)`，从此再没有一次 `sceFiberSwitch` 调用**；主线程卡在 `FUN_8120683C` 的 `sceFiberGetSelf`→(f==0→FUN_81207632 idle) 分支（pc `8120686C/812068D2`、`812B1B70`）。(2) 实验 `P5D_GETSELF0=1`（线程级 `sceFiberGetSelf` 返回 **0**，符合真实语义）：流程改变但**陷入虚拟文件 worker 无限循环** —— `[VFW]` 19,348 条反复在 `0x81182742`（processor 循环），计数到 **#38,676,000**，外层 `n` 冻结在 ~202,753，8M 块上限因嵌套执行永不完成（跑 11+ 分钟，被手动 kill）。→ 线程级 GetSelf 返回 0 也不是修复方向。结论：**dummy（非 0）与 0 都不能让 guest 调度器恢复 fiber B**；需要看清 `FUN_8120683C` else 分支的判定：它取 self（dummy）→ `self[0x80]|=2`、按 `+0x94/+0x98` 处理链表 → `iVar3=self[0x94]`（为 0 则 `iVar3=DAT_816CC624` 链表头）→ **仅当 `self != iVar3 && iVar3 != 0` 时调用 `sceFiberSwitch(iVar3)`**；因此要么 dummy 与链表头相等、要么链表头为 0（`DAT_816CC624/620` 状态异常）才导致不切换。NEXT: 在 `FUN_8120683C` 的 else 分支块（`0x812068BC/0x812068C4/0x812068D2`）打印 `DAT_816CC624/620` 头尾、dummy 的 `+0x80/+0x94/+0x98`、以及 `sceFiberSwitch` 是否被调用/参数；同时 dump 两台 fiber 对象的 `+0x80/+0x94/+0x98`，确认 fiber B 是否仍在 guest 链表里（是否被 A 完成流程误摘除）。修复后 fiber B 被持续调度 → app 主循环 → 第一帧。 |
| M893 | §18.4438: ★★★★★ **不切换 fiber B 的直接原因找到：线程级 dummy fiber 对象被清零 + guest 链表头/尾为 0**。新探针 `P5D_LISTPROBE=1`（主循环里在 `FUN_8120683C` 的 `0x812068BC/C4/D2` 块打印）与 n=3M raw dump：`[LIST@3M] head=00000000 tail=00000000 A80=00000003 A94=848463A0 A98=00000000 B80=00000001 B94=00000000 B98=00000000 cur=00000000 pc=812B1B70`；`[RAW]` 显示 `0x816CC620`/`0x816CC624`（guest 链表 tail/head）均为 0，`0x816CC628=0x84600000`（线程 id）、`0x816CC630=2`（flags），而 `[DUMPSELF] 0x85119330`（我们 HLE 在**线程级** `sceFiberGetSelf` 返回的 dummy 对象）**前 8 个字全为 0**——包括本该置 1 的 `+0x80`！结合 `FUN_8120683C` else 分支逻辑：`self=GetSelf()`（dummy，但 `+0x80` 已 0）→ `if (self[0x80]&1)==0` 跳过完成位/摘链 → `iVar3=self[0x94]=0` → `iVar3=DAT_816CC624=0` → `if (self!=iVar3 && iVar3!=0)` 为假 → **不调用 sceFiberSwitch** → 主循环空转。即：**dummy 被清零 + guest 链表头尾为 0 的组合导致调度器永远不切换**。fiber A 的 `+0x94=848463A0`（指向 B）是 A 完成时的陈旧链接，但 head/tail 已被后续流程清空。NEXT: (a) 监视 `0x816CC620/0x816CC624` 与 dummy 区 `0x85119330..0x851193D0` 的写入者（wr32_watch 加地址过滤），找出"谁清了链表头与 dummy"；(b) 修正 HLE：线程级 `sceFiberGetSelf` 每次返回**重新武装**的 dummy（`+0x80=1`）或按真实语义返回链表头/0 的正确组合，使 `FUN_8120683C` 能走到 `sceFiberSwitch(fiberB)`；(c) 之后 fiber B 持续被调度 → app 主循环 → 第一帧。 |
| M894 | §18.4439: ★★★★★★ **修复"线程级 GetSelf dummy 被清零 + 链表头为 0 导致永不切换"后，app 主循环彻底跑起来：外层 n 从 1717 推进到 30,000,000，fiber B（848463A0）持续执行 app 主代码，并进入 boot 电影解码循环（`[SEQST]` pc=811DFAFE/811DFB18/811DFB3A，`[FRAMEDUMP] n=30,000,000 flags=00000003 pc=811DFB3A blk=811DFB30 sp=8484EF28 fib=848463A0`）**。修复（18.4439，env `P5D_GETSELFFIX=1`）：线程级 `sceFiberGetSelf` 每次返回**重新武装**的 dummy ——`dummy+0x80=1`（running）、`dummy+0x94=link`（若 guest 链表头 `DAT_816CC624` 非 0 用它，否则从 `{848463A0,84836300}` 中取第一个 `+0x80` bit0=1 且 bit2=0 的存活 fiber）、`dummy+0x98=0`；这样 `FUN_8120683C` else 分支里 `iVar3=self[0x94]=fiberB`（非 0）→ 走 `sceFiberSwitch(fiberB)` → fiber B 被调度。验证（`P5D_NOSCHEDRUN=1` + `P5D_GXMABI=1` + `P5D_GETSELFFIX=1`，30M，`out30m_m964fix30.txt`）：`[FIBSW] #565 n=1754 lr=812068F2 fb=848463A0`（blk≈1.5M 后第一次 switch！）；n=5M..30M 均有 `[FRAMEDUMP]`/`[SEQST]`/`[JOB]`，`[TS]` 13 线程正常，exit=0 无崩溃；`[GETSELF-ARM] dummy=84DC9EC0 ->link=848463A0`。当前仍 `ctr=0`、`gxm(b/e/p)=0/0/0`（还在 boot 电影阶段，与旧路径 n 5M~60M 的电影阶段一致）。NEXT: 130M FASTSLEEP 运行确认电影结束后 app 恢复/标题页出现；然后处理下一个可见门（GXM begin/present、SEQREQ 页面切换）。 |
| M895 | §18.4440: **130M 长跑进行中（M894 修复后首个完整 boot 电影阶段确认）**：`P5D_GETSELFFIX=1` + `P5D_NOSCHEDRUN=1` + `P5D_GXMABI=1` + `P5D_FASTSLEEP=1`，130M 目标，当前（25 分钟）推进到 **n≈35,225,000**，状态稳定无崩溃：`[FRAMEDUMP] n=35,225,000 flags=00000003 t4=0 t8=0 ctr=0 pc=811DFA3C blk=811DFA0E sp=8484EF28 fib=848463A0`；fiber B（848463A0）在 **appMovie 软件解码热循环** `0x811DFA0E/811DFA3C` 反复执行（watchdog `pcring: 811DFA3C 811DFA3C 811DFA0E ...`），fiber A（84836300）在调度器 `pc=8120682A`；`[WD]` `total=1500000 blk=811DFA0E`、`[VFW] #3,440,000 at=81182742`（虚拟文件 worker 也在跑）；`[SEQST]` 至 n=30M 仍 h=0、`[JOB]` ctr=0、`gxm(b/e/p)=0/0/0`、`[TITLEMOV]/[MOVSTAT]/[SEQREQ]` 均 0。**即：boot 电影（旧路径 n 5M~60M 的阶段）正在真实解码中，速度约 2M 外层 n/分钟（CPU 约 65k 块/秒），预计再 25-30 分钟到达旧路径的电影结束点 n≈61M**。本轮不打断该运行（保持后台），下一轮直接检查 n>60M 后是否出现电影结束/`SEQREQ`/`TITLEMOV`/ctr>0。验证：`out130m_m965fix130.txt` 持续增长、exit 未发生、无 BADMEM。 |
| M896 | §18.4441: ★★★★★★ **boot page1（S1 标题加载页）真正跑起来了：应用帧计数开始增长、页面序列回调链执行、资源加载与存档槽机制活跃**。130M 长跑（`P5D_GETSELFFIX=1`+`P5D_NOSCHEDRUN=1`+`P5D_GXMABI=1`+`P5D_FASTSLEEP=1`，`out130m_m965fix130.txt`）关键证据：**(a) 帧计数 `ctr` 从 0 增长到 174**（首个 `ctr=1` 在 `n=59,455,000`，`pc=811DA53A blk=811E6A0E`，随后 `t4/t8` 时间戳非零；n=62.75M 时 `ctr=174`）；**(b) `[SEQCB]` 179 条**（页面序列回调被调用，如 `blk=81185864 target=81185926`）；**(c) `[SEQREQ]` 8 条**（`page5 start=811859C1 update=811859D3 end=811859E5`）；**(d) `[SEQST] n=60M h=85AE4E5C ctrl=85AE4E1C cur=1 prev=-1 tab=813B01B4`**（序列控制器初始化，页面 1 激活）；**(e) `[NODE]` 加载步骤推进（`load-step #1000 list=85AE4F90 node=85AF22AC jstate=16`）、`streamcnt=12`；**(f) `[NSET]` 14,720 条 + `[SAVESLOT]`/`[SAVESLOT-POP]` 各 4,909 条**（每帧在分配对象、存档槽保护代码频繁执行——说明已进入正常帧循环）；**(g) `[GDCHK]` 119 条 ret=0、`[IDR]` 60 条（initDataRead 步进）**。当前仍 `gxm(b/e/p)=0/0/0`（GXM begin/end/present 尚未出现）且 `[TITLEMOV]/[MOVSTAT]` 0。**重要负面发现：该运行 wall-clock 极慢**——进程 CPU 仅约 26 分钟却跑了 ~1.5 小时，`ctr` 从 165→174 用了约 10 分钟（≈2.5 分钟/帧），说明每帧有**真实阻塞等待**（疑似 Vulkan present/vsync 或窗口消息/实时节流），使 130M 目标需数小时。NEXT: (1) 定位每帧真实阻塞点（在 present/display 路径、Vulkan swapchain acquire、或 host 线程 sleep 上打时间戳探针）；(2) 消除该阻塞（关闭真实 present 等待或改为虚拟时钟步进）→ 迭代速度恢复；然后继续观察 page1 → 标题页切换（`[TITLEMOV]`/`[MOVSTAT]`/`SEQREQ` 页面变化）。 |
| M897 | §18.4442: ★★★★ **计时探针消解"每帧真实阻塞"假设**：新增 `[RATE]`（每 5M 外层 n 打印 wall_ms/blocks_per_s）与 `[GXMSLOW]`（GXM ABI dispatch 调用 >3ms 打印名称/耗时）。65M 计时运行（`P5D_GETSELFFIX=1`+`P5D_NOSCHEDRUN=1`+`P5D_GXMABI=1`+`P5D_FASTSLEEP=1`，`out65m_m966timing.txt`）结果：**(a) 电影阶段速度正常**：n=5M/10M/…/55M 各段 `blocks_per_s` 为 **87k→110k**；**(b) `[GXMSLOW]` 只有 1 条**：`sceGxmInitialize va=812B1570 took=392,408us`（一次性 Vulkan 初始化，392 ms），**没有任何逐帧 GXM 调用超过 3ms**；**(c) n=60M 段（boot page1 加载页开始）速度降为 44,397 blocks/s**（wall 112.6s/5M）——这是 page1 资源加载/资产处理的**真实工作量**，不是阻塞调用；**(d) 帧计数持续增长**：`n=63,710,000 ctr=225`、`[SEQCB]` 230 条、`[SEQREQ]` 已列出 **page0..page5 全部 start/update/end 回调**、`[SEQST] cur=1 tab=813B01B4`、`[NODE]` 加载步进；**(e) `gxm(b/e/p)=0/0/0`、`[GXM]` 0 条、`[TITLEMOV]` 0** —— 仍未开始 GXM 绘制/标题电影。结论：之前 130M 运行 wall 1.5h/CPU 26min 的极端慢速不是持续逐帧阻塞（当前运行 CPU 1170s/约 22min 即到 n=63.7M，帧率正常增长），更像 OS/窗口调度偶发；**真正的下一步是 page1 加载完成后进入标题渲染（GXM begin/end/present）**。NEXT: 让运行过 n=65M 看 page1 是否完成/切换到标题；检查 `binit=0`（criFs binder 未初始化）是否影响 page1 资源加载（streamcnt=12、[JOB] st_gres2=0xFFFFE3B3）；必要时在 GETSELFFIX 路径补 criFs 初始化（或直接检查 Fios 读取是否满足）。 |

| M900 | §18.4445: ★★★★ **CRIFSHLE 实验：criFs 初始化成功返回 0，但 binder 仍未初始化、且初始化时机太晚**。实验：`P5D_CRIFSHLE=1` 在 n=55,000,000 处通过 `call_guest_cb2(&s, 0x8128399E, 0, 0, 4000000)` 调 **guest `criFs_Initialize(NULL,0,0)`**（70M，`out70m_m969crifshle.txt`）：`[CRIFSHLE] criFs_Initialize(NULL,0,0) -> 00000000 n=55000000`（返回 0 = 成功），但结果：**(a)** `[JOB]` 至 n=60M 仍 `binit=0 btab=0`（binder 未初始化）；**(b)** `[CRILOG]` 200 条错误按类别统计：`W2008121610:The binder module is not initialized.` ×46（n 1717..59,855,953）、**`E2008102820:criFsLoader_Create has been called before the library initialization.` ×37（n 1717..59,855,953）**、n=1717 集中出现 ACF/ACB/DSP 音频相关错误（`E2010052671 Can not open ACF`、`W2010110102 ACF not registered`、`E2013081521 invalid DSP Bus Setting`、`E2011112202` 等）、后续 `W2010110104 ACF not registered` ×30、`E2012060501` ×30；**(c)** page1 继续但无绘制：n=65,360,000 时 `ctr=287`、`[SEQST] cur=1 tab=813B01B4`、`[GXM]` 0 条、`[TITLEMOV]` 0、gxm(b/e/p)=0/0/0；`done` 未出现（手动终止）。结论：**guest criFs_Initialize 在 n=55M 调用虽然返回 0，但没有建立 binder；而且游戏在 n=1717 的 boot 初始化阶段就已经调用 `criFsLoader_Create`（早于我们的 hook）** → 时机太晚 + binder 安装缺失。NEXT: (1) 在 guest `criFs_Initialize`（0x8128399E）入口加探针（n/lr），确认游戏自身是否调用它、何时调用；(2) 把 CRIFSHLE hook 提前（例如 n 很小或 boot init 前），保证 `criFsLoader_Create` 之前完成初始化；(3) 检查 binder 安装依赖（binder 模块/文件是否由 0x8128399E 内部完成，还是需要额外的 HLE 支持），并用 0x8153FEF4/0x8154013C 之外的真实 binder 状态验证。 |
| M901 | §18.4446: ★★★★ **page1 加载在 n≈62.78M 完全停滞 + 0x8128399E 并非游戏调用的 CRI 初始化**：(1) 新探针 `[CRIFSINIT-CALL]`（0x8128399E 入口）在 3M 运行里 **0 条** → **游戏自身从不调用 0x8128399E**，M874 把它当 `criFs_Initialize` 的假设很可能错误（它是某个惰性/内部函数；我们 55M 调用返回 0 只是碰巧成功返回）。(2) 早期 hook 实验（`P5D_CRIFSHLE_AT=1716`）**没有触发** `[CRIFSHLE]`：外层 n 在内嵌执行时会跳号（n 从 <1716 直接跳到 1717+），精确相等 hook 会漏掉 → 需改成 `n >= AT` 且 once。(3) page1 加载停滞证据（`out70m_m969crifshle.txt`）：`[IDR]`（initDataRead，state=2 idx=0 handle=0xC8）从 n=59.45M 反复到 **60.63M 后停止**；`[GDCHK]` ret=0 持续到 **62.27M 后停止**；`[NODE] load-step #1000 list=85B24FA0 node=85B322BC job=85B321C0 jstate=16`（n=62.78M）之后只剩 `[SEQCB]`（同一 page1 回调 `blk=81185864 target=81185926` 每帧重复数百次）与 `[FRAMEDUMP]`（n=65.36M ctr=287），`[SEQST] cur=1` 不变、GXM 0、TITLEMOV 0 → **加载器停在 jstate=16 的等待状态，page1 永远不完成**；CRILOG 里 `W2008121610 binder not initialized` ×46 与 `E2008102820 criFsLoader_Create called before library initialization` ×37 印证 binder/loader 初始化顺序问题。NEXT: 用 rea 反编译 `0x8128399E`（确认它到底是什么）与打印 `E2008102820` 的函数（其 binder 状态全局 + 初始化检查），找到真正的 CRI FS 初始化函数与 binder 状态全局；然后 (a) 把 CRIFSHLE hook 改成 `n >= AT` 提前调用**真正的** init，(b) 或由 HLE 直接设置 binder 状态全局/补 `criFsLoader_Create` 所需前置条件。 |
| M902 | §18.4447: ★★★★★ **Ghidra 证据纠正 M901：0x8128399E 就是 CRI FS 初始化路径；hook 位置 bug 找到（原来在 n%5000 块内）；初始化时机窗口定位在 n≈5000**：(1) Ghidra `P5DRefs2` 查询：binder 状态全局 `0x8153FEF4`、`0x8154013C` 的 **WRITE 来自 `FUN_81284960`**（`81284ce0`/`81284b7e`），而 `FUN_81284960` **唯一调用者是 `FUN_8128399E` 的 `0x81283BAE`** → **0x8128399E 就是 CRI FS 初始化入口**（M901 的"假设错误"结论需修正；`[CRIFSINIT-CALL]`=0 的原因见 (3)）。(2) **hook 位置 bug**：原 CRIFSHLE hook 代码位于外层循环 `if ((n % 5000) == 0) { ... }` 块内部 → 只在 **n 为 5000 的倍数**时执行；这解释了 `P5D_CRIFSHLE_AT=1716` 永不触发、`n>=2` 实际在 n=5000 触发。已把 hook **移动到外层循环最前**（`++n` 之后、块分发之前）。(3) 时机窗口实验：`AT=2`（n=2 触发）：`criFs_Initialize -> 0` 但 `binit_after=0`（**太早，前置未就绪，init 空返回**），随后 guest 在 `0x8127B37A` 空指针崩溃（BADMEM va=0x38）；`AT=1700`：hook 未打印、n<5000 即崩溃（BADMEM va=0x400 blk=812B2260）；而旧位置在 **n=5000 触发时 `binit_after=0x816A0BA0`（成功建立）**、`[JOB2M] binit=0x816A0BA0 btab=0 bctx816C5558=0x4001F000`。=> **CRI FS 初始化的最早可用时机 ≈ n 5000（boot init n=1717 之后）**，boot init（n=1717）里的 audio loader 创建必然早于它（CRILOG 不可避免），但**页面资源加载（n≈59M）在其之后**，理论上 binder 可用。NEXT: 已后台启动 70M 长跑（`AT=5000`，`out70m_m974crifs5k.txt`），检查 page1 是否加载完成、`[GXM]`/`[TITLEMOV]` 是否出现；若 binder 仍阻断 audio/resource，则需要进一步提前 init（找到 n=1700 崩溃的前置缺失并补齐，如 libc heap / CRI heap 初始化）。 |

| M906 | §18.4451: **page1 定向诊断探针套件就位（n>=59,000,000 才启用），用于锁定 CRI FS 卡点的等待对象与缺失的 Fios 完成信号**：在 HLE 层新增 5 个门控探针：(1) `[H57]` —— 所有 HLE 调用（va/pc/lr/a0-a3/fib/thr），条件 `g_main_n>=59,000,000`，上限 3000 条；(2) `[WAITSEMA57]` —— `sceKernelWaitSema` 的 obj/need/have/pc/fib，上限 200；(3) `[SETEF57]` —— `sceKernelSetEventFlag` 的 obj/bits/pc/fib，上限 200；(4) `[FHOPEN57]` —— `sceFiosFHOpen` 的 path/fh/pc/fib，上限 120；(5) `[FHREAD57]` —— `sceFiosFHRead` 的 fh/dst/size/pc/fib，上限 120。动机（M905）：page1 在 n≈59.69M 卡死，WD 环解码显示 worker 线程 4001C000 在 `WaitSema→SignalSema→DelayThread` 轮询等待读完成信号量，主 CRI FS 循环 `SetEventFlag` 后自旋；需要抓取"卡死前最后一段 HLE 调用序列"，看是哪个 Fios 请求没有完成、哪个 sema 对象没被 signal。已后台启动 **64M 诊断长跑**（`out64m_m977page1probe.txt`，环境同上：CRIFSHLE=1/AT=5000 + GETSELFFIX + NOSCHEDRUN + GXMABI + FASTSLEEP）；下一轮读取 `[H57]`/`[WAITSEMA57]`/`[SETEF57]`/`[FHOPEN57]`/`[FHREAD57]` 序列，定位缺失的完成投递（Fios 读完成 signal / 回调），然后修复 → page1 加载完成 → 标题页。 |

| M908 | §18.4453: ★★★★★★ **page1 卡点最终定位：应用在"vblank 帧循环"里等显示同步，而我们的 vblank 桩立即返回且在 guest-thread 模式无抢占 → 加载 worker 线程被饿死**。探针数据（`out64m_m978page1probe2.txt`，n≥59M 后）：`[H57]` 直方图（3000 条）：`812B2A50@81207612` **x959**（sceKernelDelayThread）、`812B27A0@81207426` x328（WaitSema）、`812B2AD0@8120745C` x327（SignalSema）、`812B2830@81207350` x322（LockLwMutex）、`812B28A0@8120735C` x322（UnlockLwMutex）、`812B2880@811732C2` x321（WaitEventFlag）、**`812B1810@811539FE` x211（sceDisplayWaitVblankStartMultiCB）**、`812B2AE0@8127BE56` x210（SetEventFlag）；`[WAITSEMA57]` 200 条仅 2 种：`obj=50018000 need=1 have=1`（104）与 `obj=50017000 need=1 have=2`（96）；`[SETEF57]` 200 条全为 `obj=60016000 bits=1`；**`[FHOPEN57]`/`[FHREAD57]` = 0**（此阶段完全没有 Fios 调用）。结论：page1 卡在**帧循环**（WaitSema 帧信号量 → 处理 → SetEventFlag 60016000 → **WaitVblank** → DelayThread），不是 Fios 读缺失；真实硬件上 vblank 等待会让出 CPU 给加载 worker 线程，而我们的 `sceDisplayWaitVblankStartMultiCB` 桩**立即返回**且 guest-thread 模型**无抢占** → 主线程永远不让出 → worker 饿死 → page1 永远不完成。**修复实验（18.4453）**：`P5D_VBPUMP=1` 时在 vblank 桩里推进虚拟时钟（16ms*cnt）并 `hle_thr_pump(s,300)` 运行就绪 guest 线程；2.5M 冒烟测试通过（exit=0、无崩溃、`[VBPUMP]` 在 n=2048 起触发）。已后台启动 64M 长跑（`out64m_m981vbump.txt`，带 VBPUMP）验证 page1 是否完成 → 标题页。 |
| M909 | §18.4454: ★★★★★ **VBPUMP 无效的原因找到：page1 帧循环运行在 guest 线程上下文（g_cur_thr=40017000），而 `hle_thr_pump` 在 g_cur_thr 非 0 时直接 return、DelayThread 在 g_cur_thr 非 0 时也直接 break（不让出）→ worker 线程永远没机会跑**。证据：(1) VBPUMP 64M 长跑（`out64m_m981vbump.txt`）仍卡在 **n=59,810,000、ctr=9、pc=81283C84 blk=8128EA74**（与 M908 相同），`[VBPUMP]` 只在 n=2048 打印 6 条（早期 vblank），说明 page1 循环里的 vblank pump 调用并未带来进展；(2) 源码：`hle_thr_pump` 第一行 `if (g_cur_thr || g_hostthreads) return;`；DelayThread case 里 `if (g_cur_thr) { ... break; }` —— **在 guest 线程执行上下文中，pump 和让出都不发生**，主线程自旋、加载 worker 饿死。**修复实验（18.4454，env `P5D_THRYIELD=1`）**：(a) `hle_thr_pump` 入口增加**虚拟唤醒扫描**：对 `waiting` 且 `g_thr_wake_vt[tid] <= g_vtime_extra` 的线程置 ready；(b) DelayThread 在 `g_cur_thr` 非 0 时登记 `g_thr_wake_vt[tid]=g_vtime_extra+usec` 并置 `g_thr_blocked=1`（让线程执行循环保存上下文并退出，使调度器能 pump 其他线程）。2.5M 冒烟测试（`out2m_m984thryield3.txt`）：`[THRYIELD-GT]` 8 条（tid 40017000 usec=5000、4001B000/4001C000 usec=30000 均让出）、exit=0、无 BADMEM。已后台启动 64M 长跑（`out64m_m985thryield.txt`，带 `P5D_THRYIELD=1`）验证 page1 是否完成 → 标题页。 |
| M910 | §18.4455: **两条负结果 + 新诊断/调度实验**：(1) `P5D_VBPUMP=1` 64M 长跑（`out64m_m981vbump.txt`）仍卡在 **n=59,810,000、ctr=9、pc=81283C84 blk=8128EA74**（与未修复完全相同），`[VBPUMP]` 仅早期 6 条 → vblank pump 对 page1 无效（原因见 M909：g_cur_thr 上下文 pump 直接 return）。(2) `P5D_THRYIELD=1` 64M 长跑（`out64m_m985thryield.txt`）同样卡在 **n=59,955,000、pc=8127BB2E blk=8127BE56、ctr=9**，`[IDR]`/`[SEQREQ]` 到 n=59.61M 后不再推进；THRYIELD 冒烟时确有让出（`[THRYIELD-GT]` 8 条），但不足让 worker 完成加载。→ **pump/让出本身不是唯一缺口**。为下一次实验新增两个工具：(a) `[PDUMP]` —— 当 `g_main_n >= 59,500,000` 时**一次性打印全部 guest 线程状态**（tid/entry/alive/ready/waiting/wait_obj/wait_bits/ctxpc/ctxsp）与全部 fiber 上下文（pc/sp/lr/r0）+ 当前 g_cur_thr/g_cur_fiber/curpc/g_in_fex，用于看 worker 到底卡在哪个 wait 对象、是否 ready；(b) `P5D_PERIODPUMP=1` —— 在 job_probes 里每 65536 块（且 `g_cur_thr==0`）执行一次 `g_pump_force=1; hle_thr_pump(s,60); g_pump_force=0`，模拟**周期抢占**，让 guest 线程在 page1 自旋期间也能得到执行片。已后台启动 64M 长跑（`out64m_m986periodpump.txt`，THRYIELD+PERIODPUMP）验证 page1 是否完成，并在 n≥59.5M 抓 `[PDUMP]` 线程快照。 |

| M921 | §18.4466: ★★★★★★ **page1 忙等根因假设：CRI 帧节拍器用"真实墙钟"算 sleep，而我们的 DelayThread 只推进"虚拟时间"→ 每帧 elapsed≈0 → sleep≈0 → 紧忙等；修复实验 `P5D_VTIME=1` 让进程时间/RTC 返回虚拟时间**。证据：(1) M920 的 CRIFORCE 未触发（`[CFORCE]` 0 条，64M 长跑 `out64m_m1001criforce.txt` 仍卡 n≈60.2M 同一处）→ 目标函数选错（当前等待不在 FUN_8127B336）；(2) 反汇编当前卡点区域发现 **`FUN_8127BB30` = CRI 帧节拍/限速器**：`FUN_8127C232()`（= `sceKernelGetProcessTimeWide()/1000` 得 ms）→ 计算 `elapsed=now-last`，`sleep = interval - elapsed - delta`（interval 来自 [r4+0x94]，上限 1000ms）→ `FUN_8127C0E8(sleep)`（`DelayThreadCB(sleep*1000us)`）；(3) 我们 HLE 的 `sceKernelGetProcessTimeWide` 用 `hle_tick_us()`=真实墙钟，而 `DelayThreadCB` 只把 `g_vtime_extra` 虚拟推进、并不真睡 → 真实墙钟几乎不动 → elapsed≈0 → 每帧 sleep≈interval（本应睡 16ms）但虚拟推进后下一帧真实时间仍≈不变 → 逻辑上永远"还差一整帧"→ 紧凑自旋（正是观察到的 6M vblank/3M 块）。**修复（18.4466，env `P5D_VTIME=1`）**：`0x812B28E0`（GetProcessTimeWide）与 `0x812B1EA0`（sceRtcGetCurrentTick）在 VTIME 下返回 `g_vtime_extra + 1,000,000`（虚拟时钟），使"计时等待"在虚拟时间下按 DelayThread 推进准确完成。2.5M 冒烟（`out2m_m1002vtime.txt`）：`[VCLOCK] procTimeWide=1665000`、`[CRIFSHLE] binit_after=816A0BA0`、exit=0、BADMEM=0。已启动 64M 长跑（`out64m_m1003vtime.txt`）。NEXT: 看 page1 计时等待是否快速推进（`[IDR]`/`[SEQST]` 换页/`[GXM]` BeginScene/`[TITLEMOV]`/ctr）。 |

```cpp
    case 0x812B2170u: /*sceAvcdecQueryDecoderMemSize(type,qinfo,dinfo)*/

        sz=((u64)qw*qh*3/2*ref + 0x3FFFF) & ~0x3FFFF;  wr32(dinfo,sz); g_avc_qw=qw; g_avc_qh=qh;
    case 0x812B2190u: /*sceAvcdecCreateDecoder(type,ctrl,query)*/
        hid=g_avc_hid++; wr32(ctrl,hid); g_avc_handle[ctrl]=hid; qw=rd(query),qh=rd(query+4);
    case 0x812B2140u: /*sceAvcdecDecodeAvailableSize(ctrl)*/
        return g_avc_qw*g_avc_qh*3/2;              // 960x544 -> 783360 (0xBF400)
    case 0x812B2120u: /*sceAvcdecDecodeFlush*/ g_avc_stopped=true;
    case 0x812B2160u: /*sceAvcdecDecodeStop(ctrl,pic)*/
        arr=rd(pic+8); pp=arr?rd(arr):0; out=!g_avc_stopped;
        if(out&&pp){ wr32(pp+0x14,lw); wr32(pp+0x18,lh); wr32(pp+0x5C,lpU); wr32(pp+0x60,lpL);} wr32(pic,out); g_avc_stopped=true;
    case 0x812B2150u: /*sceAvcdecDeleteDecoder(ctrl)*/ handle.erase(ctrl); g_avc_stopped=false;
    case 0x812B2180u: /*sceAvcdecDecode(ctrl,au,pic)*/
        // 数据源：P5D_VDEC_RAW（默认 title_c_p5d001_nv12.raw），P5D_VDEC_START 起始帧
        arr=rd(pic+8); pp=arr?rd(arr):0;
        pw=rd(pp+0x0C); ph=rd(pp+0x10); b0=rd(pp+0x3C); b1=rd(pp+0x40);   // SceAvcdecPicture.frame.pPicture[0]/[1]
        // 读一帧 NV12（960x544*3/2=783360）→ Y 写 b0、UV 写 b1（或连续写 b0+Y）
        // 发布：wr32(pic,1)  // ArrayPicture.numOfOutput=1
        //       wr32(pp+0x14,pw); wr32(pp+0x18,ph);            // frame.horizontalSize/verticalSize
        //       wr32(pp+0x44,1); wr32(pp+0x48,90000);           // info.numUnitsInTick=1 / timeScale=90000
        //       info.fixedFrameRateFlag@0x4C=1；info.pts.upper@0x5C / lower@0x60 = AU 的 pts（au+0/au+4）
        //       ++g_vdec_frame
  }
  return 0xFFFFFFFFu;   // 未处理 -> 继续原有分派
}
```

后端接口（`vulkan_backend.h`）：
```cpp
SceInt32 upload_gxm_control_to_unit(SceUInt32 unit, const void* control16,
                                    const SceUInt8* hostPixels, SceUInt32 bytes);
```
—— 内部 `resolve_gxm_texture` 解析控制块（含 swizzle/尺寸/格式）后按 hostPixels 上传到该 unit。
编译：Idle 优先级，exit=0；二进制含 `[ABIMOVTEX]`/`P5D_MOVIE_ENGINE`。
意义：这是"**原版代码自己绘制**"的关键一步——影片帧不再是宿主层覆盖，而是进入引擎的纹理采样路径，由原版 GXP 片元着色器绘制。等用户不在游戏时运行验证：

```
P5D_MOVIE_CAPTURE=1  (或不加 MOVIE_CAPTURE，用 RT 截图)
```

| §18.4521 | Implemented the ENGINE-DRAWN MOVIE path: when a draw's bound fragment texture control block declares size = 960x544 (the movie texture), upload our pre-decoded BGRA movie frame directly as that unit's content via upload_gxm_control_to_unit(unit, ctrl16, hostPixels, bytes) -> the ORIGINAL fragment shader samples and draws the movie frame (no longer relying on the host fullscreen-blit demo layer). Toggle P5D_MOVIE_ENGINE=1; log tag [ABIMOVTEX]. Implementation location: before the draw-time texture upload block in the harness (18.4521): static int _me=-1; if(_me<0) _me=(getenv("P5D_MOVIE_ENGINE")!=nullptr)?1:0; if(_me && g_movie_va){ for(int _u=0;_u<16;++_u){ if(_frag_tex[_u] all zero) continue; uint32_t _w1; memcpy(&_w1,_frag_tex[_u]+4,4); uint32_t _tm=_w1&0xE0000000u; unsigned _tw=0,_th=0; if(_tm==0x60000000u||_tm==0x80000000u||_tm==0xC0000000u){ _tw=((_w1>>12)&0xFFFu)+1u; _th=(_w1&0xFFFu)+1u; } if(_tw==g_movie_w && _th==g_movie_h){ int _rc=upload_gxm_control_to_unit((unsigned)_u,_frag_tex[_u],GP(g_movie_va),(unsigned)(g_movie_w*g_movie_h*4u)); printf("[ABIMOVTEX] unit=%u rc=%d %ux%u frame=%ld n=%u"); } } }. Backend API (vulkan_backend.h): SceInt32 upload_gxm_control_to_unit(SceUInt32 unit, const void* control16, const SceUInt8* hostPixels, SceUInt32 bytes) - internally resolve_gxm_texture parses the control block (swizzle/size/format) then uploads hostPixels to that unit. Compiled at Idle priority, exit=0; binary contains [ABIMOVTEX]/P5D_MOVIE_ENGINE. This is a key step toward 'the original code draws it itself' - the movie frame enters the engine texture-sampling path and is drawn by the original GXP fragment shader. Verify when the user is not gaming: P5D_HIDEWINDOW=1 P5D_MOVIE_ENGINE=1 P5D_MOVIE_CLOCK=wall P5D_MOVIE_START=300 P5D_MOVIE_CAPTURE=1 (or RT capture). NEXT: verify [ABIMOVTEX] appears + RT screenshot shows movie content (engine-drawn); if page1 has no 960x544 movie-texture draw, find the movie quad's fragment program hash and adjust the gate. |
1) **`P5D_HIDEWINDOW=1`**：backend 初始化后立即 `FindWindowA(0,"P5D Native Port")` + `ShowWindow(SW_HIDE)` —— 运行渲染时**不再弹出/显示窗口**，不会切掉用户全屏游戏画面；
2) **`P5D_MOVIE_CLOCK=wall`**：影片帧按**墙钟 29.97fps** 推进（此前只在 DisplayQueueAddEvent 推进 1 帧 → 画面静止），让 title 影片真正播放；
3) **`P5D_MOVIE_CAPTURE=1`**：**离屏证据**——每帧把影片 BGRA 写成 `p5d_moviecap_N.bmp`（项目自带 BMP 写入器，前 16 帧），**完全不需要窗口/桌面截屏**即可取证。
实现（18.4520，`recomp_harness.cpp`）：
```cpp
static int g_hidewin_env = -1;
static void p5d_maybe_hide_window(void) {
  if (g_hidewin_env < 0) g_hidewin_env = (getenv("P5D_HIDEWINDOW") != nullptr) ? 1 : 0;
  if (!g_hidewin_env) return;
  HWND _hw = FindWindowA(nullptr, "P5D Native Port");
  if (_hw) ShowWindow(_hw, 0);
}
static void p5d_write_bgra_bmp(const char* path, const void* bgra, int w, int h);   // 自带 54B 头 BMP
// movie_advance_frame():
{ static int _mw=-1; static long long _t0=-1; static long _start=-1;
  if (_mw<0) { _mw = (getenv("P5D_MOVIE_CLOCK") && strstr(...,"wall")) ? 1 : 0; _start = ...P5D_MOVIE_START; }
  if (_mw) { g_movie_frame = _start + (now_ms - _t0)*30000/1001/1000; } }
{ if (g_moviecap_env<0) g_moviecap_env = (getenv("P5D_MOVIE_CAPTURE")!=nullptr)?1:0;
  if (g_moviecap_env) p5d_write_bgra_bmp("p5d_moviecap_N.bmp", _dst, w, h); }
main: if (!g_gxmabi) gxmvk_init(); p5d_maybe_hide_window();
```
编译：以 **Idle 优先级**运行 g++（`ProcessPriorityClass::Idle`，不抢用户游戏 CPU），exit=0，二进制含 `P5D_HIDEWINDOW`/`[MOVIECAP]`/`clock=wall` 三处标签。
用户环境约定（写入项目规则）：**用户在全屏游戏时——禁止弹窗、禁止窗口置顶/移动/激活、禁止桌面屏幕捕获；证据优先用离屏捕获（MOVIECAP）**。

③ `save_screenshot` 交换链读取修正（present 前 capture）。 |

```cpp
static inline uint8_t* GP(uint32_t va) {
  if (va >= 0x80600000u && va < 0x84600000u) off = va - 0x80600000u;
  else if (va >= 0xA0000000u && va < 0xA2000000u) off = (va-0xA0000000u) + 0x28000000u;  // region B
  else if (va >= 0xA2000000u && va < 0xB0000000u) off = (va-0xA2000000u) + 0x2A000000u;  // tail
  else if (va >= 0x84600000u && va < 0x8C600000u) off = (va-0x84600000u) + 0x04000000u;   // heapA 96MB
  else if (va >= 0x8C600000u && va < 0xA0000000u) off = (va-0x8C600000u) + 0x10000000u;   // bigarena 320MB
  ... }
```

| §18.4512 | Localized and fixed the root cause of the texture upload rc=-3: inside upload_gxm_control_resolved, translate(data_byte_addr) fails because the HLE heap arenas (heapA 0x84600000-0x8C600000 / bigarena 0x8C600000-0xA0000000 / regionB 0xA0000000-0xA2000000 / tail 0xA2000000-0xB0000000) are only known to GP() (direct g_img+offset mapping) and were NEVER registered in the p5d::mem address-space registry, while the backend's p5d::mem::translate/contains only know the registry -> texture data pointers (e.g. 0x90029580, inside bigarena) were judged "not in address space" -> return -3.
```cpp
unsigned tp = (typeMask >> 29) & 7;
w0 = (fmt & 0x80000000) | (((mip-1) & 0xF) << 17);
w1 = (fmt & 0x1F000000) | (typeMask & 0xE0000000);
if (tp==1 || tp==2) w1 |= (lh & 0xF) | ((lw & 0xF) << 12);          // swizzled: log2(w/h)
else                w1 |= ((h-1) & 0xFFF) | (((w-1) & 0xFFF) << 12);
w2 = data & 0xFFFFFFFC;
w3 = ((fmt >> 12) & 7) << 28;
// typeMask: linear=0x60000000, tiled=0x80000000, swizzled=0x20000000, strided=0xC0000000, cube=0x40000000
```

```c
// FUN_811efe6a(param_1, param_2, param_3) - uniform 写入 helper

}
// NID 映射（gxm_abi.cpp 表）：
//   0x65DD0C84 = sceGxmSetUniformDataF      int sceGxmSetUniformDataF(void *uniformBuffer,
//               const SceGxmProgramParameter *parameter, unsigned componentOffset,
//               unsigned componentCount, const float *sourceData)
//   0x31FF8ABD = sceGxmSetVertexProgram
//   0xA949A803 = sceGxmShaderPatcherGetProgramFromId   0x633CAA54 = ProgramFindParameterBySemantic
//   0x5C79D59A = ProgramParameterGetResourceIndex
```
同时 Ghidra 反编译 **`FUN_811EF610`（属性表构建）证实我们的语义/格式映射完全正确**：
```c
// position:  SceGxm_633CAA54(prog,0xb,0)  fmt=9(F32) comps=3/4  (flags&0x400000 ? 4 : 3)
// texcoord0: SceGxm_633CAA54(prog,0x9,0)  fmt=8(F16) comps=3   offset = 0xc (或 0x10)
// texcoord1: SceGxm_633CAA54(prog,0x3,0)  fmt=8(F16) comps=3   offset = +6
// color:     SceGxm_633CAA54(prog,0x6,0)  fmt=4(U8N) comps=4   offset = +4
// (0x10000): SceGxm_633CAA54(prog,0xe,0)  fmt=8(F16) comps=2
// blendW:    SceGxm_633CAA54(prog,0x5,0)  fmt=4(U8N) comps=4   blendI: semantic 0x4 fmt=0(U8) comps=4
// == sem enum: POSITION=0xb, TEXCOORD0=0x9, TEXCOORD1=0x3, COLOR=0x6, TEXCOORDx=0xe, BLENDWEIGHTS=0x5, BLENDINDICES=0x4
// 属性表项写入: [i*8+0]=stream(0), [i*8+2]=offset, [i*8+4]=format, [i*8+5]=componentCount, [i*8+6]=resourceIndex
```
**实现（18.4509，`recomp_harness.cpp`）**：
```cpp
if (strncmp(_ge->name, "sceGxmSetUniformDataF", 21) == 0) {
    uint32_t _ubo=s->r[0], _par=s->r[1], _coff=s->r[2], _ccnt=s->r[3], _src=_stk[0];
    uint8_t* _pq=GP(_par); uint32_t _res=0; if (_pq) std::memcpy(&_res,_pq+0xC,4);
    uint8_t* _dst=GP(_ubo); uint8_t* _ssrc=GP(_src);
    if (_dst && _ssrc && _ccnt && _ccnt<=64) {
        size_t _off = (size_t)_res*16u + (size_t)_coff*4u;   // vec4 寄存器槽 + 分量偏移
        if (_off + _ccnt*4 <= 0x1000) std::memcpy(_dst+_off,_ssrc,_ccnt*4);
        printf("[ABIUFD] ubo=%08X res=%u coff=%u cnt=%u first=(%.3f,%.3f,%.3f,%.3f)\n",...);
    }
    s->r[0]=0; return s->r[14];
}
```

```cpp
if (strstr(name,"ReserveFragmentDefaultUniformBuffer")) _pend_fout = s->r[1];
... dispatch ...
if (_pend_vout) { uint32_t va=*(u32*)GP(_pend_vout); if(va) _cur_v_ubo=va; printf("[ABIUBO] vert ubo=%08X"); }
if (_pend_fout) { ... _cur_f_ubo=va; printf("[ABIUBO] frag ubo=%08X"); }
// draw 时上传：
if (_cur_v_ubo) { uint8_t* src=GP(_cur_v_ubo); if(src) update_uniform_buffer_raw(src, 0x1000); printf("[ABIUBO] upload vert ubo first=(...) "); }
if (_cur_f_ubo) { ... update_fragment_uniform_buffer_raw(src, 0x1000); }
```

3) 语义：引擎的 0x811EF610 用 GetProgramFromId + FindParameterByName 从 GXP 取参数项（name/res/type），
填充 `SceGxmVertexAttribute[]` 与 `SceGxmVertexStream[]`，再调用 CreateVertexProgram；

4) **实现（18.4505）**：
```cpp
// GetProgramFromId(programId) -> GXP VA
if (strncmp(name,"sceGxmShaderPatcherGetProgramFromId",35)==0) { s->r[0]=_pid2gxp[s->r[0]]; return; }
// FindParameterByName(program, name) -> GXP 内参数项 guest VA
auto _gxp_find_by_name = [](uint32_t gxpVA, const char* name)->uint32_t {
  uint8_t* g=GP(gxpVA); if(!g) return 0;
  uint32_t pc,po,gsz; memcpy(&pc,g+0x24,4); memcpy(&po,g+0x28,4); memcpy(&gsz,g+8,4);
  uint32_t pb=0x28+po;
  for (i<pc) { p=g+pb+i*16; nameoff=rd32(p); if name matches -> return gxpVA+pb+i*16; }
  return 0; };
// FindParameterBySemantic(program, semantic, index) -> 按语义名映射（position/normal/texcoord[0/1]/color/weights/indices）
// GetCategory(param) -> u16@+4 & 0xF；GetResourceIndex(param) -> u32@+0xC
```

```
int sceGxmShaderPatcherCreateVertexProgram(SceGxmShaderPatcher *shaderPatcher, SceGxmShaderPatcherId programId,
    const SceGxmVertexAttribute *attributes, unsigned int attributeCount,
    const SceGxmVertexStream *streams, unsigned int streamCount, SceGxmVertexProgram **vertexProgram);
int sceGxmSetVertexStream(SceGxmContext *context, unsigned int streamIndex, const void *streamData);
int sceGxmPrecomputedDrawSetVertexStream(SceGxmPrecomputedDraw *precomputedDraw, unsigned int streamIndex, const void *streamData);
```
结构布局（8 字节属性 / 4 字节流）：
```
SceGxmVertexAttribute: +0 u16 streamIndex, +2 u16 offset, +4 u8 format, +5 u8 componentCount, +6 u8 regSet
SceGxmVertexStream:    +0 u16 stride, +2 u16 streamIndex
```
实现（18.4500，`recomp_harness.cpp`）：
1) `abi_decode_attr(src, fmt, comps, float out[4])`：支持 UBYTE/BYTE/USHORT/SHORT 归一化、FLOAT、HALF（IEEE half→float）、FIXED（/65536）；
2) 在 `ShaderPatcherCreateVertexProgram` 分支（分配 fake obj 之后）解析 attributes（`r2`,`r3`）与 streams（`_stk[0]`,`_stk[1]`），存 `_vobj2attrs[_nextobj]` / `_vobj2strms[_nextobj]`，打印 `[ABIVFMT]`；
3) `PrecomputedVertexStateInit/PrecomputedDrawInit` 记录当前顶点程序对象 `_cur_vobj`；
4) 捕获 `*SetVertexStream`（两 API 参数同形 `(obj,index,data)`）→ `_stm2va[streamIndex]=guestVA`，打印 `[ABIVS]`；
5) `sceGxmDraw` 时：`_vc = _stk[0]`（indexCount）+ `_vobj2attrs[_cur_vobj]` → 逐顶点逐属性按 `[{vobj2strms}[attr.stream].stride] + attr.offset` 从 guest 读取解码 → 写入 128B/顶点（loc i → offset i*16）→ `upload_vertex_stream(vc*128, vc)`；打印 `[ABIVTX]`（vc/attrs/rc/前两顶点），失败打印 `[ABIVTX] FAIL`。

**意义**：这是本项目第一次由**真实 Vulkan 管线 + 着色器 + 光栅化**产出可见像素，并成功 present 到窗口
（此前所有"全黑"的怀疑点——管线/render pass/视口/裁剪/提交/present——全部被证明正常）。
**此前黑屏的两个真凶已定位并验证**：
1. 顶点布局不匹配：真实管线要求 **stride=128（8×vec4，loc0..7）**，而 `create_vertex_buffer` 的内置 `test_triangle` 是 28 字节步长（M953）；
2. RT 渲染架构：BeginScene 必须走 `begin_scene_pass(RT)`（M947/M950），否则 draw 落在 swapchain 而 display 拷贝空 RT（M946）。
**下一步（真实游戏内容必需的三个数据通路）**：
```
① 真实 GXM 顶点流解包：sceGxmSetVertexStream / PrecomputedDrawSetVertexStream 捕获 guest VA
   → 按 GXP 程序属性表把每个顶点解包成 128B 步长的 per-location vec4（loc0=pos, loc1=color, loc2=uv...）
   → upload_vertex_stream；这是"三角形变游戏画面"的第一道关；
② 真实 uniform：sceGxmSetUniformDataF / SetDefaultUniformBuffer / Precomputed 版本
   → update_uniform_buffer(_raw)（当前 RINIT 零表导致 MVP 全 0）；
③ 纹理：sceGxmTextureInit*/SetTexture/PrecomputedFragmentStateSetTexture
   → 后端 upload_texture_to_unit / RT alias（当前 [TEXBIND] dummy=16）。
```
实验证据文件：`p5d_rt_first_triangle.png`（本帧渲染结果）。 |

| §18.4497 | MAJOR DISCOVERY: the backend's P5D_ZFORCE switch comments document the previous project's real "zero pixels" culprit - after vertex transform z > w (outside the Vulkan clip volume 0<=Zc<=Wc); with depthClampEnable=FALSE the whole triangle is clipped away, so even with correct pipeline/binding/viewport not a single pixel is written! Key original text from vulkan_backend.cpp: 'h144k34 depth-clip attribution experiment - the root cause of this round's zero pixels: [VREAD] proved vertex data, indices, binding offsets and pipeline descriptors all correct, [DYNSTATE] proved viewport/scissor normal. But after decoding the bound vertices with the pipeline descriptors, every vertex has z greater than w: vert_0015 (main pass): loc0=(288.9,165.7,2.125,1.0) -> z_ndc=2.125; vert_0014 (background quad): loc0=(-1,-1,2.0,1.0)..(1,1,2.0) -> z_ndc=2.0. Vulkan spec 27.3: with depthClampEnable=FALSE primitives are clipped to 0<=Zc<=Wc -> if z is out of range the whole triangle is discarded. This is exactly why "every link is correct but not a single pixel is written". Switch: P5D_ZFORCE=w -> z=w (z_ndc=1.0); P5D_ZFORCE=<float> -> z=constant.' This means the root cause of our current out62m_m1034uni.txt (identity uniforms active, rp/viewport all correct, red FS still black) is very likely the same z>w clipping. Another important discovery: the backend also has P5D_DBG_VS_BUILTIN=1 (passthrough vertex shader) and P5D_DIAG_FS_IN=1 (debug fragment showing varyings). The historical comments also record that the previous project once achieved a fully red screen with red-FS (geometry/blend/depth/present all correct) and afterwards was stuck on 'the app's own fragment shader outputs all black (varying/texture sampling semantics)'. DECISIVE EXPERIMENT 18.4497: rerun 62M with P5D_DBG_VS_BUILTIN=1 P5D_REALFS=red P5D_ZFORCE=w: the built-in VS directly outputs the test-triangle NDC coordinates (-0.5..0.5), red FS, legal z -> the RT should turn red; if red then rasterization/pipeline/present are fully proven and the remaining work is real uniform/vertex/texture data upload (same sticking point as the previous project). 62M run started (out62m_m1035redz.txt). **修复（18.4493）**：BeginScene 拦截改为**候选探测 + 自动判别**：

- 对每个候选按两种布局判别：
  - 布局 A：`+0 flags, +4 width, +8 height, +0xC stride, +0x10 data, +0x14 format, +0x18 type`
  - 布局 B：`+0 width, +4 height, +8 data`
- 选中条件：`w/h ∈ [64,2048]` 且 `data ∈ [0x80000000,0xC0000000)`，否则打印 `[ABICAND]` 供人工判别
- 选中则 `begin_scene_pass(data,w,h)`，否则回退 `begin_frame()`

```cpp
  if (w4 in [64,2048] && w8 in [64,2048] && w10 in [0x80000000,0xC0000000)) -> layout A;
  else if (w0,w4 in range && w8 data-like) -> layout B;
  print [ABICAND] #i ptr=%08X w0/w4/w8/wC/w10;
选中后 begin_scene_pass(...)
```

| §18.4490 | HONEST CORRECTION: M940-M942's 'present succeeded' only means vkQueuePresentKHR returned result=0 (the submission path worked); the frame content is still completely black - the user's observation of a pure-white/empty window is correct. Measured: p5d_rt_first.bmp (960x544, produced after the M943 ordering fix) analyzed with PIL gives mean=0.00, max=0, 100% pixels (0,0,0) -> the RT content is entirely black. Data-path gaps (evidence): err [TEXBIND] #0 real=0 alias=0 dummy=16 (all 16 textures bound to dummy, no real textures); err [FUBOHOST] #1 ... UBO float 0.00000... (fragment UBO all zeros); the M941 RINIT hack overrides DAT_816CBE2C with a zero table (to avoid the BADMEM) so uniforms are necessarily zero; [REAL-PIPE] #1 OK only means the pipeline/modules were created, not that the drawn content is correct. Conclusion: the end-to-end STRUCTURAL chain is connected (BeginScene -> real pipeline -> Draw -> RT -> copy -> present result=0), but the RENDER DATA PATH is not: textures unbound (all dummy), uniforms all zero (RINIT zero-table override), vertex/geometry data unverified -> black output.
```cpp
#ifdef _WIN32
#include <windows.h>
static void hle_pump_win_messages(void) {
    MSG m; int _k = 0;
    while (PeekMessageA(&m, nullptr, 0, 0, PM_REMOVE) && _k++ < 128) { TranslateMessage(&m); DispatchMessageA(&m); }
}
#else
static void hle_pump_win_messages(void) {}
#endif
// job_probes（每执行块）：
{ static uint32_t _pmc = 0; if (((++_pmc) & 0x3FFFu) == 0u) hle_pump_win_messages(); }
// 主循环：
while (n < maxb) { if ((n & 0xFF) == 0) hle_pump_win_messages(); ... }
```
覆盖两条路径：外层主循环（每 256 块，约 10-20ms）与**嵌套执行/渲染帧循环**（job_probes 每 16384 块）→ 窗口消息持续被处理，Windows 不再标记挂起；WM_CLOSE 也能被正常接收（可关闭窗口）。

| §18.4489 | Fixed the game window showing 'Not Responding': the harness never processed Win32 messages (no PeekMessage pump), so while the main thread ran the AOT loop for a long time Windows marked the window hung; added a message pump. Cause: recomp_harness.cpp had no #include <windows.h> / PeekMessage at all (measured count 0), while the Vulkan window is created by the backend on the guest main thread and the main thread then stays buried in AOT/nested execution -> the Windows message queue backs up -> 'Not Responding' in the title bar (white/ghost window). FIX 18.4489: #ifdef _WIN32 #include <windows.h> static void hle_pump_win_messages(void) { MSG m; int _k=0; while (PeekMessageA(&m,nullptr,0,0,PM_REMOVE) && _k++<128) { TranslateMessage(&m); DispatchMessageA(&m); } } #else static void hle_pump_win_messages(void) {} #endif; call it from job_probes every 16384 executed blocks ({ static uint32_t _pmc=0; if (((++_pmc) & 0x3FFFu)==0u) hle_pump_win_messages(); }) and from the main loop every 256 iterations (while (n < maxb) { if ((n & 0xFF)==0) hle_pump_win_messages(); ... }). This covers both the outer main loop (~10-20ms) and the nested-execution/render frame loop (job_probes), so window messages are processed continuously and Windows no longer marks the window hung; WM_CLOSE is received too. Verified: 2.5M smoke (out2m_m1026pump.txt): [CRIFSHLE] binit_after=816A0BA0, [THREXIT] 0, [PREEMPT] 10, exit=0, BADMEM=0. Build+link OK; 62M run started (out62m_m1027pump.txt, message pump + RT screenshot). NEXT: confirm the window is responsive and p5d_rt_first.bmp is produced/inspected. |

| §18.4488 | RT screenshot ordering fix: save_rt_screenshot(cd) must be called AFTER present_frame(cd) because the RT only gets created into g_rt_pool inside present_frame; capturing before always returns rc=-1. Evidence (out62m_m1024rtshot.txt): [ABIRT] cd=8CF00000 rc=-1 (retry next display entry); [ABIRT] cd=8D300000 rc=-1 (retry next display entry) (both failed); [ABIDISP] sceGxmDisplayQueueAddEntry data=8D300000 n=59475321; err [CPYIMG] cd=8D300000 src=... 960x544 dst=... idx=0 (but at present time the RT was in the pool and the copy succeeded); [PRESENT] #1 imgIdx=0 result=0(VK_SUCCESS). Cause chain: present_frame(cd) creates the RT into g_rt_pool ([RTPOOL] create cd=8D300000 960x544) while we called save_rt_screenshot BEFORE present_frame -> the RT was not in the pool -> rc=-1 ([RTSHOT] cd=... 不在 RT 池). FIX 18.4488: move the first-frame RT capture to AFTER present_frame(_data); keep the retry logic: if (_dq && _data) { p5d::vulkan::present_frame(_data); static int _cap_done=0; if (!_cap_done) { int _rr = save_rt_screenshot(_data,'p5d_rt_first.bmp'); if (_rr==0) { _cap_done=1; printf('[ABIRT] saved p5d_rt_first.bmp from cd=%08X n=%u\n',_data,g_main_n); } else { static int _rt=0; if (_rt++<8) printf('[ABIRT] cd=%08X rc=%d (retry next display entry)\n',_data,_rr); } } }. Build+link OK; 62M run started out62m_m1025rtshot2.txt producing p5d_rt_first.bmp. NEXT: convert BMP to PNG and inspect the real game frame; also confirm page1 progress ([IDR]/[SEQST]/ctr). |

```
err: [INFO] Vulkan: Creating screenshot image...
err: [INFO] Screenshot image created (960x544)
err: [SHOTSTAT] frame=1 max=0 mean=0.00 file=p5d_frame_first.bmp      ← 全黑！
err: [INFO] Screenshot saved: p5d_frame_first.bmp (960x544)
```
分析：
1) `end_frame()` 路径：结束 RP → 提交 cmd → **直接 vkQueuePresentKHR(swapchain)**，而游戏的绘制结果在**离屏 RT**（color data `8CF00000`）里，swapchain 图像从未被写入 → 黑屏；
2) 正确路径（与旧 host 的 eboot_probe 一致）：`DisplayQueueAddEntry(oldSync,newSync,surface)` 的 surface `+0` = RT data VA →
   - `end_scene_pass()`：结束 render pass（保持命令缓冲打开）；
   - `save_rt_screenshot(data, "p5d_rt_first.bmp")`：把**游戏真实 RT** 回读成 BMP（可视化验证用）；
   - `present_frame(data)`：后端内部 `vkCmdCopyImage(RT → swapchain)` + barrier + 提交 + `vkQueuePresentKHR`；
3) 实现（18.4486，`recomp_harness.cpp` GXMABI 分发块）：
```cpp
namespace p5d { namespace vulkan { void end_scene_pass(); int save_rt_screenshot(unsigned int cd, const char* name); } }
if (strncmp(name,"sceGxmEndScene",14)==0 || strncmp(name,"sceGxmDisplayQueueAddEntry",26)==0) {
    const bool _dq = strncmp(name,"sceGxmDisplayQueueAddEntry",26)==0;
    uint32_t _data = 0; if (_dq) { uint8_t* sp = GP(s->r[2]); if (sp) std::memcpy(&_data, sp, 4); }
    p5d::vulkan::end_scene_pass();
    if (_dq && _data) {
        static int _cap_done = 0;
        if (!_cap_done) { _cap_done = 1; int _rr = p5d::vulkan::save_rt_screenshot(_data, "p5d_rt_first.bmp");
                          printf("[ABIRT] save_rt_screenshot(%08X) rc=%d\n", _data, _rr); }
        p5d::vulkan::present_frame(_data);
    }
    printf("[ABIDISP] %s data=%08X n=%u\n", name, _data, g_main_n);
    s->r[0] = 0; return s->r[14];
}
```
4) 编译链接成功（二进制含 `[ABIRT]`）；已启动 62M 长跑（`out62m_m1023rtpresent.txt`）。

2) 反编译 **`FUN_811E68C8`（GFD job worker）**：
```c
puVar2 = *(u32**)(param_2 + 4);            // 任务系统对象
if (puVar2[4] != 2) {                       // +0x10 = stop flag
  do {
    FUN_812b27a0(*puVar2, 1, 0);            // WaitSema(gfdJobCountSema, 1, NULL)
    FUN_81207344(puVar2 + 3);               // lock mutex(+0xC)
    iVar3 = puVar2[7];                      // +0x1C read index
    FUN_811e6a4c(&local_40, puVar2[5] + iVar3*0x20, 0x20);  // 复制 32 字节 job entry
    ... iVar3++, wrap at puVar2[6](+0x18)
    FUN_81207352(puVar2 + 3);               // unlock
    (*local_40)(auStack_3c);                // ← job entry 第 1 个字 = 函数指针
    puVar2[0xb] = puVar2[0xb] - 1;
  } while (puVar2[4] != 2);
}
```
→ job entry 首字为 0 ⇒ worker 调用 NULL。**根因**：我们 WaitSema 在无 token 时把线程标 blocked、置 waiting，但 **SignalSema 唤醒等待者时只置 ready，没有把 token 从计数器里扣掉**（而唤醒后的 guest 不会再 decrement）→ 计数虚高 → worker 被"多出来"的计数唤醒 → 队列空位 → NULL 任务 → 线程死亡。page1 的 CRI 加载 op 完成回调（`0x8128D503`，由 `FUN_81290a60(op+0xc, ..., 0x8128D503, op)` 注册）因此永远无人执行 → op 状态恒为 1。
3) **修复（18.4473）**：
```cpp
// WaitSema 阻塞分支（guest 线程）：
g_thr_blocked = 1; g_thr_wait_obj = obj; g_thr_wait_bits = need; g_thr_wait_mode = 0x5E4Au;
g_thr_wake_vt.erase(g_cur_thr);         // 禁止 deadline 伪唤醒 sema 等待者
// SignalSema 唤醒：
if (kv.second.wait_mode == 0x5E4Au) { uint32_t need = kv.second.wait_bits ?: 1;
  if (count >= need) { count -= need; waiting=0; ready=1; break; }   // 转移 token
} else { waiting=0; ready=1; }
```

| §18.4473 | MAJOR ROOT CAUSE: the GFD job worker threads die because of 'semaphore token misalignment' -> decompiling FUN_811E68C8 proves workers pull a NULL job function pointer (INDIRECT-MISS reg1=0 target=0 block=811E6928, [THREXIT] pc=FFFFFFFD lr=811E6936, 5 threads 40012000-40016000 all die at n=59,454,348); fixed WaitSema/SignalSema token transfer. Evidence chain: (1) out62m_m1009criop2.txt [THREXIT] (5 lines, at n=59,454,348); [TCREATE2] tid=40012000..40016000 entry=811E68C9 (GFD job workers); [SCREATE] obj=50013000 init=0 name='gfdJobCountSema', obj=50014000 init=10240 name='gfdJobEmptySema', obj=50015000 init=0 gfdJobCountSema, obj=50016000 init=8 gfdJobEmptySema; [SEM] wait obj=50013000 need=1 have=0 thr=40012000; [INDIRECT-MISS] reg1=00000000 target=00000000 block=811E6928; [THREXIT] badblock tid=40012000 pc=FFFFFFFD lr=811E6936. (2) Decompiled FUN_811E68C8 (GFD job worker): puVar2 = *(u32**)(param_2+4); if (puVar2[4] != 2) { do { FUN_812b27a0(*puVar2,1,0) (WaitSema gfdJobCountSema); lock mutex(puVar2+3); iVar3 = puVar2[7] (read index +0x1C); FUN_811e6a4c(&local_40, puVar2[5] + iVar3*0x20, 0x20) (copy 32-byte job entry from queue at +0x14); iVar3++, wrap at puVar2[6] (+0x18); unlock; (*local_40)(auStack_3c) (job entry first word = function pointer); puVar2[0xb]--; } while (puVar2[4] != 2); } => job entry first word 0 means worker calls NULL. ROOT CAUSE: our WaitSema marks the thread blocked + waiting with no token, but SignalSema only sets the waiter ready without deducting the token from the count (and the woken guest does not decrement on resume) -> inflated count -> worker woken by 'extra' counts -> empty queue slot -> NULL job -> thread death. Therefore page1's CRI load-op completion callback (0x8128D503, registered by FUN_81290a60(op+0xc, ..., 0x8128D503, op)) never runs -> op status stays 1. FIX 18.4473: WaitSema guest block branch sets g_thr_wait_bits=need, g_thr_wait_mode=0x5E4A, erases g_thr_wake_vt[g_cur_thr] (no spurious deadline wake); SignalSema transfers the token (if wait_mode==0x5E4A: if count>=need { count-=need; ready=1; break; }) else old behavior. 2.5M smoke out2m_m1010sematok.txt: binit_after=816A0BA0, [THREXIT] 0, [INDIRECT-MISS] 0, [PREEMPT] 10, exit=0, BADMEM=0. 62M run started out62m_m1011sematok.txt (P1TICK); NEXT: check [THREXIT]/[INDIRECT-MISS] gone, whether page1 advances (ctr/[IDR]/[GXM]). |

分析：

| §18.4466 | page1 busy-wait root-cause hypothesis: the CRI frame pacer computes sleeps from the REAL wall clock, but our DelayThread only advances VIRTUAL time -> elapsed~0 per frame -> sleep~0 -> tight busy loop; fix experiment P5D_VTIME=1 makes process time/RTC return virtual time. Evidence: (1) M920's CRIFORCE never fired ([CFORCE] 0 lines, 64M run out64m_m1001criforce.txt still stalls at n~60.2M) -> wrong target function. (2) Disassembling the current stall region found FUN_8127BB30 = CRI frame pacer/limiter: FUN_8127C232() (= sceKernelGetProcessTimeWide()/1000 in ms) -> elapsed=now-last; sleep = interval - elapsed - delta (interval from [r4+0x94], capped 1000ms) -> FUN_8127C0E8(sleep) (DelayThreadCB(sleep*1000us)). (3) Our HLE sceKernelGetProcessTimeWide uses hle_tick_us()=real wall clock, while DelayThreadCB only advances g_vtime_extra virtually and does not really sleep -> real wall clock barely moves -> elapsed~0 -> each frame computes sleep~interval (should sleep 16ms) but virtual advance leaves real time still ~unchanged -> logically "still a full frame behind" forever -> tight spin (exactly the observed 6M vblank / 3M blocks). FIX (18.4466, env P5D_VTIME=1): 0x812B28E0 (GetProcessTimeWide) and 0x812B1EA0 (sceRtcGetCurrentTick) return g_vtime_extra + 1,000,000 (virtual clock) under VTIME so timed waits complete accurately in virtual time. 2.5M smoke out2m_m1002vtime.txt: [VCLOCK] procTimeWide=1665000, [CRIFSHLE] binit_after=816A0BA0, exit=0, BADMEM=0. 64M run started out64m_m1003vtime.txt; NEXT: check whether page1 timed waits advance quickly ([IDR]/[SEQST] page switch/[GXM] BeginScene/[TITLEMOV]/ctr). |

| §18.4458 | BREAKTHROUGH: PERIODPUMP (call-counter version) got past the n~59.8M CRI/frame-loop stall - page1 entered the app job-queue phase; also found/fixed 'preemption without wake deadline leaves workers permanently waiting'.
