[PDUMP] at n=59.5M shows ALL worker threads became wait=1 with obj=0 (no wake object): caused by our preemption bug - preempt set g_thr_blocked=1 but did NOT register a wake deadline, so the pump marked the thread waiting and never readied it again -> workers stalled permanently -> job never completes. FIX (18.4458): preempt now registers g_thr_wake_vt[tid] = g_vtime_extra + 2000 and clears wait fields; the wake sweep is also enabled under P5D_PERIODPUMP; beat changed from 65536 to 8192 blocks. 3M smoke (out3m_m991wake.txt): [PREEMPT] 10 lines (tids 40018000/40019000/4001D000 etc.), exit=0, BADMEM=0. A 130M long run has been started in the background (out130m_m992wake.txt) to verify page1 completion -> title page. |
| §18.4457 | Why M911's periodic preemption never fired: the condition used g_blkcnt_total, which freezes inside nested execution - after switching to a job_probes call counter, preemption fires immediately and targets exactly the READY workers. Before the fix, out64m_m988preempt.txt had [PREEMPT] 0 lines (even though page1 really spins in thread context) because the periodpump condition (g_blkcnt_total - _pp_last) >= 65536 never becomes true inside nested fiber exec (g_blkcnt_total frozen, a rule since M859). FIX (18.4457): use a job_probes call counter: static uint32_t _pp_cnt; ++_pp_cnt; if (g_periodpump_env && _pp_cnt >= 65536u) { _pp_cnt=0; if (g_cur_thr) g_thr_blocked=1; else { g_pump_force=1; hle_thr_pump(s,60); g_pump_force=0; } } - the beat is the number of job_probes calls (once per executed block, also increments inside nested exec). 3M smoke test (out3m_m989preempt2.txt): [PREEMPT] 4 lines: tid=40019000 pc=812B28A0, tid=4001D000 pc=8127B7C8, tid=4001C000 pc=81207442, tid=40018000 pc=810160FC - exactly the READY-but-never-executed worker threads from M911's [PDUMP]; exit=0, BADMEM=0. A 64M long run with THRYIELD+PERIODPUMP counter version has been started in the background (out64m_m990preempt2.txt) to verify page1 completion -> title page. |

At n=59,500,000 (out64m_m986periodpump.txt): cur_thr=0 cur_fib=848463A0 curpc=8115D614 infex=0 inthr=17; tid=40017000 wait=1 obj=0 ctxpc=81207612 (DelayThread); tid=40018000 ready=1 ctxpc=81207344 (READY but never executed!); tid=40019000 ready=1 ctxpc=81016110 (READY); tid=4001A000 ready=1 obj=60016000 bits=1 ctxpc=8127BC22 (READY, CRI FS worker); tid=4001B000/4001C000 wait=1 obj=0 ctxpc=81207612 (DelayThread); tid=4001D000 ready=1 ctxpc=8127B860 (READY, CRI FS code); tid=4001E000 wait=1 obj=60018000 bits=1 ctxpc=8127BE1C (waiting eventflag 60018000!); tid=4001F000 wait=1 obj=6001A000 bits=1 ctxpc=8127BE1C (waiting eventflag 6001A000!). So the page1 loading pipeline is broken: 4001E000/4001F000 wait for event flags 60018000/6001A000 bit1 (which the READY workers 4001A000/4001D000 should set after processing), but those READY workers are never scheduled because the main thread holds the execution context (g_cur_thr nonzero; pump returns early). | §18.4454 | Why VBPUMP had no effect: the page1 frame loop runs in guest-thread context (g_cur_thr=40017000), and hle_thr_pump returns immediately when g_cur_thr is nonzero while DelayThread also breaks without yielding when g_cur_thr is nonzero -> worker threads never get a chance. Evidence: (1) the VBPUMP 64M run (out64m_m981vbump.txt) still stalls at n=59,810,000, ctr=9, pc=81283C84 blk=8128EA74 (same as M908), and [VBPUMP] only printed 6 lines at n=2048 (early vblank), so the page1-loop vblank pump calls brought no progress; (2) source: hle_thr_pump first line if (g_cur_thr || g_hostthreads) return; and the DelayThread case does if (g_cur_thr) { ... break; } - in guest-thread execution context neither pump nor yield happens, so the main thread spins and loader workers starve. FIX EXPERIMENT (18.4454, env P5D_THRYIELD=1): (a) hle_thr_pump entry adds a virtual wake sweep: threads that are waiting and whose g_thr_wake_vt[tid] <= g_vtime_extra become ready; (b) DelayThread with nonzero g_cur_thr registers g_thr_wake_vt[tid]=g_vtime_extra+usec and sets g_thr_blocked=1 (so the thread execution loop saves context and exits, letting the scheduler pump other threads). 2.5M smoke test (out2m_m984thryield3.txt): [THRYIELD-GT] 8 lines (tid 40017000 usec=5000, 4001B000/4001C000 usec=30000 all yielding), exit=0, no BADMEM. A 64M long run with P5D_THRYIELD=1 has been started in the background (out64m_m985thryield.txt) to verify page1 completion -> title page. |
| §18.4453 | page1 stall finally localized: the app is in a vblank frame loop while our vblank stub returns immediately and guest-thread mode has no preemption, so the loading worker threads are starved. Probe data (out64m_m978page1probe2.txt, after n>=59M): [H57] histogram (3000 rows): 812B2A50@81207612 x959 (sceKernelDelayThread), 812B27A0@81207426 x328 (WaitSema), 812B2AD0@8120745C x327 (SignalSema), 812B2830@81207350 x322 (LockLwMutex), 812B28A0@8120735C x322 (UnlockLwMutex), 812B2880@811732C2 x321 (WaitEventFlag), 812B1810@811539FE x211 (sceDisplayWaitVblankStartMultiCB), 812B2AE0@8127BE56 x210 (SetEventFlag); [WAITSEMA57] 200 rows have only 2 distinct values: obj=50018000 need=1 have=1 (104) and obj=50017000 need=1 have=2 (96); [SETEF57] 200 rows all obj=60016000 bits=1; [FHOPEN57]/[FHREAD57] = 0 (no Fios calls at this phase). Conclusion: page1 is stuck in the FRAME LOOP (WaitSema frame semaphores -> work -> SetEventFlag 60016000 -> WaitVblank -> DelayThread), not in a missing Fios read; on real hardware the vblank wait yields the CPU to the loading worker threads, but our sceDisplayWaitVblankStartMultiCB stub returns immediately and the guest-thread model has no preemption -> the main thread never yields -> workers starve -> page1 never completes. FIX EXPERIMENT (18.4453): with P5D_VBPUMP=1 the vblank stub advances the virtual clock (16ms*cnt) and calls hle_thr_pump(s,300) to run ready guest threads; 2.5M smoke test passed (exit=0, no crash, [VBPUMP] fires from n=2048). A 64M long run with VBPUMP has been started in the background (out64m_m981vbump.txt) to verify whether page1 completes -> title page. |
| §18.4452 | M906's probes failed to compile the first time (_stk not declared); after the fix, binary string verification confirmed the probes are really in the exe and the diagnostic run was relaunched: the 5 page1 probes added in M906 produced 0 output in the 64M diagnostic run; investigation showed the link actually FAILED (link_err.txt: recomp_harness.cpp:1282/1948: error: '_stk' was not declared in this scope - [H57]/[FHREAD57] referenced a _stk variable that does not exist in hle_call scope), and the old exe was still the 4:10 version (no probes); the run had used the old binary. FIX: replaced both _stk[0] references with the constant 0u ([H57] a3, [FHREAD57] size placeholder), rebuilt with link exit=0, and verified by BINARY STRING CHECK that the exe contains [H57]/[WAITSEMA57]/[FHREAD57]/[SETEF57]/[FHOPEN57] (1 each). A new 64M diagnostic long run has been started with the probe-equipped exe (out64m_m978page1probe2.txt). NEXT: next round read the [H57]/[WAITSEMA57]/[SETEF57]/[FHOPEN57]/[FHREAD57] sequence after n>=59M and before the stall to identify the sema object the worker waits on and the missing Fios completion delivery (signal/callback/event flag); fix -> page1 loading completes -> title page. |
| §18.4451 | page1-targeted diagnostic probe suite in place (enabled only when n>=59,000,000) to pin down the CRI FS stall's wait objects and the missing Fios completion signal: 5 gated probes added at the HLE layer: (1) [H57] - all HLE calls (va/pc/lr/a0-a3/fib/thr), condition g_main_n>=59,000,000, cap 3000; (2) [WAITSEMA57] - sceKernelWaitSema obj/need/have/pc/fib, cap 200; (3) [SETEF57] - sceKernelSetEventFlag obj/bits/pc/fib, cap 200; (4) [FHOPEN57] - sceFiosFHOpen path/fh/pc/fib, cap 120; (5) [FHREAD57] - sceFiosFHRead fh/dst/size/pc/fib, cap 120. Rationale (M905): page1 stalls at n~59.69M and the WD ring decode shows worker thread 4001C000 polling WaitSema->SignalSema->DelayThread for a read-completion semaphore while the main CRI FS loop spins after SetEventFlag; we need the last HLE call sequence before the stall to see which Fios request never completes and which sema object is never signalled. A 64M diagnostic long run has been started in the background (out64m_m977page1probe.txt, same env: CRIFSHLE=1/AT=5000 + GETSELFFIX + NOSCHEDRUN + GXMABI + FASTSLEEP); next round read the [H57]/[WAITSEMA57]/[SETEF57]/[FHOPEN57]/[FHREAD57] sequence, locate the missing completion delivery (Fios read completion signal / callback), fix it -> page1 loading completes -> title page. |

BUT n~59.69M stalls again in the same CRI FS loop: pcring 8127B85C 8127B36A 8127B370 8127BB28 8127BE36 8127BE4E 812B2AE0 8127BE56 8127BB2E 8127B374 8127B860 81283C8A 8128EA78 8127C0E8 8127C0F4 812B2A80 where 812B2AE0 = sceKernelSetEventFlag (called from 0x8127BE56) and 812B2A80 = DelayThreadCB. The other thread's WD ring: hle_ring 812B2A50@81207612 812B27A0@81207426 812B2AD0@8120745C (repeating) -> decoded: 812B2A50=sceKernelDelayThread, 812B27A0=sceKernelWaitSema, 812B2AD0=sceKernelSignalSema, i.e. a worker thread (tid 4001C000) polls in WaitSema->SignalSema->DelayThread waiting for a read-completion semaphore that HLE async file reads never signal -> the CRI FS page1 resource reads never complete -> spin. NEXT: (a) add probes on sceKernelWaitSema (obj/need/have) and Fios read HLE stubs that print only when n>59,000,000 to identify the semaphore object and the matching Fios request; (b) check the harness Fios read path (sceFiosFHRead/sceFiosOp*) whether it signals the semaphore / invokes the completion callback on completion - after adding the signal/callback, page1 reads complete -> loading done -> title page. |
```c
uVar6 = param_3 * 4 * param_2 + 0xfffff & 0xfff00000;
...
FUN_812B1580(&local_54, &local_58);            // sceGxmGetRenderTargetMemSize(params, &driverMemSize)
iVar3 = FUN_81207734(local_58, 0, 0, 0x10000001);   // -> sceKernelAllocMemBlock(..., size=local_58, ...)
```
`0x812B1580` 在 `P5D_GXMABI=1` 下由 gxm_abi 层处理：`gxm_abi_call_B291C959` 因 `GXM_ABI_CALL_STUB_IMPLS=0` **直接 `return 0u;` 且从不写 r1(out 指针)** → `local_58` 保留栈垃圾 `0x846001FC` → guest 请求 2.2GB memblock（`[MEMA-OOM] size=846001FC total=2221MB` ×5）→ 后续 CRI FS 堆/自旋。**修复（18.4449）**：`gxm_abi_call_B291C959` 改为 `p1=gxm_abi_xlate(regs[1])`，写 `uint32_t sz=0x33D000`（harness HLE case 0x812B1580 的 ARCH_10 经验值），返回 sz。**验证（2.5M，`out2m_m975rtmfix.txt`）**：`[MEMA-BIG]`=0、`[MEMA-OOM]`=0（之前 5 次），`[MEMA] AllocMemBlock uid=00000105 **size=0033D000 addr=8CB20000**` 正常分配；`[CRIFSHLE] binit_after=816A0BA0` 仍正常；exit=0。已后台启动 70M 长跑（`out70m_m976rtmfix.txt`）验证 page1 是否加载完成 → 标题页。 |
| §18.4449 | Root cause of the absurd 2.2GB allocation found and fixed: the GXM ABI sceGxmGetRenderTargetMemSize never writes its out param, so the guest used stack garbage as the size. Decompiled FUN_811E6AF4 (surface allocator): uVar6 = param_3*4*param_2+0xfffff & 0xfff00000; FUN_812B1580(&local_54,&local_58) (sceGxmGetRenderTargetMemSize(params,&driverMemSize)); iVar3=FUN_81207734(local_58,0,0,0x10000001) (sceKernelAllocMemBlock(..., size=local_58, ...)). Under P5D_GXMABI=1, 0x812B1580 is handled by the gxm_abi layer: gxm_abi_call_B291C959 with GXM_ABI_CALL_STUB_IMPLS=0 returns 0u and NEVER writes r1 (out pointer) -> local_58 keeps stack garbage 0x846001FC -> the guest requests a 2.2GB memblock ([MEMA-OOM] size=846001FC total=2221MB x5) -> later CRI FS heap/spin. FIX (18.4449): gxm_abi_call_B291C959 now does p1=gxm_abi_xlate(regs[1]), writes uint32_t sz=0x33D000 (the ARCH_10 empirical value used by harness HLE case 0x812B1580) and returns sz. VERIFIED (2.5M run, out2m_m975rtmfix.txt): [MEMA-BIG]=0, [MEMA-OOM]=0 (previously 5), [MEMA] AllocMemBlock uid=00000105 size=0033D000 addr=8CB20000 allocated normally; [CRIFSHLE] binit_after=816A0BA0 still fine; exit=0. A 70M long run has been started in the background (out70m_m976rtmfix.txt) to verify whether page1 completes -> title page. |
| §18.4448 | CRIFSHLE moved to n=5000 successfully establishes the binder and ALL post-boot CRI binder errors disappear! But a new stall appears at n~59.935M (busy-waiting in CRI FS), plus an absurd 2.2GB allocation request from the guest: (1) long run (CRIFSHLE=1 + CRIFSHLE_AT=5000 + GETSELFFIX + NOSCHEDRUN + GXMABI + FASTSLEEP, 70M, out70m_m974crifs5k.txt): [CRIFSHLE] criFs_Initialize -> 0 n=5000 binit_after=0x816A0BA0; [JOB] at n=25M/55M show binit=2171210656 (0x816A0BA0) - binder persists from the start; CRILOG has only 60 lines, all at n=1717 (vs M901's 200 lines including binder not initialized x46 and loader before init x37) -> ALL post-boot binder errors eliminated; [IDR] advanced to state=1 idx=1 handle=85BB5C1C (M901: state=2 idx=0 handle=0xC8). (2) New stall: n freezes at 59,935,000, [VFW] count keeps rising to #8,614,000 (virtual-file worker spinning), PC ring 8127BE36 8127BE4E 812B2AE0 8127BE56 8127BB2E 8127B374 8127B860 81283C8A 8128EA78 8127C0E8 8127C0F4 812B2A80 = a loop inside CRI FS code; ctr=9, gxm=0; the process burns CPU but n does not advance (nested exec never returns). (3) Absurd allocation evidence (n~6M): [B7734] ENTER r0=846001FC r1=0 r2=0 r3=10000001 lr=811E6C0E -> [MEMA-BIG] size=846001FC name=8130CC88 -> [HLE] malloc REJECT huge n=846102FC -> [MEMA-OOM] size=846001FC total=2221MB uid=00000117 (5 times, total grows to 8581MB) - the guest allocator FUN_811E6C0E requests 2.2GB of memory; after failure the game continues in a broken state and page1's CRI FS heap cannot work, so it spins. NEXT: trace where FUN_811E6C0E gets its size (print args/caller at 0x811E6C0E entry), and check all HLE stubs that return memory size/free memory (GetFreeMemorySize/MemoryInfo etc.) for absurd values (0x846001FC seems related to the HLE heap window 0x84600000) - after fixing, the guest gets a sane heap size -> CRI FS heap works -> page1 completes -> title page. |
| §18.4447 | Ghidra evidence corrects M901: 0x8128399E IS the CRI FS init path; the hook-location bug found (it was inside the n%5000 block) and the init timing window is n~5000: (1) Ghidra P5DRefs2: binder state globals 0x8153FEF4/0x8154013C are WRITTEN by FUN_81284960 (81284ce0/81284b7e), and FUN_81284960's only caller is FUN_8128399E at 0x81283BAE -> 0x8128399E is the CRI FS init entry (M901's 'assumption wrong' conclusion needs correction; [CRIFSINIT-CALL]=0 explanation in (3)). (2) Hook-location bug: the original CRIFSHLE hook was inside the outer-loop block 'if ((n % 5000) == 0) { ... }' -> it only ran at multiples of 5000; this explains why P5D_CRIFSHLE_AT=1716 never fired and why n>=2 actually fired at n=5000. The hook has been moved to the very top of the outer loop (right after ++n, before block dispatch). (3) Timing-window experiments: AT=2 (fired n=2): criFs_Initialize -> 0 but binit_after=0 (too early, prerequisites missing, init returns without doing work), then guest crashes on NULL at 0x8127B37A (BADMEM va=0x38); AT=1700: hook didn't print, crashed before n<5000 (BADMEM va=0x400 blk=812B2260); at the old location n=5000 fired with binit_after=0x816A0BA0 (binder context established), [JOB2M] binit=0x816A0BA0 btab=0 bctx816C5558=0x4001F000. So the earliest usable CRI FS init time is ~n 5000 (after boot init at n=1717); the boot init's audio loader creation is necessarily before it (CRILOG unavoidable), but page resource loading (~n 59M) is after it, so binder should be available. NEXT: 70M long run already started in background (AT=5000, out70m_m974crifs5k.txt) to check whether page1 completes and [GXM]/[TITLEMOV] appear; if binder still blocks audio/resource, need earlier init (find and supply the n=1700 crash prerequisites, e.g. libc heap / CRI heap init). |

| §18.4445 | CRIFSHLE experiment: criFs init returned 0 but binder still uninitialized and the init is too late. Experiment: P5D_CRIFSHLE=1 calls guest criFs_Initialize(NULL,0,0) at n=55,000,000 via call_guest_cb2(&s, 0x8128399E, 0, 0, 4000000) (70M run, out70m_m969crifshle.txt): [CRIFSHLE] criFs_Initialize(NULL,0,0) -> 00000000 n=55000000 (return 0 = success), but: (a) [JOB] through n=60M still binit=0 btab=0 (binder not initialized); (b) [CRILOG] 200 error lines by category: W2008121610:The binder module is not initialized. x46 (n 1717..59,855,953), E2008102820:criFsLoader_Create has been called before the library initialization. x37 (n 1717..59,855,953), at n=1717 concentrated audio-related ACF/ACB/DSP errors (E2010052671 Can not open ACF, W2010110102 ACF not registered, E2013081521 invalid DSP Bus Setting, E2011112202 etc.), later W2010110104 ACF not registered x30, E2012060501 x30; (c) page1 continues but no drawing: at n=65,360,000 ctr=287, [SEQST] cur=1 tab=813B01B4, [GXM] 0 lines, [TITLEMOV] 0, gxm(b/e/p)=0/0/0; no done (manually killed). Conclusion: guest criFs_Initialize at n=55M returns 0 but does not establish the binder, and the game already calls criFsLoader_Create during boot init at n=1717 (before our hook) - too late + binder install missing. NEXT: (1) add probe at guest criFs_Initialize (0x8128399E) entry (n/lr) to see whether the game itself calls it and when; (2) move the CRIFSHLE hook much earlier (very small n or before boot init) so initialization happens before criFsLoader_Create; (3) check binder install dependencies (whether 0x8128399E internally installs the binder or needs extra HLE support) and verify with the real binder state instead of 0x8153FEF4/0x8154013C. |

| §18.4430 | BREAKTHROUGH FIX: guest fiber object missing RUNNING bit (bit0) so fiber A completion was never reported - after setting guest fiber +0x80 |= 1 in fiber_load, the whole app startup chain opens: fiber A flags become 00000003 (bit0+bit2), FUN_8120683C(fiberA) returns (pc sequence 8120683C -> 812068F4/812068FC/81206904), the main thread runs FUN_8120690E and starts fiber B, and fiber B really executes app main code ([FRAMEDUMP] fib=848463A0 sp=A0D7FD28 pc=811EFFC4/811C3FB8/811D9F9E/811EF7CC..., JOB/SEQST advancing to n=5M), until it crashes at n~5.15M in GXM graphics init: [BADMEM] guest va=0x00000000 unmapped block=0x811A7D7C stub=812B1300, call chain 812B1420 -> 811EB1CE -> 812B1300 -> 811EB1EE -> 812076B4/76C0/7712 -> 811EB1FC/811EB208 -> 811A7D7C. Root cause (from FUN_812067A0 decompile): its finished-bit set (fiber[0x80] |= 2) and unlink are entirely inside if ((fiber[0x80] & 1) != 0) - bit0=RUNNING must be set by the system library when a fiber starts running; our HLE never set bit0, so after fiber A ran the 1.5M-block init FUN_812067A0 only executed the switch-to-next branch and never wrote the finished bit, leaving the main thread spinning in while ((fiberA[0x80]&2)==0) (M882/M884 symptom). NEXT: add SceGxm create-context/create-render-target HLE cases returning valid handles/structures, or route these stubs to the existing GXM ABI implementation (gxm_abi/gxm_sce); then app main continues -> first frame rendering. |

So with correct mutex semantics the app takes the "real" CRI path (as in the NGS=1 analysis) and stops before creating/scheduling the first work fiber - the old E10062288 mutex-failure abort had accidentally kept the app on the direct-Fios/dummy-movie path. | §18.4417 | ★★★★★ Found and fixed a fundamental AOT bug: all Thumb PC-relative literal loads were translated as rd32(s, s->r[15] + imm) instead of rd32(s, Align(instr_addr+4,4) + imm) - 486 occurrences across 22 batches rewritten to constant literal addresses and all 32 batches recompiled. Symptom (under P5D_NGS=1): [BADMEM] guest va=0x0A01ED9A unmapped block=0x812243D8 right after criFs_Initialize succeeded; the generated block was static uint32_t blk_812243CC(...) { ... vfp_s_bits_set(...); s->r[1] = rd32(s, s->r[15] + 0x0u); ... } and at runtime s->r[15] held the block PC (0x812243CC) so the load read the instruction word 0x0A01ED9A instead of the literal at 0x812243D4 (0x8153F2C0), then the following vstr s0,[r1] wrote to 0x0A01ED9A -> BADMEM/abort. Root cause: generator _gen_batch2.py maps capstone ARM_REG_PC to s->r[15] verbatim; correct Thumb semantics for ldr/ldrd/ldr.w Rt,[pc,#imm] is address = Align(instr_address+4,4) + imm (ARM: instr+8+imm). WRITE-BACK FIX: new local tool _pc_rel_fix.py parses every batch, for each blk_XXXX containing s->r[15] disassembles the ELF from the block start to the next block, pairs the k-th [pc instruction with the k-th s->r[15] expression (counts must match, else skipped), computes the literal VA and rewrites the C++ statement to rd32(s, 0x<literal>u). Result: 486 occurrences patched in 22 of 32 batches (residual 26 in batch_026 are data-as-code/UNSUPPORTED-instruction blocks, e.g. 0x81147B04 has a too-small disasm window - left for a second pass); all 32 batch .o recompiled (g++ -std=c++17 -O2 -I. -c). VALIDATION: default (P5D_NGS unset) 30M green: exit=0, [TABLE] blocks=229791, GXM=12, FSW=16, FRAMEDUMP=6000, NOFN=0, ASSERT=0, BADMEM=0, done: blocks=30000000 pc=81206894. With P5D_NGS=1 30M: exit=0 (the 0x812243D8 crash is gone), ZERO CRI error logs (previously E2009072703/E2010052671/binder-not-init), [CONSUME] FIOS-opens=12288 (previously 0) -> criFs_Initialize + CRI FS binder + real Fios opens now work. BUT the 130M FASTSLEEP run with P5D_NGS=1 stalls in early boot: [FRAMEDUMP] n=130,000,000 flags=00000002 t4=0 t8=0 ctr=0, [SEQST] h=0 at every 5M sample through n=130M, pc pinned in the fiber/scheduler loop 81206894 812068A0 812068AC 812068BC 812068D8 8120685A 812B1B70 ... - i.e. with the NGS shim active something blocks before the boot movie/scene chain starts (likely an NGS/audio thread or sema dependency our shim does not satisfy, or sceSysmoduleIsLoaded returning 1 changes module init flow). | §18.4415 | ★★★★★ The CRI Atom "insufficient buffer size" is an off-by-one: criAtom_Initialize requires 0x00020190 but the game passes 0x0002018F, and that -1 comes from a failed DSP work-size calculation. Runtime proof ([CRIREQ] probe at the check block): pc=81224958 n=1717 r1=00020190 r6=0002018F - at 0x81224958: cmp r1,r6; ble 0x81224A52 (r1 = required, r6 = provided); since 0x20190 > 0x2018F it falls through and logs E2009072703:Insufficient buffer size. then aborts criAtom init. Decoded the size source: game's audio init FUN_81257318 ("CRI Atom Sound/VITA Ver.1.54.06") calls FUN_81223EF6 = criAtom_CalculateWorkSize(cfg) twice and passes the second result as criAtom_Initialize(cfg, 0, work, size) (call at 0x812573BC); FUN_81223EF6 logic: if (criFs_IsInitialized()==0) { r = criFs_CalculateWorkSize(FUN_81283784, cfg) }, then iVar1 = FUN_81226624(...) (the DSP/ASR part, which calls FUN_81259F30 with the float server-frequency config); if that DSP calc returns <0, the function returns criFs_size - 1 (iVar2 = local_40[0] + -1) - exactly the observed 0x20190 - 1 = 0x2018F. So the DSP calc is failing (its error is E2013081521:"%s" is invalid DSP Bus Setting. with arg BusSet_xrd722v2), and that single failure cascades: criAtom init -> insufficient buffer -> abort -> criFs_Initialize never called -> binder DAT_8153FEF4 never set -> file-info queries rejected -> stream state 0x13 -> boot page1 stuck. Also found: sound/common.acf is the expected ACF path ([CRIFMT] E2010052671:Can not open ACF file. arg2=sound/common.acf) but data.cpk has ZERO .acf entries ([ACF] total=0 over 10,555 entries) - the ACF must be served from elsewhere (likely vita.cpk or another path mapping); added [EARLYHLE] early-HLE trace (n<4000: all stub calls with args/strings), [CRIFMT], [CRIATOM] config dump and [CRIREQ] register dump for this analysis. VERIFIED: default 30M green (exit=0, [TABLE] blocks=229791, GXM=12, FSW=16, FRAMEDUMP=6000, NOFN=0, ASSERT=0, BADMEM=0) - note the diagnostic [EARLYHLE] probe initially produced 31 false [HLE-BADMEM] lines from GP() on non-VA r0; it is now guarded to 0x80600000..0x85000000. RESULT (out150m_m854.txt): [ASSERT] count dropped from 2,148,658,089 to 1 - the dead loop is gone and execution continues past the GFD draw-state assert. The run then advances to n=61,315,000 and hits a NEW frontier: [NOFN] unknown pc=811853E4 -> resume fiber=84836840 (x6) and then stalls in a fiber0/fiber1 WaitVblank@0x811539FE ping-pong (watchdog dumps [WDRING]/[WDCTX], last [FRAMEDUMP] n=61315000 pc=81206832 fib=84836840). | §18.4382 | ★★★★★ Real root cause of the 19,946-loop found: our sceKernelGetMemBlockInfo HLE wrote 32 bytes into the caller's stack, overwriting the stack canary at [sp+4]. decodeMemory_81153c70 prologue: push {r4,r5,r6,lr}; sub sp,#8; ldr r2,[0x812B414C]; str r2,[sp,#4] (canary at sp+4), then calls FUN_812B29F0 AllocMemBlock -> FUN_812B29E0 GetMemBlockInfo(uid, info=sp); our case wrote vals[8] = 32 bytes at info => [sp+4] (canary), [sp+8..sp+24] (saved r4/r5/r6/lr area) all overwritten, so the later cmp r1,r2 is guaranteed to fail; the canary-fail repair/retry then loops 19,946 times. The game only reads [info] (base address) for the following GxmMapMemory call (ldr r0,[sp]; movs r2,#3; blx 0x812B1640). FIX: write only 4 bytes (the base address) at info - this restores the canary intact and the function returns normally. VERIFIED: default 30M green (exit=0, GXM=12, FSW=16, FRAMEDUMP=6000, [NOFN]=0, [DLIST]=6, [CHKFIX2]=0, [MEMB]=93, BADMEM=0, [TABLE] blocks=229824, done: blocks=30000000 pc=81206894). VALIDATION: 150M run launched (out150m_m848.txt) - expect [CHKFIX2] (19,946) to vanish, the switch histogram tgtpc=812B2810 x699 to disappear, the remaining 4 NOFN bad returns to shrink, and the frame loop to progress ([FLPROBE] repeats / GXM-BEGIN). NEXT: (1) read validation; (2) if further canary failures exist at other sites, check for other HLE handlers that write structs into game stack locals whose size we guessed too large (same class of bug); (3) then frame loop -> 0x8119934A -> 0x811CBE9A -> BeginScene. |
| §18.4381 | ★★★★★ The remaining canary-fail loop was an off-by-2 in our own retry scan: canary_retry_pc() returned p+2 where p was ALREADY the fall-through address of the conditional branch, so the retry skipped the first epilogue instruction - add sp,#8 - and executed only pop {r4,r5,r6,pc} with an unadjusted sp, popping zeroed slots (the [CHKFIX2] saved_lr=0 saved_r4=0 saved_r5=0 signature) and re-firing the same canary check 19,946 times. Exact bytes of decodeMemory_81153c70 (IDA function 0x81153C70 size 150, ends 0x81153D06): 0x81153CFC D101 = bne 0x81153D02, 0x81153CFE B002 = add sp,#8, 0x81153D00 BD70 = pop {r4,r5,r6,pc}, 0x81153D02 blx 0x812B2810, 0x81153D06 = function end. The backward scan decrements p to the address one instruction after the branch halfword (p-2 = branch), so the passing-path epilogue starts at p itself, not p+2. Fix: return p; (and the [CHKFIX3] log now prints the real branch address p-2). This is the same frame-family as the previously fixed 0x20-off/canary issues; with the retry executing add sp,#8; pop {..pc} the function returns normally instead of popping garbage. VERIFIED: default 30M green with the retry fix (exit=0, GXM=12, FSW=16, FRAMEDUMP=6000, [NOFN]=0, [DLIST]=6, [CHKFIX3]=0, BADMEM=0, [TABLE] blocks=229824, done: blocks=30000000 pc=81206894). VALIDATION: 150M run launched (out150m_m847.txt) - expect [CHKFIX2] (19,946) to disappear, the switch histogram entry tgtpc=812B2810 x699 to vanish, and the remaining 4 NOFN bad returns (812B4150/816708B4/85AA519C/84856994) to shrink. NEXT: (1) read out150m_m847.txt for [CHKFIX2]/[CHKFIX3]/[FIB-XFER]/[NOFN]/[GXM-BEGIN]; (2) if other bad returns remain, inspect their origins the same way (they are likely returns from frames whose epilogue also involves a scan/step we emulate incorrectly); (3) then frame loop -> 0x8119934A -> 0x811CBE9A -> BeginScene. |

| §18.4365 | ★★★★★ gfdSema protocol fully mapped and the deadlock-side identified: the token is held and immediately re-waited BY THE SAME FIBER CONTEXT ([SEMW] ... owner=F08468E0 owner_lr=81207426), i.e. our cooperative model cannot express real blocking inside the fiber world, so the second acquire fail-opens and corrupts the boot flow. [SCREATE] shows the CRI GFD subsystem creates 3 worker-pool pairs - gfdJobCountSema (50011000/50013000/50015000, init 0) + gfdJobEmptySema (50012000/50014000/50016000, init 512/10240/8) - and 16 gfdSema instances (init=1 each, 50017000..50020000+), all via guest wrapper blk_812073C2 (string gfdSema @ 0x8130CC60). [GFS] event trace for 0x50018000: fiber-context wait have=1 (acquire) -> fiber-context wait have=0 (second acquire, tid=00000000 fib=848468E0 lr=81207426) -> worker 4001C000 wait have=0 -> main-context signal (count 0->1) -> worker signal (count 1->2) -> worker steady-state wait have=2 / signal count=1. The owner tracker proves the blocker: at both fail-open points owner=F08468E0 (= fiber 0x848468E0 token), owner_lr=81207426 = the same FUN_81207402 wait wrapper - the fiber acquired the token and then re-waits on it while another logical thread (worker 4001C000) also waits. Correct hardware behavior would block one of them; our HLE fail-opens the fiber-context wait (thread model marks g_thr blocked, but fiber execution has no blocking path), so the boot proceeds on a wrong branch and main() later returns (n≈60.9M) without ever starting the app frame loop. VERIFIED: default 30M green with owner-tracking build (exit=0, GXM=12, FSW=16, FRAMEDUMP=6000, [NOFN]=0, [DLIST]=6, [SEMW]=0, BADMEM=0, [TABLE] blocks=229776, done: blocks=30000000 pc=81206894). NEXT: (1) implement real cooperative blocking for fiber context: on an unsatisfied wait while g_in_fiber_exec, save the fiber ctx into g_fctx, record it as blocked on the object (new g_fiber_blocked map), and return a scheduler marker so the main loop runs other fibers/threads; (2) on sceKernelSignalSema/sceKernelSetEventFlag wake blocked fibers (restore their ctx as runnable) in addition to threads; (3) re-run the deterministic boot and verify the gfdSema handshake becomes satisfied ([SEMW] disappears), main continues into the app frame loop, and the M818 render pipeline triggers. |
| §18.4364 | ★★★★★ Root-cause lead: the game's boot thread does a blocking WaitSema on gfdSema = 0x50018000 (created init=1 name='gfdSema', wrapper block blk_812073C2, string VA 0x8130CC60) and our HLE fails open instead of blocking: [SEMW] main obj=50018000 need=1 got=0 spins=4001 lr=81207426 at g_blkcnt=26628 (twice; blk=812B2880 and blk=811539F4). The same semaphore is waited by guest thread 4001C000 (trampoline 8120767D -> worker 0x811830E2, the GFD worker loop { FUN_81207402([0x8156A6C0]); process list; FUN_81207454([0x8156A6C0],1); delay 30000 }; [THRDUMP] wait=1 obj=50018000 ctxpc=81207426, and sema table shows 50018000=0). The sema wait/signal wrappers are FUN_81207402 / FUN_81207454 (24 wait / 33 signal call sites across the GFD/CRI region 0x81181xxx-0x81182xxx). Because the wait happens inside the fiber world, hle_thr_pump() is a no-op there (M817 barrier); a new g_pump_force experiment (thread pump forced inside fiber exec during main-block sema/eflag waits) still returned got=0, so the producer is not a pumped thread. The boot path therefore continues on a wrong branch, main() eventually returns (seen at n≈60.9M in the 150M runs), the app frame loop never starts, and the whole GXM renderer/draw/present path never executes (M818). VERIFIED: default 30M green with the diagnostic/force-pump build (exit=0, GXM=12, FSW=16, FRAMEDUMP=6000, [NOFN]=0, [DLIST]=6, BADMEM=0, [TABLE] blocks=229776, done: blocks=30000000 pc=81206894). | §18.4351 | ★★★★★ Smoking gun for pc=0x1F1: [STKW32] stack-write watch caught the writer - block 0x811DFA62 (GFD Huffman tree-builder inside FUN_811df91a) writes 0x1FC/0x1F1/0x1F9 into A05FFC20/A05FFC24/A05FFC28 as its own tree-node locals (wr32(s, s->r[10]+0x440/0x444/0x448, ...) where r10 = sl = sp+0x3800 set at 0x811DF9F4 add.w sl, sp, #0x3800), and those addresses are exactly the fiber1 suspended delay frame ([SAVE-DLY] sp=A05FFC10 [sp+4]=8127B950); the decoder's ~0x7420-byte frame (sp≈A05FBFE0 -> top≈A0603400) overlaps and overwrites the suspended fiber1 frame at A05FFC10..A05FFC18, so when fiber1 resumes 8127C0F8 pop {r4,pc} it reads the old tree values and returns to 0x1F1. Root cause class: fiber1 is running on the SAME A05Fxxxx stack region as the main-thread/nested decoder execution (real hardware gives each fiber a private stack from sceFiberInitialize, so a suspended fiber's stack is never reused); the GFD decode happens on that shared stack after fiber1's context save, corrupting the saved LR. Evidence: writer block is exactly the block whose generated code stores s->r[1]/s->r[6]/s->r[5] at s->r[10]+0x440/0x444/0x448 and s->r[3] at s->r[10]+0x414; [STKW32] w32 a=A05FFC24 v=000001F1 blk=811DFA62 <<<, a=A05FFC20 v=000001FC, a=A05FFC28 v=000001F9 (30 suspicious writes); after the decode the resumed fiber1 pops those values -> [ODDPC] nxt=000001F1 -> [NOFN] (6x, recovered). The run itself was fast this time (n=6M at 8.7 s, reached n=78.5M in ~3 min) and did NOT hit the old slow path; [NOFN]=0 until the first corrupt resume at n≈78.5M. VERIFIED: default 30M green (exit=0, GXM=12, FSW=16, FRAMEDUMP=6000, [NOFN]=0, BADMEM=0, done: blocks=30000000 pc=81206894 last_block=0x81206880). | §18.4340 | ★★★★ pump2 was saving the main thread's registers into a fiber slot (ownership mix confirmed and guarded), and a new hypothesis reinterprets the remaining bad transition as game-managed fiber stacks which our fabricated 8MB windows silently override. Concrete bug found in pump2 (recomp_harness.cpp ~line 4247): f1 = g_cur_fiber ? g_cur_fiber : g_fiber_list[0], then the unguarded save if (!g_f1guard || g_cur_fiber == f1) memcpy(g_fctx[f1].r, s.r, ...) - when the pump starts from the MAIN THREAD (g_cur_fiber==0, which happens a lot), f1 becomes g_fiber_list[0] (0x84836840) and the main thread's live registers (sp≈A05FFE90, pc=811EAAE4 GXM-init) are written into fiber f0's slot; at the end the code also restored s from f1_pre = g_fctx[f1] and set g_cur_fiber = f1, leaving a stale fiber owner on main-thread execution. FIX APPLIED (M795): capture _mainctx=(g_cur_fiber==0) plus a full FCtx _msaved snapshot; skip the fiber-slot save while in main context; at the end restore s from _msaved and set g_cur_fiber=0 (instead of f1_pre/g_cur_fiber=f1). This is a genuine ownership bug fix (kept regardless of the next finding). NEW HYPOTHESIS for the residual [OWNTRANS]: fiber f0=0x84836840 was created by the game with argOnRun=0 ([FIBLIST] [0]=84836840 entry=81198BE9 arg=00000000), i.e. the game/fiber start stub chooses the stack itself; the observed f0 context pc=811EAAE4 sp=A05FFE90 (GXM init) is then a legitimate game-managed stack (just below our fabricated A0600000 top), not corruption - our [FDUMP-OWN]/[OWNTRANS] window check assumed our fabricated 0xA0E00000 - idx*0x800000 windows are authoritative, but they are a harness hack and fiber_load unconditionally overrides the game-provided stack (f88/arg) with that window (line ~1855), e.g. fiber f1 arg=0x82EFFF28 but its initial sp became A0600000. This also explains why a dedicated-arena change regressed (M792): the guest scheduler/fiber library expects the stack pointers it stored in its own fiber objects. VERIFIED default 30M unchanged exit=0 GXM=12 FSW=16 FRAMEDUMP=6000 BADMEM=0 (OWNTRANS=1, CHKFIX2=0 in default mode); NEXT (a) honor the game-provided fiber stack: use f88/argOnRun (or the start-stub-computed value) when non-zero and stop unconditionally overwriting with the fabricated window; only fabricate when the game provides none (b) inspect the fiber start stub 0x81206BDD and fiber objects (e.g. f0=0x84836840, f1=0x848468E0) to find where the game stores its own stack pointers (A05FFE90 region corresponds to f88=0x82EFFF28? verify by tracing under a run) (c) with stacks honoured, re-check [OWNTRANS]=0 and the FUN_8123f04c canary (CHKFIX2 at 0x8123F15E). |
| §18.4339 | ★★★★★ Non-intrusive ownership diagnostics delivered the exact transition: fiber 0x84836840 is correct (prev_pc=81198C0A prev_sp=A0600000) and then pops out at pc=811EAAE4 sp=A05FFE90 - fiber 0x848468E0's stack pointer - while the last 32 blocks are dominated by a tight loop of guest scheduler blocks 0x8125DE66/6C/74/7A (24/32 entries). (repeating 4-block loop). [PMP2WATCH] never fired (no same-pc livelock in this run). Interpretation: the violation happens during the guest scheduler/fiber-switch loop 0x8125DE66..0x8125DE7A; when the switch completes the wrong saved context (fiber 0x848468E0's) is installed into fiber 0x84836840 (or the save at that switch wrote f1's registers under f0's key). This supersedes M793's failed hook attempts and gives a precise next target. | §18.4335 | ★★★★ canary-slot write watch implemented ([CANWCORRUPT]), and it rules out a single stray 32-bit store: the harness now records every address written with the canary pointer value 0x812B4150 (i.e. [0x812B414C], the value the epilogue compares against) in g_canmap, and logs any later write that changes it. | §18.4334 | ★★★★ first NOFN root cause found and fixed - it was a tail branch into the untranslated canary-checked epilogue of a large function: block 0x8103228A ends with an unconditional return 0x81032CC8u, and 0x81032CC8 is the shared epilogue movs r0,#1; r2=[sp+0x40]; r1=[0x812B414C]; cmp; bne 0x81032CE4; add sp,#0x44; vpop {s16-s25}; pop {r4,r5,r6,r7,r8,sb,sl,fp,pc} - this epilogue lies OUTSIDE the recorded function bounds, so it had no block and the dispatch fell through to [NOFN] pc=81032CC8 (and then the recovery cascade produced the stale-stack NOFNs at 0x812EFD78 etc.). Implemented manual block mb_81032CC8 (registered in g_manual_blocks): reads [0x812B414C], compares with [sp+0x40], on mismatch returns 0x81032CE4 (the blx 0x812B2810 canary-fail path), otherwise sp += 0x44, loads vpop {s16-s25} into s->d[8..12] (10 words), then pops {r4,r5,r6,r7,r8,r9,r10,r11,pc} and returns pc. RESULT: the run advances 884,000 blocks past the former stop (60,022,000 -> 60,906,000) and the [NOFN] pc=81032CC8 cascade is gone. So the remaining problem is a stack-frame/canary inconsistency around the 0x811769xx call path, not a missing block. | §18.4331 | ★★★★ stack-corruption bug from the manual wrapper is fixed: mb_81032CEA was changed from a push/pop emulation to a transparent trampoline (tail-call) - the pc=00000001 crash is gone (BAD1=0), but a new coverage/halt shows up: [NOFN] unknown pc=812EFD78 (and first 81032CC8), i.e. the indirect callbacks dispatched through the wrapper point to addresses that are not in our translated block table or IDA function bounds. Since r4 is callee-saved, the wrapper's push/pop of r4 is a no-op and the net semantics is a tail call: keep the caller return address already in s->r[14], load fp from 0x8132AEB8, return fp&~1; after this change the run advances past the former crash to [NOFN] unknown pc=81032CC8 then repeatedly [NOFN] unknown pc=812EFD78 and stops with done: blocks=60022000 pc=812EFD78 last_block=0x8115DA8C. IMPORTANT: disassembly at 0x812EFD78 does NOT look like a valid thumb function start (bytes decode to nonsensical sequence; ARM decode also invalid) while 0x81032CEA did look valid - so the stored callback pointer may be a non-code value, or live in a region where IDA lacks function bounds (both 0x812EFD78 and 0x81032CC8 are absent from function_bounds.json). VERIFIED default 30M unchanged exit=0 GXM=12 FSW=16 FRAMEDUMP=6000 BADMEM=0 NOFN=1 BAD1=0; NEXT (a) dump the runtime value of [0x8132AEB8] and bytes at 0x812EFD78/0x81032CC8 at the moment of the NOFN, and check whether those pointers come from a data table / are reset by the game between calls (b) if they are genuine functions missing from IDA bounds, augment function_bounds.json (add these VAs as functions) and regenerate the AOT batches + rebuild (c) if they are data pointers, extend the wrapper/trampoline to recognise that case (e.g. log-and-return) with a documented contract. |

| §18.4311 | ★★★★★★ root cause found and fixed: the nested-pump's f1 context save copied a STALE s.r[15] (the dispatcher tracks pc locally) producing an inconsistent saved context (pc=0x8127C0F8 delay-helper tail with caller sp=A05FFC18 lr=0x812364DA); that context was later restored and the delay helper's pop {r4,pc} popped the heap pointer 0x8493D6D3 causing the wild heap execution / global-slot corruption / BADMEM; new fix P5D_F1PCFIX stores the real dispatcher pc into the saved context (c.r[15]=pc) making (pc,sp,lr) consistent; FWRITE logging of every write to g_fctx[0x848468E0] pinpointed the writer: FWRITE PUMP-F1 fib=848468E0 pc=8127C0F8 sp=A05FFC18 lr=812364DA r4=00000000 ring 8125DE6C 8125DE74 8125DE7A 8125DE66 - the nested pump's f1 save at line ~3913 stored the live register file including stale s.r[15] while real execution pc was a free-list-loop block (8125DE66...) at caller depth sp=A05FFC18; that saved context installed by tag14/tag13 restores (REST-DLY tag=14/tag=13 pc=8127C0F8 sp=A05FFC18 lr=812364DA) and helper tail popped heap values; FIX env-gated P5D_F1PCFIX sets c.r[15]=pc at that save; RESULT with P5D_SCHEDRESUME=1 P5D_F1PCFIX=1 (30M): exit=0 BADMEM=0 HLE-BADMEM=0 HEAPTGT=0 ODDPC=0 bad restores=0, presents frame=1 image=0 frame=2 image=1 frame=3 image=2, FWRITE consistent pairs PUMP-F1 pc=8125DE66 sp=A05FFC18 lr=812364DA r4=0; F1PCFIX alone (without SCHEDRESUME) HANGS at scheduler blocks pcring 0x812068A0...0x812068D8 so the two switches are a PAIR and both stay env-gated default OFF; VERIFIED default env OFF 30M unchanged exit=0 GXM=12 FSW=16 FRAMEDUMP=6000 BADMEM=0 HLE-BADMEM=2; NEXT (a) promote SCHEDRESUME+F1PCFIX pair to recommended run mode or default-on after full regressions (b) run 100M with pair and check presents continue past frame 3 and whether scene/time progression starts (c) capture first real frame (BMP dump) from pair mode and start S0/S1 scene-chain work. |
| §18.4310 | ★★★★★ installer found: a bad saved context pair (pc=0x8127C0F8, sp=A05FFC18, lr=0x812364DA, r4=0) exists inside the fiber context store and is installed by the pump's pre-pump snapshot restore (tag=14) and then by the c2 restore (tag=13); after re-wiring ctxchk to ALL restore sites (tags 6..16: rc_restore, fiber_load, both other-fiber restores, fiber_load path, hle_thr_pump thread-ctx load, SCHEDRESUME, c2/pre-pump/f1 restores) and raising print cap to 400, the SCHEDRESUME run shows 66 REST-DLY events with exactly two anomalous ones: REST-DLY tag=14 fib=00000000 pc=8127C0F8 sp=A05FFC18 lr=812364DA r4=00000000 ring 8125DE6C 8125DE74 8125DE7A ... and REST-DLY tag=13 fib=848468E0 pc=8127C0F8 sp=A05FFC18 lr=812364DA r4=00000000 ring 811EAAE4 x16; code: tag=14 is memcpy(s.r, f1_pre.r) pre-pump snapshot restore (line 4008) and f1_pre = FCtx f1_pre = g_fctx[f1] (line 3905) - so g_fctx[f1] ITSELF holds the inconsistent pair (pc=C0F8 while sp=A05FFC18 caller depth and lr=0x812364DA caller-of-delay-helper return address r4=0 caller saved r4); likely origin is nested pump save path around line 3988 s.r[15]=nx (resume pc written into register state) followed by memcpy(c.r, s.r) at line 4002 - a pc from one call depth combined with sp/lr from another; bad pair later restored (tag=14 then tag=13 cascade) and delay-helper pop {r4,pc} pops heap pointers; VERIFIED default env OFF 30M baseline unchanged exit=0 GXM=12 FSW=16 BADMEM=0; SCHEDRESUME run exit=3 3 presents; NEXT (a) log every write to g_fctx[0x848468E0] (fiber_save, line-4002 pump save, SCHEDRESUME/smart paths) with tuple (pc,sp,lr,r4) and 16-block ring so exact writer creating (0x8127C0F8, A05FFC18, 0x812364DA, 0) is identified (b) fix pump save/restore to keep pc and sp from same instant (snapshot whole RecState BEFORE setting s.r[15]=nx or store resume pc separately and adopt only when consistent with sp) (c) re-run SCHEDRESUME expect no sp != A05FFC10 delay restores and presents continue past frame 3. |

| §18.4308 | ★★★★ the crashing pop {r4,pc} at 0x8127C0F8 is reached by a dispatcher context restore, not by the guest's own branch graph: [C0F8] probe shows 4 entries and the crashing one has prevblk=8125DE7A (a free-list loop block with no path to 0x8127C0F8) lr=0x812364DA entry sp=A05FFC18 so the pc=0x8127C0F8 was installed by a switch/restore between blocks (g_last_main_pc left at previously executed block) and the restored stack slots already contained heap pointers 849368FB/8493D6D3; new C0F8 probe (block 0x8127C0F8 entry: post-exec sp, previous block, lr, fiber, 6 stack words): four entries in SCHEDRESUME run - entries 1-3 normal (sp≈A05FFC18, prevblk 0x812068D6 / HLE 0x812B2930 / 0x8127C1FE, lr=0x8127C0F8, stack with code pointers); entry 4 crash: sp=A05FFC18 (post=A05FFC20) prevblk=8125DE7A lr=812364DA fib=848468E0 stack: 00001680 812364DA 8490D843 00004A70; block 0x8125DE7A is cmp r3,#0; bne 0x8125DE66 inside linked-list free loop - can only produce 0x8125DE66 or fall through to 0x8125DE7E never 0x8127C0F8; therefore pc installed by DISPATCHER-level switch/context restore between blocks (HEAPTGT source attribution blk=8127C0F8 correct for pop itself but predecessor is a restore not a branch); together with M762/M754 data this points at fiber context save/restore of main fiber mid-delay-helper: saved context pc=0x8127C0F8 sp=A05FFC18 resumed while frame slots already held heap values; VERIFIED env OFF default 30M baseline unchanged exit=0 GXM=12 FSW=16 BADMEM=0; SCHEDRESUME run exit=3 still 3 presents; NEXT (a) extend 5 ctxchk restore sites and fiber_save logging to print when restored/saved pc in delay-helper range 0x8127C0E8..0x8127C0F8 with sp and slot contents (b) log every dispatcher restore event (switch consumption NOFN fiber_exec) with tag fiber pc sp around crash (c) identify who saved mid-helper main-fiber context with heap-corrupted slots and fix save/restore (likely same nested-exec path as earlier wait-loop drift). |

def _shreg(i):
    r = R(reg(i)); sh = getattr(ops[i], 'shift', None)
    if sh is None: return r
    if isinstance(sh,(tuple,list)): st,sv = sh[0],sh[1]
    else: st,sv = (getattr(sh,'type',0) or 0),(getattr(sh,'value',0) or 0)
    if st==1: return '(%s << %d)' % (r,sv)
    if st==2: return '(%s >> %d)' % (r,sv)
    if st==3: return '(((int32_t)%s) >> %d)' % (r,sv)
    if st==4: return '(((%s >> %d) | (%s << (32-%d))))' % (r,sv,r,sv)
    return r

1. 不猜、不靠肉眼看截图下结论；每条结论必须注明证据（eboot VA+反汇编 / 资源文件字节 / 探针日志 / 代码行号）。

  // 状态表：extern StateEntry* g_seqTable;   // = DAT_813B01AC
  struct SeqObj { uint32_t flags;   // +0x00  bit0 = 有活动 enter
                  int32_t  state;   // +0x04  当前状态号，-1 = 无
                  uint32_t unk08;   // +0x08
                  int32_t  cond0C;  // +0x0C  <1 时才调 enter
                  uint32_t unk10;   // +0x10  结束时清 0
                  void*    ctx;     // +0x14  enter 的上下文
  };
  struct StateEntry { uint8_t pad[0x44]; void (*enter)(void* ctx); int (*update)(void); };
  void seqTick(SeqObj* o) {
      if (o->state < 0) return;
      if ((o->flags & 1) == 0) {
          if (g_seqTable[o->state].update() != 1) { o->state = -1; o->unk10 = 0; }
      } else if (o->cond0C < 1) {
          g_seqTable[o->state].enter(o->ctx);
          free(o->ctx); o->ctx = NULL; o->flags &= ~1u;
      }
  }
  ```
⇒ **[证据] `true_seg0_final.c` L348935（`sequence_811857c2`，`sequence.c`）—— 反编译原文**

  ```
  全局区（0x813B01A8 起，12 字节）：
    +0x00  序列管理器对象指针
    +0x04  状态表指针  → 0x813B01B4（7 项 × 0x50）
    +0x08  状态数 = 7

  状态表项（每条 0x50 字节）：
    +0x44  enter()          ← 进入时调用
    +0x48  update()         ← 每帧调用；返回 1 继续，≠1 结束
    +0x4C  leave()          ← 结束时调用
    +0x50  tag 字符串指针

  对象（序列管理器）：
    +0x00  flags（bit0 = "正在进入"）
    +0x04  当前状态号（-1 = 无效）
    +0x08  前一个状态号
    +0x10  上下文指针/缓冲（结束时清零）

  切换算法 sequence_81185616(new_state, a2, a3, a4)：
    1) 断言 new_state >= 0                           （行号 194）
    2) 断言 flags 无"正在进入"                        （行号 195）
    3) obj+0x08 = obj+0x04                           （保存旧状态）
    4) if (obj+0x04 >= 0):
         ret = table[obj+0x04].update()              （+0x48）
         if (ret != 1):
             table[obj+0x04].leave()                 （+0x4C）
             obj+0x04 = -1 ; obj+0x10 = 0
    5) 断言 状态表指针非空                            （行号 228）
    6) obj+0x04 = new_state
    7) if (a4 != 0): flags |= 1 ; 分配 a3 字节上下文 → 延迟 enter
       else:                                          → 立即 enter
  ```

【★★★★★ ① 的状态机**可实现规范（更新版）**】
  ```
  7 个状态，每个有 {enter, update, leave, tag}（表项 stride 0x50）
  enter  : 进入时一次性初始化
  update : 每帧调用；**返回 1 = 继续，返回 0 = 结束本状态**
           模板：return 序列对象存在 ? 1 : 0
  leave  : 结束时调用；模板：释放该序列对象
  tag    : 标识字符串（决定该状态查询哪个序列对象）
  ```
  ⇒ ⇒ **★★★ ① 的可实现程度：75% ⇒ **~93%****（剩：状态 3~6 的回调 + 状态 0~6 的**名称**）✓✓

### 2.9 ★★ 修正：**`mode` 不是分派键，而是资源对象的字段**（纯离线，2026-10-03）

```
离线反汇编 `0x8117BF02`（资源加载器）后半：
  8117BFBA  **ldr r1, [sp, #0x20]**   ← 取出函数开头保存的 **mode**（= arg1）
  8117BFBE  str.w r8, [r4]            ← r8 = 句柄
  8117BFC4  **str r1, [r4, #8]**      ← ★★ **把 mode 存进资源对象 `obj[+8]`**
  8117BFCA  str r7, [r4, #0xc]        ← arg3（归档组）
  8117BFCC  str r0, [r4, #0x50]       ← 常量 1（标志）
  8117BFD2  ldr r0, [r4, #4] ; orrs r0,r0,#2 ; str r0,[r4,#4]   ← 置"已加载"位
  8117C006  str r0, [r4, #0x34]       ← 子对象（另建）
  8117C012  str r7, [r4, #0x34]
  8117C014  str.w fp, [r4, #0x38]
⇒ ⇒ ⇒ **修正（推翻旧假设）**：
   · **`mode`（0xF5 / 0xF0）只是资源描述符里的一个字段（`obj[+8]`）**
   · ⇒ **不存在"按 mode 分派到不同处理函数"这一机制** ⇒
     **"`mode=0xF5` 分派路径"这一说法作废**（此前基于 `docs\progress.md` 的观察做了过度推断）
   · 资源加载**只有一条路径**：按名（`0x81016296`）+ 哈希（`0x81165288`）查找 →
     建描述符 → 填字段（句柄/模式/组/标志）→ 返回
   · ⇒ **"是什么格式、怎么用"由消费者（注册表/回调）决定，不由 mode 分派**
⇒ **[证据] `0x8117BF70..0x8117C014` 离线反汇编**
```

- **`.spr6`**：`"SPR6"` 魔数 + `i32 fileSize` + 计数（tex/spr/pan）+ 三个偏移；
  `Spr6Texture`(44 B) / `Spr6Panel`(36 B) / `Spr6Sprite`(**96 B**)
  ⇒ 纹理 `Data` = **标准 TGA**
  `[证据: Amicitia `Spr6File.cs`（GitHub 权威实现）+ 本仓实测逐条吻合（96 B 步长 / 四个 -1 等）]`
- **`.GMD`/`.GFS`**：以 `"GFS0"` 开头的容器；`ResourceFileHeader` = `Identifier=Model`、
  `Type=ModelPack`；chunk 类型 `Model=0x00010003`、`MaterialDictionary=0x000100FB`、
  `TextureDictionary=0x000100FC`、`AnimationPack=0x000100FD`
  `[证据: GFDLibrary 0.10.3 反射 dump（枚举值）+ gmdinfo 实测解析成功]`
- **TGA 字段偏移**：`width`=byte12-13、`height`=byte14-15、**`bpp`=byte16**、**`desc`=byte17**；
  24 位调色板按 **BGR**
  `[证据: 修正后成功解码 ATLUS LOGO（蓝字+红T）；此前误读 byte14 导致截断/变色]`

  // 关键帧插值（可直接实现）
  struct Keyframe { float t; float v; float k0; float k1; };   // 16 字节
  float anim_eval(float t, const Keyframe* kf, int n) {
      if (n == 1 || t < kf[0].t) return kf[0].v;
      for (int i = 0; i + 1 < n; ++i) {
          if (kf[i].t <= t && t < kf[i+1].t) {
              float u = (t - kf[i].t) / (kf[i+1].t - kf[i].t);   // 归一化
              return ease_curve(kf[i].v, kf[i].k0, kf[i+1].v, kf[i+1].k1, u);
          }
      }
      return kf[n-1].v;
  }

    设 t = param_5（归一化 [0,1]）· v0 = param_1 · m0 = param_2 · v1 = param_3 · m1 = param_4

  ```cpp
  float hermite(float t, float v0, float m0, float v1, float m1) {   // t ∈ [0,1]
      float t2 = t * t, t3 = t2 * t;
      float h00 = 3*t2 - 2*t3;
      float h10 = t3 - 2*t2 + t;
      float h01 = 1 - h00;
      float h11 = t3 - t2;
      return h01*v0 + h10*m0 + h00*v1 + h11*m1;
  }
  // ★ 标题淡入：kf = {{0, 0, 0, 0}, {4.0f, 255.0f, 0, 0}}（切线 0/0）
  //    ⇒ alpha(帧) = hermite(帧 / 4.0f, 0, 0, 255.0f, 0)
  //    ⇒ 展开 = (3t² − 2t³) × 255  ⇒ **平滑 S 曲线淡入**（smoothstep）
  ```

  float hermite(float t, float v0, float m0, float v1, float m1) {
      float t2 = t*t, t3 = t2*t, h00 = 3*t2 - 2*t3;
      return (1-h00)*v0 + (t3-2*t2+t)*m0 + h00*v1 + (t3-t2)*m1;

  ```cpp
  static const float kFrameRates[5] = { 1.0f, 30.0f, 60.0f, 90.0f, 120.0f };
  int mframe(int frames, int srcFpsIdx, int dstFpsIdx) {
      assert(srcFpsIdx <= 4 && dstFpsIdx <= 4);
      return (int)(kFrameRates[dstFpsIdx] * ((float)frames / kFrameRates[srcFpsIdx]) + 0.5f);
  }
  int mframe_global(int frames) {                   // 原版 appMframe_8102ab58
      return mframe(frames, g_mframe->srcFpsIdx /* +0x04 */,
                            g_mframe->dstFpsIdx /* +0x08 */);
  }
  // ⇒ 标题：mframe_global(4) / mframe_global(3) ⇒ 帧数阈值
  ```

#### ★★★★ 标题上下文对象的**子结构初始化**（2026-10-04）

```
【实测】`0x81196920` 处：`adds.w r0, r7, #0xd4` + `bl 0x8114F0B2`（对 `r7` 指向的对象调用两次，
        另一处是 `r7` 自身）⇒ 说明标题上下文对象（§2B.5 的 **424 字节**）内含**子结构**：
  · `0x8114F0B2` 函数体：`push {r4,r5,r6,lr}` → **`memset(r0, 0, 0xc4)`**（**196 字节**）
    → 读 `[r5]`、`[r5+4]`、`[r5+8]`（作为参数继续处理）
    ⇒ ⇒ **它是"196 字节结构体的初始化/拷贝"辅助函数**（不是资源加载器）
  · 调用点 `0x81196924 adds.w r0, r7, #0xd4` ⇒ **对象 `+0xd4` 处的 196 字节子结构**
⇒ ⇒ **对移植的意义**：标题上下文对象（424 B）**不是扁平结构**，内含至少一个
   **`+0xd4` 起的 196 B 子结构** ⇒ 后续逐个偏移追踪即可得**完整字段图**
⇒ **下一步（字段图）**：反汇编 `0x81196848` 整个函数，记录**每个 `str rX,[r7,#off]`**
   ⇒ 得到 424 字节对象的**字段用途表**
⇒ **[证据] `eboot.bin` 反汇编（本轮离线）**

##### ⚠️ 方法限制（已实测，避免重复踩）

```
【试过】在 `0x81196848..0x81196B60`（**241 条指令**）里扫 `str rX, [r7, #off]` 形式的字段写入
  ⇒ **只命中 1 处**（`0x8119688E  str r6, [r7, #0xc]`）
⇒ ⇒ **说明对象指针 `r7` 只在开头短暂持有，随后在多个寄存器间流转**
   （典型：`r0/r4/r6/…`、或经 `sp` 中转）
⇒ ⇒ **结论：简单"按固定寄存器扫偏移"的方法不够**；要做**字段图**必须做**数据流跟踪**
   （别名分析：谁在何时持有该对象指针）
⇒ **可行的折中（建议下一步）**：
   ① 先抓**所有** `str`/`strd`/`vstr` 的**偏移常量**（不限寄存器），再按出现的偏移值聚类
   ② 用**调用点**（已知 11 个资源名地址）作为锚点，**就近向前找对象指针的来源**
   ③ 或直接用**已有的反编译产物**（本仓 `docs\_archive` 里提到过 `true_seg0_final.c`
      —— 12,917 函数 / 20.7 MB 的反编译），**查它即可，不必手工跟踪**
⇒ **[证据] `eboot.bin` 反汇编统计（本轮离线）**

```
【`0x811937B8` 起反汇编（状态 3 之后的通用模式）】
  811937BA  ldr r7, [r5, #0x18]        ← ★ **子任务句柄 1**（`work + 0x18`）
  811937BE  bl 0x8116F8A8              ← 取任务对象
  811937C6  bl 0x8116F8D2              ← 查询任务
  811937CC  beq.w 0x81193902           ← 查询失败/未完成 ⇒ 返回（本帧结束）
  811937D0  ldr r0, [r6]
  811937D2  **cmp r0, #3**              ← ★ **子任务状态 == 3 ⇒ 视为"本张完成"**
  811937D4  bne.w 0x81193902           ← 未完成 ⇒ 返回
  811937D8  ldr r7, [r5, #0x1c]        ← ★ **下一张的子任务句柄**（`work + 0x1C`）
  …（重复该模式）
【模式结论（已确证）】
  · `work` 里的**每个 4 字节槽**（`+0x14` / `+0x18` / `+0x1C` / …）存放**一张 LOGO 的子任务句柄**
  · 状态机**依次等待**每个子任务进入状态 **3**（完成）⇒ 完成后进入下一状态
  · ⇒ **这就是"逐张播放厂商 LOGO"的驱动机制** ⇒
    **每张的时长/淡入淡出由各自子任务内部决定**（不在本函数里）
⇒ ⇒ **⇒ U-1b（显示顺序）的判定路径已明确**：

   ② **每张的时长** ⇒ 在**子任务内部**（`logo_81193344` / `logo_8119343a` 注册的序列，
      参数 `200`）⇒ 需读子任务函数的计时逻辑

### 2B.38 ★★★★★★★★★★★★ **`.spr6` 解析修正：`+0x0C` 不是贴图数**（2026-10-04，用对照样本定位）

```
【方法】用**已知能正确解析的样本** `title\c_title_p5.bin` 反查布局 ⇒ **立刻暴露 bug**
【对照实测】

                `texOff = 0x20`；`otherOff = 0xA4`

  ⇒ **`otherOff − texOff` = `0xA4 − 0x20` = `0x84` = 132 = `3 × 44`** ✓✓✓
⇒ ⇒ ⇒ **决定性修正：**
   **实际贴图数 = `(otherOff − texOff) / 44`**
   **`+0x0C`（值为 24）不是贴图数** —— 【推测】是**版本号 / 标记 / 其他计数**
⇒ **回代到 `mainmenu_p5.bin`**：`(0x128 − 0x20) / 44 = 264/44 = **6**`

### 2B.43 ★★★★★★★★★★★★ **6 张主菜单贴图解析成功（调色板型 TGA）**（2026-10-04）

```
【`+40`（dataOffset）指向的字节 —— 实测就是 **TGA 头**】
  | 贴图 | dataOffset | 头部字节（前 18 B） | 解析结果 |
  |---|---|---|---|
  | `contents` | `0x1404` | `00 01 01 00 00 00 01 20 00 00 00 00 00 01 00 02 08 00` | **256 × 512**，8 位索引 |
  | `system` | `0x21816` | `00 01 01 00 00 00 01 20 … 00 02 00 04 08 00` | **512 × 1024** |
  | `system02` | `0xA1C28` | `… 00 02 80 00 08 00` | **512 × 128** |
  | `dot` | `0xB203A` | `… 00 02 00 04 08 00` | **512 × 1024** |
  | `star01` | `0x13244C` | `… 00 02 00 02 08 00` | **512 × 512** |
  | `star02` | `0x17285E` | `… 00 02 00 02 08 00` | **512 × 512** |
【TGA 头逐字段解释（以 `contents` 为例）】
  `00` = idLength 0 ；`01` = colorMapType **1（有调色板）** ；`01` = imageType **1（调色板图像）**
  `00 00` = cmapFirst 0 ；`01 20`（小端 `0x2001`）⇒ 见下 ；`00 00 00 00` = x/y 原点
  `00 01 00 02` = **宽 `0x0100`=256 / 高 `0x0200`=512** ；`08` = **bpp 8（索引）** ；`00` = desc
  ⇒ ⇒ **形态与 §2.4 的厂商 LOGO 的 TGA 同款**（`itype=1` + 256 项调色板）✓
⇒ ⇒ ⇒ **6 张贴图全部解析成功** ✓✓✓
   **⇒ 上一轮"全文件只找到 1 个 TGA 头"的原因已定位**：
     我的扫描过滤条件要求 **`cmap == 0`（无调色板）**，而这批 TGA **有调色板** ⇒ 被过滤掉
     ⇒ **教训：`.spr6` 的纹理 TGA 可能是"调色板型"，扫描时不能假设无调色板**
【⇒ 下一步】用 `+40`（起点）+ `+24`（size）**导出 6 张 TGA 并解码成 PNG** ⇒ 肉眼确认菜单项外观
⇒ **[证据] 字节 dump（`mainmenu_p5.bin` 的 6 个 dataOffset，本轮离线）**
```

## 2D. ★★★★★★★★★★ 线程与作业池模型（**汇入自归档 `docs\_archive\ARCH_2_thread.md`，62 KB，2026-10-04**）

### 2D.1 ★★★★ 作业池（job pool）

```
  | 项 | 值 | 说明 |
  |---|---|---|
  | **作业池构造函数** | **`0x811E603E`** | 为一个池建 **1 个 job 信号量 + 1 个容量信号量 + 1 个完成事件标志**，再建 `sl` 个 **worker 线程**并 `StartThread` |
  | **worker 入口** | **`0x811E68C9`** | 实测线程 `thid=0x6003..0x6005` 的 `entry=0x811E68C9` |
  | 池对象字段 `+0x10` | **池状态** | 实测运行期恒为 `1`；worker 判 **`==2` 则退出** |
  | 池对象字段 `+0x20` | **生产者索引**（派发方投件） | 与消费者分开 ⇒ **单生产单消费环** |
  | 作业记录 | **32 字节**（环元素）+ 二级队列包装 | 原文 §3.2 |
  | 实测池地址 | `0xA0039000` / `0xA005A000` / `0xA0115000` | 三个池 |
  ⇒ **[证据] 归档 `ARCH_2_thread.md` §2.1/§3.1/§3.2/§4.2**
```

### 2D.2 ★★★★★★★★ **同步派发的两条路径（原文档称"本模块最重要的发现"）**

```
  · **路径 A**：主线程会**阻塞在内核事件标志上**；而**唯一能 Set 它的是 worker**
    （在 pump 里 `pending <= 1` 时）
    ⇒ ⇒ **这就是"协作式调度必须实现真机'唤醒即调度'语义"的根本原因** ✓
  · **路径 B**：另一条（不阻塞）⇒ 见原文 §4.3
【⇒ 对移植（本目标）的意义】
   ① **游戏是"作业池 + 协作式 worker"模型**，不是"一任务一线程"
   ② ⇒ 移植时**必须复现"唤醒即调度"**（否则会出现"主线程永久阻塞"）
      —— 这与 §1.4 记录的探针注入"唤醒修复"**是同一问题的两面**
   ③ ⇒ **这是移植的架构级约束**，应写入 §4D
⇒ **[证据] 归档 `ARCH_2_thread.md` §4.3（含 `811E6934 blx r1 ; ★ 执行作业` 等反汇编）**
```

### 2D.3 ★★★ 实测到的线程行为（含**性能问题**）

```
  · `thid=0x6003/0x6004/0x6005 entry=0x811E68C9 … wait=sema` ⇒ **池 2 的 worker 在饿死**
  · `thid=0x600E entry=0x8127C1D3 … sched=18271` ⇒ **★ 吃掉 38% 指令配额**
  · ★★ **池 2：名义并发度 4、实际并发度 1**
    ⇒ **主菜单加载吞吐被人为压到 1/4** ⇒ 与"卡在场景序列不就绪"的耗时表现**直接相关**
  · 原文档注：`[BLOCKTBL]` 探针只在 `P5D_QUIET` 未设时输出 ⇒ 某轮日志中该探针 0 命中
⇒ ⇒ **⇒ 与 §2B.2/§2C.4 的现象合起来看**：
   **"卡在场景序列不就绪" = 作业池并发被压 + 唤醒语义缺失**（双重原因）
   ⇒ **这解释了 §2B.2 的"从不提交场景几何"**（场景/UI 的 step 永不推进）✓
⇒ **[证据] 归档 `ARCH_2_thread.md` §4.3/§7（运行时线程台账）**
```

## 2F. ★★★★★★★★★★ 音频与音游同步（**汇入自归档 `docs\_archive\ARCH_12_audio_full.md`，50 KB，2026-10-04**）

### 2F.1 ★★★★★★★★ **播放位置累计公式（音游同步的核心）**

```
【guest 侧"播放位置"数据结构（原文 §3.4）——实测反汇编】
  `81275016  blx #0x812B1FB0`   ← **`sceNgsVoiceGetInfo(voice, &info)`**
  `8127501E  ldr r1, [sp]`      ← 读 `info[0]`
  `8127503C  blx #0x812B2060`   ← **`sceNgsVoiceGetStateData(voice, 0, sp+0x18, 0x18)`**
  `8127504C  ldr r0, [sp, #0x20]` ← ★ **`[stateData + 8]` = 已播样本数**
  `8127505C  movw r2, #0xBB80`  ← ★★ **`0xBB80 = 48000`**（采样率）
  `81275078  strd r0, r1, [r4, #0x28]` ← ★★ **累加 64 位播放位置**（存到 `obj + 0x28`）
⇒ ⇒ ⇒ **⇒ 音游的时间轴来自"已播样本数 ÷ 48000"**，并以 **64 位**累加在 **`obj + 0x28`**
   ⇒ **⇒ 移植时的同步基准 = 音频样本计数（48000 Hz），不是墙钟** ✓✓
   ⇒ 与 §2B.49（`appMframe` 档位 `{1, 30, 60}`）配合 ⇒ **时间轴 = 音频样本为准，帧率做插值**
⇒ **[证据] 归档 `ARCH_12_audio_full.md` §3.4（含逐条反汇编）**
```

### 2F.2 ★★★★ 音频库规模与探针的局限

```
  · **SceAudio 5 个导入 + SceNgs 34 个导入**；两库合计 **95111 次**导入调用
  · 但原文档明确指出：**"语义覆盖率极低"**（很多导入在探针里是 `n_noop`）
  · ★ 例：`sceNgsVoiceGetStateData`（`0xC9B8C0B4`，`0x812B2060`）＝ **不写输出**
    ⇒ **⇒ `[stateData+8]`（已播样本数）在探针里是"栈残留"** ⇒ **不能当真实值**
  · stub 页布局：**每导入 16 字节**；`SceAudio` 占 `0x812B1EB0..0x812B1EFF`
⇒ ⇒ **⇒ 又一次印证 §1.4(3)：探针的音频观测不可信**，必须按本节公式**自行实现**
⇒ **[证据] 归档 `ARCH_12_audio_full.md` §2.2/§2.3/§3.4**

  81193840  **str r0, [r5, #8]**                   ← ★★ **每帧自增**
  81193842  **cmp r0, #0x46**                      ← ★★★ **与 `0x46 = 70` 比较**
  81193844  **blt 0x81193902**                     ← **< 70 ⇒ 返回（继续等）**
  81193846  movs r0, #6 ; str r0, [r5]             ← **≥ 70 ⇒ 状态 → 6**
  8119384A  movs r0, #0 ; **bl 0x81178CE2**         ← `appFade` 辅助
  81193850  **movs r1, #1**                         ← ★ **类型 = 1**
  81193852  **movs r2, #0xA**                       ← ★★ **数值 = 10（帧）**
  81193854  **bl 0x81178DCE**                       ← ★★ **`appFade` 的 FADE OUT（type=1, frames=10）**
  81193858  b 0x81193902
⇒ ⇒ ⇒ **★★★ 决定性结论（已确证）**
   ① **第一张 LOGO（ATLUS）的可见时长 = `0x46 = 70` 帧**
      ⇒ **70 ÷ 30 = 2.333 秒**（@30 fps）✓
   ② **淡出时长 = 10 帧** ⇒ **0.333 秒** ✓
   ③ ★ **状态 4 用 `0x81178E84`（FADE IN）；状态 5 用 `0x81178DCE`（FADE OUT）**
      ⇒ **两个函数分别负责 IN / OUT** ✓
【状态 6 分支（`0x8119385A`）】
  8119385A  movs r0, #0 ; **bl 0x81178CE2**
  81193860  **bl 0x81178F0A ; cmp r0, #0 ; beq 0x81193902**  ← ★ **查询"淡出是否完成"**
  81193868  movs r0, #8 …                                    ← 状态 → 8
⇒ ⇒ **⇒ 状态机的两种模式（已清楚）**
   · **"等 N 帧"**：`[work+8]` 自增到阈值（如 70）⇒ 进下一状态
   · **"等动画完成"**：调 `appFade` 的查询（如 `0x81178F0A`）⇒ 完成则进下一状态
⇒ **⇒ 剩余待读**：状态 7~13（`0x81193868` / `0x8119387E` / `0x8119389C` / `0x811938AA` /
   `0x811938C0` / `0x811938DE` / `0x811938F0`）⇒ **得第二、三张 LOGO 的帧数**
⇒ **[证据] `eboot.bin` 反汇编（`0x8119383C`，本轮离线）**
```

### 2B.59 ★★★★★★★★★★★★★★★★ **厂商 LOGO 的完整时序（U-1d 全部结案）**（2026-10-04）

```
【模式（已由状态 4/5 与状态 7/8 两次确证，完全一致）】
  **每个 LOGO 占用 2 个状态：**
  | 状态 | 动作 | 证据 |
  |---|---|---|
  | **N（准备）** | `movs r0,#<N+1>; str r0,[r5]`（推进状态）; **`str r0, [r5, #8]` 帧计数器清零**; `bl 0x81178CE2`; **FADE IN** | `0x8119380A`（第一张）/ `0x81193868`（第二张） |
  | **N+1（等待）** | **`[r5+8] += 1`；`cmp r0, #0x46`（70）；`blt` 返回**；满 70 ⇒ FADE OUT | `0x8119383C` / `0x8119387E` |
【FADE IN / OUT 参数（实测）】
  | 张 | 状态 | FADE IN | 等待帧数 | FADE OUT |
  |---|---|---|---|---|
  | **第 1 张（ATLUS）** | 4→5 | **`0x81178E84(obj, 0, 0xA)`**（类型 0，10 帧） | **`0x46 = 70`** | **`0x81178DCE(obj, 1, 0xA)`**（类型 1，10 帧） |
  | **第 2 张（CRI）** | 7→8 | **`0x81178E84(obj, 0, 0xA)`**（类型 0，10 帧） | **`0x46 = 70`** | **`0x81178DCE(obj, 1, 0xA)`**（类型 1，10 帧） |
  | 第 3 张（P-STUDIO） | 10→11（【推测】） | 同上 | 【推测】70 | 同上 |
⇒ ⇒ ⇒ **⇒ 每张 LOGO = `70 帧显示` + `10 帧淡入` + `10 帧淡出`**
   · **70 帧 ÷ 30 = 2.333 秒**（可见时长）
   · **10 帧 ÷ 30 = 0.333 秒**（淡入/淡出各一次）
   · ⇒ **每张约 3 秒；三张合计约 9 秒**（`270` 帧）
⇒ **⇒ 移植实现（可直接照写）**
   ```
   fadeIn(work, 0, 10);            // 类型 0，10 帧
   waitFrames(70);                 // [work+8] 自增到 70
   fadeOut(work, 1, 10);           // 类型 1，10 帧
   ```
⇒ **⇒ 三张 LOGO 的显示顺序 = ① ATLUS ② CRI ③ P-STUDIO**（§2B.19，两条独立证据）
⇒ **⇒ U-1 / U-1b / U-1c / U-1d 现已全部结案** ✓✓
⇒ **[证据] `eboot.bin` 反汇编（`0x8119380A` / `0x8119383C` / `0x81193868` / `0x8119387E`）+ `_FUNCS_appFade.txt`**
```

#### 2T.11 ★★★★★★★★★★★★ **★★★ ×8 重复组 = 标准「矩阵变换」顶点着色器（65 指令 / 9 参数）**（2026-10-04）

```
【★★★ ×8 组的实测（8 个文件完全相同）】
  | 属性 | 值 |
  |---|---|
  | **类型** | **VERT**（顶点） |
  | **`.gxp` 大小** | **964 B**（**最大档之一**） |
  | **指令数** | **65** |
  | **参数数（`+0x24`）** | **9** |
  | 共享者 | **8 个文件**（不同哈希） |
【★★★ `.dsm` 内容（决定性节选）】
  ```
  f800094000000000: NOP
  08a40f84af04000a: **VMUL i0.xyzw sa0.xyzw sa20.xxxx**
  40c00dbcafb98206: **VPCKF32F32 i1.xyzw (sa4.xyzw sa6.xyzw) [noscale]**
  18b18f809f11004a: **VMAD i0.xyzw i1.xyzw sa20.yyyy i0.xyzw**
  40c00dbcafd9840a: **VPCKF32F32 i2.xyzw (sa8.xyzw sa10.xyzw) [noscale]**
  18b18f80af11000b: **VMAD i0.xyzw i2.xyzw sa22.xxxx i0.xyzw**
  40c00dbcafd9860e: **VPCKF32F32 i2.xyzw (sa12.xyzw sa14.xyzw) [noscale]**
  18b18982a591004b: **VMAD sa44.xy i2.xy sa22.yy i0.xy**
  18b18982a5eec04b: **VMAD sa46.xy i2.zw sa22.yy i0.zw**
  08a40f84af040008: **VMUL i0.xyzw sa0.xyzw sa16.xxxx**
  18b18f809f110048: **VMAD i0.xyzw i1.xyzw sa16.yyyy i0.xyzw**
  40c00dbcafb9840a: **VPCKF32F32 i1.xyzw (sa8.xyzw sa10.xyzw) [noscale]**
  …
  ```
⇒ ⇒ ⇒ **★★★ 三条决定性结论**
   ① ★★★ **这是标准的「矩阵变换」顶点着色器**
      | 模式 | 含义 |
      |---|---|
      | **`VPCKF32F32 i1 = (sa4, sa6)`** | 把两个 4-float 向量**打包** ⇒ **矩阵的一行** |
      | **`VMAD i0 = i1 × sa20.yyyy + i0`** | ★ **矩阵乘向量（逐行累加）** |
      | 重复结构 | `i0 = sa0 × c.x` → `+ row1 × c.y` → `+ row2 × c.z` → … |
      ⇒ ⇒ **⇒ 经典 `4×4 矩阵 × 向量`（`VMUL` + 3× `VMAD`）** ✓✓✓
      · **常量寄存器 `sa16` / `sa18` / `sa20` / `sa22`** = **MVP 矩阵的行**
      · **`+0x24 = 9`** ⇒ **9 个参数**（【推测】矩阵 + 位置/法线等）✓
   ② ★★★ **⇒ ×8 组 = 「模型 / 蒙皮变换」顶点着色器**
      ⇒ **⇒ 被 **8 个不同材质 / 模型共用一个程序****
        （典型场景：多个模型共用同一个 MVP 变换）✓
   ③ ★★ **规模：`964 B` · `65 条指令` · `9 个参数`** ⇒ **最大档之一**
【★ 对移植的意义】
  · ★★ **这是"最重"的一支（65 条指令）** ⇒ **移植工作量的**上限样本****
  · ★★ **×8 复用** ⇒ **只需实现一次** ⇒ **印证 §2T.10 的「111 唯一 < 142」** ✓
  · ★ **⇒ 该类「矩阵变换」顶点着色器是 P5D 的**主力形态****
    （与 §2T.7 的「VERT / `VMAD` **57 支**」**完全一致**）✓✓
【⇒ 对目标④的补充】
  · ★★ **着色器的"形态学"已清楚**：
    | 形态 | 特征 | 数量（§2T.7） |
    |---|---|---|
    | **矩阵变换**（顶点） | `VMUL` + `VMAD`×3 + `VPCKF32F32` 打包 | **57**（VERT/VMAD） |
    | **半精度计算**（片段） | `VF16*` 族 | **54**（FRAG/VF16） |
    | **屏幕空间 sprite** | `LDR [16B]` + `VRCP`×2 + `VMAD2`×2 + `VMUL`×2 | 2（`vert_0014`/`0015`） |
    | **清屏 / 后处理 quad** | `VMOV.f32 o4` + `VMUL o0` + `VMUL o2=0` | 4（`vert_0000`/`0006`/`0008`/`0007`） |
    | **纹理调制**（片段） | `VF16MUL pa0 = pa0 × pa2` | 含 `frag_0084` |
⇒ **[证据] ×8 组的 8 个 `.gxp`（均 964 B / 65 指令 / `+0x24=9`）+ 其 `.dsm` 全文**

### 3.3 ★★★★★★★★ **U-10 结案：`[VSET]` = 探针日志标签（非游戏概念）**（2026-10-04）

```
【结论先行】**U-10（"`[VSET]` 分类"）结案：
  `[VSET]` **不是游戏内的分类标记**，而是**本工程探针**为
  `sceGxmSetVertexStream` 打的**日志前缀**。**
【★ 证据（digest + 归档，四处独立）】
  | 来源 | 内容 |
  |---|---|
  | `P5D_DIGEST.md` L180 | `| 0x895DF2E9 | — | **sceGxmSetVertexStream** | 记 g_vstream[stream] | 大量（[VSET] / [GXPPARM] **1631**）|` |
  | `P5D_DIGEST.md` L7336 | `| **0x811E7D60** | 后处理链的顶点流设置点 | 224×68 直方图 pass | 日志：**[VSET] va=AE600000 armed=1 lr=811E7D6…** |` |
  | `P5D_DIGEST.md` L7337 | `| **0x811E44C8** | 主 RT pass 的顶点流设置点 | 全屏合成 quad | 日志：**[VSET] va=A2D501E0 armed=1 lr=811E44C…** |` |
  | `ARCH_21_scene_graph.md` L316 | `811E7D5C  SetVertexStream(ctx, 0, [gfx+0x5B0])   ; ← [VSET] va=…` |
  | `ARCH_10_gxm_full.md` L168 | `| 895DF2E9 | sceGxmSetVertexStream | **812B14A0** | 真实现+探针 |` |
⇒ ⇒ ⇒ **★★★ 三条结论**
   ① ★★★ **`[VSET]` = `sceGxmSetVertexStream` 的探针日志标签**
      · **NID `0x895DF2E9`** · **桩 VA `0x812B14A0`** · 作用：**记 `g_vstream[stream]`**
      · 日志格式：**`[VSET] va=<地址> armed=1 lr=<调用点>`**
      · 调用量：与 `[GXPPARM]` 合计 **1631**
   ② ★★ **两个关键调用点（顺带得到的渲染事实）**
      | 调用点 | 场景 |
      |---|---|
      | **`0x811E7D60`** | ★ **后处理链的 224×68 直方图 pass** 的顶点流 |
      | **`0x811E44C8`** | ★ **主 RT pass 的全屏合成 quad** 的顶点流 |
      ⇒ ⇒ **⇒ 后处理链含一颗 `224×68` 直方图 pass + 一颗全屏合成 quad** ✓
   ③ ★ **`0x811E7D5C` 的调用形态**：`SetVertexStream(ctx, 0, [gfx + 0x5B0])`
      ⇒ `gfxState + 0x5B0` 处存放顶点流指针
【⇒ 对目标的意义】
  · ★★ **该未决项实为"探针侧术语"** ⇒ **与原版游戏逻辑无关** ✓
  · ★ 顺带补充了**后处理链的组成**（直方图 pass + 全屏 quad）⇒ 归入 §2B 渲染管线

  ⇒ 记录推送到 **`obj+0x20C`** 的列表（记录由 `0x81122CE2` 分配，**逐轨道一次**）

### 4C.5 ★★★★★★★★★★ **音游时间轴：同步公式（2026-10-04 新增，来自 §2F.1）**

```
【要实现的】判定的时间基准：
  · **音频播放位置 = 已播样本数（`[stateData + 8]`）÷ 48000**，以 **64 位**累加
  · 存放位置：**`obj + 0x28`**（`strd r0, r1, [r4, #0x28]`）
  · 采样率常量：**`0xBB80 = 48000`**
  · 取样本数的 API：**`sceNgsVoiceGetStateData(voice, 0, buf, 0x18)`**（`0x812B2060`）
    ⇒ **`buf + 8` = 已播样本数**
  · 辅以 `sceNgsVoiceGetInfo(voice, &info)`（`0x812B1FB0`）
【公式（可直接照写）】
  `播放位置(秒) = 累计样本数 / 48000`
  `判定时刻(ms) = 播放位置(秒) × 1000`
  ⇒ 与判定窗口（**160~740 ms**，§4C.2）比较 ⇒ 得出判定结果
【与帧率的配合】
  · `appMframe` 档位 = **`{1.0, 30.0, 60.0}`**（§2B.49）
  ⇒ ⇒ **时间轴以"音频样本"为准**，渲染帧率（30/60）只做**插值/对齐** ✓
⇒ **依据**：§2F.1（逐条反汇编）/ §4C.2（窗口表）/ §2B.49（帧率档位）
⇒ **现状**：**公式与常量已确证** ⇒ 可直接实现 ✓
⇒ **⚠️ 注意**：**不要用探针的音频值**（§2F.2：`sceNgsVoiceGetStateData` 在探针里**不写输出**
   ⇒ 读到的是**栈残留**）⇒ 必须**自己维护样本计数**
```

## 4D. ★★★★★★★★ 原生移植 PC 版：**实施清单**（2026-10-04，按新目标"分析服务于移植"）

> **新目标的判定标准 = "可实现"**：本节把已确证的知识**翻译成原生引擎要写的代码**。
> 每条都给出 **要做什么 → 依据（本文档章节/地址）→ 现状**。

### 4D.0 ★★★★★★★★★★★★★★★★ **★ 第一优先：复用工程已有的 `src/assets/*`（不要重写）**（2026-10-04）

> 依据 §2L.4~§2L.7：工程里**已存在**一套**平台无关、零外部依赖**的资源解析 + 渲染核心。
> **移植的第一动作应是"接线"，而不是"重写"。**

```
【已有资产（实测，`P5D-Native-Android-Port\src\assets\`）】
  | 文件 | 大小 | 职责 | 移植动作 |
  |---|---|---|---|
  | **`p5d_render_core.h`** | **86.8 KB / 1,097 行** | ★★★ **平台无关渲染核心**（`Scene`/`Pose`/`Frame`/`render()`；**软件光栅 + `exportGpu` 两条路径**） | **直接 `#include`**，调 `render()` 置 `exportGpu` |
  | **`p5d_gmd.h`** / **`p5d_gmd2.h`** | 45.2 / 28.3 KB | `.gmd` 模型解析（含**逆绑定矩阵 / 段序 / 节点记录**，§2L.2/§2L.3） | 直接复用 |
  | **`p5d_gap.h`** / **`p5d_gap2.h`** | 24.9 / 9.7 KB | `.gap` 动画解析（含 **`k=28` = 7 个 IEEE-754 半精度**，§2L.1） | 直接复用 |
  | **`p5d_dds.h`** | 4.6 KB | DDS 纹理 | 直接复用 |
  | `p5d_char_render.cpp` / `_demo.cpp` | 38 / 37.8 KB | 调用者（读盘 / BMP 输出 / 自动装配规则） | **作为"如何调用核心"的范例** |
【★ 移植的三步（照此即可）】
  ```cpp
  // ① 读 asset（PC: 文件系统；Android: AAssetManager）→ 内存块
  std::vector<uint8_t> gmdBytes = load("dance/field/object/m230_001.GMD");
  std::vector<std::vector<uint8_t>> gapBytes = loadAll("dance/player/p5/201/*.GAP");
  // ② 填 Scene，置 exportGpu（生产路径）
  p5d::Scene sc;
  sc.parts      = parseParts(gmdBytes, gapBytes);   // 用 p5d_gmd.h / p5d_gap.h
  sc.gapBytes   = gapBytes;
  sc.time       = t;                                // 动画时刻（秒）
  sc.cam        = &camTrack;                        // ★ 来自 .GFS 的 keyType 28（§2L.7）
  sc.camNear    = 1.0f;                             // ★ 世界单位 = 厘米（§2L.7）
  sc.exportGpu  = true;                             // ★ 只导出，不光栅化（ARCH_211）
  p5d::Frame f;  p5d::render(sc, f);
  // ③ 把 sc.gpu 映射为 GL（§2L.6）
  uploadVBO_INT32(sc.gpu.verts);                    // {pos,nrm,uv,rgba} 40 B
  uploadEBO(sc.gpu.idx);                            // 每 3 个 = 1 三角形
  for (auto* img : sc.gpu.texSlots) texImage2D_RGBA8(img);   // 零解码
  drawByTriTexSlot(sc.gpu.triTex, sc.gpu.triDraw);  // 逐三角槽位分批 + 混合模式
  ```
【★ 为什么这是第一优先】
  ① **核心已"不碰文件系统、不写文件、不引用任何 Windows 头"**（§2L.4 的依赖证明命中 0）
     ⇒ **Android / PC 同一份代码** ✓
  ② **GPU 导出路径是官方认定的生产路线**（§2L.7：软件光栅 0.9 fps ⇒ 仅作正确性基准）

    每项 = `+0x44` enter / `+0x48` update / `+0x4C` leave（+ `+0x50` 起 tag 字符串）

 5. 7 项 handler 地址：见 **§1.1 完整表**（state 0..6 的 enter/update/leave 全部就绪）

### 4D.6b ★★★★★★★★★★ **架构级约束（来自 §2C/§2D/§2E，移植必须遵守）**（2026-10-04）

```
【约束 1：协作式调度必须复现"唤醒即调度"】（§2D.2）
  · 原版：**主线程会阻塞在内核事件标志上，而唯一能 Set 它的是 worker**
  · ⇒ **移植时必须实现"唤醒即调度"语义**，否则主线程永久阻塞
  · ⇒ 这与探针注入的"唤醒修复"是同一问题的两面（§1.4(3)）
【约束 2：作业池模型】（§2D.1）
  · 原版用**作业池 + N 个 worker**（构造函数 `0x811E603E`，worker 入口 `0x811E68C9`）
  · 池字段：`+0x10` 状态（`==2` ⇒ worker 退出）、`+0x20` 生产者索引（单生产单消费环）
  · ⇒ 移植时**不要用"一任务一线程"**替代（会改变时序与并发行为）
【约束 3：2D 精灵/UI 走屏幕像素坐标，无需矩阵】（§2C.3，两处独立证据）
  · **`vert_0015`（`gxp_vert_0015` + `gxp_frag_0084`）无矩阵 uniform，顶点流 = 屏幕像素坐标**
  · ⇒ 移植 2D 层**直接按像素提交**，不必反推 MVP
  · 顶点格式参考：`vert_0014` = stride 16（`loc0` = F32×3@0 位置、`loc1` = U8N×4@12 颜色）§2E.2
【约束 4：不要用探针翻译的 SPIR-V 理解原版着色器】（§2E.3）
  · 探针的 USSE 翻译**未实现控制流（BR 族）** ⇒ 条件分支被线性化（两条路都执行）
    ⇒ 实测片元里有 **1181 条无谓词 `KILL`**
  · 且 **UBO 槽"只保留最后一次上传"** ⇒ 逐 draw 的 uniform 观测不可靠
  · ⇒ 应以 **GXP 原始参数表 + 顶点格式**为准
【约束 5：时间轴按 30 / 60 fps 量化】（§2B.49）
  · `appMframe` 的档位表 = **`{1.0, 30.0, 60.0}`** ⇒ 与影片 29.97/30 fps **一致**
【约束 6：本地化资源一律用 `c_` 版】（§4D.3b，§2B.47 对照实验）
  · 否则画面出现**韩文**
⇒ **[证据] §2C/§2D/§2E/§2B.47/§2B.49 各节**
```

  |---|---|---|
  | **U-6** 主菜单 per-item x/y | 已排除 `.bin` / 数据段 / 布局回调 ⇒ **推断为运行时构建** | ★ **跑到主菜单 ⇒ 直接 dump 布局数据** |

  · 而 **`.bf` 的 36 个 opcode 处理函数**（`0x811A0D91..0x811A1E63`）**正在该空洞内**
    ⇒ 我们只能用 `tools\p5d_dis_va.py`（capstone）**逐函数反汇编**（§2U.7.15~7.19）
【★ 用它做什么】
  · 用 Ghidra + VitaLoaderRedux 打开 `eboot.bin` ⇒ **反编译该空洞**
  · ⇒ ⇒ **`.bf` 的 36 个算子族全部可读** ⇒ **U-15 彻底收口** ✓
  · ★ 附带：**自动解析导入表 / NID** ⇒ 与 §2G.1 的"`nid_resolver.h` 不是权威表"结论**互相印证**

【★★★★★★★★★ 决定性实测（一条命令定案）】
  ```powershell
  [System.Net.Dns]::GetHostAddresses('github.com')
  ⇒ **127.0.0.1**                        ← ★★★★★★★★★ **!!!**

  | 域 | DNS 解析 |
  |---|---|
  | **`github.com`** | ★ **`127.0.0.1`** ← **被劫持!** |
  | `codeload.github.com` | `20.205.243.165`（正常） |
  | `raw.githubusercontent.com` | `185.199.111.133` 等（**正常 DNS，但连接被墙**） |

【★★★ 终极根因（**一举解释全部现象**）】
  · ★★★ **`WattToolkit`（瓦特工具箱）劫持了 `github.com` 的 DNS**
    ⇒ 把它指向**本机 `127.0.0.1`**（WattToolkit 自己的本地代理）
    ⇒ 该代理响应头带 **`Server: github.com,WattToolkit`** ✓✓✓
  · ★★★ **它对**大文件/归档**的处理不完整**
    ⇒ 返回 **302 → `codeload.github.com`**，但对归档请求最终返回的是**HTML 提示页**（约 2 KB）
    ⇒ ⇒ **⇒ 这就是为什么所有下载都只有几 KB 且 SHA512 不符** ✓✓✓
  · ★★ **它还导致了 vcpkg curl 的 `SSL connect error 35`**（本地代理的 TLS 不完整）✓
  · ★★ **`raw.githubusercontent.com` 是**真正被墙**（DNS 正常但连接被关闭）⇒ 另一独立问题** ✓
【★★★★★ 三条解决方案（按推荐度）】
  | # | 方案 | 说明 |
  |---|---|---|
  | **1** | ★★★ **关闭 WattToolkit 的"GitHub 加速"功能（或整个退出 WattToolkit）** | ★ **最直接** ⇒ `github.com` 恢复正常解析 ⇒ 下载立刻可用 |
  | **2** | ★★★ **把 WattToolkit 的加速模式**正确开启**** | 它有"GitHub 加速"选项，**开启后应正常代理大文件** |
  | **3** | ★★ **改 `hosts` 把 `github.com` 指回真实 IP**（如 `20.205.243.166`） | 需管理员权限，且可能与 WattToolkit 冲突 |
【★★★ 对本工程的**决定性意义**】

  · ⇒ ★★★ **⇒ 只要关闭/正确配置 WattToolkit,整条下载链**立即通畅****

【来源】`C:\dev\out\glsl_p5d\{vk13-bba87606….glsl, vk13-b0592054….glsl}`（§4E.11 批量产物）
【★★★ 两个顶点着色器的输入属性对比】
  | `layout` | **`vert_0014`**（全屏合成 quad，3915 B） | **`vert_0015`**（sprite，4160 B） |
  |---|---|---|
  | `location = 0` | `in vec4 **vertex_position**` | `in vec4 **vertex_position**` |
  | `location = 1` | `in vec4 **vertex_color**` | `in vec4 **vertex_color**` |
  | `location = 2` | **（无）** | ★ `in vec4 **vertex_texcoord0**` |
  | `location = 1`（out） | `out vec4 **v_Color0**` | `out vec4 **v_Color0**` |
  | `location = 4`（out） | **（无）** | `out vec4 **v_TexCoord0**` |
  · **两者的 `gl_Position` 公式逐字相同**：
    ```glsl
    gl_Position = outs[0] * (vec4(2.0, -2.0, 2.0, 2.0) / vec4(screen_width, screen_height, …));
    gl_Position.z = gl_Position.w;
    gl_Position = outs[0] * renderVertInfo.viewport_flip;
    gl_Position.z = ((max(((gl_Position.z / gl_Position.w) * z_scale) + z_offset, 0.0) …));
    ```
⇒ ⇒ ⇒ **★★★ 四条决定性结论**
   ① ★★★ **`vert_0014` 与 `vert_0015` 的差异被**完全解释****
      · **`vert_0014`：2 个输入**（`vertex_position` + `vertex_color`）⇒ **全屏 quad 不需要 UV**
      · **`vert_0015`：3 个输入**（+ **`vertex_texcoord0`**）⇒ **sprite 需要 UV**
      ⇒ ⇒ **⇒ 与 §2T.6 的「`vert_0015` 多一条 `VMOV.f32 o8.xy pa8.xy`」**完全吻合**** ✓✓✓
        · **`o8` = UV 输出**（`v_TexCoord0` 位于 `loc = 4`）
        ⇒ ⇒ **⇒ 两条独立证据（`.dsm` 指令 + GLSL 布局）互证** ✓✓
   ② ★★★ **`gl_Position` 公式**逐字相同** ⇒ **两者共用同一套「屏幕空间 → NDC」投影** ✓
   ③ ★★★ **属性命名确认（`vert_0014`/`vert_0015` 族）**
      | 位置 | 名称 |
      |---|---|
      | **`loc = 0`** | **`vertex_position`** |
      | **`loc = 1`** | **`vertex_color`** |
      | **`loc = 2`** | **`vertex_texcoord0`** |
      ⇒ ★★ **⇒ 与 §2E 的「`vert_0014` = `loc0` F32×3 位置 + `loc1` **U8N×4 颜色**」完全一致** ✓✓
   ④ ★★★ **重要发现：属性语义**按着色器而定**，不是全局固定**
      · **`vert_0014` / `vert_0015` 的 `loc = 1` = `vertex_color`**
      · 但**另一支顶点着色器**（§4E.11 的样本）的 `loc = 1` = **`vertex_normal`**
        （且含 `loc = 2` = `vertex_texcoord0`）
      ⇒ ⇒ **⇒ 这**印证了 §2E 的 `g_vfmt[hash]` 设计**：
        **每个着色器程序自带属性表**（由 `CreateVertexProgram` 顺带捕获）✓✓✓
      ⇒ ★ **⇒ 移植时必须**逐程序**读取属性表，不能假定全局布局** （**重要架构结论**）✓
【⇒ 对移植的直接价值】
  · ★★★ **2D sprite / UI 的属性布局已完全确定**（`pos` + `color` + `uv`）⇒ **可直接照写 VBO** ✓
  · ★★★ **屏幕空间投影公式已确认**（`vec4(2, -2, 2, 2) / 屏幕尺寸` + `viewport_flip` + `z_scale/z_offset`）✓
  · ★★ **"属性语义逐程序而定"是重要的架构约束** ⇒ 与 §2E / §4D.6b 的结论**互相加强** ✓

【★★★ 生成的 GLSL（`gxp_frag_0084` 完整语义）】
  ```glsl
  #version 430
  layout(binding = 3, std140) uniform GxmRenderFragBufferBlock {
      float back_disabled; float front_disabled; float writing_mask;
      float use_raw_image; float res_multiplier;
  } renderFragInfo;
  layout(binding = 0) uniform sampler2D fragTex_colorMap;
  layout(location = 1) in vec4 v_Color0;
  layout(location = 4) in vec4 v_TexCoord0;
  layout(location = 0) out vec4 out_color;
  vec4 pa[32]; vec4 sa[32]; vec4 internals[3]; vec4 r[20];
  bool p[4]; int idx[2]; vec4 outs[20];

  void frag_init() {
      if ((renderFragInfo.front_disabled != 0.0) && gl_FrontFacing)  discard;
      if ((renderFragInfo.back_disabled  != 0.0) && (!gl_FrontFacing)) discard;
  }
  vec2 unpack2xF16(float _88) { return unpackHalf2x16(floatBitsToUint(_88)); }
  float pack2xF16(vec2 _110)  { return uintBitsToFloat(packHalf2x16(_110)); }

  void primary_program() { /* 从 pa[0] 解包 4×f16 → 相乘 → 再打包回 pa[0] */ }

  void main() {
      pa[0] = vec4(pack2xF16(v_Color0.xy), pack2xF16(v_Color0.zw), pa[0].z, pa[0].w);
      frag_init();
      vec4 _135 = texture(fragTex_colorMap, v_TexCoord0.xy);
      pa[0] = vec4(pa[0].xy, pack2xF16(_135.xy), pack2xF16(_135.zw));
      primary_program();
      frag_output_finalize();     // unpack2xF16 × 4 → out_color
  }
  ```
⇒ ⇒ ⇒ **★★★ 八条决定性发现**
   ① ★★★ **`gxp_frag_0084` 完整语义已解出**
      · **输入**：`v_Color0`（`loc=1`）· `v_TexCoord0`（`loc=4`）· 纹理 `fragTex_colorMap`（`binding=0`）
      · **输出**：`out_color`（`loc=0`）
      · **计算** = **`pack2xF16(v_Color0) × texture(...)`** ⇒ **正是「顶点色 × 纹理色」** ✓✓✓
      ⇒ **⇒ 与 §2T.6 从 `.dsm` 读出的「`VF16MUL pa0 = pa0 × pa2`」**完全吻合**** ✓✓
   ② ★★★ **`GxmRenderFragBufferBlock`（`binding=3`, std140）= GXM 默认片段 UBO**
      · **5 个 float**：`back_disabled` · `front_disabled` · `writing_mask` · `use_raw_image` · `res_multiplier`
      · ⇒ **`frag_init()` 用 `front_disabled`/`back_disabled` 做 `discard`**
        ⇒ ⇒ **⇒ 这正是 §2T.7 的「5 支 `KILL`」的来源!** ✓✓

struct GxTexture {              // 原版大小 0xC
    uint32_t gpuHandle;         // +0x00  GPU 句柄
    uint16_t width;             // +0x04
    uint16_t height;            // +0x06
    uint32_t refCount;          // +0x08  初始 = 1
};
// 创建（原版 FUN_81163F8C，源文件 appGraphics\appGxTexture.c）
GxTexture* gx_texture_create(p1, p2, p3, p4) {
    auto* t = alloc<GxTexture>();
    t->refCount = 1; t->width = 0; t->height = 0;
    t->gpuHandle = gx_gpu_texture_create(p1, p2, p3, p4);
    return t;
}
// 宽高查询（原版包装 FUN_8116318A/98 → 0x81163FB4/FBE）
uint32_t tex_width (GxTexture* t) { return t->width;  }
uint32_t tex_height(GxTexture* t) { return t->height; }
// 绑定（原版 FUN_81160516）
void tex_bind(int unit, GxTexture* t) {
    if (!t) restore_default_unit(6); else bind_unit(6);
    g_texArray[unit] = t;
}

### 4F.5 精灵绘制（12 参数，§2.16/§2.17）

| 参数 | 语义 |
|---|---|
| `param_1`, `param_2` | ★ **基准 X / Y** |
| `param_3` | ★ **Z（深度/层）** |
| `param_4`, `param_5` | ★ **宽 / 高**（下限 `0.00024414062f = 2^-12`） |
| `param_6`, `param_7` | ★ **UV 偏移 U / V** |
| `param_8` | ★★★ **旋转角度（度）** |
| `param_9` | ★ **alpha**（`& 0xff != 0` 才绘制） |
| `param_10` | ★ **UV 矩形 `[u0, v0, w, h]`**（可为 null） |
| `param_11` | ★★★ **纹理结构体指针** |
| `param_12` | ★ 是否先调 `FUN_811605FC()` |

```cpp
// 顶点格式（原版 local_a4[24] = 4 × 6 float）：
//   [ x, y, z, alpha, u, v ]
void draw_sprite(float x, float y, float z, float w, float h,
                 float uvOffU, float uvOffV, float rotDeg, float alpha,
                 const float* uvRect, GxTexture* tex, bool beginFrame)
{
    if (w < 0.00024414062f || h < 0.00024414062f) return;
    if (((uint32_t)alpha & 0xff) == 0) return;
    if (beginFrame) draw_state_init();
    float tw = tex_width(tex), th = tex_height(tex);
    float sx = g_screenScaleX, sy = g_screenScaleY;
    float v[4][6];
    // 4 个顶点：计算 (x,y) 偏移 + (u,v)
    // 若 rotDeg != 0：
    //   float rad = rotDeg * 0.017453292f;      // ★ 原版常量（度 → 弧度）
    //   float c = cosf(rad), s = sinf(rad);
    //   x' = x*c - y*s ;  y' = y*c + x*s ;
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i) { v[i][2]=z; v[i][3]=alpha; }
    static const uint8_t idx[6] = {0, 1, 2, 0, 2, 3};
    tex_bind(0, tex);
    if (draw_check()) gx_primitive(/*type*/0, v, 4, idx, 6, 0);
}
```

// 原版：FUN_81160C58 打包命令 → OT 链表 → 帧末由回调执行
struct DrawCmd {                  // 原版 28 字节
    uint32_t color;               // +0x00
    float    x, y, w, h;          // +0x04, +0x08, +0x0C, +0x10
    uint32_t param1;              // +0x14
    uint8_t  flag;                // +0x18
};
enum DrawKind { KIND_RECT, KIND_OTHER1, KIND_OTHER2, KIND_SPRITE12, KIND_TEXT };
// 原版回调表（0x81162F08 一族，均为参数解包器）：
//   KIND_RECT      → FUN_81162F08 → FUN_81160B7E   （矩形，4 参）
//   KIND_OTHER1    → FUN_81162F1E → FUN_81160CC4
//   KIND_OTHER2    → FUN_81162F56 → FUN_81160EF0   （6 参）
//   KIND_SPRITE12  → FUN_81162F7A → FUN_811610A4   （12 参，精灵）
//   KIND_TEXT      → FUN_81162FFA → FUN_811629B2   （+0x60 偏移 ⇒ 文字/列表）
void submit_draw(DrawKind k, const DrawCmd& cmd) {
    DrawCmd* p = alloc<DrawCmd>(28); *p = cmd;
    ot_append(callback_for(k), p);      // 原版 appOt_8116E49E / 8116E522
}
// 帧末
void flush_draws() { for (auto& n : ot_list) n.callback(n.data); }

// 每个"画面"都是一个 named sequence
class Sequence {
public:
    virtual void enter()  {}
    virtual int  update() = 0;      // ★ 返回 1 = 继续；≠1 = 结束（§1.16）
    virtual void leave()  {}
    const char* tag;                // 状态名（如 "main menu bg p5"）
    bool        enabled;            // entry+0x40（§1.24）
};

                     void(*update)(), void(*leave)(), void* obj);
