### 18.4291 PORT M746: WAIT-LOOP CORRUPTION ROOT CAUSE = CANARY-CHECK FAIL-PATH FALL-THROUGH LEAKING 0x18 BYTES PER ITERATION.

New probes `[EC6-START]` / `[EC6-SPCHG]` on wait-loop block 0x811E5EC6 (main dispatcher):
```
[EC6-START] sp=A0D7FDA8 lr=8120766A r4=84BF3870 fib=848468E0 ring: ... 811E5EE8 811E5EC6
[EC6-SPCHG] from=A0D7FDA8 to=A0D7FD90 lr=812067B6 r4=84600000 ...
[EC6-SPCHG] from=A0D7FD90 to=A0D7FD78 lr=8120765C r4=84600000 ...
   ... sp keeps dropping by 0x18 per iteration ... A0D7FBC8 ...
```
=> the wait helper's loop **leaks 0x18 bytes of stack every iteration** and r4 changes from the waited task to
`0x84600000` (the GetThreadId TLS object). DEFAULT mode already shows this (`[EC6-SPCHG]=20`), but the loop never
returns there (state stays 0), so no bad PC is observed.

Iteration ring:
```
811E5EE8 811E5EC6 811E5ECE 8120760C 812B2A50 81207612 811E5ED4 811E5EE4 81207632 812B1B70 81207648 8120764C
812B27B0 8120765C 81207660 812067A0 ... 8120682A 81206832 81207664 812B2A50 8120766A 81207672 811E5EE8 811E5EC6
```
The bit1-set path calls helper `0x81207632`:
```
81207632 push {r4,r5,lr}      ; 12 bytes
81207634 sub  sp,#0xc         ; 12 bytes  => 0x18 bytes of frame
...       ldr r1,[sp,#4]      ; saved r5 slot (frame at sp+4)
          ldr r0,[0x812B414C] ; __stack_chk_guard
          cmp / bne 0x81207676
81207676 blx 0x812B2810        ; __stack_chk_fail  <-- HLE returns 0 instead of aborting
8120767A nop
8120767C (falls through to the NEXT function, frame NOT restored)
```
=> canary check fails every iteration, `__stack_chk_fail` HLE returns, execution falls through without
`add sp,#0xc; pop {r4,r5,pc}`, leaking 0x18 bytes and leaving r4 = GetThreadId's return value 0x84600000.
After enough iterations the helper's own frame base is corrupted; once the pumped task state reaches 6, the
wait-helper epilogue `pop {r4,pc}` pops GSC-data `0x003E7B24` as PC -> `[ODDPC]`.
This single emulation gap explains the whole M741-M745 chain.

VERIFIED: default 30M `exit=0, GXM=12, FSW=16, BADMEM=0`; lp+wemu 30M `exit=0, BADMEM=0, HLE-BADMEM=13`.

### 18.4307 PORT M762: THE WILD HEAP JUMP COMES FROM THE DELAY HELPER'S `pop {r4,pc}` - ITS SAVED FRAME SLOT HOLDS HEAP POINTERS, NOT A RETURN ADDRESS.

New `[HEAPTGT]` probe in the main dispatcher: fires when a block returns `nxt` inside the code-less heap range
0x84600000..0x8C600000; prints source block, r0-r7, lr, sp, fiber, 24-block ring and a reminder to disassemble
the source block. RESULT: exactly ONE hit in the SCHEDRESUME run:
```
[HEAPTGT] nxt=8493D6D3 blk=8127C0F8 r0=00000018 r1=8493C370 r2=00000024 r3=8493C32C
          r4=849368FB r5=8153FA20 r6=00001680 r7=812B414C lr=812364DA sp=A05FFC20 fib=848468E0
          ring: ... 8125DE66 8125DE6C 8125DE74 8125DE7A ...
```
Source block = 0x8127C0F8 = `pop {r4,pc}` of the DELAY HELPER:
```
8127C0E8  push {r4, lr}
8127C0EA  movs.w r1, #0x3e8
8127C0EE  mul   r0, r0, r1
8127C0F2  cbz   r0, 0x8127C0F8
8127C0F4  blx   0x812B2A80        (DelayThread HLE)
8127C0F8  pop   {r4, pc}          <- pops heap pointers
```
Popped values: `[sp]=0x849368FB` (saved r4) and `[sp+4]=0x8493D6D3` (pc) - BOTH are heap addresses, and both are
ODD (Thumb-style function pointers). So the saved `{r4,lr}` frame slot does NOT contain a code return address:
the frame was either never written by the `push` for this entry, or it was overwritten after the push.

The preceding ring shows a linked-list free loop writing heap nodes:
```
8125DE66  str r4, [r3] ; 8125DE68 adds r3,r1 ; 8125DE6C ldr r1,[r1,#4] ; 8125DE70 cbnz r1
8125DE72  str r4, [r5,#4] ; 8125DE74 subs r0,#1 ; 8125DE76 str r4,[r3,#4] ; 8125DE7A cmp r3 ; bne 0x8125DE66
8125DE92  pop {r4,r5,r6,pc}
```
- a prime candidate for overwriting heap/stack state (free-list corruption).

### 18.4311 PORT M766: THE PUMP SAVED A STALE `s.r[15]` INTO THE f1 CONTEXT - FIXED BY STORING THE REAL DISPATCHER `pc` (`P5D_F1PCFIX`); WITH `SCHEDRESUME` THE RUN COMPLETES 30M CLEANLY WITH PRESENTS.

`[FWRITE]` logging of every write to `g_fctx[0x848468E0]` identified the bad-context writer:
```
[FWRITE] PUMP-F1 fib=848468E0 pc=8127C0F8 sp=A05FFC18 lr=812364DA r4=00000000
   ring: 8125DE6C 8125DE74 8125DE7A 8125DE66 ... (free-list loop blocks)
```
The nested pump at line ~3913 does:
```
uint32_t f1 = g_cur_fiber ? g_cur_fiber : g_fiber_list[0];
uint32_t f2 = (g_fiber_list[1] == f1) ? g_fiber_list[0] : g_fiber_list[1];
...
{ FCtx& c = g_fctx[f1]; std::memcpy(c.r, s.r, ...); }
```
`s.r[15]` is stale in the dispatcher (the real pc is tracked in the local `pc` variable), so the save stored
`pc=0x8127C0F8` (a delay-helper tail) together with caller `sp=A05FFC18`, `lr=0x812364DA`, `r4=0` - an impossible
(pc,sp) pair. That context was later installed by the pre-pump snapshot restore (`tag=14`) and the `c2` restore
(`tag=13`), and the delay helper's `pop {r4,pc}` popped heap pointers (0x849368FB / 0x8493D6D3), causing the wild
heap execution (M761/M762/M763) and the global-slot corruption (BADMEM).

FIX (env-gated `P5D_F1PCFIX`): at that save, write the REAL current dispatcher pc into the saved context:
```
{ FCtx& c = g_fctx[f1]; std::memcpy(c.r, s.r, ...); if (g_f1pcfix) c.r[15] = pc; ... }
```
RESULT with `P5D_SCHEDRESUME=1 P5D_F1PCFIX=1` (30M):
```

[HEAPTGT] = 0   [ODDPC] = 0   bad restores = 0

[FWRITE] consistent pairs: PUMP-F1 pc=8125DE66 sp=A05FFC18 lr=812364DA r4=0
```
F1PCFIX ALONE (without SCHEDRESUME) HANGS at the scheduler blocks (watchdog pcring `0x812068A0 ... 0x812068D8`);
the two switches are a PAIR and remain env-gated default OFF for now.

Watch implementation: at block 0x811C6C72 the handle is captured; after every main-loop block the words
`[handle+4]` (state), `[handle+0x8c]` (data pointer) and `[handle+0x90]` (size) are compared and changes logged with the
attributing block (`[HW] byblk=...`).

RESULTS (pair+GXMABI):
```
[HW] byblk=811C6C72 st:0000DEAD->00000000 p:0000DEAD->00000000 sz:0000DEAD->00000000
[HW] byblk=811830CC st:00000000->00000003 p:00000000->00000000 sz:00000000->00000000
(no further changes)
[FHDL] handle=84D2AAA0 m0=84D19A60 m4=00000000 +0x8c=00000000 +0x90=00000000 lr=8120745C sp=A05FFDB8
[F830] obj=84D2AAA0 r1=A05FFDBC state4=00000003 +0x8c=00000000 +0x90=00000000 lr=811E5CA6
[FAB4] type=00000003 flags=00000001 params=A05FFDB8 pw: 0 0 0 0 0 0
```
=> the Fios object is created empty, is transitioned to state 3 (DONE) but the fields `+0x8c` (data pointer) and `+0x90`
(size) are NEVER filled. Callback 0x8118308A:
```
8118308A  sub sp,#8; canary...
8118309A  ldrsh r2,[r0,#4]        ; state
811830A2  cmp r2,#3; bne 0x811830B4 (return 0)
811830A8  ldr r2,[r0,#0x90]       ; size
811830AC  ldr r0,[r0,#0x8c]       ; data pointer
811830B0  str r2,[r1]             ; *size_out = size
811830B2  return data pointer
```
so it returns 0 and writes 0 → the GFD factory's params struct is `{offset=0, size=0, data=0}` → type-3 object
bounds zero → `FUN_811DE912` -1 → byteswap size -1 → 0x3FFFFFFF iterations.

Root cause is now precisely in the **Fios read/completion path**: the handle is marked done but the data pointer/size are
never written. Most likely because the HLE Fios op stubs report completion immediately (OpIsDone→1, OpWait→0,
OpGetError→0, FHClose→0) so the guest completion handler that should copy the buffer address/length into
`[handle+0x8c]/[handle+0x90]` either never runs or reads a zero op-struct.

### 18.4331 PORT M786: MANUAL WRAPPER BECOMES A TRANSPARENT TRAMPOLINE (STACK LEAK FIXED); NEW NOFN HALTS AT 0x81032CC8 / 0x812EFD78.

Diagnosis of the `pc=00000001` crash:
- the missed function `0x81032CEA` is `push {r4,lr}; ldr r2,[0x8132AEB8]; blx r2; pop {r4,pc}`;
- our first emulation pushed 8 bytes (r4/lr) and expected the callee to return through the manual pop block `0x81032CF8`;
- in the failing run `[MANPOP]=0` (the callee never returned through it) and the 8 bytes were leaked, so a later
  `pop {r4,r5,r6,pc}` at block `0x8115DA8C` popped a misaligned frame:
```
[BAD1] pc=8115DA8C blk=8115DA8C sp=A05FFEB0 lr=8115DE54 r0=0000001C r1=0000001F ...
       stk: 84ABD6C4 00000001 00000018 8115D3C8 ...
```
- since `r4` is callee-saved, the wrapper's push/pop of r4 is a no-op and the net semantics is a **tail call**: keep the caller
  return address already in `s->r[14]`, load `fp` from `[0x8132AEB8]`, return `fp & ~1`.

Fix:
```cpp
static uint32_t mb_81032CEA(RecState* s) {   // transparent trampoline (tail-call)
  uint32_t fp = 0; { uint8_t* q = GP(0x8132AEB8u); if (q) std::memcpy(&fp, q, 4); }
  s->r[2] = fp;
  return fp & ~1u;   // s->r[14] already holds the caller return address
}
```
Result: `[BAD1]`/`pc=1` gone; the run advances past the old crash to a new halt:
```
[NOFN] unknown pc=81032CC8 -> resume fiber=84836840 (count 1) fctx_r0=00000004 sp=A05FFEA0 pc=8115DA42
[NOFN] unknown pc=812EFD78 -> resume fiber=84836840 (count 2) ...
done: blocks=60022000 pc=812EFD78 last_block=0x8115DA8C
```
Note: bytes at `0x812EFD78` do not decode into a plausible thumb function start (ARM decode also invalid), and both `0x812EFD78`
and `0x81032CC8` are absent from `function_bounds.json`. So either the callback pointer is a data value (misinterpreted as code),
or the function lives in a region IDA did not classify.

VERIFIED: default 30M unchanged `exit=0, GXM=12, FSW=16, FRAMEDUMP=6000, BADMEM=0` (NOFN=1, BAD1=0).

   `pop {r4,r5,r6,pc}` at `0x8115DA8C` read it as a return address.

- the harness `[NOFN]` recovery itself resumes the main fiber from a saved context:
  `resume fiber=84836840 ... fctx_r0=00000004 sp=A05FFEA0 pc=8115DA42`;
- i.e. it re-enters a context whose SP no longer matches the active call path, and the epilogue pops a rodata pointer.

The `function_bounds.json` truncation (last entry `FUN_812b2af0` ends `0x812B2AF8`) is still a real fact, but the tail is rodata, so
extending bounds will not fix this NOFN.

### 18.4340 PORT M795: PUMP2 MAIN-THREAD -> FIBER-SLOT SAVE BUG FIXED; REMAINING OWNERSHIP "VIOLATION" MAY BE GAME-MANAGED FIBER STACKS.

Bug (pump2, `recomp_harness.cpp` ~4247):
```cpp
uint32_t f1 = g_cur_fiber ? g_cur_fiber : g_fiber_list[0];
...
if (!g_f1guard || g_cur_fiber == f1) { std::memcpy(g_fctx[f1].r, s.r, ...); }   // g_f1guard defaults 0
```
When the pump starts from the main thread (`g_cur_fiber == 0`), `f1` becomes `g_fiber_list[0]` (0x84836840) and the
**main thread's live registers** (sp~A05FFE90, pc=811EAAE4 GXM-init) are stored into fiber f0's slot; at the end the harness
restored `s` from `f1_pre` and set `g_cur_fiber = f1`, i.e. a stale fiber owner on top of main-thread execution.

Fix (M795): capture `const bool _mainctx = (g_cur_fiber == 0)` and a full `FCtx _msaved` snapshot; skip the fiber-slot save in
main context; at the end restore `s` from `_msaved` and set `g_cur_fiber = 0`.

Residual `[OWNTRANS]` (still exactly one event) + new interpretation:

### 18.4346 PORT M801: SERVING THE GAME'S FILE-TABLE LOOKUP (`FUN_81181d90`) FROM CPK - FIRST OPEN REQUEST RETURNS `state=3` VIA THE GAME'S OWN PATH.

rea decompilation of the open callback `FUN_81182c56` (M800) showed the not-found path calls `FUN_81181d90(name,&size)`:
- returns 0 -> auto-register `type=0/size=-1` (state 0, worker/wait hacks needed);
- returns data -> callback sets request `state=3`, copies payload, done.

So M801 overrides `FUN_81181d90` with a manual block (`mb_81181D90`) before the AOT dispatch:
```

  name = cstr(s->r[0]);
  fios_ensure_cpk(); data = cpk_read_any_impl(name)   // CRILAYLA handled inside cpk_reader.h
  if (data) { buf = hle_malloc(size); memcpy(GP(buf), data);
              *(u32*)GP(s->r[1]) = size; s->r[0] = buf; return s->r[14]; }   // [F2LOAD]
  else { *(u32*)GP(s->r[1]) = 0; s->r[0] = 0; return s->r[14]; }             // fall back to auto-register
```
Result: the first open (`GFDPSP2PRESET.GSC`) returns `state=3` directly; `[OPENRET] r0=84B56A60 [r0]=00000000 state4=3 name=GFDPSP2PRESET.GSC`.

Additionally a generic request filler was added as a safety net for any path that still produces `state=0` requests:
- capture requested name at `0x81182C56` entry; capture returned request object at Fios open-return `0x811E5C74` (`g_pending_reqs`);
- every 256 `job_probes` calls, scan pending requests: if `state(+4)==0` and entry type `(+4)!=0xC`, read name from CPK, allocate/copy, then set
  `request+0x8C=buf`, `request+0x90=size`, `request+4=3`, `entry+4=0xC`, `entry+0x88=size`, `entry+0x94=buf`, `entry+0xA0=0`; log `[REQFILL]`.
- in this run `[REQFILL]=0` (first request already state=3); it stays for other files.

### 18.4347 PORT M802: SECOND VIRTUAL FILE FULLY LOADED (4MB GFD) + THE RUN ENTERS THE LEGITIMATE HUFFMAN DECODE.

Root cause of every previous "run dies right after the second OPENCB": the generated accessor aborts on unmapped guest memory:
```cpp
static inline uint8_t* P(RecState* s, uint32_t a){ ... else { fprintf(stderr, "[BADMEM] guest va=0x%08X ...", a, g_cur_block);
    harness_badmem(a); std::abort(); } ... }
```
The Fios worker block `0x8118310A` did `r7=[r6]` (null linked entry) then `r1=[r7+4]` -> va=4 -> abort. Fix (manual block before the AOT dispatch):
```
mb_8118310A:
  r7 = [r6]
  if (r7 == 0) { r7 = 0; r1 = 0; return 0x811831D0; }        // the guest's own bne target
  r1 = [r7+4]
  return (r1 != 0xC) ? 0x811831D0 : 0x81183112;
```
Result (150M pair run, P5D_GXMABI=1 P5D_SCHEDRESUME=1 P5D_F1PCFIX=1 P5D_NESTED_UNTIL=1500000):

```
[OPENRET] r0=84B8B080 [r0]=0 state4=3 name=GFDPSP2.GSC
[MB8310A] r6=84B8B080 linked=0 -> skip to 811831D0   (12x)
[BADMEM]=0, [NOFN]=0
last [FRAMEDUMP] n=41,955,000 pc=811DFB14 blk=811DFB0A sp=A05F8B00  <-- 4MB GFD Huffman decode
```
The run no longer aborts; it is decoding the 4MB GFD preset (the FUN_811df91a-style symbol-by-symbol decoder). 41.9M blocks in 420 s is slow (~100k blocks/s
vs ~700k blocks/s in other stages) -> next target is decode-path throughput.

```
puVar2 = alloc(0x58); ... 
FUN_812b12d0(DAT_816cbe00, local_38, local_48);        // sceGxmShaderPatcherRegisterProgram
```

### 18.4349 PORT M804: SYNTHESIZED GXM HANDLES - RENDERER SETUP RUNS (CREATE CONTEXT / RENDER TARGET / 59 SHADER PATCHERS), FRAME-SLOT FIBER RETURN STILL CORRUPT (pc=0x1F1).

Problem: backend stubs `sceGxmCreateContext`, `sceGxmCreateRenderTarget`, `sceGxmSyncObjectCreate`, `sceGxmShaderPatcherCreate` return 0 **without writing the out pointer**;
the GXM ABI wrappers only wrote the guest out slot when the backend set a host handle -> guest got `context=0`, `renderTarget=0`, `patcher=0`,
so the renderer's init checks failed and the game never built its frame pipeline.

Fix (local patch in `C:\dev\tmp\recomp_split\gxm_abi.cpp`, backup `gxm_abi.cpp.bak_m804`): in the four wrappers, write an opaque synthesized guest handle when the
backend leaves the out handle null:
```cpp
{
    void* slot = gxm_abi_xlate(a1);
    if (slot) { static uint32_t _fh = 0x85410000u;
        uint32_t guest_handle = out1 ? gxm_abi_untranslate_ptr(out1) : (_fh += 0x40u);
        std::memcpy(slot, &guest_handle, sizeof(guest_handle)); }
}
```
sync object uses a separate counter base `0x85420000`.

Result (150M/560 s pair run):

```
[GXMABI] sceGxmCreateRenderTarget   2x ret=0

[GXMABI] sceGxmShaderPatcherCreateFragmentProgram r0=85410040 ...
24x sceGxm(GetPrecomputedDrawSize|PrecomputedDrawInit|PrecomputedDrawSetParams)
[EPROV]=3, [F2LOAD]=2, [DEC-CALL]=12, last n=77,765,000
```

```
pc ring: 811E5CEA -> 81198BEA -> 81198BF6 -> 8120682A -> 81206832 -> 000001F1
```

### 18.4351 PORT M806: `[STKW32]` FOUND THE `pc=0x1F1` WRITER - THE GFD DECODER'S STACK FRAME OVERWRITES FIBER1'S SUSPENDED FRAME (SHARED STACK REGION).

Instrumentation: `P5D_STKW=1` enables a write watch on guest VAs `A05FFC10..A05FFC30` inside `wr32_watch`/`wr16_watch`/`wr8_watch`
(`[STKW32]/[STKW16]/[STKW8]`, capped 400 normal + unlimited suspicious values `0x1F1/0x1FC/0x1F9/0x1E5`) plus an overlap check in the HLE
`memcpy`/`memset` cases (`[STKW-HLE]`).

150M pair run with `P5D_STKW=1` (fast this time: n=6,000,000 at 8.7 s; reached n=78,500,000 in ~3 min):
```
[STKW32] w32 a=A05FFC20 v=000001FC blk=811DFA62 ... <<<
[STKW32] w32 a=A05FFC24 v=000001F1 blk=811DFA62 ... <<<
[STKW32] w32 a=A05FFC28 v=000001F9 blk=811DFA62 ... <<<
... (30 suspicious writes, all blk=811DFA62)
[STKW-HLE] = 0
[FRAMEDUMP] n=78500000 pc=000001F1 blk=812B1BA0 sp=A05FFC28 fib=848468E0
```
`0x811DFA62` is inside `FUN_811df91a` (the GFD Huffman decoder) - the tree-building loop. Its generated block:
```
wr32(s, s->r[10] + 0x440u, s->r[1]);      // sl+0x440  = tree[key].x
wr32(s, s->r[10] + 0x444u, s->r[6]);      // sl+0x444  = tree[key].y
wr32(s, s->r[10] + 0x448u, s->r[5]);      // sl+0x448
wr32(s, s->r[10] + 0x414u, s->r[3]);      // sl+0x414
...
```
with `r10 (sl) = sp + 0x3800` (`0x811DF9F4 add.w sl, sp, #0x3800`), i.e. these are the decoder's legitimate tree-node locals.
Writing to `A05FFC20/24/28` implies the decoder's `sp ≈ A05FBFE0`, so its ~`0x7420`-byte frame spans `≈A05FBFE0..A0603400`, which
**contains the suspended fiber1 delay frame at `A05FFC10`** (`[SAVE-DLY] sp=A05FFC10 [sp]=3 [sp+4]=8127B950`).
Thus after the decode the suspended fiber1 frame no longer holds its return address; on resume `8127C0F8 pop {r4,pc}` yields the stale tree
values (`0x1FC/0x1F1/0x1F9`) -> `[ODDPC] nxt=000001F1` -> `[NOFN]` (6x, recovered).

Root cause class: fiber1 runs on the **same `A05Fxxxx` stack region** as the main-thread/nested GFD decode. On real hardware each fiber has
its own private stack from `sceFiberInitialize`, so a suspended fiber's frame memory is never reused by other execution. Here the decode
executes on the shared stack after fiber1's context save and overwrites the saved LR.

VERIFIED: default 30M `exit=0, GXM=12, FSW=16, FRAMEDUMP=6000, [NOFN]=0, BADMEM=0, done: blocks=30000000 pc=81206894 last_block=0x81206880`.

   stack for each fiber (or a per-fiber private planted stack) so fiber frames never share the main stack;
2. enforce stack-ownership invariants in the dispatcher (a fiber context save/restore must have sp inside that fiber's own stack range;
   main-thread contexts must use the main stack range) with a diagnostic when violated;
3. re-run pair -> `0x1F1` should disappear, fiber1's wait loop stays valid, then check `BeginScene/EndScene/DisplayQueue` reachability.

### 18.4355 PORT M810: LIVE FIBER-CONTEXT SHADOW ELIMINATES THE `pc=0x1F1` CORRUPTION.

Problem chain (M802-M809): the suspended fiber1 stack is legitimately reused by the GFD Huffman decoder's large frame, so a saved `g_fctx` snapshot
(`pc=8127C0F8, sp=84856580`) becomes stale; resuming it pops decoder tree values (`0x1FC/0x1F1/0x1F9/0x1E5`) -> `pc=0x1F1` -> `[NOFN]` 6x.

Fix: **never resume a stale snapshot - keep a live shadow of the running fiber's context and prefer it at load time**:
- new globals `g_live_fctx`, `g_live_fiber`, `g_live_valid`;
- in the main loop, right before `++n` (block boundary): if `g_cur_fiber == 0x848468E0` and `pc` is a plausible code VA,
  `g_live_fctx = {s.r, s.apsr}; g_live_fctx.r[15] = pc; g_live_valid = 1` (`[LIVEUPD]`);
- in the main-loop sync-switch load path, before loading from `g_fctx[_t]`:
```
if (_t == g_live_fiber && g_live_valid &&
    (saved.r[15] != live.r[15] || saved.r[13] != live.r[13])) { [FIB-LIVEWIN] ...; saved = live; }
```
- transfer logs improved: `[FIB-XFER] ... saves_from=%d resumes_to=%d saves_to=%d` (cap 700), `[FIB-XFER-FEX]` same (cap 400).

150M pair run result:
```

[FIB-XFER] from=84836840 save_pc=8120682A save_sp=848468A8 -> to=848468E0 tgtpc=812B2810 tgtsp=848568A0 saves_from=78 resumes_to=76 saves_to=77

[NOFN]=0, [ODDPC]=0          <-- previously 6 each
[EPROV]=3, [F2LOAD]=2
[FRAMEDUMP] n=60,970,000  pc=812067A0  fib=84836840   (game's own frame loop)
[GXM-BEGIN]=0, [GXM-PRESENT]=0
```
So the fiber context/stale-stack corruption class is closed; the next blocker is purely "frame loop does not reach BeginScene/render".

### 18.4357 PORT M812: CORRECTION - `[0x81513DEC]` IS CLEARED BY DESIGN; A/B MATRIX SHOWS THE PAIR SCHEDULER FLAGS ARE REQUIRED FOR REAL BOOT.

M811 claimed pair mode "missed" the per-frame callback registration because `[0x81513DEC]=0`. The `[CBWR]` write-watch (added on `0x81513DEC`) corrects this:
```
pair run:   [CBWR] v=00000000 blk=811E5C0A fib=848468E0 sp=84856920     (one write, zero)
default:    [CBWR]=0 (no write)  but [THRD] cb=811E5929
gxm-only:   [CBWR]=0 (no write)  but [THRD] cb=811E5929
```
Disassembly of `FUN_811E5C0A`:
```
push {r4,r5,r6,lr}
[0x81513DD4] = r0;  [0x81513DDC] = r1;  [0x81513DD8] = r2;  [0x81513DE0] = r3;
[0x81513DE4] = [sp+0x10]; [0x81513DE8] = [sp+0x14]; [0x81513DF0] = [sp+0x18];
[0x81513DEC] = 0;               <-- explicit clear
pop  {r4,r5,r6,pc}
```
=> `0x81513DEC` is part of an 8-slot callback table (provider registration) that this init function **intentionally zeroes**; the slot's nonzero value in
default/GXMABI-only modes is just the eboot's initial `.data` value `0x811E5929` because that init function is never reached there. `FUN_811E5CDA` (frame slot)
therefore calls nothing in a correctly-initialized (pair-mode) run - this is by design, not a bug.

A/B matrix (150M blocks):
| mode | result |
|---|---|
| `P5D_GXMABI=1` only | completes 150M in ~13 s (1.17M blk/s) but **stalls** at `pc=81206894` (main-thread canary loop), 10 threads, no GFD/fonts |
| `P5D_GXMABI=1 P5D_SCHEDRESUME=1 P5D_F1PCFIX=1` (pair) | real boot: `[F2LOAD]=2` (GFD 62,100 + 4,094,756), `[EPROV]=3` fonts, 13 threads, frame loop `0x812067A0` |

### 18.4359 PORT M814: DETERMINISTIC VIRTUAL CLOCK (REPRODUCIBLE RUNS); DETERMINISTIC STALL NOW AT THE GXM SHADER-PATCHER SETUP LOOP.

Nondeterminism evidence (same binary/env, pair mode):
- two 60M runs: run1 `[F2LOAD]=0 [EPROV]=0`, last `[FRAMEDUMP] n=430000 pc=811F0002`; run2 `[F2LOAD]=1` (GFDPSP2PRESET only);
- 150M runs: one reached `[EPROV]=3`/fonts and n=61.0M, another `[EPROV]=0` n=33.3M.
Root cause: HLE time came from the host wall clock:
```
static uint64_t hle_tick_us() { ... steady_clock::now() ... }
case 0x812B28E0:  // sceKernelGetProcessTimeWide -> hle_tick_us()
case 0x812B1EA0:  // sceRtcGetCurrentTick -> hle_tick_us()
```
so the game's timers/timeouts saw different real elapsed times each run and took different boot branches.

Fix (deterministic):
```
static uint64_t hle_tick_us() { return 0x100000ull + (uint64_t)g_blkcnt_total * 2ull; }  // 2 us per executed guest block
```
Verification: two consecutive 60M pair runs are now **behaviorally identical**:
```
[CLOCK] rtcTick=1084210, procTimeWide=1095096, rtcTick=1101832, rtcTick=1101832
[F2LOAD]=1 (GFDPSP2PRESET.GSC 62,100)
last [FRAMEDUMP] n=435000 pc=811830A8 blk=811830A2 sp=84856710 fib=848468E0
[NOFN]=0, [PROCWR]=0, [EPROV]=0
```
So the previous "fast" path was partly a real-time-dependent branch; now we have a **reproducible** execution to debug.

The deterministic run stalls in the GXM shader-patcher program/parameter setup loop:
```
pcring: 811EFFA0 811EFFA4 811EFFA6 811EFFAE 811EFF92 812B1530 811EFF9A 812B12A0 (repeat)
[WD] n=26628 ... stall=71
hle: sceGxmShaderPatcherGetProgramFromId @811EFF9A / sceGxmProgramFindParameterByName @811EFFA0
     r1 walks parameter table 8130C8F0..8130CA0C (each +0x10/ +0x??)
main n only 435,000 after 300 s
```
This is `FUN_811efe9e`-style program setup (M799): the parameter scan is long/repeating because the GXM backend's `GetProgramFromId` /
`FindParameterByName` always return 0.

VERIFIED: default 30M green with the virtual clock: `exit=0, GXM=12, FSW=16, FRAMEDUMP=6000, [NOFN]=0, BADMEM=0, done: blocks=30000000 pc=81206894 last_block=0x81206880` (`[APPFN]=3`, `[CLOCK]=2`).

   `ProgramParameterGetCategory`) returning non-null handles so the 0x22-parameter scans can terminate instead of cycling;
3. re-run the deterministic 60M/150M pair and capture the next first blocker.

### 18.4360 PORT M815: GUEST SLEEPS ADVANCE THE VIRTUAL CLOCK -> DETERMINISTIC FULL BOOT AND REPRODUCIBLE RUNS.

M814's deterministic clock (`0x100000 + g_blkcnt_total*2` us) made runs reproducible but slow: the game's sleep/poll loops had to burn guest blocks to
make virtual time advance (e.g. a 60M run reached only main n=9.34M in 300 s and appeared stuck in the GXM patcher loop).

Fix: advance virtual time explicitly when the guest sleeps:
```
static uint64_t g_vtime_extra = 0;                       // M815
hle_tick_us() = 0x100000 + g_blkcnt_total*2 + g_vtime_extra;
case 0x812B2A50 (sceKernelDelayThread):   g_vtime_extra += (s->r[0] ? s->r[0] : 1);
case 0x812B2A80 (sceKernelDelayThreadCB): g_vtime_extra += (s->r[0] ? s->r[0] : 1);
```

   becomes slow/unstable and stalls around n=8.7M (CPU 11 s over 8 min wall; killed) - full pumping inside the fiber world is unsafe.


### 18.4365 PORT M820: gfdSema PROTOCOL + SELF-RE-WAIT IN FIBER CONTEXT - FIBER BLOCKING IS THE MISSING SCHEDULER FEATURE.

Full `[SCREATE]` picture of the CRI GFD subsystem (all created in boot, name pointers decoded):
```
50011000 init=0    gfdJobCountSema     | 50012000 init=512    gfdJobEmptySema
50013000 init=0    gfdJobCountSema     | 50014000 init=10240  gfdJobEmptySema
50015000 init=0    gfdJobCountSema     | 50016000 init=8      gfdJobEmptySema
50017000..50020000+ (16x) init=1  gfdSema      (created by wrapper blk_812073C2, string VA 0x8130CC60)
```
`[GFS]` trace for `0x50018000` (the one the boot thread blocks on):
```
wait tid=00000000 have=1 lr=81207426 fib=848468E0   <- fiber context acquires token
wait tid=00000000 have=0 lr=81207426 fib=848468E0   <- SAME fiber context re-acquires -> should block
wait tid=4001C000 have=0 lr=81207426 fib=848468E0   <- worker thread 4001C000 also waits (decode worker)
signal thr=00000000 lr=8120745C count=0 -> 1
signal thr=4001C000 lr=8120745C count=1 -> 2
...
wait tid=4001C000 have=2 ... signal count=1  (steady state)
```
`[SEMW]` with the new owner tracker:
```
[SEMW] main obj=50018000 need=1 got=0 spins=4001 lr=81207426 blk=812B2880  n=26628 owner=F08468E0 owner_lr=81207426
[SEMW] main obj=50018000 need=1 got=0 spins=4001 lr=81207426 blk=811539F4 n=26628 owner=F08468E0 owner_lr=81207426
```
`owner = F08468E0` is the **fiber 0x848468E0 token**, `owner_lr = 81207426` is the `FUN_81207402` wait wrapper: the fiber acquired the
token and then re-waits on it. In the guest thread model another logical thread (worker `4001C000`, a GFD decode worker with loop
`{ wait gfdSema; process job; signal gfdSema; delay(30000) }`) also wants it; real hardware would block one side, our HLE **fail-opens the
fiber-context wait** and lets the boot run on a wrong branch - this is the architectural gap behind the whole M818/M819 chain
(no app frame loop -> no draw lists -> no `BeginScene`).

The missing scheduler feature: **blocking waits inside fiber execution**:
1. on an unsatisfied `WaitSema`/`WaitEventFlag` while `g_in_fiber_exec`, save the current fiber ctx (`g_fctx[fiber]`), record
   `g_fiber_blocked[fiber] = {obj, bits, mode}`, and yield back to the main loop (return a scheduler marker) instead of fail-open;
2. in `sceKernelSignalSema`/`sceKernelSetEventFlag`, wake blocked fibers like blocked threads (clear blocked record, mark runnable);
3. main loop then runs other fibers/threads; when the woken fiber is scheduled it resumes at the HLE return site with success.

```
}
```

### 18.4367 PORT M822: CRI MANA / SceKernel TIMER HLE (Create/Start/Stop/Delete/GetTime) - THE MISSING SYSCHEDULER CLOCK.

`import_map.json` maps the previously-unhandled stubs in the movie/Mana region:
```
0x812B27D0  SceLibKernel  NID 2255B2A5   (sceKernelCreateTimer)
0x812B2A30  SceThreadmgr  NID 3EFD3165   (sceKernelGetTimerTime -> uint64 r0:r1)
0x812B2A40  SceThreadmgr  NID 48091E0C   (sceKernelStartTimer)
0x812B2A70  SceThreadmgr  NID 869E9F20   (sceKernelStopTimer)
0x812B2A90  SceThreadmgr  NID AB1E42C4   (sceKernelDeleteTimer)
```
Guest wrappers (Ghidra) confirm the semantics:
```
FUN_8129BA36("CRI Mana Timer", 0x800, 0)  -> handle;  then start(handle); then gettime(handle) -> 64-bit base stored
FUN_8129BA1C: obj[6]=1; start(handle); base = gettime(handle)
FUN_8129BAAC: now = gettime(handle); obj[4..5]=now; stop(handle); obj[6]=0
FUN_8129BAA2: delete(handle)
FUN_8129BAC8: base  = gettime(handle) when running -> elapsed = now-base (microseconds; *param_3 = 1000000)
FUN_8129B9F0: if !running: 64-bit counter at obj+0x40 ++
```
These are **CRI Mana scheduler timers** (Sofdec/movie middleware uses Mana for its frame timing). Without them `hle_call` fell through to default (return 0), so every timer read
returned 0 and the scheduler's clock was frozen.

New HLE implementation (deterministic, virtual clock):
```
struct HleTimer { uint64_t acc, start_us; int running; };
std::map<uint32_t,HleTimer> g_timers;  uint32_t g_next_timer = 0x50030000;
812B27D0 create: uid = (g_next_timer += 0x1000); g_timers[uid]=HleTimer(); r0=uid
812B2A40 start : if (!running) { running=1; start_us=hle_tick_us(); } r0=0
812B2A70 stop  : if (running) { acc += hle_tick_us()-start_us; running=0; } r0=0
812B2A90 delete: g_timers.erase(uid); r0=0
812B2A30 time  : v = acc (+ hle_tick_us()-start_us if running); s->r[1]=v>>32; r0=v&0xFFFFFFFF
```
VERIFIED: default 30M green (`exit=0, GXM=12, FSW=16, FRAMEDUMP=6000, [NOFN]=0, [DLIST]=6, [TIMER]=0, BADMEM=0,
[TABLE] blocks=229776, done: blocks=30000000 pc=81206894 last_block=0x81206880`).

### 18.4372 PORT M827: APPMESSAGE WINDOW UPDATE DECOMPILED; RECURSIVE RE-ENTRY GUARDED VIA MANUAL BLOCKS.

`FUN_8102A500` = **appMessage message-window update** (process `85AA3D9C`, cb0 = `[PROC] exec p=85AA3D9C cb0=8102A501`):
```
push.w {r4,r5,r6,r7,r8,sb,sl,lr}                       // 0x20-byte frame (matches [RECUR] sp -0x20/level)
r5 = [0x8132AE60]                                      // appMessage manager
while (r5) {
  node = r5; r1 = node[0]; ... flags patching (bit16 -> |=4)
  for (w = node[0x14]; w; w = w[0x1A0]) appMessageWindow_81029BFC(w);   // per-window processing
  next = node[0x18]; node[0x18] = 0;
  while (next) {
    w = next[0x1A0];
    ... list unlink bookkeeping ...
    if (w) { vtable = w[0x10]; handler = vtable[0]; handler(w, -1, 1); } // window callback -> RECURSION source
    if (w[0x44])  { appFont_8101e576(w[0x44]);  w[0x44] = 0; }
    if (w[0x94])  { appFont_8101e576(w[0x94]);  w[0x94] = 0; }
    if (w[0xF8])  { free font array; w[0xF8] = 0; }
    FUN_81025BEA(w[0x11C]);
    appList_810162E8(*(w[4]));
    next = w[0x1A0]; ...
  }
}
return 0;   // 0x8102A654 pop.w {r4,r5,r6,r7,r8,sb,sl,pc}
```
`appMessageWindow_81029BFC` (596B) does the per-window message processing (window state, layout `81029612`, fonts `8101FA8C/8101E3EA/8101FA68`,
message list, scroll) and at its end calls `(*(code*)**(window+0x10))(window, -1, 2)` - the window handler, which in this app re-enters appProcess exec
-> re-runs this same update (recursion).

Fix = **manual-block recursion guard**:
```
static int g_a500_depth;
mb_8102A500: if (depth >= 3) { log [A500GUARD]; r0=0; return lr; }  depth++; return gbn_raw(0x8102A500)(s);
mb_8102A654: if (depth > 0) depth--; return gbn_raw(0x8102A654)(s);   // real epilogue pop.w
gbn_raw(pc): lower_bound on g_all (bypasses g_manual_blocks)
```
Registered in `init_manual_blocks()`: `0x8102A500 -> mb_8102A500`, `0x8102A654 -> mb_8102A654`.

### 18.4375 PORT M830: FINISHED-FIBER RESTART FROM RECORDED FIRST-START CONTEXT ([FIBMETA]/[FIBRST]).

Evidence chain (M829):
```
[SPLOOP] #1-#5 sp=848568F0 [sp+4]=8116FA64  (normal exec frames)
[SPLOOP] #8   sp=848568E0 [sp]=[sp+4]=00000000  -> exec pop {r4,pc} returns pc=0 (fiber finished)
[WDCTX] fib=848468E0 pc=8116F758 sp=848568E0   -> but the saved ctx still says pc=0x8116F758
[WD] pcring: fiber0 loop -> 812B1BA0 -> 8116F758 repeating; no frame progress
```
So fiber1 finishes, yet restart does not rebuild it: the old restart path read the user entry from `[fiber+0x84]` in guest memory, which can be zero/cleared, so every switch was a no-op.

Fix (new code in `recomp_harness.cpp`):
```
struct FibMeta { uint32_t entry; uint32_t sp; };
std::map<uint32_t, FibMeta> g_fib_meta;           // recorded at first-start ctx creation (fiber_load 'new ctx' branch)
static bool fib_restart(FCtx& c, uint32_t fiber, const char* where) {
  auto m = g_fib_meta.find(fiber); if (m == end) return false;
  memset(&c,0,sizeof(c));
  c.r[0]=fiber; c.r[13]=m->second.sp; c.r[14]=0xFFFFFFF0u; c.r[15]=m->second.entry;
  log [FIBRST] ... where;
  return true;
}
```
Used at:
1. switch handler: `if (it->second.r[15] == 0u) { if (!fib_restart(it->second, t, "switch")) { ...old guest-memory fallback... } }`
2. slice handler: same with `where=slice`.
`[FIBMETA]` prints the recorded entry/sp.

### 18.4376 PORT M831: CANARY-FAIL RETRY = PASSING-PATH EPILOGUE (BACKWARD SCAN FROM THE FAIL STUB).

Evidence trail from the two validation runs:
```
out150m_m841 (M830b raw-LR retry):
  [CHKFIX2] 19946   ... repair canary at sp=848568A0 ... failpc_lr=81153D06 -> retry=81153D06 ...
  switch target histogram:  to=848468E0 tgtpc=812B2810 tgtsp=848568A0  x699
out150m_m840 (legacy 0x8120682A retry):
  [CHKFIX2] ~120, same 812B2810 switch target x699
```
Disassembly of the reporting failure site (`0x81153CF4..0x81153D08`):
```
81153CF4  adds r0,r5
81153CF6  ldr  r2,[sp,#4]      ; saved canary
81153CF8  ldr  r1,[r6]         ; expected canary (r6 = canary storage)
81153CFA  cmp  r1,r2
81153CFC  bne  0x81153D02      ; fail path
81153CFE  add  sp,#8           ; <-- passing-path epilogue starts here
81153D00  pop  {r4,r5,r6,pc}
81153D02  blx  0x812B2810      ; __stack_chk_fail (never returns)
81153D06  nop                  ; lr points here
81153D08  push {r4,lr}         ; next function!
```
Retrying at `lr` (0x81153D06) executes a `nop` and then the **next function's prologue with the canary-failing function's frame still on the stack** -> its own canary check fails
again at the same site -> 19,946-iteration loop (and the saved fiber context keeps being the canary stub 0x812B2810 -> the switch livelock).
The legacy `0x8120682A` fallback instead jumped into the fiber manager with a stale frame -> the NOFN bad-return list
(`812B4150`, `816708B4`, `85AA519C`, `84856994`, `8102A50E`, `846182D0`) and the empty-frame exec continuation (`[SPLOOP]` #8).

Fix: `canary_retry_pc(RecState* s)`:
```
lr = s->r[14]
B = lr-4 (32-bit BLX) or lr-2 (16-bit blx rN)
p = B
loop up to 16 halfwords backwards:
  hw = *(u16*)(p-2)
  if (hw & 0xFF00)==0xB000   -> p -= 2   (add sp,#imm)
  else if (hw & 0xFF00)==0xBD00 or 0xBC00 -> p -= 2   (16-bit pop)
  else if (hw==0xE8BD || hw==0xE92D)      -> p -= 2   (pop.w/push.w prefix halfword)
  else if (hw & 0xF000)==0xD000           -> return p+2 (fall-through after bne = passing epilogue)
  else break -> return lr
```
`[CHKFIX3]` logs `lr`, `B`, `bne@`, `retry`. Special case `lr==0x8120767A -> 0x81207672` (helper 81207632 epilogue) kept.

the retry address. The `[SPLOOP]` evidence already pointed the same way (exec continuation frames at sp 848568F0 normally, then 848568D0 with the
saved-LR slot overwritten by 846182D0, then empty frames `[sp]=[sp+4]=0`).

### 18.4377 PORT M832: BALANCED-RETURN FOR THE APPMESSAGE RECURSION GUARD (STACK DESYNC SOURCE).

Evidence chain:
```
[SPLOOP] #1-#5 sp=848568F0 [sp]=00000000 [sp+4]=8116FA64   (normal exec frame: [sp+4] = runner return)
[SPLOOP] #6   sp=848568D0 [sp]=815554C0 [sp+4]=846182D0   (0x20 off; saved-LR slot overwritten by the process pointer)
[SPLOOP] #7   sp=848568D8 [sp]=[sp+4]=0
[SPLOOP] #8   sp=848568E0 [sp]=[sp+4]=0 -> exec pop {r4,pc} returns pc=0
switch target histogram: to=848468E0 tgtpc=812B2810 tgtsp=848568A0 x699 (canary stub)
[CHKFIX2] 19946 loops at lr=81153D06 with saved_lr=0, saved_r4=0, saved_r5=0 (frame zeroed)
```
Cause: `mb_8102A500`'s guard path did `s->r[0]=0; return s->r[14];` - this simulates "function returned" **without** the function's
`push.w {r4,r5,r6,r7,r8,sb,sl,lr}` (0x20 bytes). Whoever called the update sees sp unchanged, and the caller's frame chain ends up 0x20 off;
later returns/pops walk into the wrong slots (the saved-LR slot receives the process pointer), frames are lost, the fiber context stays at the
canary-fail stub, and the one-tick livelock follows.

Fix in `mb_8102A500`:
```
if (depth >= 1) {
  sp2 = sp - 0x20;
  mem[sp2+0x00..0x1C] = { r4, r5, r6, r7, r8, sb(r9), sl(r10), lr };   // emulate push.w {r4,r5,r6,r7,r8,sb,sl,lr}
  s->r[13] = sp2; s->r[4] = 0;          // epilogue: adds r0,r4,#0 -> return value 0
  return 0x8102A654u;                   // real epilogue block: adds r0,r4,#0; pop.w {r4,r5,r6,r7,r8,sb,sl,pc}
}
```
=> a **balanced return** to the caller with the correct frame chain. `[A500GUARD]` log updated to
`depth=... sp=old->new lr=... -> balanced-return via 8102A654`.

Generated block (batch_026):

Table check: **no block at 0x8102A50E** (the fall-through `movs r4,#0; cmp r5,#0; beq.w 0x8102A654`).

```

```

### 18.4381 PORT M836: CANARY-RETRY OFF-BY-2 (SKIPPED `add sp,#8`) FIXED.

The `[CHKFIX2]` 19,946-loop signature:
```
[CHKFIX2] repair canary at sp=848568A0 (copy from 0x812B414C); saved_lr=00000000 saved_r4=00000000 saved_r5=00000000 fib=848468E0
[CHKFIX2] failpc_lr=81153D06 -> retry=81153D00 sp=848568A0 saved_lr=00000000 fib=848468E0
```
Raw Thumb bytes of `decodeMemory_81153c70` (function 0x81153C70, size 150 = ends at 0x81153D06):
```
81153CF4 1C28   adds r0,r5
81153CF6 9A01   ldr  r2,[sp,#4]      ; saved canary
81153CF8 6831   ldr  r1,[r6]         ; expected canary
81153CFA 4291   cmp  r1,r2
81153CFC D101   bne  0x81153D02      ; fail path
81153CFE B002   add  sp,#8           ; <-- passing epilogue: MUST be executed on retry
81153D00 BD70   pop  {r4,r5,r6,pc}
81153D02 blx  0x812B2810            ; __stack_chk_fail (never returns)
81153D06 = function end / nop
```
`canary_retry_pc()` scans backwards from the blx (B=0x81153D02) over epilogue halfwords:
`p: D02 -> D00 (pop) -> CFE (add sp) -> finds bne at CFC`. At that point `p == 0x81153CFE` (the address just past the
branch halfword) = exactly the epilogue start. The old code returned `p+2 = 0x81153D00`, skipping `add sp,#8`; the pop then read
the frame at the wrong offset (zeroed slots) -> garbage pc -> same canary check re-fired -> 19,946 loop.
Fix: `return p;` (and the `[CHKFIX3]` log prints the actual branch address `p-2`).

```
...       (body)
81153CAA  blx  0x812B29F0     ; AllocMemBlock -> r0=uid
81153CAE  adds r5,r0
81153CB0  add  r1,sp,#0       ; info = sp  <-- pointer passed to GetMemBlockInfo
81153CB2  blx  0x812B29E0     ; GetMemBlockInfo(uid, info=sp)
...
81153CF6  ldr  r2,[sp,#4]     ; read canary
81153CF8  ldr  r1,[r6]
81153CFA  cmp  r1,r2
81153CFC  bne  0x81153D02     ; mismatch -> __stack_chk_fail
81153CFE  add  sp,#8
81153D00  pop  {r4,r5,r6,pc}
```
Our HLE case 0x812B29E0 did:
```
uint32_t vals[8] = { base, size, size, 0,0,0,0,0 };
std::memcpy(p, vals, 32);     // <-- 32 bytes at info == sp !
```
=> writes `[sp] = base`, `[sp+4] = size` (= canary slot overwritten!), `[sp+8] = size`, `[sp+12..sp+28] = 0`
(the pushed r4/r5/r6/lr area). The subsequent canary compare therefore **always fails** -> repair writes `[sp+4] = canary` again and retries at the
passing epilogue, but every call re-corrupts the same slot -> **19,946-iteration canary-fail loop**, and the fiber context ends up saved at the
canary stub (`tgtpc=812B2810 x699`). This also explains why fixing the retry address (M836) changed nothing.

The game only uses `[info]` (the first word = base address) for the next call:
```
81153CD0 ldr r0,[sp]        ; base address
81153CD2 adds r1,r4         ; size
81153CD4 movs r2,#3
81153CD6 blx 0x812B1640     ; GxmMapMemory(base, size, 3)
```
FIX: `std::memcpy(p, vals, 4)` - write only the base address; keep the caller's canary and saved registers intact.

### 18.4386 PORT M841: THE ASSERT SPIN WAS A STALE-LOCAL-pc BUG IN OUR DISPATCH LOOPS (2.149e9 ITERATIONS -> 1).

`assert_hle()` hook (platform assert-decision stub at `0x8115F7E0`):
```
FUN_8115F9CA: push {r4,lr}; bl 0x8115F7E0; cmp r0,#0; beq ret; movs r0,#0; str r0,[r0]   // real stub returns 1 -> NULL write = abort
```
Our hook intercepts pc==0x8115F7E0, sets `s->r[0]=0`, `s->r[15]=s->r[14]` and returns 1. But the dispatch loops did:
```
if (family_skip(s, pc)) continue;
if (nulldesc_skip(s, pc)) continue;
if (assert_hle(s, pc)) continue;       // <-- local pc NOT refreshed
```
=> next iteration `pc` is still `0x8115F7E0` => hook again => infinite loop; blocks/loop counters untouched. That is exactly the
`[ASSERTRATE]` signature (block count frozen at 26628, loop counters frozen, assert counter -> 2,149,658,089 = 2^31+1,169,641).
FIX (3 sites): `if (assert_hle(s, pc)) { pc = s->r[15]; continue; }` for loop_site 0 (fiber exec), loop_site 1 (`hle_thr_pump`),
loop_site 2 (main dispatch); loop_site 3 (`pump2`) already used `ppc = s.r[15]`.

RESULT (`out150m_m854.txt`, FASTSLEEP): `[ASSERT]` = **1** (was 2,148,658,089). Execution continues past the GFD draw-state assert;
the run advances to `n=61,315,000`, then a NEW frontier appears:

```
last [FRAMEDUMP] n=61315000 pc=81206832 fib=84836840
[WDRING] 812B2AC0 81198BF2 812067A0 812B1B70 812067B6 8120680E 8120681C 81206820 81206822 812B1BA0 8115FB52 8115FB4A
[WDCTX] fib=84836840 pc=8120682A sp=848468A8 ; fib=848468E0 pc=8120682A sp=848568E8 r0=00000005 r5=84618110
```
Note: `batch_027` (supplemental `FUN_81185308`, 32 blocks) DOES contain `0x811853E2` and `0x811853E8`, and `0x811853E4` is the `bl` inside
block `0x811853E2` (which returns `0x811853E8`), so `pc=0x811853E4` must come from another path (bad return / context).

### 18.4387 PORT M842: DUPLICATE BLOCK TABLES - SUPPLEMENTAL BATCHES MUST WIN (fixed bad pc 0x811853E4).

Symptom after M841: `[NOFN] unknown pc=811853E4` x6 and `[BADPC] where=fexec-top pc=811853E2/811853E4 lr=8115FB52 sp=848568E8`.
Static compare (`batch_026.cpp` vs `batch_027.cpp`):
```
batch_026: blk_811853E2 = { r0=5; return 0x811853E4; }              // TRUNCATED (wrong function end from IDA table)
batch_027: blk_811853E2 = { r0=5; r14=0x811853E8; return 0x8115FAD2; }  // CORRECT (bl 0x8115FAD2)
```
`build_all_blocks()` collected all tables into `g_all` and did a plain `std::sort` by VA, so for duplicate VAs the retained winner was
implementation-defined; here the wrong `batch_026` block won -> dispatch returned `0x811853E4` (an address that is NOT a block start; the real
instruction there is the `bl` of block E2) -> NOFN.
FIX (`build_all_blocks`):
```
std::map<uint32_t, BlockFn> _ded;
for (int i = 29; i >= 0; --i) { ... for each block: _ded.emplace(va, fn); }   // first insert wins = highest batch index
g_all.clear(); for (auto& kv : _ded) g_all.push_back({kv.first, kv.second});    // sorted for lower_bound
```
`[TABLE] blocks`: 229824 -> **229749** (75 duplicate VAs resolved; supplemental translations preferred).
VERIFIED: default 30M green. FASTSLEEP 150M (`out150m_m856.txt`): `[NOFN]=0`, `[BADPC]=0`, ended cleanly-ish at
`[HARNESS] indirect miss at pc=8116E60E` -> `[INDIRECT-MISS] reg2=81185299 target=81185298 block=8116E60E`.

Observation: with `P5D_GXMABI=1` all GXM guest calls go through `gxm_abi.cpp` (`[GXMABI]` 4025 at boot), NOT through the harness HLE
cases 0x812B1570/0x812B1720, so:
```

sce_gxm.cpp:324  sceGxmDisplayQueueAddEntry: STUB_LOG(...); return 0;               // no present, no callback

```
The guest registers `displayQueueCallback` in `SceGxmInitializeParams`; the harness HLE case 0x812B1570 used to capture it into `g_display_cb`,
and case 0x812B1720 used to schedule `g_disp_pending = g_display_cb` (run by the main loop via `call_guest_cb` at recomp_harness.cpp:2293).
With GXMABI routing this was dead.
FIX (gxm_abi.cpp + recomp_harness.cpp):
```
extern "C" void p5d_hle_set_display_cb(uint32_t cb, uint32_t cbds);
extern "C" void p5d_hle_display_queue(uint32_t cb, uint32_t data);
static uint32_t g_p5d_display_cb = 0;
// sceGxmInitialize (gxm_abi_call_B0F1E4EC)
if (p0) { memcpy(&_cb, q+8, 4); memcpy(&_cbd, q+0xC, 4); if (_cb) { g_p5d_display_cb=_cb; p5d_hle_set_display_cb(_cb,_cbd); } }
// sceGxmDisplayQueueAddEntry (gxm_abi_call_EC5C26B5)
if (g_p5d_display_cb) p5d_hle_display_queue(g_p5d_display_cb, a2);
// recomp_harness.cpp hooks
extern "C" void p5d_hle_set_display_cb(uint32_t cb, uint32_t cbds) { g_display_cb=cb; g_display_cbds=cbds; }
extern "C" void p5d_hle_display_queue(uint32_t cb, uint32_t data) { g_disp_pending=cb; g_disp_pending_cbd=data; }
```

### 18.4403 PORT M858: MOVIE-DECODE PHASE IDENTIFIED AS REAL GUEST HUFFMAN/BITSTREAM DECODE (virtual-time consistent).

`cur.pc` during n=5M..55M sweeps blocks inside `FUN_811DF91A` (rea decompile): a canonical-Huffman/bitstream decoder:
```
FUN_811df91a(param_1, param_2):
  FUN_812b2270(auStack_741c, param_1, 0x410);              // copy 0x410-byte header/table
  ... build 0x80-entry table (stride 0x70), fields +0x414/+0x440/+0x444/+0x448

  ... bitstream loop: every 8 bits reload uVar8 = *(byte*)(iVar11+1); follow table links;
      write decoded byte: *puVar2 = (char)iVar10; count = local_7414
```

means 50M blocks ≈ 100 s of virtual time, matching the dummy-USM movie length; the app leaves the decode phase at n≈60M (cur.pc=811C100C) and the frame counter advances

### 18.4409 PORT M864: MISSING AOT BLOCK 0x811829CC KILLED THE FILE WORKER; batch_031 FIXES IT.

Symptom (from M863 instrumentation):
```
[THREXIT] badblock tid=4001B000 pc=811829CC lr=811829D6 sp=849BC930
```

`FUN_811829CE` is the worker loop (`do { FUN_81182742(0); FUN_8120760C(30000); } while(1);`). Disassembly around the bad pc:
```
8118299E  cmp r4,#0
811829A0  beq #0x811829cc
...

811829C4  ldr r2,[r4,#4]      ; state machine continue
811829C6  cmp r2,#0x17
811829C8  bhi #0x811828d8
811829CA  b   #0x81182760
811829CC  pop {r4,r5,r6,pc}   <-- epilogue of the processor function; NO AOT BLOCK EXISTED HERE
811829CE  push {r4,lr}        <-- worker loop
```
The processor function's real extent is `0x81182742..0x811829CC`, but IDA's bounds say `FUN_81182742 size 280` (ends 0x8118285A), so the CFG stopped early and
the AOT table had no block at 0x811829CC (only stray block 0x8118285A from an older supplemental batch). When the state machine took the `beq 0x811829CC`
epilogue path, the dispatcher hit a missing block -> thread marked dead -> virtual-file requests were never processed again.


### 18.4413 PORT M868: `sceKernelCreateLwMutex` HLE BUG FIXED - CRI INIT UNBLOCKED, NEXT BLOCKERS EXPOSED VIA [CRILOG].

The bootstrap stall had a very mundane root: our HLE for `sceKernelCreateLwMutex` (0x812B2910) returned `hle_malloc(64)` (a pointer). But the API is
`int sceKernelCreateLwMutex(SceKernelLwMutexWork *work, const char *name, unsigned attr, int count, const OptParam *opt)` -> **returns an int error code (0 = success)**.
CRI's wrappers check that code, so CRI logged (hidden until now):
```
E10062288:sceKernelCreateLwMutex function has failed.      x6 at n=1717
```
and bailed out of its init sequence. Consequence: `FUN_81224160 = criAtom_Initialize` never reached the point where it calls `FUN_8128399E = criFs_Initialize`
(sole callers of criFs_Initialize: FUN_81224160 @0x81224638 and FUN_81235A10 @0x81235F30; both inside CRI library inits), so `DAT_8153FECC` (criFs inited flag)
stayed 0 and the binder global `DAT_8153FEF4` was never written by `FUN_81284960` -> every `FUN_8128715E` binder info query returned -1
("W2008121610:The binder module is not initialized.") -> the stream reader got size 0 -> stream state 0x13 -> appResourceList nodes never completed ->
boot page1 never ends.
FIX in recomp_harness.cpp:
```cpp
case 0x812B2910u: {   // sceKernelCreateLwMutex(work,name,attr,count,opt) -> 0 on success; ZERO the SceKernelLwMutexWork (0x20 B) at r0
  uint32_t _w = s->r[0]; if (_w) { uint8_t* _p = GP(_w); if (_p) std::memset(_p, 0, 0x20); }
  r0 = 0; break; }
```
New diagnostic `[CRILOG]` probe (intercepts CRI log functions 0x81278F96 / 0x81279176 / 0x81279486 / 0x81279520, prints the message string):
the mutex error is gone; the CRI init now proceeds and reveals the next issues at n=1717:
```
E2009072703:Insufficient buffer size.                                     <- logged by FUN_81224160 (criAtom_Initialize) at 0x81224960
W2008121610:The binder module is not initialized.                         <- FUN_8128715E (as before, but now only as a downstream symptom)
E2008102820:criFsLoader_Create has been called before the library initialization.   <- FUN_8128DE06
E2010052671:Can not open ACF file. (path = %s)                           <- criAtom ACF config file missing
W2010110102:ACF file is not registered.
E2013081521:"%s" is invalid DSP Bus Setting.
E2011112202
```
So the whole resource-load chain is currently gated by **CRI Atom initialization**: the game passes a work buffer that CRI considers too small, and the ACF file open fails, so
criAtom_Initialize aborts before calling criFs_Initialize. (Also proven: `FUN_81284084` = `return DAT_8153FECC;` = criFs_IsInitialized; `FUN_8128399E` = criFs_Initialize.)
VERIFIED: default 30M green with the fix (`exit=0, [TABLE] blocks=229791, GXM=12, FSW=16, FRAMEDUMP=6000, NOFN=0, ASSERT=0, BADMEM=0`).
NEXT: (a) find why criAtom's work buffer is "insufficient" (caller-provided size vs required in FUN_81224160), (b) find the ACF file in data.cpk/vita.cpk and make the
file HLE serve the path the guest opens; then criAtom init completes -> criFs_Initialize runs -> binder initialized -> file sizes resolve -> streams 0xC -> nodes done ->
`global_resource` -> `init gamedata` -> boot page1 ends -> title.

### 18.4417 PORT M872: AOT PC-RELATIVE LITERAL LOADS WERE WRONG - 486 SITES FIXED, ALL BATCHES RECOMPILED.

Symptom (only visible once the NGS shim let CRI init proceed): `[BADMEM] guest va=0x0A01ED9A unmapped block=0x812243D8`, exit=3,
right after `criFs_Initialize` returned successfully (pc ring `... 8122463C 81224728 812243C8 812847B4 812243CC 812243D8`).
Generated AOT code for the crashing block:
```cpp
static uint32_t blk_812243CC(RecState* s) {
  g_cur_block = 0x812243CCu;
  vfp_s_bits_set(s, 0, rd32(s, s->r[10] + 0x4u + 0x0u));   // vldr s0,[sl,#4]
  s->r[1] = rd32(s, s->r[15] + 0x0u);                      // ldr r1,[pc,#0]  <-- WRONG BASE
  return 0x812243D8u; }
```
Correct semantics: `ldr r1,[pc,#0]` at 0x812243D0 reads `Align(0x812243D0+4,4)+0 = 0x812243D4` (ELF literal = 0x8153F2C0).
Our code read `s->r[15]`, which at runtime is the block's own PC (0x812243CC) -> got the instruction word `0x0A01ED9A`
(same value as the first halfword pair at 0x812243CC) -> the following `vstr s0,[r1]` wrote to 0x0A01ED9A -> BADMEM.
Root cause: generator `_gen_batch2.py` maps capstone `ARM_REG_PC` to `s->r[15]` verbatim; it never computed the
per-instruction literal address.
FIX TOOL (local, `C:\dev\tmp\_pc_rel_fix.py`, batches are game-derived so the tool itself is the reusable artifact):
for every batch file, for every `static uint32_t blk_XXXX(RecState* s) { ... }` line containing `s->r[15]`:
1. disassemble the ELF from XXXX to the next block start (Thumb);
2. collect instructions whose operand string contains `[pc` (k of them);
3. collect the k `s->r[15]` + offset expressions in the generated line (if counts differ -> skip and log);
4. literal VA = `Align(instr.address+4,4) + imm` (imm parsed from the generated `+ 0x...` terms);
5. rewrite each `s->r[15] (+ 0x..)*` to `0x<literal>u`.
Result: **486 occurrences patched in 22 of the 32 batches**; residual 26 in `batch_026` are in data-as-code / UNSUPPORTED-instruction
blocks (`0x81147B04` etc. have disassembly windows too small to pair) and are left for a second pass.
All 32 batches recompiled with `g++ -std=c++17 -O2 -I. -c batch_XXX.cpp -o batch_XXX.o` (pre-patch sources backed up to
`C:\dev\p5d_build\tools_backup\batches_prepcrel_4417\`).
VERIFICATION:
```
default (P5D_NGS unset), 30M: exit=0, [TABLE] blocks=229791, GXM=12, FSW=16, FRAMEDUMP=6000, NOFN=0, ASSERT=0, BADMEM=0
P5D_NGS=1, 30M: exit=0 (0x812243D8 crash GONE), ZERO CRI error logs, [CONSUME] FIOS-opens=12288 (was 0)
P5D_NGS=1, 130M FASTSLEEP: stall in early boot - [FRAMEDUMP] n=130,000,000 flags=00000002 t4=0 t8=0 ctr=0,
   [SEQST] h=0 at every 5M sample, pc pinned in fiber/scheduler loop 81206894 812068A0 812068AC 812068BC 812068D8 8120685A 812B1B70 ...
```
So with NGS enabled and the literal-load bug fixed, criFs/CRI FS works (12288 Fios opens) but something now blocks *before* the
boot-movie/scene chain (NGS/audio dependency or `sceSysmoduleIsLoaded` semantics). Default path is unchanged and green.
NEXT: diff the NGS-enabled early path against the default 130M run; probe wait objects/threads in the 812068xx scheduler loop; refine
SceNgs/SceAudio HLE (`812B1E90` IsLoaded semantics, system handle, and the update/lock functions seen in the HLE histogram
`812B2020`/`812B1FF0`/`812B2080`) until the NGS-enabled boot follows the normal path -> boot page ends -> title.

### 18.4430 PORT M885: fiber RUNNING 位缺失是 app 启动死等的根因；修复后 fiber B 执行 app 主代码，推进到 GXM 初始化崩溃

1) 根因（结合 `FUN_812067A0` 反编译）：其完成处理
```c
if ((*(uint *)(self + 0x80) & 1) != 0) {      // bit0 = RUNNING
    ... 从 DAT_816CC624/620 链表摘除 ...
    *(uint *)(self + 0x80) = uVar2 | 2;       // bit2 = FINISHED 只在这里写
}
if (iVar3 == 0) iVar3 = DAT_816CC624;
if ((self != iVar3) && iVar3) sceFiberSwitch(iVar3, 0, 0);
```
**bit0=running 必须由系统库（SceFiber）在 fiber 开始运行时置位**；我们的 HLE 从未置 bit0，
所以 fiber A 跑完 1.5M 块 init 后 FUN_812067A0 只执行"切下一个 fiber"分支，完成位从未写回 fiber A，
主线程 `FUN_8120683C(fiberA)` 的 `while ((fiberA[0x80]&2)==0)` 死等（M882/M884 的现象）。

```c
if (fiber) { uint8_t* _q = GP(fiber + 0x80u); if (_q) { uint32_t _v=0; memcpy(&_v,_q,4); _v |= 1u; memcpy(_q,&_v,4); } }
```

### 18.4439 PORT M894: 修复线程级 GetSelf dummy 语义 -> app 主循环跑起来（进入 boot 电影解码）

1) 问题回顾（M893）：线程级 `sceFiberGetSelf` 返回的 dummy 对象在 n≈3M 时被清零（`[DUMPSELF] 0x85119330` 前 8 字全 0），
同时 guest 链表头/尾 `0x816CC620/624` 也为 0 → `FUN_8120683C` else 分支 `iVar3 = self[0x94]=0`，`iVar3 = DAT_816CC624 = 0`，
`if (self != iVar3 && iVar3 != 0)` 为假 → **永不调用 sceFiberSwitch**。
2) 修复（18.4439，`P5D_GETSELFFIX=1`）：
```cpp
// thread-level sceFiberGetSelf: re-arm dummy each call and link it to an alive fiber
if (!g_in_fiber_exec && _gsfix) {
    if (!g_dummy_getself) g_dummy_getself = hle_malloc(0xA0u);
    f = g_dummy_getself;
    uint32_t link = read32(0x816CC624);                 // guest list head if valid
    if (!link) { for (cand in {0x848463A0, 0x84836300})   // else first alive fiber
                     if ((read32(cand+0x80) & 1u) && !(read32(cand+0x80) & 2u)) { link = cand; break; } }
    write32(f+0x80, 1u);    // running
    write32(f+0x94, link);  // next -> FUN_8120683C will call sceFiberSwitch(link)
    write32(f+0x98, 0u);    // prev = head
}
```
这样 `FUN_8120683C` else 分支：`self[0x80]&1` 成立 → 摘链（`DAT_816CC624=self[0x94]=fiberB`）→
`iVar3=fiberB != 0` 且 `self != iVar3` → **`sceFiberSwitch(fiberB)`** → fiber B 被调度。
3) 验证（`P5D_NOSCHEDRUN=1` + `P5D_GXMABI=1` + `P5D_GETSELFFIX=1`，30,000,000 块，`out30m_m964fix30.txt`）：

### 18.4449 PORT M904: 修复 GXM ABI GetRenderTargetMemSize 未写 out 参数（2.2GB 荒谬分配的根因）

1) 反编译 `FUN_811E6AF4`（surface/texture 分配器，`dec_811E6C0E.c`）关键段：
```c
uVar6 = param_3 * 4 * param_2 + 0xfffff & 0xfff00000;   // 像素缓冲大小
...
FUN_812B1580(&local_54, &local_58);                     // sceGxmGetRenderTargetMemSize(params, &driverMemSize)
iVar3 = FUN_81207734(local_58, 0, 0, 0x10000001);       // -> sceKernelAllocMemBlock(..., size=local_58, ...)
```
2) 卡点链条：
- `0x812B1580` 在 `P5D_GXMABI=1` 下走 gxm_abi 层：`gxm_abi_call_B291C959`（sceGxmGetRenderTargetMemSize）
  因 `GXM_ABI_CALL_STUB_IMPLS=0` 直接 `return 0u;` —— **从不写 r1（driverMemSize out 指针）**；
- 于是 `local_58`（guest 栈局部）保留先前垃圾值 **0x846001FC**；
- guest 用 0x846001FC 当 size 调 `sceKernelAllocMemBlock` → `[MEMA-BIG] size=846001FC` → `[HLE] malloc REJECT huge n=846102FC`
  → `[MEMA-OOM] size=846001FC total=2221MB uid=00000117`（共 5 次，total 8581MB）；
- 失败后游戏带病继续 → page1 的 CRI FS 堆无法工作 → n≈59.935M 在 CRI FS 内自旋（M903）。
3) 修复（18.4449，`gxm_abi.cpp`）：
```cpp
extern "C" uint32_t gxm_abi_call_B291C959(uint32_t* regs, uint32_t* stack_args) {
    (void)stack_args;
    const uint32_t a1 = regs ? regs[1u] : 0u;      // unsigned int * driverMemSize
    void* p1 = gxm_abi_xlate(a1);
    uint32_t sz = 0x33D000u;                        // ARCH_10 empirical (same as harness HLE case 0x812B1580)
    if (p1) std::memcpy(p1, &sz, 4);
    return (uint32_t)sz;
}
```

### 18.4453 PORT M908: page1 卡点定位 = vblank 帧循环（worker 线程被饿死）；VBPUMP 修复实验

1) 探针数据（`out64m_m978page1probe2.txt`，n≥59M 后、卡死前）：
`[H57]` 直方图（3000 条，按 va/lr）：
| va@lr | 次数 | 名称 |
|---|---|---|
| 812B2A50@81207612 | **959** | sceKernelDelayThread |
| 812B27A0@81207426 | 328 | sceKernelWaitSema |
| 812B2AD0@8120745C | 327 | sceKernelSignalSema |
| 812B2830@81207350 | 322 | sceKernelLockLwMutex |
| 812B28A0@8120735C | 322 | sceKernelUnlockLwMutex |
| 812B2880@811732C2 | 321 | sceKernelWaitEventFlag |
| **812B1810@811539FE** | **211** | **sceDisplayWaitVblankStartMultiCB** |
| 812B2AE0@8127BE56 | 210 | sceKernelSetEventFlag |
- `[WAITSEMA57]` 200 条仅两种：`obj=50018000 need=1 have=1`（104）、`obj=50017000 need=1 have=2`（96）；
- `[SETEF57]` 200 条全为 `obj=60016000 bits=1`；
- `[FHOPEN57]`=0、`[FHREAD57]`=0 → **此阶段完全没有 Fios 调用**（排除"Fios 读完成缺失"假设）。
- `[IDR]` 到 state=1 idx=0 后停止；`[FRAMEDUMP] n=59,810,000 ctr=9`。
2) 解释：page1 卡在**帧循环**：
`WaitSema(帧信号量 50017000/50018000) → 处理帧 → SetEventFlag(60016000,bit1) → WaitEventFlag → WaitVblankStart(812B1810) → DelayThread(5000us) → 循环`
- 真实硬件上 `sceDisplayWaitVblankStartMultiCB` 会阻塞 ~16ms，把 CPU 让给加载 worker 线程；
- 我们的 HLE 桩**立即返回**，且 guest-thread 模型**无抢占** → 主线程永远不让出 → worker 线程被饿死 → page1 加载永不完成。
3) 修复实验（18.4453，env `P5D_VBPUMP=1`）：
```cpp
case 0x812B1810u: {  // sceDisplayWaitVblankStartMultiCB
  ...
  if (_vbp) { g_vtime_extra += 16000ull * cnt;
              hle_thr_pump(s, 300); }   // run ready guest threads during the vblank wait
}
```
4) 2.5M 冒烟测试（`out2m_m980vbump2.txt`）：`[VBPUMP]` 从 n=2048 起触发、exit=0、无 BADMEM；
已后台启动 **64M 长跑**（`out64m_m981vbump.txt`，带 `P5D_VBPUMP=1`）验证 page1 是否完成 → 标题页。

若仍卡住，检查 pump 是否真的让 worker 前进（线程 ctxpc / 加载队列推进）、以及 vblank 次数与 sema 计数的节奏。

### 18.4454 PORT M909: VBPUMP 无效根因（g_cur_thr 上下文 pump/让出都被禁用）+ THRYIELD 合作让出实验

1) VBPUMP 长跑结果（`out64m_m981vbump.txt`）：
```
[FRAMEDUMP] n=59810000 flags=00000003 ctr=9 pc=81283C84 blk=8128EA74 sp=84855FC0 fib=848463A0 gxm(b/e/p)=0/0/0   (与 M908 相同卡点)
[VBPUMP] 仅 6 条，全部 n=2048（早期 vblank）
[IDR] state=1 idx=1 handle=85B8591C n=59613200（加载状态未再推进）
```
2) 根因（源码 `recomp_harness.cpp`）：
- `hle_thr_pump` 第一行：`if (g_cur_thr || g_hostthreads) return;`
  → page1 帧循环运行在 **guest 线程上下文**（H57 显示 thr=40017000）时，pump 永远不执行；
- DelayThread case：`if (g_cur_thr) { ...(probe)... break; }`
  → **guest 线程里 DelayThread 不让出**，调度器无法运行其它线程；
=> 主线程在帧循环里自旋/空转，加载 worker 线程永远得不到执行 → page1 永不完成。
3) 修复实验（18.4454，`P5D_THRYIELD=1`）：
```cpp
// (a) hle_thr_pump 入口：虚拟时间到期唤醒
if (g_thryield_env) {
  for (auto& kv : g_thr) { HThread& t = kv.second;
    if (t.alive && t.waiting) { auto it = g_thr_wake_vt.find(kv.first);
      if (it != g_thr_wake_vt.end() && g_vtime_extra >= it->second) { t.waiting = 0; t.ready = 1; g_thr_wake_vt.erase(it); } } }
}
// (b) DelayThread 在 guest 线程上下文：登记虚拟唤醒时间并阻塞让出
if (g_cur_thr) { ... if (g_thryield_env) {
    g_thr_wake_vt[g_cur_thr] = g_vtime_extra + (s->r[0] ? s->r[0] : 1u);
    g_thr_blocked = 1; g_thr_wait_obj = 0; g_thr_wait_bits = 0; g_thr_wait_mode = 0; }
  break; }
```
4) 2.5M 冒烟测试（`out2m_m984thryield3.txt`）：
```
[THRYIELD-GT] tid=40017000 usec=5000 -> yield
[THRYIELD-GT] tid=4001B000 usec=30000 -> yield
[THRYIELD-GT] tid=4001C000 usec=30000 -> yield   (共 8 条)
done: blocks=2500000 ... exit=0；BADMEM 0
```
已后台启动 **64M 长跑**（`out64m_m985thryield.txt`，`P5D_THRYIELD=1`）验证 page1 是否完成 → 标题页。

### 18.4457 PORT M912: 周期抢占判据错误（g_blkcnt_total 冻结）→ 改用调用计数后抢占生效

1) 现象：M911 的周期抢占在 64M 长跑 `out64m_m988preempt.txt` 中 `[PREEMPT]` **0 条**，
尽管 page1 确实在 guest 线程上下文里自旋（PDUMP 已证实）。
2) 原因：periodpump 条件写成
```cpp
if (g_periodpump_env && (g_blkcnt_total - _pp_last) >= 65536u) { ... }
```
而 **`g_blkcnt_total` 在嵌套 fiber 执行期间冻结**（M859 起已知规则：内层 exec 不递增该计数），
page1 的帧循环正好在嵌套执行里 → 条件永不成立。
3) 修复（18.4457）：用 **job_probes 调用次数** 作节拍（每个执行块调用一次、嵌套内也递增）：
```cpp
{ static uint32_t _pp_cnt = 0; ++_pp_cnt;
  if (g_periodpump_env && _pp_cnt >= 65536u) { _pp_cnt = 0;
    if (g_cur_thr) { g_thr_blocked = 1; }                         // 抢占当前线程
    else { g_pump_force = 1; hle_thr_pump(s, 60); g_pump_force = 0; } } }   // 运行所有 ready 线程
```
4) 3M 冒烟测试（`out3m_m989preempt2.txt`）：
```
[PREEMPT] tid=40019000 pc=812B28A0 fib=848463A0
[PREEMPT] tid=4001D000 pc=8127B7C8 fib=848463A0
[PREEMPT] tid=4001C000 pc=81207442 fib=848463A0
[PREEMPT] tid=40018000 pc=810160FC fib=848463A0
done: blocks=3000000 ... exit=0；BADMEM 0
```
=> 抢占对象正是 M911 [PDUMP] 中 **ready=1 却从未执行的 worker 线程**（40018000/40019000/4001C000/4001D000）。
5) 已后台启动 **64M 长跑**：`out64m_m990preempt2.txt`（THRYIELD+PERIODPUMP 计数版）。

2) 新卡点：反编译 `FUN_81003CCC`（`dec_loop.c`）：
```c
puVar2 = (undefined4 *)FUN_81003ba0();
puVar5 = puVar2 + 0x84;                                  // &ctx[0x210]
do { iVar3 = appJobQueue_8101600e(puVar5); } while (iVar3 == 0);   // 等 [ctx+0x210+4]==0

```
`appJobQueue_8101600e` = `return param_1[1] == 0;`（作业队列空闲判断）。
3) 根因（`[PDUMP]` n=59.5M，`out64m_m990preempt2.txt`）：**所有 worker 线程 wait=1 且 obj=0（无唤醒对象）**：
```

tid=40019000 alive=1 ready=0 wait=1 obj=00000000 ctxpc=8120735C
tid=4001A000 alive=1 ready=0 wait=1 obj=60016000 bits=1 ctxpc=8127BE1C
tid=4001C000 alive=1 ready=0 wait=1 obj=00000000 ctxpc=8120744A
tid=4001D000 alive=1 ready=0 wait=1 obj=00000000 ctxpc=8127B7D8
tid=4001E000/4001F000/40020000 wait=1 obj=60018000/6001A000/6001C000 bits=1
```
→ 我们的**抢占 bug**：preempt 只置 `g_thr_blocked=1`，**没有登记唤醒期限**，pump 把线程标为 waiting 后永不再 ready
 → worker 永久停摆 → app 作业队列永远不完成。
4) 修复（18.4458）：
```cpp
if (g_cur_thr) {   // preempt
  g_thr_wake_vt[g_cur_thr] = g_vtime_extra + 2000ull;   // 登记唤醒期限
  g_thr_wait_obj = 0; g_thr_wait_bits = 0; g_thr_wait_mode = 0;
  g_thr_blocked = 1;
}
// 唤醒扫描条件：if (g_thryield_env || g_periodpump_env == 1) ...
// 节拍 65536 → 8192 块
```

### 18.4466 PORT M921: CRI 帧节拍器真实时钟 vs 虚拟时间不一致 → `P5D_VTIME=1` 虚拟时钟修复实验

1) M920 CRIFORCE 无效：`[CFORCE]` 0 条（`out64m_m1001criforce.txt`），page1 仍卡 n≈60.2M → 选错目标函数。
2) 反汇编当前卡点（0x8127BB00 起，Thumb）发现 **`FUN_8127BB30` = CRI 帧节拍/限速器**：
```
8127bb38 bl 8127c232              ; FUN_8127C232 = sceKernelGetProcessTimeWide()/1000 -> ms in r0
8127bb42 bl 8127c244              ; elapsed = now - last
8127bb48...  vldr s1,[r4,#0x94]   ; interval (ms)
8127bb6e bgt ...                  ; if (interval - elapsed - delta) <= 0 -> no sleep
8127bb96 movt r0,#0x447a; vmov s1,r0   ; 1000.0f 上限
8127bbbc bl 8127c0e8              ; DelayThreadCB(min(remain,1000)*1000us)
8127bbc0 bl 8127c232              ; 再取 now 更新 last
```
`FUN_8127C232` 本身：`blx 812b28e0`（sceKernelGetProcessTimeWide）→ `/1000` → ms。
3) 问题：HLE `0x812B28E0` 返回 **真实墙钟**（`hle_tick_us()`）；而 `DelayThreadCB` 只推进
`g_vtime_extra`（虚拟），并不真正睡觉 → 每帧"真实 elapsed≈0"，节拍器永远判定还需要睡一整帧（16ms），
但真实时间几乎不动 → **虚拟推进后逻辑上仍是同一帧** → 紧凑忙等（6M vblank / 3M n 的观测完全吻合）。


### 18.4473 PORT M928: GFD job worker 因信号量 token 不对齐死亡 → 修复 token 转移

1) 证据（`out62m_m1009criop2.txt`）：
```
[TCREATE2] tid=40012000..40016000 entry=811E68C9        <- GFD job worker ×5
[SCREATE] obj=50013000 init=0     name='gfdJobCountSema'
[SCREATE] obj=50014000 init=10240 name='gfdJobEmptySema'
[SCREATE] obj=50015000 init=0     name='gfdJobCountSema'
[SCREATE] obj=50016000 init=8     name='gfdJobEmptySema'
[SEM] wait obj=50013000 need=1 have=0 thr=40012000
[INDIRECT-MISS] reg1=00000000 target=00000000 block=811E6928
[THREXIT] badblock tid=40012000 pc=FFFFFFFD lr=811E6936
... 40013000/40014000/40015000/40016000 同样
```
2) 反编译 **`FUN_811E68C8`（GFD job worker，156 字节）**：
```c
puVar2 = *(undefined4 **)(param_2 + 4);          // 任务系统对象
if (puVar2[4] != 2) {                             // +0x10 stop flag
  do {
    FUN_812b27a0(*puVar2, 1, 0);                  // WaitSema(gfdJobCountSema(50013000), 1, NULL)
    FUN_81207344(puVar2 + 3);                     // LockMutex(+0xC)
    iVar3 = puVar2[7];                            // +0x1C 读索引
    FUN_811e6a4c(&local_40, puVar2[5] + iVar3 * 0x20, 0x20);   // 复制 32B job entry（队列 +0x14）
    iVar3++; puVar2[7] = iVar3; if (iVar3 == puVar2[6]) puVar2[7] = 0;   // +0x18 队列长度回绕
    FUN_81207352(puVar2 + 3);                     // Unlock
    local_24 = puVar2;
    (*local_40)(auStack_3c);                      // ← job entry 第 1 个字 = 函数指针
    puVar2[0xb] = puVar2[0xb] - 1;
  } while (puVar2[4] != 2);
}
```
3) 根因：`INDIRECT-MISS target=0` = worker 从**空槽**取到 NULL 函数指针。我们的
`WaitSema` 在无 token 时把线程标 blocked/waiting **但不扣计数**；`SignalSema` 只把等待者置 ready
**也不扣计数**，而唤醒后的 guest 不会再 decrement → **计数虚高** → worker 被多余计数唤醒 → 取空槽 → 调 NULL → 线程死亡。
page1 的 CRI 加载 op 完成回调 `0x8128D503`（`FUN_81290a60(op+0xc, ..., 0x8128D503, op)` 注册）因此永远不执行 → op 状态恒为 1。
4) 修复（18.4473）：
```cpp
// WaitSema 阻塞（guest 线程）
g_thr_blocked = 1; g_thr_wait_obj = obj; g_thr_wait_bits = need; g_thr_wait_mode = 0x5E4Au;
g_thr_wake_vt.erase(g_cur_thr);          // 禁止 deadline 伪唤醒 sema 等待者
// SignalSema 唤醒
for (auto& kv : g_thr) if (kv.second.waiting && kv.second.wait_obj == obj) {
  if (kv.second.wait_mode == 0x5E4Au) { uint32_t need = kv.second.wait_bits ? kv.second.wait_bits : 1u;
    uint32_t cnt = g_sema[obj]; if (cnt >= need) { g_sema[obj] = cnt - need; kv.second.waiting=0; kv.second.ready=1; break; } }
  else { kv.second.waiting = 0; kv.second.ready = 1; } }
```

```

[THREXIT] 0     [INDIRECT-MISS] 0     [PREEMPT] 10
done: blocks=2500000 ... exit=0；BADMEM 0
```

```cpp
extern "C" uint32_t gxm_abi_call_7B1FABB6(uint32_t* regs, uint32_t* stack_args) {   // fragment
    (void)stack_args;
    const uint32_t out_va = (regs ? regs[1] : 0u);     // void ** uniformBuffer

    uint8_t* slot = reinterpret_cast<uint8_t*>(gxm_abi_xlate(out_va));
    if (slot) std::memcpy(slot, &ubo_va, sizeof(ubo_va));
    return 0u;
}
```

→ app 传给 Precomputed 状态的 **program 指针恒为 0**。根因：`sce_gxm.cpp` 的

2) 修复（18.4482，全部在 `recomp_harness.cpp` 的 GXMABI 分发块、读栈参数之后）：
```cpp
static uint64_t hle_gxp_hash(uint32_t gxpva) {   // FNV-1a64 over SceGxmProgram
  uint8_t* g = GP(gxpva); if (!g) return 0;
  uint32_t mg=0, sz=0; memcpy(&mg,g,4); memcpy(&sz,g+8,4);
  if (mg != 0x00505847u || sz < 0x18u || sz > 0x40000u) return 0;
  uint64_t h = 0xcbf29ce484222325ull;
  for (uint32_t i=0;i<sz;++i){ h ^= (uint64_t)g[i]; h *= 1099511628211ull; }
  return h; }

// RegisterProgram(patcher, programHeader, programId*)
if (strstr(_ge->name,"ShaderPatcherRegisterProgram")) {
  uint64_t gh = hle_gxp_hash(s->r[1]);
  auto it = gh ? _abi_man.find(gh) : _abi_man.end();
  if (it != _abi_man.end()) { uint8_t* q = GP(s->r[2]);
    if (q) { memcpy(q, &_nextid, 4); _pid2spv[_nextid] = it->second;
             printf("[ABIPGID] id=%08X hash=%016llX spv=%s\n", ...); _nextid += 0x20u; } } }

// CreateVertexProgram / CreateFragmentProgram(..., out = stack arg 7th = _stk[2])
auto it = _pid2spv.find(s->r[1]);
if (it != _pid2spv.end()) { uint8_t* q = GP(_stk[2]);
  if (q) { memcpy(q, &_nextobj, 4); (_frag?_fobj2spv:_vobj2spv)[_nextobj] = it->second;
           printf("[ABIPGOBJ] ..."); _nextobj += 0x40u; } }

// PrecomputedVertex/FragmentStateInit / PrecomputedDrawInit: 从 program 对象映射捕获
uint32_t obj = s->r[1];
if (!_frag) { auto it = _vobj2spv.find(obj); if (it != _vobj2spv.end()) _abi_vspv = it->second; }
else        { auto it = _fobj2spv.find(obj); if (it != _fobj2spv.end()) _abi_fspv = it->second; }
```

### 18.4486 PORT M941: 首帧黑屏根因 = 未把离屏 RT 拷贝到 swapchain；改为正确显示路径

1) `out62m_m1022capture.txt`：
```
err: [FRAMESUBMIT] frame=1 img=0 cmd=... inRP=0
err: [INFO] Vulkan: Creating screenshot image...
err: [INFO] Screenshot image created (960x544)
err: [SHOTSTAT] frame=1 max=0 mean=0.00 file=p5d_frame_first.bmp     <- 全黑
err: [INFO] Screenshot saved: p5d_frame_first.bmp (960x544)
```
2) 根因：游戏把画面渲染到**离屏 RT**（`DisplayQueueAddEntry` 的 color surface `+0` = data VA `8CF00000`/`8D300000`），
而 M940 的 `end_frame()` 只是把**空的 swapchain 图像**提交并 present → 黑屏。
3) 正确显示路径（与旧 host `eboot_probe.cpp` 一致）：
```cpp
p5d::vulkan::end_scene_pass();                                   // 结束 RP，cmd 保持打开
if (first) p5d::vulkan::save_rt_screenshot(data, "p5d_rt_first.bmp");  // 回读游戏真实 RT
p5d::vulkan::present_frame(data);                                // 后端: vkCmdCopyImage(RT→swapchain)+submit+present
```
4) 实现（18.4486，`recomp_harness.cpp` GXMABI 分发块）：
```cpp
namespace p5d { namespace vulkan { void end_scene_pass(); int save_rt_screenshot(unsigned int cd, const char* name); } }
if (strncmp(name,"sceGxmEndScene",14)==0 || strncmp(name,"sceGxmDisplayQueueAddEntry",26)==0) {
    const bool _dq = strncmp(name,"sceGxmDisplayQueueAddEntry",26)==0;
    uint32_t _data = 0; if (_dq) { uint8_t* sp = GP(s->r[2]); if (sp) std::memcpy(&_data, sp, 4); }
    p5d::vulkan::end_scene_pass();
    if (_dq && _data) {
        static int _cap_done = 0;
        if (!_cap_done) { _cap_done = 1; int _rr = p5d::vulkan::save_rt_screenshot(_data, "p5d_rt_first.bmp");
                          printf("[ABIRT] save_rt_screenshot(%08X) rc=%d\n", _data, _rr); }
        p5d::vulkan::present_frame(_data);
    }
    printf("[ABIDISP] %s data=%08X n=%u\n", name, _data, g_main_n);
    s->r[0] = 0; return s->r[14];
}
```

### 18.4489 PORT M944: 窗口"未响应"修复 —— Win32 消息泵

1) 现象：游戏窗口标题栏显示"未响应"（Not Responding）。
2) 原因：`recomp_harness.cpp` 从不处理 Win32 消息（`windows.h` / `PeekMessage` 计数均为 0）；
   Vulkan 窗口由后端在 guest 主线程创建，之后主线程一直执行 AOT 块/嵌套渲染循环，
   消息队列积压 → Windows 判定窗口挂起（表现为白色无响应窗口）。
3) 修复（18.4489）：
```cpp
#ifdef _WIN32
#include <windows.h>
static void hle_pump_win_messages(void) {
    MSG m; int _k = 0;
    while (PeekMessageA(&m, nullptr, 0, 0, PM_REMOVE) && _k++ < 128) { TranslateMessage(&m); DispatchMessageA(&m); }
}
#else
static void hle_pump_win_messages(void) {}
#endif

// job_probes（每个执行块）：嵌套执行/渲染帧循环也会处理消息
{ static uint32_t _pmc = 0; if (((++_pmc) & 0x3FFFu) == 0u) hle_pump_win_messages(); }

// 外层主循环
while (n < maxb) {
    if ((n & 0xFF) == 0) hle_pump_win_messages();
    ...
}
```
4) 验证：2.5M 冒烟（`out2m_m1026pump.txt`）：
```
[CRIFSHLE] criFs_Initialize -> 0 n=5000 binit_after=816A0BA0
[THREXIT] 0   [PREEMPT] 10
done: blocks=2500000 ... exit=0；BADMEM 0
```
5) 编译链接成功；已启动 62M 长跑：`out62m_m1027pump.txt`（消息泵 + RT 截图）。
NEXT：确认窗口不再"未响应"、`p5d_rt_first.bmp` 产出并查看真实画面。

FIX 18.4489: add #ifdef _WIN32 #include <windows.h> and static void hle_pump_win_messages(void) { MSG m; int _k=0; while (PeekMessageA(&m,nullptr,0,0,PM_REMOVE) && _k++<128) { TranslateMessage(&m); DispatchMessageA(&m); } } (#else empty); call from job_probes every 16384 executed blocks ({ static uint32_t _pmc=0; if (((++_pmc) & 0x3FFFu)==0u) hle_pump_win_messages(); }) and from the main loop every 256 iterations (while (n<maxb) { if ((n&0xFF)==0) hle_pump_win_messages(); ... }). 1) 用户反馈：窗口显示纯白、没有真实画面。实测确认：
```
p5d_rt_first.bmp (960x544) -> PIL 统计: mean=0.00  max=0  top color (0,0,0) 100%
```
=> **RT 内容完全为黑**。M940–M942 的 "present 成功" 只代表 `vkQueuePresentKHR result=0`（提交流程成功），
不代表画面内容正确；**之前 README/里程碑中"首帧已上屏/有真实画面"的表述不准确，已更正**。
2) 渲染数据通路缺口（证据）：
```
err: [TEXBIND] #0 real=0 alias=0 dummy=16        ← 16 个纹理全部 dummy
err: [FUBOHOST] #1 ... UBO float: 0.00000 ...    ← 片元 UBO 全 0
RINIT 把 DAT_816CBE2C 覆盖成零表（避免 BADMEM）→ uniform 必然为 0
[REAL-PIPE] #1 OK 只说明管线/模块创建成功
```
3) 结论：端到端**结构链**已通（BeginScene→真实 SPIR-V 管线→Draw→RT→RT→swapchain copy→present result=0），
但**渲染数据通路未通**：纹理全 dummy、uniform 全零、顶点数据未校验 → 输出黑屏。
4) 决定性实验（18.4490）：`P5D_REALFS=red`（后端内置常量红色片元着色器，不依赖纹理/uniform）：
- RT 截图变红 ⇒ 顶点/光栅化/管线/呈现正确，问题在纹理+uniform 数据；
- 仍黑 ⇒ 问题在 draw 之前的几何/管线绑定。

```
   → 后端 upload_texture_to_unit / RT alias 真实上传；
b) uniform 通路：sceGxmSetUniformDataF、SetDefaultUniformBuffer、Precomputed* 版本
   → 把 guest 数据写入真实 UBO（去掉 RINIT 零表 hack 或仅兜底）；
c) 顶点流：upload_vertex_stream / PrecomputedDrawSetVertexStream 的 guest VA→host 解包校验。
```

```c
        ...
    }
    return 0;
}
```
`begin_frame()` → `cmd_begin_render_pass` 面向 **swapchain image**（`[FRAMEBEGIN] frame=1 img=0`）：
**所有 draw 画在 swapchain 上，app 的 RT（`8D300000`）从未被写入**。

1) M946 实验（`out62m_m1029swappresent.txt`，红 FS + 直接 present swapchain）：

=> 不是显示源问题，而是 **draw 被丢弃**：管线创建时 `_rp` 回退到 `g_rp_clear`（离屏 RP），

2) 旧 host 成熟实现（`p5dsrc/src/loader/eboot_probe.cpp`）：

```cpp
g_cur_color_ch      = gxp_rd(_csurf+8);
g_cur_color_stride  = gxp_rd(_csurf+0xC);
g_cur_color_data    = gxp_rd(_csurf+0x10);
...
```

```cpp
    if (_q) std::memcpy(&_csurf, _q, 4);

    else p5d::vulkan::begin_frame();
    s->r[0] = 0; return s->r[14];
}
if (strncmp(_ge->name, "sceGxmEndScene", 14) == 0) { p5d::vulkan::end_scene_pass(); s->r[0]=0; return s->r[14]; }
if (strncmp(_ge->name, "sceGxmDisplayQueueAddEntry", 26) == 0) {
    uint32_t _data = 0; { uint8_t* _sp = GP(s->r[2]); if (_sp) std::memcpy(&_data, _sp, 4); }
    p5d::vulkan::end_scene_pass();
    if (_data) { p5d::vulkan::present_frame(_data);
        static int _cap=0; if(!_cap){ int _rr = p5d::vulkan::save_rt_screenshot(_data,"p5d_rt_first.bmp");
            printf("[ABIRT] cd=%08X rc=%d\n", _data, _rr); if(_rr==0) _cap=1; } }
    s->r[0] = 0; return s->r[14];
}
```

2) 分析：

3) 修复（18.4493）：BeginScene 拦截 = **候选探测 + 自动判别**：
```cpp
uint32_t _cand[6] = { s->r[3], 0,0,0,0,0 };
for (int _i = 0; _i < 4; ++_i) { uint8_t* _qs = GP(_sp + _i*4u); if (_qs) std::memcpy(&_cand[1+_i], _qs, 4); }
for (int _i = 0; _i < 6; ++_i) {
  uint32_t _c = _cand[_i]; uint8_t* _q = GP(_c); if (!_q) continue;
  uint32_t w0,w4,w8,wC,w10; memcpy 5 words;
  // 布局 A: +0 flags, +4 w, +8 h, +0xC stride, +0x10 data
  // 布局 B: +0 w, +4 h, +8 data
  if (!_csurf) {
    if (w4∈[64,2048] && w8∈[64,2048] && w10∈[0x80000000,0xC0000000)) { _csurf=_c; _cd=w10; _cw=w4; _ch=w8; }
    else if (w0∈[64,2048] && w4∈[64,2048] && w8 data-like) { _csurf=_c; _cw=w0; _ch=w4; _cd=w8; }
  }
  printf("[ABICAND] #%d ptr=%08X w0=%08X w4=%08X w8=%08X wC=%08X w10=%08X\n", ...);
}
if (_cd && _cw && _ch) begin_scene_pass(_cd,_cw,_ch); else begin_frame();
```

### 18.4500 PORT M955: 真实 GXM 顶点流通路（第一版：捕获 + 128B 解包 + 上传）

1) Vita SDK 签名（`gxm_abi.cpp` guest ABI 注释）：
```c
int sceGxmShaderPatcherCreateVertexProgram(SceGxmShaderPatcher *shaderPatcher, SceGxmShaderPatcherId programId,
    const SceGxmVertexAttribute *attributes, unsigned int attributeCount,
    const SceGxmVertexStream *streams, unsigned int streamCount, SceGxmVertexProgram **vertexProgram);
int sceGxmSetVertexStream(SceGxmContext *context, unsigned int streamIndex, const void *streamData);
int sceGxmPrecomputedDrawSetVertexStream(SceGxmPrecomputedDraw *precomputedDraw, unsigned int streamIndex, const void *streamData);
```
2) 结构布局：
```
SceGxmVertexAttribute (8B): +0 u16 streamIndex, +2 u16 offset, +4 u8 format, +5 u8 componentCount, +6 u8 regSet
SceGxmVertexStream    (4B): +0 u16 stride, +2 u16 streamIndex
```
3) 实现（`recomp_harness.cpp`）：
```cpp
// (a) 解码器
static void abi_decode_attr(const unsigned char* p, unsigned int fmt, unsigned int comps, float* out);
// fmt: 0=UBYTE/255, 1=BYTE/127, 2=USHORT/65535, 3=SHORT/32767, 4=FLOAT, 5=HALF, 6=FIXED/65536

// (b) CreateVertexProgram 捕获属性表/流表
_vobj2attrs[_nextobj] = _av;  _vobj2strms[_nextobj] = _sv;
printf("[ABIVFMT] obj=%08X attrN=%u streamN=%u\n", ...);
for attr: printf("[ABIVFMT]  attr%zu stream=%u off=%u fmt=%u comps=%u\n", ...);
for strm: printf("[ABIVFMT]  strm%zu stride=%u idx=%u\n", ...);

// (c) 当前顶点程序对象
if (!_frag) _cur_vobj = s->r[1];     // PrecomputedVertexStateInit / PrecomputedDrawInit

// (d) 捕获 SetVertexStream（两个 API 同形）
if (strstr(_ge->name, "SetVertexStream")) { _stm2va[s->r[1]] = s->r[2]; printf("[ABIVS] ..."); }

// (e) draw 时解包 + 上传
if (strncmp(_ge->name,"sceGxmDraw",10)==0) {
    uint32_t _vc = _stk[0];
    auto _at = _vobj2attrs.find(_cur_vobj);
    if (_at != _vobj2attrs.end() && !_at->second.empty() && _vc>0 && _vc<=65536) {
        static std::vector<float> _vtx; _vtx.assign(_vc*32, 0.0f);
        for each attr i: find stride for attr.stream; find streamVA; for each vertex v:
            uint8_t* _src = GP(streamVA + v*stride + attr.offset);
            float _f[4]; abi_decode_attr(_src, attr.fmt, attr.comps, _f);
            memcpy(&_vtx[v*32 + i*4], _f, 16);
        upload_vertex_stream(_vtx.data(), _vc*128u, _vc);
        printf("[ABIVTX] vc=%u attrs=%u rc=%d v0=(...) v1=(...)\n", ...);
    }
}
```


2) GXP 参数表结构（来自 `tools/gxp_containers.py` 已验证代码）：
```
SceGxmProgram: +0x24 u32 parameter_count, +0x28 u32 parameter_table_offset
参数项 (16B): +0 int name_offset; +4 u16 flags(cat=w0&0xF, type=(w0>>4)&0xF, comp=(w0>>8)&0xF);
             +8 u32 array_size; +0xC u32 resource_index
参数类别: 0=ATTRIBUTE；类型: 0=FLOAT(4B),1=HALF(2B),2=FIXED(4B),3=PACKED_HALF(2B),4=U8,5=S8,6=U16,7=S16
```

3) 实现（18.4502，`recomp_harness.cpp`）：
```cpp
// (a) RegisterProgram: _pid2gxp[_nextid] = GXP VA
// (b) CreateVertexProgram 且 _av.empty(): 解析 GXP 参数表 → 隐式属性
uint32_t _pc=0,_po=0; memcpy(&_pc,_g+0x24,4); memcpy(&_po,_g+0x28,4);
uint32_t _pbase=0x28+_po; uint32_t _off=0;
for (_i=0.._pc) {
    uint8_t* _p = GP(_pbase + _i*16);
    int32_t _no = rd32(_p); uint16_t _w0 = rd16(_p+4);
    uint32_t _cat=_w0&0xF, _typ=(_w0>>4)&0xF, _cmp=(_w0>>8)&0xF;
    if (_cat==0 && _cmp>=1 && _cmp<=4) { attr{stream=0, offset=_off, fmt=map(_typ), comps=_cmp}; _off += _cmp*typeSize(_typ); }
}
// (c) SetVertexProgram -> _cur_vobj
// (d) 索引绘制：_vc = max(index)+1（读 index buffer，u16/u32）
// (e) 解包 + upload_vertex_stream(_vc*128, _vc)
```

1) `out62m_m1040gxpp.txt`：
```

[ABIVARG]  stk0words: 0000000C 00000000 00000045 00000002
```
2) 根因：`_pbase = 0x28 + parameter_table_offset` 是 **GXP 文件内偏移**；
   代码却写 `GP(_pbase + _i*16u)` → 把偏移当 **guest VA** → 翻译失败返回 null → `break`。
3) 修复（18.4504）：
```cpp
uint32_t _pc=0,_po=0; std::memcpy(&_pc,_g+0x24,4); std::memcpy(&_po,_g+0x28,4);
uint32_t _gsz=0;      std::memcpy(&_gsz,_g+8,4);
uint32_t _pbase = 0x28u + _po;              // FILE OFFSET inside the GXP (NOT a guest VA)
for (uint32_t _i = 0; _i < _pc && _i < 64u; ++_i) {
    if (_pbase + _i*16u + 16u > _gsz) break;
    uint8_t* _p = _g + _pbase + _i*16u;
    int32_t _no = 0; std::memcpy(&_no, _p, 4);
    uint16_t _w0 = 0; std::memcpy(&_w0, _p + 4, 2);
    uint32_t _cat=_w0&0xF, _typ=(_w0>>4)&0xF, _cmp=(_w0>>8)&0xF;
    const char* _nm = "?";
    if (_no >= 0 && _pbase + _i*16u + (uint32_t)_no < _gsz) _nm = (const char*)(_g + _pbase + _i*16u + _no);
    ...
}
```

2) 关联调用链：
```
sceGxmShaderPatcherCreateVertexProgram(...)
```

3) 引擎内部流程（AOT 反推 `0x811EF610`/`blk_811EFADA`/`blk_811EFAF6`）：
- 属性数组在栈 `sp+0x3C`、count 在 `sp+0x10`；streams 数组在 `sp+0x18`、`[sp+4]=streamCount`、`[sp+8]=out`；
- 引擎先通过 **GetProgramFromId + FindParameterByName** 从 GXP 取参数（name/res/type），
  自己填 `SceGxmVertexAttribute[]`，再调用 CreateVertexProgram。
4) **实现（18.4505）**：
```cpp
// (a) GetProgramFromId -> GXP VA
if (strncmp(name,"sceGxmShaderPatcherGetProgramFromId",35)==0) { s->r[0]=_pid2gxp[s->r[0]]; return s->r[14]; }
// (b) GXP 参数项查找（返回 guest VA = gxp + 0x28 + po + i*16）
auto _gxp_find_by_name = [](uint32_t gxpVA, const char* name)->uint32_t {
  uint8_t* g=GP(gxpVA); if(!g||!name) return 0;
  uint32_t pc,po,gsz; memcpy(&pc,g+0x24,4); memcpy(&po,g+0x28,4); memcpy(&gsz,g+8,4);
  uint32_t pb=0x28+po;
  for (uint32_t i=0;i<pc && i<256;++i) { if(pb+i*16+16>gsz) break;
    int32_t no=0; memcpy(&no,g+pb+i*16,4);
    if(no<0 || pb+i*16+(uint32_t)no>=gsz) continue;
    if(std::strcmp((const char*)(g+pb+i*16+no),name)==0) return gxpVA+pb+i*16; }
  return 0; };
// (c) FindParameterBySemantic：position/normal/texcoord[0/1]/color/weights/indices 名称映射
// (d) GetCategory(param) -> u16@+4 & 0xF；GetResourceIndex(param) -> u32@+0xC
```

```cpp
if (_pend_fout) { ... _cur_f_ubo=_va; printf("[ABIUBO] frag ubo=%08X\n", _va); _pend_fout=0; }
// draw 时：
if (_cur_v_ubo) { uint8_t* _src=GP(_cur_v_ubo); if(_src) p5d::vulkan::update_uniform_buffer_raw(_src, 0x1000u); }
if (_cur_f_ubo) { uint8_t* _src=GP(_cur_f_ubo); if(_src) p5d::vulkan::update_fragment_uniform_buffer_raw(_src, 0x1000u); }
```

3) SceGxmTexture 16B 控制块编码（Vita3K 位域；旧 host `tex_init` 公式）：
```cpp
unsigned tp = (typeMask >> 29) & 7;
w0 = (fmt & 0x80000000u) | (((mip-1u) & 0xFu) << 17);
w1 = (fmt & 0x1F000000u) | (typeMask & 0xE0000000u);
if (tp == 1u || tp == 2u) w1 |= (lh & 0xFu) | ((lw & 0xFu) << 12);   // swizzled: log2
else                      w1 |= ((h-1u) & 0xFFFu) | (((w-1u) & 0xFFFu) << 12);
w2 = data & 0xFFFFFFFCu;
w3 = ((fmt >> 12) & 0x7u) << 28;
// typeMask: linear=0x60000000, tiled=0x80000000, swizzled=0x20000000, strided=0xC0000000, cube=0x40000000
```

```cpp
static uint32_t g_movie_va = 0;  static FILE* g_movie_fp = nullptr;
```
